en.s: On 7 November 921, the Treaty of Bonn, the text of which calls itself a "pact of friendship" (amicitia), was signed between Charles III of France and Henry I of Germany in a minimalist ceremony aboard a ship in the middle of the Rhine not far from Bonn. The use of the river, which was the border between their two kingdoms, as a neutral territory had extensive Carolingian precedents and was also used in classical antiquity and in contemporary Anglo-Saxon England.

zh.s: 921年11月7日，法国的查理三世与德国的亨利一世在一艘位于莱茵河中央、距波恩不远的船上举行简朴仪式，签署了《波恩条约》。条约文本称其为“友好协定”（amicitia）。这条作为两国边界的河流被用作中立地点，此举在加洛林王朝时期已有许多先例，古典时代和当时的盎格鲁-撒克逊英格兰也曾采用类似做法。

en.s: The Battle of Demetritzes in 1185 was fought between the Byzantine army and the Normans of the Kingdom of Sicily, who had recently sacked and captured the Byzantine Empire's second city, Thessalonica. It was a decisive Byzantine victory, which led to the immediate re-occupation of Thessalonica and ended the Norman threat to the Empire.

zh.s: 1185年的德米特里泽战役发生在拜占庭军队与西西里王国的诺曼军队之间；诺曼人此前洗劫并占领了拜占庭帝国第二大城市塞萨洛尼基。拜占庭取得决定性胜利，随即收复塞萨洛尼基，也终结了诺曼人对拜占庭帝国的威胁。战斗于1185年11月7日打响。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: Battle of Tốt Động – Chúc Động
en.s: The Battle of Tốt Động – Chúc Động or the Battle of Tụy Động (Chinese: 崒洞祝洞之戰) in 1426 was the decisive battle in the 14-year Lam Sơn uprising which established Vietnam's independence from Ming China in 1428. The battle took place on November 7, 1426 in the Red River Delta between Tốt Động and Chúc Động, two villages of Chương Mỹ District, near Hanoi.

zh.s: 左屯—祝洞之战，又称崒洞之战，发生于1426年，是蓝山起义期间的决定性战役。蓝山起义持续14年，最终使越南于1428年摆脱明朝统治、恢复独立。战役于1426年11月7日在红河三角洲举行，地点位于河内附近彰美县的左屯村和祝洞村之间。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.t: Elizabeth Stuart is crowned Queen of Bohemia
en.s: Elizabeth Stuart (19 August 1596 – 13 February 1662) was Electress of the Palatinate and briefly Queen of Bohemia as the wife of Frederick V of the Palatinate. The couple's selection for the crown by the nobles of Bohemia was part of the political and religious turmoil that set off the Thirty Years' War.

zh.t: 伊丽莎白·斯图亚特加冕为波希米亚王后
zh.s: 伊丽莎白·斯图亚特（1596年8月19日—1662年2月13日）是普法尔茨选帝侯夫人，并因嫁给普法尔茨的腓特烈五世而短暂成为波希米亚王后。波希米亚贵族推举这对夫妇登上王位，发生在引发三十年战争的政治与宗教动荡期间。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The Cádiz expedition of 1625 was a naval expedition against Spain by English and Dutch forces. The plan was put forward because after the Dissolution of the Parliament of 1625, George Villiers, 1st Duke of Buckingham, Lord High Admiral, wanted to undertake an expedition that would match the exploits of the raiders of the Elizabethan era and in doing so, would return respect to the country and its people after the political stress of the preceding years.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1625年加的斯远征是英国和荷兰军队针对西班牙的一次海上远征。1625年议会解散后，海军大臣白金汉公爵乔治·维利尔斯提出这项计划，希望远征能够比肩伊丽莎白时代袭击者的战绩，并在此前的政治压力之后重振国家及其人民的声望。
zh.n: 此条目记录源信息框所列事件的结束日期。

en.s: The Treaty of the Pyrenees was signed on 7 November 1659 and ended the Franco–Spanish War that had begun in 1635. Negotiations were conducted and the treaty was signed on Pheasant Island, situated in the middle of the Bidasoa River on the border between the two countries, which has remained a French-Spanish condominium ever since.

zh.s: 1659年11月7日，《比利牛斯条约》签署，结束了始于1635年的法西战争。谈判和签约地点均为野鸡岛。该岛位于两国边界的比达索阿河中央，此后一直由法国和西班牙共同管辖。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: The London Gazette, the oldest surviving journal, is first published
en.s: The London Gazette, known generally as The Gazette, is one of the official journals of record or government gazettes of the Government of the United Kingdom, and the most important among such official journals in the United Kingdom, in which certain statutory notices are required to be published.

zh.t: 《伦敦公报》创刊，成为现存最古老的官方公报
zh.s: 《伦敦公报》通常简称《公报》，是英国政府的官方记录刊物之一，也是其中最重要的一份。某些法定通知必须在英国的这类官方刊物上刊登。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The Battle of Varja took place on November 7, 1700 close to at the villages of Varja and Aa, in the Swedish Empire during the Estonian campaign of the first year in the Great Northern War. A Swedish force consisting of 800 men under the command of generals Georg Reinhold Patkul and Hans Henrik von Tiesenhausen were sent out from Rakvere to secure the road at which the main army under Charles XII of Sweden were going in order to relief the city of Narva which had been besieged by the Russians for a while.

zh.s: 瓦尔亚战役发生于1700年11月7日，地点在瑞典帝国境内瓦尔亚和阿阿村附近，是大北方战争第一年爱沙尼亚战事的一部分。瑞典军队派出800人，由将军格奥尔格·赖因霍尔德·帕特库尔和汉斯·亨里克·冯·蒂森豪森率领，从拉克韦雷出发，为瑞典国王卡尔十二世的主力军开路。主力军正前往解救被俄军围困多时的纳尔瓦。

en.t: O Ewigkeit, du Donnerwort, BWV 60, a dialogue cantata by Johann Sebastian Bach for Leipzig, was first performed
en.s: O Ewigkeit, du Donnerwort (O eternity, you word of thunder), BWV 60, is a church cantata for the 24th Sunday after Trinity composed by Johann Sebastian Bach. It was first performed in Leipzig on 7 November 1723, and is part of Bach's first cantata cycle. It is one of Bach's dialogue cantatas: its topic, fear of death and hope of salvation, plays out mainly through a conversation between two allegorical figures, Fear (sung by an alto voice) and Hope (sung by a tenor).

zh.t: 巴赫《永恒啊，你雷鸣般的话语》BWV 60首次演出
zh.s: 《永恒啊，你雷鸣般的话语》（BWV 60）是约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫创作的教会清唱剧，用于三一主日后第24个星期日。1723年11月7日，该曲在莱比锡首次演出，属于巴赫第一套清唱剧作品。它是巴赫的对话体清唱剧之一，主题是对死亡的恐惧与对救赎的希望，主要通过两个寓言人物“恐惧”和“希望”之间的对话展开，前者由女低音演唱，后者由男高音演唱。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Virginia on November 7, 1786. The attorney general of Virginia Edmund Randolph defeated the member of the Virginia House of Delegates from Prince George County Theodorick Bland and the U.S. congressional delegate from Virginia Richard Henry Lee. The incumbent governor of Virginia Patrick Henry declined to seek re-election.

zh.s: 1786年11月7日，弗吉尼亚州举行州长选举。该州检察长埃德蒙·伦道夫击败了来自乔治王子县的弗吉尼亚州众议院议员西奥多里克·布兰德，以及弗吉尼亚州国会代表理查德·亨利·李。现任州长帕特里克·亨利决定不竞选连任。

en.s: The Battle of Calliano on 6 and 7 November 1796 saw an Austrian corps commanded by Paul Davidovich rout a French division directed by Claude Belgrand de Vaubois. The engagement was part of the third Austrian attempt to relieve the French siege of Mantua during the French Revolutionary Wars. The battle was preceded by a clash at Cembra on 2 November and followed by actions at Rivoli Veronese on 17 and 21 November.

zh.s: 1796年11月6日至7日，保罗·达维多维奇指挥的奥地利军团击溃了克洛德·贝尔格朗·德·沃布瓦率领的法国师，这场交战称为卡利亚诺战役。它是法国大革命战争期间奥军第三次试图解救被法军围困的曼图亚。此前，双方于11月2日在琴布拉交战；此后又于11月17日和21日在里沃利韦罗内塞交战。

en.s: The Battle of Niakhura, also known as the Battle of Iori River and Battle of Kakabeti, took place on 7 November 1800. During this battle, the invading army of Umma Khan V, which had entered the territory of the Kingdom of Kartli-Kakheti (Georgia) in alliance with the Georgian prince Alexander, suffered a crushing defeat.The victorious forces consisted of two Russian battalions under Major Generals Ivan Lazarev and Vasily Gulyakov, supported by the Georgian militia commanded by princes Ioane and Bagrat.

zh.s: 尼亚胡拉战役又称伊奥里河战役、卡卡贝蒂战役，发生于1800年11月7日。乌玛汗五世的入侵军队与格鲁吉亚王子亚历山大结盟，进入卡尔特利—卡赫季王国领土后，在这场战役中遭到惨败。获胜一方由俄军两个营组成，指挥官是伊万·拉扎列夫和瓦西里·古利亚科夫少将；格鲁吉亚民兵由王子约阿内和巴格拉特指挥，并提供支援。

loc: 多米尼加共和国埃尔塞伊博省

en.s: The Battle of Palo Hincado was the first major battle of the Spanish reconquest of Santo Domingo of the Spanish colonial Captaincy General of Santo Domingo, that was occupied by the French in the Spanish West Indies. The site is in the present day Dominican Republic, on the island of Hispaniola in the Caribbean. The battle was fought on November 7, 1808, at Palo Hincado savanna, near El Seibo in the colony of Santo Domingo. A force of 2,000 Spanish Dominican and Puerto Rican troops, led by General Juan Sánchez Ramírez, defeated a force of 600 troops of French Army of Napoleon, led by Governor General Marie-Louis Ferrand.

zh.s: 帕洛因卡多战役是西班牙收复圣多明各行动中的首场主要战役。当时，圣多明各是西班牙在西印度群岛的殖民地总督区，已被法国占领。战场位于今天的多米尼加共和国，处于加勒比海伊斯帕尼奥拉岛上。1808年11月7日，战斗在埃尔塞伊博附近的帕洛因卡多草原打响。胡安·桑切斯·拉米雷斯将军率领2000名西班牙、多米尼加和波多黎各士兵，击败了由总督玛丽-路易·费朗率领的600名拿破仑法军。

en.s: The siege of Santo Domingo (1808) (Spanish: Sitio de Santo Domingo de 1808) was the second and final major battle of the Spanish reconquest of Santo Domingo and was fought between November 7, 1808 and July 11, 1809 at Santo Domingo, Captaincy General of Santo Domingo. A force of Dominican and Puerto Rican of 1,850 troops led by Gen.

zh.s: 1808年的圣多明各围城战是西班牙收复圣多明各行动中的第二场、也是最后一场主要战役，交战双方于1808年11月7日至1809年7月11日在圣多明各交战。胡安·桑切斯·拉米雷斯将军率领1,850名多米尼加和波多黎各士兵，并得到英国海军封锁支援，围攻由约瑟夫-大卫·德·巴尔基耶将军率领、驻守城内的2,000名法军，最终攻占该城。

en.s: The Spanish reconquest of Santo Domingo (Spanish: Reconquista Española de Santo Domingo) was a successful revolt against French rule in the Captaincy General of Santo Domingo which lasted from November 7, 1808, to July 9, 1809. In 1808, following Napoleon's invasion of Spain, the criollos of Santo Domingo revolted against the French, which caught the attention of British forces engaged in the Caribbean campaign of 1803–1810.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1808年11月7日至1809年7月9日，圣多明各都督府发生反抗法国统治的起义，最终成功收复该地。1808年拿破仑入侵西班牙后，圣多明各的克里奥尔人起义反抗法国人，引起了正在加勒比地区开展1803至1810年战役的英军关注。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Raid on Kamennobrodskoye or Kamennobrodskoye massacre was a surprise attack carried out by Kabardian and other Circassian mountaineer forces against the Russian settlement of Kamennobrodskoye on November 7, (according to some sources, November 2) 1809 in Russo-Circassian War.

zh.t: 卡缅诺布罗德斯科耶突袭
zh.s: 1809年11月7日，卡巴尔达人和其他切尔克斯山地部族武装突袭俄国定居点卡缅诺布罗德斯科耶。这次行动也称卡缅诺布罗德斯科耶屠杀。部分资料将日期记为11月2日。事件发生于俄切战争期间。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Suipacha was fought on 7 November 1810 in Bolivia during the Bolivian War of Independence between the Spanish colonial army and the Republican forces sent by the Primera Junta from Buenos Aires. At the time Bolivia was known as Upper Peru (Alto Perú). It was the first decisive defeat of the Royalists by Republican forces. The battle took place 25 km (16 mi) southeast of Tupiza, near the small town of Suipacha, on the margin of the Suipacha river in the Sud Chichas province (Potosí Department. in today Bolivia).

zh.s: 苏伊帕查战役于1810年11月7日在玻利维亚爆发，是玻利维亚独立战争的一部分，交战双方为西班牙殖民军和布宜诺斯艾利斯五月革命政府派出的共和军。当时玻利维亚称为上秘鲁。这是保王军首次遭到共和军决定性击败。战场位于图皮萨东南25公里（16英里）处，靠近苏伊帕查小镇，位于南奇查斯省、波托西省境内的苏伊帕查河畔。

美国印第安纳州蒂珀卡努县

en.s: The Battle of Tippecanoe (/ˌtɪpikəˈnuː/ TIP-ee-kə-NOO) was fought on November 7, 1811, near present-day Lafayette, Indiana between American forces led by Governor William Henry Harrison of the Indiana Territory and Native American warriors associated with the Shawnee leader Tecumseh. Tecumseh and his brother Tenskwatawa (commonly known as "The Prophet") were leaders of a confederacy of Native Americans from various tribes that opposed US expansion into Native territory. As tensions and violence increased, Governor Harrison marched with an army of about 1,000 men to disperse the confederacy's headquarters at Prophetstown, near the confluence of the Tippecanoe and Wabash Rivers.

zh.s: 蒂珀卡努战役于1811年11月7日在印第安纳州拉斐特附近打响。交战双方是印第安纳领地州长威廉·亨利·哈里森率领的美军，以及与肖尼族领袖特库姆塞有关联的美洲原住民战士。特库姆塞和他的兄弟滕斯克瓦塔瓦（通常被称为“先知”）领导着一个由多个部族组成的联盟，反对美国向原住民土地扩张。随着紧张局势和暴力不断升级，哈里森率领约1000人出征，准备解散这个联盟。

en.t: 1816 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: A presidential election was held in Tennessee on November 7, 1816 as part of the 1816 United States presidential election. The Democratic-Republican ticket of the U.S. secretary of state James Monroe and the governor of New York Daniel D. Tompkins was elected unopposed. The Federalist Party failed to nominate a candidate.

zh.s: 1816年11月7日，田纳西州举行美国总统选举，作为1816年美国总统选举的一部分。美国国务卿詹姆斯·门罗与纽约州州长丹尼尔·D·汤普金斯组成的民主—共和党竞选组合没有对手，当选。联邦党未能提名候选人。

en.s: The 1823 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1823, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia. Democratic-Republican candidate and former United States Senator for Georgia George Troup narrowly defeated fellow Democratic-Republican candidate and former acting Governor Matthew Talbot in a Georgia General Assembly vote.

zh.s: 1823年11月7日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。民主共和党候选人、前佐治亚州联邦参议员乔治·特鲁普（George Troup）在州议会投票中以微弱优势击败同党候选人、前代理州长马修·塔尔博特（Matthew Talbot）。

en.t: 1836 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: A presidential election was held in Mississippi on November 7, 1836 as part of the 1836 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Mississippi voted for the Democratic candidate, Martin Van Buren, over Whig candidate Hugh Lawson White. Van Buren won Mississippi by a narrow margin of 2.56%.

zh.t: 1836年密西西比州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1836年11月7日，密西西比州举行美国总统选举，作为1836年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。密西西比州支持民主党候选人马丁·范布伦，胜过辉格党候选人休·劳森·怀特。范布伦以2.56个百分点的微弱优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1836 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: A presidential election was held in Connecticut on November 7, 1836 as part of the 1836 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Connecticut voted for the Democratic candidate, Martin Van Buren, over Whig candidate William Henry Harrison. Van Buren won Connecticut by a narrow margin of 1.3%.

zh.t: 1836年康涅狄格州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1836年11月7日，康涅狄格州举行美国总统选举，作为1836年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。康涅狄格州支持民主党候选人马丁·范布伦，胜过辉格党候选人威廉·亨利·哈里森。范布伦以1.3个百分点的微弱优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1836 United States presidential election in New Hampshire
en.s: A presidential election was held in New Hampshire on November 7, 1836 as part of the 1836 United States presidential election. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New Hampshire voted for the Democratic candidate, Martin Van Buren, over Whig candidate William Henry Harrison. Van Buren won New Hampshire by a margin of 50.02%.

zh.t: 1836年新罕布什尔州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1836年11月7日，新罕布什尔州举行美国总统选举，作为1836年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。新罕布什尔州支持民主党候选人马丁·范布伦，胜过辉格党候选人威廉·亨利·哈里森。范布伦在新罕布什尔州的得票优势为50.02个百分点。

en.t: 1836 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 7, 1836, as part of the 1836 United States presidential election. The Whig ticket of the former major general William Henry Harrison and the U.S. representative from New York's 26th congressional district Francis Granger defeated the Democratic ticket of the incumbent vice president Martin Van Buren and the U.S. representative from Kentucky's 13th congressional district Richard Mentor Johnson.

zh.t: 1836年印第安纳州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1836年11月7日，印第安纳州举行总统选举，作为1836年美国总统选举的一部分。辉格党候选人、前少将威廉·亨利·哈里森与纽约州第26国会选区联邦众议员弗朗西斯·格兰杰搭档，击败了民主党候选人、现任副总统马丁·范布伦与肯塔基州第13国会选区联邦众议员理查德·门托·约翰逊组成的竞选组合。

en.t: 1836 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: A presidential election was held in Missouri on November 7, 1836, as part of the 1836 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Missouri voted for the Democratic nominee, Martin Van Buren, over Whig nominee Hugh Lawson White. Van Buren won Missouri by a margin of 19.96%.

en.s: The Battle of Lacolle was fought on November 7, 1838 between Loyal Lower Canada volunteer forces under Major John Scriver and Patriote rebels under Colonel Ferdinand-Alphonse Oklowski. On November 6, on their way to Lacolle, the Patriote rebels had won a first skirmish, but they lost in the final confrontation the next day. The battle lasted half an hour.

zh.s: 拉科勒战役于1838年11月7日打响，交战双方是约翰·斯克里弗少校率领的下加拿大保皇派志愿军，以及费迪南-阿方斯·奥克洛夫斯基上校率领的爱国者叛军。11月6日，爱国者叛军前往拉科勒途中先赢得一场小规模交战，但第二天在最后的战斗中落败。战斗持续了半小时。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1848 was the 16th quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 7, 1848. It was won by Zachary Taylor of the Whig Party, who ran against Lewis Cass of the Democratic Party and former President Martin Van Buren of the newly-formed Free Soil Party. Incumbent President James K. Polk, having achieved all of his major objectives in one term and suffering from declining health, kept his promise not to seek re-election. The contest was the first presidential election that took place on the same day in every state, and it was the first time that Election Day was statutorily a Tuesday.

zh.s: 1848年美国总统选举于11月7日星期二举行。辉格党候选人扎卡里·泰勒击败民主党候选人刘易斯·卡斯和自由土地党候选人、前总统马丁·范布伦。当时的总统詹姆斯·波尔克兑现了不再竞选连任的承诺。这是美国首次所有州在同一天举行总统选举，也是首次依法将选举日定在星期二。

en.t: United States presidential election in Texas, 1848
en.s: The 1848 United States presidential election in Texas was held on November 7, 1848. Texas voters chose 4 electors to represent the state in the Electoral College, which chose the President and Vice President. Texas was annexed by the United States on February 19, 1846, making this the first presidential election in which the state participated. Texas overwhelmingly voted for the Democratic nominee Lewis Cass, who received 70% of the vote. Texas was, by far, Cass's strongest state, and the only state where he received over 70% of the popular vote.

He landed his men on the Missouri side and marched to Belmont.

en.s: The Battle of Clark's Mill was a battle of the American Civil War, occurring on November 7, 1862 in Douglas County, Missouri. Having received reports that Confederate troops were in the area, Capt. Hiram E. Barstow, Union commander at Clark's Mill, sent a detachment toward Gainesville and he led another southeastward. Barstow's men ran into a Confederate force, skirmished with them and drove them back. His column then fell back to Clark's Mill where he learned that another Confederate force was coming from the northeast. Unlimbering artillery to command both approach roads, Barstow was soon engaged in a five-hour fight with the enemy.

zh.s: 克拉克磨坊战役是美国内战中的一场战斗，于1862年11月7日在密苏里州道格拉斯县发生。克拉克磨坊的联邦军指挥官希拉姆·E·巴斯托上尉接到报告，称该地区出现南方邦联军队，于是派出一支分队前往盖恩斯维尔，自己率另一支部队向东南进发。巴斯托的士兵遇到南军，与之交火并将其击退。随后他的部队撤回克拉克磨坊；在那里，他得知另有一支南军正从东北方向赶来。巴斯托将火炮部署在能控制两条来路的位置，很快与敌军展开了持续五小时的战斗。

en.s: The Second Battle of Rappahannock Station took place on November 7, 1863, near the village of Rappahannock Station (now Remington, Virginia), on the Orange and Alexandria Railroad, between Confederate forces under Maj. Gen. Jubal Early and Union forces under Maj. Gen. John Sedgwick as part of the Bristoe Campaign of the American Civil War. The battle resulted in a victory for the Union.

zh.t: 拉帕汉诺克站第二次战役
zh.s: 拉帕汉诺克站第二次战役于1863年11月7日在弗吉尼亚州拉帕汉诺克站村附近（今弗吉尼亚州雷明顿）爆发，地点在奥兰治和亚历山德里亚铁路线上。南方邦联军由朱巴尔·厄利少将率领，联邦军由约翰·塞奇威克少将率领。这场战斗是美国内战布里斯托战役的一部分，最终由联邦军获胜。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1865 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 7, 1865. Republican Marcus Lawrence Ward defeated Democratic nominee Theodore Runyon with 51.07% of the vote.

zh.s: 1865年新泽西州州长选举于11月7日举行。共和党候选人马库斯·劳伦斯·沃德以51.07%的选票击败民主党候选人西奥多·伦扬。

en.s: The 1865 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 7, 1865, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee Henry C. Rogers defeated Democratic nominee John R. Jones.

zh.s: 1865年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于1865年11月7日举行，选出该州州务卿。共和党候选人亨利·C·罗杰斯击败民主党候选人约翰·R·琼斯。

en.s: The 1865 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1865. Union candidate Lucius Fairchild won the election with nearly 55% of the vote, defeating Democratic candidate Harrison Carroll Hobart. The incumbent Governor, James T. Lewis, refused nomination for re-election. The American Civil War had concluded just a few months before this election was held; both major party candidates in this election were retired brigadier generals who had served with distinction in the war.

zh.s: 1865年威斯康星州州长选举于11月7日举行。联合党候选人卢修斯·费尔柴尔德以近55%的得票率胜出，击败民主党候选人哈里森·卡罗尔·霍巴特。现任州长詹姆斯·T·刘易斯拒绝接受连任提名。选举前几个月，美国内战刚刚结束；两大党候选人都曾是退役准将，并在战争中表现出色。

en.s: The 1865 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 7, 1865, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. National Union nominee and incumbent member of the Minnesota House of Representatives William J. Colvill defeated Democratic nominee William Lochren.

zh.t: 1865年明尼苏达州州检察长选举
zh.s: 1865年明尼苏达州州检察长选举于1865年11月7日举行。国民联盟党候选人、时任明尼苏达州众议员威廉·J·科尔维尔击败民主党候选人威廉·洛克伦。

en.s: The 1865 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1865, to elect the lieutenant governor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and former Speaker of the Minnesota House of Representatives Thomas H. Armstrong defeated Democratic nominee Charles W. Nash.

zh.s: 1865年明尼苏达州副州长选举于1865年11月7日举行。共和党候选人、前州众议院议长托马斯·H·阿姆斯特朗击败民主党候选人查尔斯·W·纳什。

en.s: The 1865 Newfoundland general election was held on November 7, 1865 to elect members of the 9th General Assembly of Newfoundland in the Newfoundland Colony. The Conservative Party led by Frederick Carter formed the government. Following the resignation of premier Hugh Hoyles, Carter took office and successfully negotiated a coalition government with several members of the Liberal Party, including leader of the opposition Ambrose Shea.

zh.s: 1865年11月7日，纽芬兰殖民地举行大选，选出第九届纽芬兰大议会成员。弗雷德里克·卡特领导的保守党组成政府。首相休·霍伊尔斯辞职后，卡特接任，并成功与自由党多名成员组成联合政府，其中包括反对党领袖安布罗斯·希伊。

en.s: The 1865 Minnesota gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1865, to elect the governor of Minnesota. Incumbent Stephen Miller did not seek a second term.

zh.s: 1865年11月7日，明尼苏达州举行州长选举。时任州长斯蒂芬·米勒没有竞选连任。

en.s: The 1865 Louisiana gubernatorial special election was held on November 7. Acting Governor James Madison Wells was elected to a full term in office over former Confederate-recognized governor Henry Watkins Allen, who was in exile in Mexico City and did not consent to his candidacy. This was the first election to take place under the Louisiana Constitution of 1864. Historian Mark W.

zh.t: 1865年路易斯安那州州长特别选举
zh.s: 1865年路易斯安那州州长特别选举于11月7日举行。代理州长詹姆斯·麦迪逊·威尔斯击败前邦联方面承认的州长亨利·沃特金斯·艾伦，正式当选完整任期；艾伦当时流亡墨西哥城，并未同意参选。这是路易斯安那州1864年宪法实施后的首次选举。历史学家马克·W·萨默斯认为，这场选举体现了温和派重建的失败，并促成联邦层面的激进重建与南方地方、州层面的分离主义抵抗之间的分裂。

en.s: The 1865 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 7. Governor John Albion Andrew did not run for a sixth term in office. Republican Alexander Bullock was elected to succeed him, defeating Democrat Darius Couch.

zh.s: 1865年11月7日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。州长约翰·阿尔比恩·安德鲁没有竞选第六个任期。共和党人亚历山大·布洛克击败民主党人达里厄斯·库奇，当选接替他。

en.s: The Battle of Noheji (野辺地戦争 Noheji sensō) was a minor battle of the Boshin War of the Meiji Restoration in Japan on November 7, 1868. It is considered a part of the larger Aizu campaign.

zh.s: 野边地战役于1868年11月7日在日本发生，是明治维新戊辰战争中的一场小规模战斗，被视为会津战役的一部分。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1871 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 7, 1871. Democrat Joel Parker defeated Republican nominee Cornelius Walsh with 51.88% of the vote.

zh.s: 1871年新泽西州州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党候选人乔尔·帕克以51.88%的选票击败共和党候选人科尼利厄斯·沃尔什。

en.s: The 1871 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 7, 1871, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Francis R. E. Cornell defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent ember of the Minnesota Senate from the 18th district John L. MacDonald and Temperance nominee Uzzel F. Sargent.

zh.t: 1871年明尼苏达州州检察长选举
zh.s: 1871年明尼苏达州州检察长选举于1871年11月7日举行。共和党候选人、现任州检察长弗朗西斯·R·E·康奈尔击败民主党候选人、时任明尼苏达州参议院第18选区议员约翰·L·麦克唐纳，以及禁酒党候选人乌泽尔·F·萨金特。

en.s: The 1871 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 7, 1871, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee Samuel P. Jennison defeated Democratic nominee Erik N. Falk and Temperance nominee Jonas Guilford.

zh.s: 1871年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于1871年11月7日举行。共和党候选人塞缪尔·P·詹尼森击败民主党候选人埃里克·N·福尔克和禁酒党候选人乔纳斯·吉尔福德。

en.s: The 1871 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1871, to elect the lieutenant governor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor William H. Yale defeated Democratic nominee David L. Buell and Temperance nominee William A. Bentley.

zh.s: 1871年明尼苏达州副州长选举于1871年11月7日举行。共和党候选人、现任副州长威廉·H·耶尔击败民主党候选人大卫·L·比尤尔和禁酒党候选人威廉·A·本特利。

en.s: The 1871 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1871. Incumbent Republican Governor William Claflin did not run for a fourth term in office. He was succeeded by Republican U.S. Representative William B. Washburn, who defeated Democrat John Quincy Adams II.

zh.s: 1871年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月7日举行。现任共和党州长威廉·克拉夫林没有竞选第四个任期。共和党联邦众议员威廉·B·沃什伯恩接任州长，他击败了民主党人约翰·昆西·亚当斯二世。

en.s: The 1871 Maryland gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1871. Incumbent Democratic Governor Oden Bowie did not seek re-election. Democratic candidate William Pinkney Whyte defeated Republican candidate Jacob Tome.

zh.s: 1871年马里兰州州长选举于11月7日举行。现任民主党州长奥登·鲍伊没有竞选连任。民主党候选人威廉·平克尼·怀特击败共和党候选人雅各布·托姆。

en.s: The 1871 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1871. Republican Cadwallader C. Washburn was elected with 53% of the vote, defeating Democratic candidate James Rood Doolittle. Incumbent Governor Lucius Fairchild did not seek re-election. Both major party candidates in this election had served as delegates to the Peace Conference of 1861 which attempted to avert the American Civil War.

zh.s: 1871年威斯康星州州长选举于11月7日举行。共和党人卡德沃拉德·C·沃什伯恩以53%的得票率当选，击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·鲁德·杜利特尔。现任州长卢修斯·费尔柴尔德没有竞选连任。两大党候选人都曾担任1861年和平会议的代表，该会议试图避免美国内战。

en.s: The 1871 Minnesota gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1871, to elect the governor of Minnesota. Incumbent Horace Austin was reelected to a second term.

zh.s: 1871年11月7日，明尼苏达州举行州长选举。时任州长霍勒斯·奥斯汀连任，开始第二个任期。

en.s: In the Chicago mayoral election of 1871, Joseph Medill defeated Charles C. P. Holden by a landslide 46-point margin. Holden was president of the Common Council, and constructed the Landmark Holden Block in 1872. The election took place on November 7, a month after Chicago suffered the calamity of the Great Chicago Fire.

zh.s: 1871年11月7日，芝加哥举行市长选举。约瑟夫·梅迪尔以46个百分点的巨大优势击败查尔斯·C·P·霍尔顿。霍尔顿当时是市议会主席，并于1872年建造了地标建筑霍尔顿街区大楼。此次选举距芝加哥大火这场灾难发生一个月。

en.s: The 1874 Newfoundland general election was held on November 7, 1874 to elect members of the 12th General Assembly of Newfoundland in the Colony of Newfoundland. The Conservative Party led by Frederick Carter formed the government. The Anti-Confederate government of Charles Fox Bennett had collapsed amidst a bribery scandal.

zh.s: 1874年11月7日，纽芬兰殖民地举行大选，选出第十二届纽芬兰大议会成员。弗雷德里克·卡特领导的保守党组成政府。查尔斯·福克斯·贝内特领导的反联邦政府因贿赂丑闻倒台。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1876
en.s: The 1876 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 7, 1876. All contemporary 38 states were part of the 1876 United States presidential election. New York voters chose 35 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New York was won by the Democratic nominees, Governor Samuel J. Tilden of New York and his running mate former Senator and Governor Thomas A. Hendricks of Indiana. Tilden and Hendricks defeated the Republican nominees, Governor Rutherford B. Hayes of Ohio and his running mate Congressman William A. Wheeler of New York.

zh.s: 1876年纽约州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。纽约州有35名选举人。民主党候选人塞缪尔·J·蒂尔登和托马斯·A·亨德里克斯击败了共和党候选人拉瑟福德·B·海斯和威廉·A·惠勒。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1876 was the 23rd quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 7, 1876. It was one of the most contentious and controversial presidential elections in American history. The results of the election remain among the most disputed ever, although there is no question that Samuel J. Tilden of New York outpolled Ohio's Rutherford B. Hayes in the popular vote. After a first count of votes, Tilden won 184 electoral votes to Hayes's 165, with 20 votes unresolved. These 20 electoral votes were in dispute in four states.

zh.s: 1876年美国总统选举于11月7日星期二举行，是美国历史上争议最激烈的总统选举之一。塞缪尔·J·蒂尔登的普选票多于拉瑟福德·B·海斯。首次计票显示，蒂尔登获得184张选举人票，海斯获得165张，另有4个州的20张选举人票结果尚未确定且存在争议。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1876 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1876 to select the governor of the state of South Carolina. The election campaign was a referendum on the Radical Republican-led state government and their Reconstruction policies. Opponents disputed the challenger Wade Hampton III's victory, gained by a margin of little more than 1100 votes statewide. But he took office in April 1877, after President Hayes withdrew federal troops as a result of a national Democratic compromise, and the incumbent Daniel Henry Chamberlain left the state.

zh.s: 1876年南卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月7日举行，成为对激进共和党州长和重建时期政策的一次公投。反对者质疑韦德·汉普顿三世获胜的结果；他在全州仅领先略多于1100票。1877年4月，海斯撤出联邦军队，这是全国民主党达成妥协的一部分。随后，时任州长丹尼尔·亨利·张伯伦离开南卡罗来纳州，汉普顿才得以就任。

en.t: United States presidential election in Texas, 1876
en.s: The 1876 United States presidential election in Texas was held on November 7, 1876. Texas voters chose 8 electors to represent the state in the Electoral College, which chose the President and Vice President. Texas overwhelmingly voted for the Democratic nominee, Governor Samuel J. Tilden of New York, who received 70% of the vote. Texas was Tilden's second-strongest state.

zh.t: 1876年得克萨斯州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1876年得克萨斯州美国总统选举于11月7日举行。得克萨斯州选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。该州以压倒性优势支持民主党候选人、纽约州州长塞缪尔·J·蒂尔登，他获得70%的选票。得克萨斯州是蒂尔登得票率第二高的州。

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1876
en.s: The 1876 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 7, 1876, as part of the 1876 United States presidential election. Voters chose 29 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania voted for the Republican nominee, Rutherford B. Hayes, over the Democratic nominee, Samuel J. Tilden. Hayes won Pennsylvania by a margin of 2.37%.

zh.t: 1876年宾夕法尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1876年宾夕法尼亚州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。宾夕法尼亚州选民选出29名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。该州支持共和党候选人拉瑟福德·B·海斯，胜过民主党候选人塞缪尔·J·蒂尔登。海斯以2.37个百分点的优势赢得宾夕法尼亚州。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Florida, 1876
en.s: Elections to the United States House of Representatives in Florida were held November 7, 1876 for the 45th Congress. These elections were held at the same time as election for Governor and the contentious 1876 Presidential election, in which Florida was one of four states whose electoral votes were in dispute.

zh.t: 1876年佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1876年佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举于11月7日举行，选出第45届国会的议员。此次选举与州长选举和争议激烈的1876年总统选举同时举行。当时佛罗里达州是总统选举人票结果存在争议的4个州之一。

en.t: United States presidential election in Wisconsin, 1876
en.s: The 1876 United States presidential election in Wisconsin was held on November 7, 1876. Wisconsin voters chose ten electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Republican Party candidate Rutherford B. Hayes won the state with 51% of the popular vote, winning Wisconsin's ten electoral votes.

zh.t: 1876年威斯康星州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1876年威斯康星州美国总统选举于11月7日举行。威斯康星州选民选出10名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人拉瑟福德·B·海斯获得51%的普选票，赢得威斯康星州和该州全部10张选举人票。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1876
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1876 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 7, 1876. Republicans gained two districts.

zh.t: 1876年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1876年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举是11月7日举行的联邦众议院大选的一部分，选出该州在联邦众议院的代表。共和党赢得了两个选区。

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1876
en.s: The 1876 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 7, 1876, as part of the 1876 United States presidential election. Voters chose eleven representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Virginia voted for the Democratic candidate, New York Governor Samuel J. Tilden over the Republican candidate, Ohio Governor Rutherford B. Hayes.

zh.t: 1876年弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1876年弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。弗吉尼亚州选民选出11名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。该州支持民主党候选人、纽约州州长塞缪尔·J·蒂尔登，胜过共和党候选人、俄亥俄州州长拉瑟福德·B·海斯。

en.s: The 1876 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 7, 1876, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent state auditor Thomas Holloday defeated Republican nominee and former lieutenant governor George Smith.

zh.s: 1876年密苏里州州审计长选举于1876年11月7日举行。民主党候选人、现任州审计长托马斯·霍洛迪击败共和党候选人、前副州长乔治·史密斯。

en.t: 1876 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1876 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 7, 1876, as part of the 1876 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nevada voted for the Republican nominee, Rutherford B. Hayes, over the Democratic nominee, Samuel J. Tilden. Hayes won the state by a margin of 5.46%.

zh.s: 1876年11月7日，内华达州举行总统选举，作为1876年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。内华达州支持共和党候选人拉瑟福德·B·海斯，胜过民主党候选人塞缪尔·J·蒂尔登。海斯以5.46个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1876 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1876 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 7, 1876, as part of the 1876 United States presidential election. en.t: 1876 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 1876 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 7, 1876, as part of the 1876 United States presidential election. Voters chose 21 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Illinois voted for the Republican nominee, Rutherford B. Hayes, over the Democratic nominee, Samuel J. Tilden. Hayes won the state by a narrow margin of 3.54%.

zh.t: 1876年伊利诺伊州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1876年11月7日，伊利诺伊州举行总统选举，作为1876年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出21名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。伊利诺伊州支持共和党候选人拉瑟福德·B·海斯，胜过民主党候选人塞缪尔·J·蒂尔登。海斯以3.54个百分点的微弱优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1876 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1876 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 7, 1876, as part of the 1876 United States presidential election. Voters chose 7 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Carolina voted for the Republican nominee, Rutherford B. Hayes, over the Democratic nominee, Samuel J. Tilden.

zh.t: 1876年南卡罗来纳州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1876年11月7日，南卡罗来纳州举行总统选举，作为1876年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。南卡罗来纳州支持共和党候选人拉瑟福德·B·海斯，胜过民主党候选人塞缪尔·J·蒂尔登。

en.t: 1876 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1876 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 7, 1876, as part of the 1876 United States presidential election. Voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Michigan was won by the Republican nominee Rutherford B. Hayes by an 8% margin, defeating Democratic candidate Samuel J. Tilden and taking the state's eleven electoral votes.

zh.s: 1876年11月7日，密歇根州举行总统选举，作为1876年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出11名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人拉瑟福德·B·海斯以8个百分点的优势赢得密歇根州，击败民主党人塞缪尔·J·蒂尔登，并拿下该州11张选举人票。

en.s: The 1876 Illinois lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1876, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Illinois. Republican nominee Andrew Shuman defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent acting lieutenant governor Archibald A. Glenn and Greenback nominee James H. Pickrell.

zh.s: 1876年伊利诺伊州副州长选举于1876年11月7日举行。共和党候选人安德鲁·舒曼击败了民主党候选人、现任代理副州长阿奇博尔德·A·格伦，以及绿背党候选人詹姆斯·H·皮克雷尔。

en.s: The 1876 Florida gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1876. Democratic nominee George F. Drew narrowly defeated Republican incumbent Marcellus L. Stearns with 50.51% of the vote. This started a 90-year streak of losses for the Republican Party in Florida, and they would not regain the governorship until 1966.

zh.s: 1876年佛罗里达州州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党候选人乔治·F·德鲁以50.51%的得票率险胜共和党现任州长马塞勒斯·L·斯特恩斯。这开启了共和党在佛罗里达州连续90年败选的纪录，该党直到1966年才重新赢得州长职位。

en.t: 1876 United States presidential election in Vermont
en.s: The 1876 United States presidential election in Vermont took place on November 7, 1876, as part of the 1876 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Vermont voted for the Republican nominee, Rutherford B. Hayes, over the Democratic nominee, Samuel J. Tilden. Hayes won Vermont by a margin of 36.92%.

zh.s: 1876年11月7日，佛蒙特州举行总统选举，作为1876年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。佛蒙特州支持共和党候选人拉瑟福德·B·海斯，胜过民主党候选人塞缪尔·J·蒂尔登。海斯以36.92个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1876 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1876 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 7, 1876, as part of the 1876 United States presidential election. Voters chose twelve representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. The Civil War would shape Kentucky politically for not merely the rest of the nineteenth century but also for the twentieth by creating entrenched divisions between secessionist, Democratic counties and Unionist, Republican ones.

zh.s: 1876年11月7日，肯塔基州举行总统选举，作为1876年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出12名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。南北战争对肯塔基州的政治影响不仅持续了19世纪余下的时间，也延续到20世纪，使支持脱离联邦的民主党县与支持联邦的共和党县之间形成长期分化。

en.t: 1876 United States presidential election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1876 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 7, 1876, as part of the 1876 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. New Jersey voted for the Democratic nominee, Samuel J. Tilden, over the Republican nominee, Rutherford B. Hayes. Tilden won the state by a narrow margin of 5.65%.

zh.s: 1876年11月7日，新泽西州举行总统选举，作为1876年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出9名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。新泽西州支持民主党候选人塞缪尔·J·蒂尔登，胜过共和党候选人拉瑟福德·B·海斯。蒂尔登以5.65个百分点的微弱优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1876 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1876, and featured Republican nominee Othman A. Abbott defeating Democratic nominee Miles Zentmeyer and Greenback Party nominee Allen Root. It was the first election held under the newly adopted Nebraska Constitution of 1875. Prior to this election, the State of Nebraska did not have an office of lieutenant governor.

zh.t: 1876年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1876年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月7日举行。共和党候选人奥斯曼·A·阿博特击败民主党候选人迈尔斯·曾特迈尔和绿背党候选人艾伦·鲁特。这是根据新通过的1875年内布拉斯加州宪法举行的首场选举。在此之前，内布拉斯加州没有副州长一职。

en.t: 1876 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1876 United States presidential election in Ohio was held on November 7, 1876, as part of the 1876 United States presidential election. State voters chose 22 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ohio was narrowly won by the Republican Party candidate and native son, Rutherford B. Hayes, with 50.21% of the popular vote. The Democratic Party candidate, Samuel J.

zh.s: 1876年俄亥俄州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出22名选举人，代表本州参加总统和副总统选举。共和党候选人、俄亥俄州本地人卢瑟福·B·海斯以微弱优势胜出，得票率为50.21%；民主党候选人塞缪尔·J·蒂尔登得票率为49.07%。

en.s: The 1876 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1876. It was the first election held under the newly adopted Nebraska Constitution of 1875. The election featured incumbent Governor Silas Garber, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee Paren England, a lawyer from Lancaster County, Nebraska, and Greenback Party nominee Jonathan F. Gardner, former independent candidate for Governor of Nebraska in 1874.

zh.s: 1876年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月7日举行。这是根据新通过的1875年内布拉斯加州宪法举行的首场选举。共和党现任州长塞拉斯·加伯击败民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州兰开斯特县的律师帕伦·英格兰，以及绿背党候选人乔纳森·F·加德纳。加德纳曾于1874年以独立候选人身份竞选内布拉斯加州州长。

en.t: 1876 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1876 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 7, 1876, as part of the 1876 United States presidential election. States voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Mississippi was won by Samuel J. Tilden, the former governor of New York (D–New York), running with Thomas A.

zh.t: 1876年密西西比州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1876年密西西比州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出8名选举人，代表本州参加总统和副总统选举。民主党候选人、纽约州前州长塞缪尔·J·蒂尔登与竞选搭档托马斯·A·亨德里克斯胜出，获得68.08%的选票。

en.t: 1876 United States presidential election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1876 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 7, 1876, as part of the 1876 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Minnesota voted for the Republican nominee, Rutherford B. Hayes, over the Democratic nominee, Samuel J. Tilden. Hayes won the state by a margin of 19.64%.

zh.t: 1876年明尼苏达州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1876年11月7日，明尼苏达州举行总统选举，作为1876年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。明尼苏达州支持共和党候选人拉瑟福德·B·海斯，胜过民主党候选人塞缪尔·J·蒂尔登。海斯以19.64个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1876 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1876 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 7, 1876, as part of the 1876 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Louisiana was one of three states (along with Florida and South Carolina) in which the vote was disputed. On election night, the Democratic nominee, Samuel J.

zh.t: 1876年路易斯安那州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1876年路易斯安那州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名选举人。路易斯安那州与佛罗里达州、南卡罗来纳州一样，选票结果存在争议。选举之夜，民主党候选人塞缪尔·J·蒂尔登领先共和党候选人卢瑟福·B·海斯6,300票；但共和党控制的计票委员会随后作废了约13,000张民主党选票和2,000张共和党选票，使海斯取得多数。两党分别派出选举人团前往华盛顿，国会成立选举委员会裁定争议，最终将这三个州的结果判给海斯。他在路易斯安那州以3.30个百分点的微弱优势获胜。

en.s: The 1876 New York state election was held on November 7, 1876, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, a judge of the New York Court of Appeals, a Canal Commissioner and an Inspector of State Prisons, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and two members of the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1876年11月7日，纽约州举行州选举，选出州长、副州长、纽约州上诉法院法官、运河委员、州监狱监察员、纽约州众议院全体议员，以及两名纽约州参议员。

en.t: 1876 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1876 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 7, 1876, as part of the wider United States presidential election. Voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the electoral college, who voted for president and vice president. Reconstruction in Georgia ended in 1871. The Tilden/Hendricks ticket carried the state by a margin of 44.06% on election day.

zh.t: 1876年美国总统选举佐治亚州投票
zh.s: 1876年11月7日，作为全美总统选举的一部分，佐治亚州举行总统选举投票。选民选出11名代表，也就是选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。佐治亚州的重建时期于1871年结束。选举日，蒂尔登和亨德里克斯组合以44.06%的差距赢得该州。

en.s: The 1876 Missouri gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1876, and resulted in a victory for the Democratic nominee, former Congressman (and 1868 gubernatorial nominee) John S. Phelps, over the Republican candidate, former Congressman Gustavus A. Finkelnburg, and Greenback nominee J. P. Alexander.

zh.s: 1876年11月7日，密苏里州举行州长选举。民主党候选人、前联邦众议员（也是1868年州长候选人）约翰·S·菲尔普斯击败共和党候选人、前联邦众议员古斯塔夫斯·A·芬克尔伯格，以及绿背党候选人J·P·亚历山大。

en.s: The 1876 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 7. Incumbent Republican governor Alexander H. Rice was re-elected to a second term in office over former Minister to the United Kingdom Charles F. Adams.

zh.s: 1876年11月7日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。共和党籍现任州长亚历山大·H·赖斯击败前英国公使查尔斯·F·亚当斯，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1876 Louisiana gubernatorial election was the third and final election to take place under the Louisiana Constitution of 1868. As a result of this election Francis T. Nicholls became Governor of Louisiana, but not before the election was contested by his opponent. The results of this election, like those of 1872, were disputed. The dispute was possibly settled by the Compromise of 1877 which allegedly gave the Governor's Mansion to Democrat Francis T.

zh.s: 1876年路易斯安那州州长选举是根据1868年路易斯安那州宪法举行的第三次、也是最后一次州长选举。选举结果使弗朗西斯·T·尼科尔斯成为州长，但选举遭到对手提出争议。与1872年一样，这次选举结果也存在争议。争议可能由1877年妥协解决；据称，该妥协把州长官邸交给民主党人弗朗西斯·T·尼科尔斯。

en.s: The last major rebellion of the indigenous Mapuches of Araucanía took place in 1881, during the last phase of the Occupation of Araucanía (1861–1883) by the Chilean state. It was planned by Mapuche chiefs in March 1881 to be launched in November the same year. Mapuche support for the uprising was not unanimous: Some Mapuche factions sided with the Chileans and others declared themselves neutral.
en.n: Mapuche uprising of 1881: Mapuche rebels destroy the Chilean settlement of Nueva Imperial after defenders fled to the hills.

zh.s: 1881年，智利国家占领阿劳卡尼亚地区的最后阶段发生了当地马普切人的最后一次大规模起义。马普切首领于1881年3月策划在当年11月发动起义。马普切人对起义的支持并不一致：一些派别支持智利人，另一些则保持中立。尽管如此，起义组织者仍成功争取到此前未曾与智利交战的马普切派别参与。多数袭击在几天内被击退，之后智利继续巩固其征服成果。
zh.n: 1881年马普切人起义：守军逃往山丘后，马普切起义者摧毁智利定居点新帝国镇。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1882
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1882 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 7, 1882. California gained two seats as a result of the 1880 Census, which were at-large districts for this election, becoming the new 3rd and 6th districts in 1884. Democrats won both at-large seats. Of California's existing districts, Democrats won both Republican-held districts.

zh.t: 1882年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1882年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举是11月7日举行的联邦众议院普选的一部分。根据1880年人口普查，加州增加了两个席位；在1884年选举中，这两个新席位改为第3和第6选区。民主党赢得了两个不分区席位，也赢下共和党原先控制的两个选区。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1882 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1882 to select the governor of the state of South Carolina. Hugh Smith Thompson was nominated by the Democrats and ran against J. Hendrix McLane, a Greenback-Labor candidate. Thompson easily won the general election and became the 81st governor of South Carolina.

zh.s: 1882年南卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月7日举行，选出该州州长。民主党提名休·史密斯·汤普森参选，他的对手是绿币—劳工党候选人J·亨德里克斯·麦克莱恩。汤普森轻松赢得大选，成为南卡罗来纳州第81任州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Pennsylvania gubernatorial election of 1882 occurred on November 7, 1882. Incumbent governor Henry M. Hoyt, a Republican, was not a candidate for re-election. Democratic candidate Robert E. Pattison defeated Republican candidate James A. Beaver to become Governor of Pennsylvania.

zh.s: 1882年宾夕法尼亚州州长选举于11月7日举行。共和党籍现任州长亨利·M·霍伊特没有寻求连任。民主党候选人罗伯特·E·帕蒂森击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·A·比弗，当选宾夕法尼亚州州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1882 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1882, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of California. Democratic nominee John Daggett defeated Republican nominee Alvah R. Conklin, Prohibition nominee William Sims and Greenback nominee William J. Sweasy.

zh.t: 1882年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1882年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于1882年11月7日举行。民主党候选人约翰·达盖特击败了共和党候选人阿尔瓦·R·康克林、禁酒党候选人威廉·西姆斯和绿背党候选人威廉·J·斯威西。

en.s: The 1882 Nevada gubernatorial election was held in the U.S. state on November 7, 1882. Lieutenant Governor Jewett W. Adams defeated Republican nominee Enoch Strother with 54.32% of the vote.

zh.s: 1882年内华达州州长选举于11月7日举行。副州长朱厄特·W·亚当斯以54.32%的得票率击败共和党候选人伊诺克·斯特罗瑟。

en.s: The 1882 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1882. Democratic nominee James Benton Grant defeated Republican nominee E. L. Campbell with 51.07% of the vote. This election marks the first time that Colorado ever supported a Democratic Party candidate for governor. Grant flipped 11 counties previously won by Pitkin, most notably Arapahoe County, home at the time to the state capital of Denver.

zh.s: 1882年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党候选人詹姆斯·本顿·格兰特以51.07%的得票率击败共和党候选人E·L·坎贝尔。这是科罗拉多州首次支持民主党州长候选人。格兰特赢下了皮特金此前获胜的11个县，其中最重要的是阿拉帕霍县，当时州首府丹佛位于该县。

en.s: The 1882 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1882, and featured Republican nominee Alfred W. Agee defeating Democratic nominee Jesse F. Warner as well as Greenback nominee D. P. Reynolds.

zh.t: 1882年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1882年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月7日举行。共和党候选人阿尔弗雷德·W·阿吉击败民主党候选人杰西·F·华纳和绿背党候选人D·P·雷诺兹。

en.s: The 1882 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1882. Incumbent Democratic Governor John W. Hall was unable to seek re-election. Former State Senator Charles C. Stockley ran as the Democratic nominee to succeed Hall and faced Republican nominee Albert Curry. The Republican Party campaigned on organizing a new constitutional convention and launched a vigorous statewide effort.

zh.s: 1882年特拉华州州长选举于11月7日举行。现任民主党州长约翰·W·霍尔不能竞选连任。前州参议员查尔斯·C·斯托克利以民主党候选人身份参选，接替霍尔，并与共和党候选人阿尔伯特·柯里竞争。共和党以组织新制宪会议为竞选纲领，在全州展开了积极的竞选活动。

en.s: The 1882 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1882. Josiah W. Begole ran on a fusion ticket, representing both the Democratic and Greenback parties. He defeated incumbent Republican David Jerome with 49.28% of the vote. Begole was the first Democrat to be elected governor of Michigan since Robert McClelland in 1852.

zh.s: 1882年密歇根州州长选举于11月7日举行。约西亚·W·贝戈尔代表民主党和绿背党组成的联合竞选阵营参选，以49.28%的得票率击败共和党现任州长戴维·杰罗姆。贝戈尔是自1852年罗伯特·麦克莱兰以来首位当选密歇根州州长的民主党人。

en.s: The 1882 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1882. Incumbent Republican governor Albinus Nance did not seek reelection. This election featured James W. Dawes, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee J. Sterling Morton and Greenback nominee Edward P. Ingersoll.

zh.s: 1882年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月7日举行。共和党现任州长阿尔比努斯·南斯没有竞选连任。共和党候选人詹姆斯·W·道斯击败了民主党候选人J·斯特林·莫顿和绿背党候选人爱德华·P·英格索尔。

en.s: The 1882 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1882. Democratic nominee Thomas M. Waller defeated Republican nominee Morgan Bulkeley with 51.04% of the vote.

zh.s: 1882年康涅狄格州州长选举于1882年11月7日举行。民主党候选人托马斯·M·沃勒以51.04%的得票率击败共和党候选人摩根·布尔克利。

en.s: The 1882 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1882. Republican nominee Samuel W. Hale defeated Democratic nominee Martin V. B. Edgerly with 50.36% of the vote.

zh.s: 1882年新罕布什尔州州长选举于1882年11月7日举行。共和党候选人塞缪尔·W·黑尔以50.36%的得票率击败民主党候选人马丁·V·B·埃杰利。

en.t: 1882 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1882 United States House of Representatives elections were held for the most part on November 7, 1882, with five states holding theirs early between June and October. They occurred during President Chester A. Arthur's term. Elections were held for 325 seats of the United States House of Representatives, representing 38 states, to serve in the 48th United States Congress.

zh.s: 1882年美国联邦众议院选举大多于11月7日举行，另有5个州在6月至10月间提前投票。选举在切斯特·A·阿瑟总统任内举行，改选来自38个州的325个联邦众议院席位，胜选者进入第48届国会。

en.s: The 1882 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1882. Democratic nominee George Washington Glick defeated incumbent Republican John St. John with 46.40% of the vote.

zh.s: 1882年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党候选人乔治·华盛顿·格利克以46.40%的得票率击败共和党现任州长约翰·圣约翰。

en.s: The 1882 California gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1882, to elect the governor of California. This was the first election held under California's 1879 constitution which moved the election date for state officers to coincide with federal elections in non-presidential even-numbered years. The Democratic Party's nominee, George Stoneman won a decisive victory over the Republican Morris M. Estee.

zh.s: 1882年11月7日，加利福尼亚州举行州长选举。这是该州1879年宪法通过后的首次选举。新宪法将州官员选举日期改为非总统选举年份的偶数年，与联邦选举同期举行。民主党候选人乔治·斯通曼大胜共和党候选人莫里斯·M·埃斯蒂。

en.s: The 1882 New York state election was held on November 7, 1882, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the chief judge and a U.S. Representative-at-large, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly. Besides, two constitutional amendments were proposed – the abolition of tolls on the State canals, and to increase the number of justices on the New York Supreme Court – and were accepted by the electorate.

zh.s: 1882年11月7日，纽约州举行州选举，选出州长、副州长、首席法官、联邦众议院无任期选举代表，以及纽约州众议院全体议员。此外，选民还通过了两项宪法修正案：取消州运河通行费，以及增加纽约州最高法院法官人数。

en.s: The 1882 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1882, to elect the Governor of Tennessee. Incumbent Republican Governor Alvin Hawkins lost re-election against Democratic nominee and former member of the Tennessee House of Representatives William B. Bate. William B. Bate was sworn in as the 23rd Governor of Tennessee on January 15, 1883.

zh.s: 1882年11月7日，田纳西州举行州长选举。时任共和党州长阿尔文·霍金斯未能连任，败给民主党候选人、前田纳西州众议员威廉·B·贝特。贝特于1883年1月15日宣誓就任第23任州长。

en.s: The 1882 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1882. Republican incumbent Alonzo B. Cornell ran for re-election to a second term in office, but was defeated for the Republican nomination by Charles J. Folger, the Secretary of the Treasury under President Chester A. Arthur. Folger's nomination was a victory for President Arthur and the Stalwart faction of the state party, but he was badly defeated in the general election by the mayor of Buffalo, Grover Cleveland.

zh.s: 1882年11月7日，纽约州举行州长选举。共和党籍现任州长阿朗佐·B·康奈尔竞选连任，但在共和党初选中败给总统切斯特·A·阿瑟内阁中的财政部长查尔斯·J·福尔杰。福尔杰获提名，被视为阿瑟总统和州内共和党强硬派的胜利，但他在普选中惨败于布法罗市长格罗弗·克利夫兰。

en.s: The 1882 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 7. Civil War Major and former Congressman Benjamin Butler ran on a fusion ticket between the Democratic Party and the Greenback Labor Party.

zh.s: 1882年11月7日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。南北战争时期的少将、前联邦众议员本杰明·巴特勒代表民主党和绿背劳工党组成的联合阵营参选。

en.s: The 1882 Texas gubernatorial election was held to elect the Governor of Texas. John Ireland was elected over U.S. Representative George Washington "Wash" Jones, an independent with Republican and Greenback support. Ireland was the third consecutive Governor to have been elected from the Texas Supreme Court.

zh.s: 1882年，得克萨斯州举行州长选举。约翰·爱尔兰击败联邦众议员乔治·华盛顿·“沃什”·琼斯当选；琼斯是获得共和党和绿背党支持的独立候选人。爱尔兰是连续第三位从得克萨斯州最高法院法官中当选的州长。

en.t: 1882 United States House of Representatives elections in Florida
en.s: The 1882 United States House of Representatives elections in Florida were held November 7 for the 48th Congress

zh.t: 1882年美国众议院佛罗里达州选举
zh.s: 1882年美国众议院佛罗里达州选举于11月7日举行，选出参加第48届国会的代表。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: The last spike of the Canadian Pacific Railway is driven
en.s: Donald Smith drove the ceremonial last spike of the Canadian Pacific Railway at Craigellachie, British Columbia. The ceremony marked completion of the rail connection. Regular transcontinental passenger service followed in 1886.
en.n: The railway-completion ceremony is distinct from the later start of regular passenger service.

zh.t: 加拿大太平洋铁路最后一颗道钉打入
zh.s: 唐纳德·史密斯在不列颠哥伦比亚省克雷格拉奇打入加拿大太平洋铁路最后一颗纪念道钉，标志着铁路线路接通。定期跨大陆客运服务于1886年开通。
zh.n: 铁路竣工仪式与后来开始的定期客运服务是不同事件。

en.s: The 1891 North-West Territories general election was held on 7 November 1891 to elect 25 members of the Legislative Assembly of the North-West Territories, Canada. It was the second general election in the History of the North-West Territories. The legislature for the first time had no appointed members. It had 25 elected members, four more than in the 1888 election.

zh.s: 1891年11月7日，加拿大西北地区举行大选，选出立法议会25名议员。这是西北地区历史上第二次大选。议会首次不再设任命议员，全部25名议员均由选举产生，比1888年选举多4席。

en.s: The 1893 Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1893 to elect the governor of Virginia.

zh.s: 1893年弗吉尼亚州州长选举于11月7日举行，选出弗吉尼亚州州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1893 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1893. Incumbent Democratic governor William Russell did not run for a fourth term in office. Republican U.S. representative Frederic Greenhalge was elected to succeed him, defeating Democratic former U.S. representative John E. Russell.

zh.s: 1893年马萨诸塞州州长选举于1893年11月7日举行。现任民主党州长威廉·罗素没有竞选第四个任期。共和党联邦众议员弗雷德里克·格林哈尔奇当选州长，接替他，并击败了民主党前联邦众议员约翰·E·罗素。

en.s: The 1893 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1893. Republican nominee Frank D. Jackson defeated Democratic incumbent Horace Boies with 49.74% of the vote.

zh.s: 1893年艾奥瓦州州长选举于11月7日举行。共和党候选人弗兰克·D·杰克逊以49.74%的得票率击败民主党现任州长霍勒斯·博伊斯。

en.s: In the 1893 Iowa State Senate elections Iowa voters elected state senators to serve in the twenty-fifth Iowa General Assembly. Elections were held in 24 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1893 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here. The general election took place on November 7, 1893.

zh.s: 1893年艾奥瓦州参议院选举中，艾奥瓦州选民选出第25届州议会的参议员。州参议院50个选区中有24个举行选举。州参议员任期为四年。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1893年选举中全州50个州参议院选区的地图。大选于1893年11月7日举行。

en.s: The Liceu bombing was a terrorist attack by the Spanish anarchist Santiago Salvador, who killed 20 to 30 people at Barcelona's Grand Lyceum Theatre on 7 November 1893. The bombing was in response to the execution of Paulí Pallàs, who had himself attempted to assassinate the Captain General of Catalonia, Arsenio Martínez Campos.

zh.s: 1893年11月7日，西班牙无政府主义者圣地亚哥·萨尔瓦多在巴塞罗那大剧院（利塞乌剧院）发动袭击，造成20至30人死亡。这次恐怖袭击是为报复保利·帕利亚斯被处决；帕利亚斯此前曾试图刺杀加泰罗尼亚都督阿森尼奥·马丁内斯·坎波斯。

en.s: The 1899 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1899, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat Anselm J. McLaurin was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a second term.

zh.s: 1899年密西西比州州长选举于1899年11月7日举行，选出该州州长。现任民主党州长安塞尔姆·J·麦克劳林已任满，不能竞选连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1899 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 7, 1899, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Maryland Senate Joshua W. Hering defeated Republican nominee and incumbent comptroller Phillips Lee Goldsborough, Prohibition nominee Phineas F. Ball, Social Democratic nominee Joseph C. Fowler and Union Reform nominee William E. George.

zh.s: 1899年马里兰州审计长选举于1899年11月7日举行，选出该州审计长。民主党候选人、马里兰州参议员和现任议员约书亚·W·赫林击败了共和党候选人、现任审计长菲利普斯·李·戈尔兹伯勒、禁酒党候选人菲尼亚斯·F·鲍尔、社会民主党候选人约瑟夫·C·福勒，以及联盟改革党候选人威廉·E·乔治。

en.s: The 1899 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1899. Incumbent Republican L. M. Shaw defeated Democratic nominee Frederick Edward White with 55.26% of the vote.

zh.s: 1899年艾奥瓦州州长选举于11月7日举行。共和党现任州长L·M·肖以55.26%的得票率击败民主党候选人弗雷德里克·爱德华·怀特。

en.s: The 1899 Maryland gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1899. Incumbent Governor Republican Lloyd Lowndes Jr. was defeated by Democratic candidate John Walter Smith.

zh.s: 1899年马里兰州州长选举于11月7日举行。共和党现任州长小劳埃德·朗兹败给民主党候选人约翰·沃尔特·史密斯。

en.s: In the 1899 Iowa State Senate elections Iowa voters elected state senators in 31 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1899 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here. The 1899 elections occurred before primary elections were established in Iowa by the Primary Election Law in 1907. The general election took place on November 7, 1899.

zh.s: 1899年艾奥瓦州参议院选举中，选民在州参议院50个选区中的31个选区选出参议员。州参议员任期为四年。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1899年选举中全州50个州参议院选区的地图。艾奥瓦州于1907年通过《初选法》确立初选制度；1899年的选举早于此法。大选于1899年11月7日举行。

en.s: The 1899 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 7, 1899, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee and former member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Maryland's 4th district Isidor Rayner defeated Republican nominee and former member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Maryland's 4th district John Van Lear Findlay, Prohibition nominee Finley C.

zh.s: 1899年马里兰州检察长选举于11月7日举行，以选出该州检察长。民主党候选人、前联邦众议员伊西多·雷纳击败共和党候选人、前联邦众议员约翰·范·利尔·芬德利。禁酒党候选人为芬利·C·亨德里克森，社会民主党候选人为查尔斯·B·巴克曼，联合改革党候选人为罗伯特·B·沃林。

en.s: The 1899 San Francisco mayoral election was held on November 7, 1899. James D. Phelan was re-elected with 56% of the vote. It was the first election held under the new city charter.

zh.s: 1899年11月7日，旧金山举行市长选举。詹姆斯·D·费伦以56%的得票率连任。这是新市宪章生效后的首次选举。

en.s: The 1899 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1899, to elect the 33rd governor of Kentucky. Incumbent Republican governor William O'Connell Bradley was term-limited and ineligible to seek re-election. During a contentious and chaotic convention at the Music Hall in Louisville, the Democratic Party nominated state Senator William Goebel.

zh.s: 1899年11月7日，肯塔基州举行州长选举，以选出第33任州长。共和党籍现任州长威廉·奥康奈尔·布拉德利受任期限制，不能竞选连任。在路易斯维尔音乐厅举行的一场激烈而混乱的党代会上，民主党提名州参议员威廉·戈贝尔。

en.s: The 1900 Canadian federal election was held on November 7, 1900, to elect members of the House of Commons of Canada of the 9th Parliament of Canada. As a result of the election, the Liberal Party, led by Prime Minister Wilfrid Laurier, was re-elected to a second majority government, defeating the Conservative Party and Liberal-Conservatives led by Charles Tupper.

zh.s: 1900年加拿大联邦选举于1900年11月7日举行，选出加拿大第九届国会的下议院议员。威尔弗里德·劳里埃领导的自由党再次赢得多数席位，击败查尔斯·塔珀领导的保守党和自由保守党。

en.s: The Battle of Leliefontein (also known as the Battle of Witkloof) was an engagement between British-Canadian and Boer forces during the Second Boer War on 7 November 1900, at the Komati River 30 kilometres (19 mi) south of Belfast at the present day Nooitgedacht Dam. During the engagement, the Canadian rearguard successfully repelled Boer assaults against the column, facilitating the successful withdrawal of the British-Canadian force from the area.

zh.s: 1900年11月7日，第二次布尔战争期间，英国和加拿大军队与布尔军队在莱利方丹交战，地点在科马蒂河畔、贝尔法斯特以南30公里处，即今努伊特赫达赫特水坝附近。交战中，加拿大后卫部队成功击退布尔军对纵队的进攻，帮助英加部队顺利撤出该地区。这场战役也称威特克卢夫战役。

en.s: The 1901 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 7, 1901, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller Joshua W. Hering defeated Republican nominee Herman S. Platt, Prohibition nominee William Kleinle and Independent candidate William J. Parker.

zh.s: 1901年马里兰州审计长选举于1901年11月7日举行，选出该州审计长。民主党候选人、现任审计长约书亚·W·赫林击败共和党候选人赫尔曼·S·普拉特、禁酒党候选人威廉·克莱因勒和独立候选人威廉·J·帕克。

en.s: The 1905 Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1905 to elect the governor of Virginia.

zh.s: 1905年弗吉尼亚州州长选举于11月7日举行，选出弗吉尼亚州州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1905 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1905. Democratic nominee John M. Pattison defeated incumbent Republican Myron T. Herrick with 50.53% of the vote.

zh.s: 1905年俄亥俄州州长选举于1905年11月7日举行。民主党候选人约翰·M·帕蒂森以50.53%的得票率击败共和党现任州长迈伦·T·赫里克。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 7, 1905, in four states. Virginia holds its gubernatorial elections in odd numbered years, every 4 years, following the United States presidential election year. Massachusetts and Rhode Island at this time held gubernatorial elections every year. They would abandon in 1920 and 1912, respectively. In Ohio, following a 1905 amendment to the constitution which moved the election schedule, the governor's term was lengthened to three years.

zh.s: 1905年11月7日，4个州举行州长选举。弗吉尼亚州每4年在总统选举年的次年举行州长选举。马萨诸塞州和罗得岛州当时每年都举行州长选举，后来分别于1920年和1912年停止这种安排。俄亥俄州在1905年通过宪法修正案调整选举日程后，州长任期延长至3年。

en.s: The 1905 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1905. Incumbent Democratic Governor William L. Douglas did not run for re-election. Republican Lt. Governor Curtis Guild Jr. won the open election, defeating attorney Charles W. Bartlett.

zh.s: 1905年马萨诸塞州州长选举于1905年11月7日举行。现任民主党州长威廉·L·道格拉斯没有竞选连任。共和党副州长小柯蒂斯·吉尔德赢得这场开放席位的选举，击败律师查尔斯·W·巴特利特。

en.s: The 1905 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 7, 1905, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller Gordon T. Atkinson defeated Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Maryland Senate Henry M. McCullough, Prohibition nominee Richard Henry Holme and Socialist nominee Sylvester L. Young.

zh.s: 1905年马里兰州审计长选举于1905年11月7日举行，选出该州审计长。民主党候选人、现任审计长戈登·T·阿特金森击败共和党候选人、现任马里兰州参议员亨利·M·麦卡洛、禁酒党候选人理查德·亨利·霍尔姆和社会党候选人西尔维斯特·L·扬。

en.s: The 1905 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1905. Incumbent Republican George H. Utter defeated Democratic nominee Lucius F. C. Garvin with 53.30% of the vote.

zh.s: 1905年罗得岛州州长选举于1905年11月7日举行。共和党现任州长乔治·H·厄特以53.30%的得票率击败民主党候选人卢修斯·F·C·加文。

en.s: The 1905 San Francisco mayoral election was held on November 7, 1905. Incumbent Eugene E. Schmitz was reelected with 56% of the vote.

zh.s: 1905年11月7日，旧金山举行市长选举。时任市长尤金·E·施密茨以56%的得票率连任。

en.s: The 1911 New Mexico gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1911, to elect the first Governor of New Mexico. Democratic nominee William C. McDonald defeated Republican nominee Holm O. Bursum. New Mexico was admitted to the Union as the 47th state on January 6, 1912, and McDonald assumed office on that date.

zh.s: 1911年新墨西哥州州长选举于1911年11月7日举行，选出新墨西哥州首任州长。民主党候选人威廉·C·麦克唐纳击败共和党候选人霍尔姆·O·伯瑟姆。新墨西哥州于1912年1月6日作为第47个州加入联邦，麦克唐纳也在当天就任。

en.s: The 1911 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1911. Incumbent Republican Aram J. Pothier defeated Democratic nominee Lewis A. Waterman with 53.36% of the vote.

zh.s: 1911年罗得岛州州长选举于1911年11月7日举行。共和党现任州长阿拉姆·J·波蒂埃以53.36%的得票率击败民主党候选人刘易斯·A·沃特曼。

en.s: The 1911 Massachusetts gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1911. Incumbent Democratic Governor Eugene Foss defeated the Republican nominee, Louis A. Frothingham with 48.84% of the vote. Primary elections were held on September 26, 1911. This was the first gubernatorial election where the nominees were chosen in primary elections.

zh.s: 1911年马萨诸塞州州长选举于1911年11月7日举行。民主党现任州长尤金·福斯以48.84%的得票率击败共和党候选人路易斯·A·弗罗廷厄姆。初选于1911年9月26日举行。这是该州首次通过初选选出政党提名的州长候选人。

en.s: The 1911 Maryland gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1911. Incumbent Governor Austin Lane Crothers did not seek re-election. Republican candidate Phillips Lee Goldsborough defeated Democratic candidate Arthur Pue Gorman Jr.; Goldsborough was the second Republican governor of Maryland since the end of Reconstruction. The Digges Amendment, which attempted to disenfranchise African Americans in Maryland, was concurrently defeated.

zh.s: 1911年马里兰州州长选举于11月7日举行。现任州长奥斯汀·莱恩·克罗瑟斯没有竞选连任。共和党候选人菲利普斯·李·戈尔兹伯勒击败民主党候选人小亚瑟·皮尤·戈尔曼；戈尔兹伯勒是重建时期结束以来马里兰州第二位共和党州长。旨在剥夺马里兰州非裔美国人选举权的迪格斯修正案也在同日遭到否决。

en.s: The 1911 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1911, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat Edmond Noel was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a second term.

zh.s: 1911年密西西比州州长选举于1911年11月7日举行，选出该州州长。现任民主党州长埃德蒙·诺埃尔已任满，不能竞选连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1911 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 7, 1911, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee Emerson Harrington won the election as he ran unopposed. The exact results of the election are unknown.

zh.s: 1911年马里兰州审计长选举于1911年11月7日举行，选出该州审计长。民主党候选人埃默森·哈灵顿没有对手，赢得选举。具体选举结果未知。

en.s: The 1911 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 7, 1911, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee Edgar Allan Poe won the election as he ran unopposed. The exact results of this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1911年马里兰州州检察长选举于1911年11月7日举行，选出该州州检察长。民主党候选人埃德加·艾伦·坡没有对手，赢得选举。具体选举结果未知。

en.s: The 1911 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1911. Democratic nominee James B. McCreary defeated Republican nominee Edward C. O'Rear with 52.01% of the vote.

zh.s: 1911年11月7日，肯塔基州举行州长选举。民主党候选人詹姆斯·B·麦克里以52.01%的得票率击败共和党候选人爱德华·C·奥雷尔。

en.t: The magazine's first issue was published on November 7, 1914
en.s: The New Republic (often abbreviated as TNR) is an American magazine focused on domestic politics, news, culture, and the arts. It publishes 10 print magazines per year and a daily online platform. The New York Times described the magazine as partially founded in Theodore Roosevelt's living room and known for its "intellectual rigor and left-leaning political views".

zh.s: 《新共和》（The New Republic，简称TNR）是一家美国杂志，内容涉及国内政治、新闻、文化和艺术。它每年发行10期纸刊，并每日更新线上平台。《纽约时报》称，这本杂志部分创办于西奥多·罗斯福的客厅，并以思想严谨和政治立场偏左著称。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Jersey, 1916
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 7, 1916. All contemporary 48 states, were part of the 1916 United States presidential election. New Jersey voters chose 14 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New Jersey was won by the Republican nominees, U.S. Supreme Court Justice Charles Evans Hughes of New York and his running mate, former Vice President Charles W. Fairbanks of Indiana. Hughes and Fairbanks defeated the Democratic nominees, incumbent President Woodrow Wilson of New Jersey and his running mate incumbent Vice President Thomas R. Marshall of Indiana.

en.s: The 1916 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1916 for the post of the Governor of Arizona. Due to battles between labor and business, the Hunt administration was facing severe electoral backlash. After facing a fairly strong primary by former Council member George Olney, Hunt prevailed and went on to face the closest election in Arizona gubernatorial history. The initial results of the 1916 election were extremely close, only 30 votes separating the two major candidates. Victory hinged on whether to count certain votes, Arizona then had a ballot where they could check a party column ballot signifying they voted for all of a party.

zh.s: 1916年亚利桑那州州长选举于11月7日举行。州长乔治·W·P·亨特的执政引起了劳工和商界选民的不满，乔治·奥尔尼在初选中向他发起挑战。亨特随后参加了亚利桑那州历史上差距最小的州长选举。初步结果显示，主要候选人仅差30票。由于选票上政党栏的排列方式，计票结果是否准确也引发争议。

en.t: United States presidential election in Massachusetts, 1916
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 7, 1916 as part of the 1916 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 18 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.Massachusetts was won by the Republican nominee, U.S. Supreme Court Justice Charles Evans Hughes of New York, and his running mate Senator Charles W. Fairbanks of Indiana. Hughes and Fairbanks defeated the Democratic nominees, incumbent Democratic President Woodrow Wilson and Vice President Thomas R. Marshall. Hughes carried the state with 50.54%, to Wilson's 46.61%, a Republican victory margin of 3.93%.

zh.t: 1916年马萨诸塞州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年马萨诸塞州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。共和党候选人查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯和查尔斯·费尔班克斯击败了民主党候选人伍德罗·威尔逊和托马斯·R·马歇尔。休斯在马萨诸塞州获得50.54%的选票，威尔逊获得46.61%，两人相差3.93个百分点。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Mexico, 1916
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in New Mexico took place on November 7, 1916. All 48 States were part of the United States presidential election. New Mexico voters chose three electors to represent them in the Electoral College, which voted for President and Vice President. New Mexico was won by incumbent President Woodrow Wilson, who secured a tumultuous reelection against Supreme Court Justice Charles Evans Hughes, and Socialist Party icon Allan L. Benson. Wilson's reluctance to bid armed forces in World War I improved his image for this election, as a "peace candidate".

zh.t: 1916年新墨西哥州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年新墨西哥州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，该州有3名选举人。伍德罗·威尔逊在竞争激烈的选举中成功连任，击败了查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯和社会党人艾伦·本森。由于威尔逊不愿让美国军队卷入第一次世界大战，他作为“和平候选人”的形象有所提升。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1916 was the 33rd quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 7, 1916. Incumbent President Woodrow Wilson, the Democratic candidate, was pitted against Supreme Court Justice Charles Evans Hughes, the Republican candidate. After a hard-fought contest, Wilson defeated Hughes by nearly 600,000 votes in the popular vote and secured a narrow majority in the Electoral College by winning several swing states with razor-thin margins. Wilson's re-election marked the first time that a Democratic Party candidate had won two consecutive Presidential elections since Andrew Jackson won re-election in the 1832 election.

zh.s: 1916年美国总统选举于11月7日星期二举行。民主党现任总统伍德罗·威尔逊对阵共和党候选人查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯。威尔逊以约60万张普选票的优势获胜，并凭借几个摇摆州的结果取得微弱的选举人票优势。这是自安德鲁·杰克逊1832年连任以来，民主党人首次连续赢得两届总统选举。

en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 1916
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 7, 1916 in Minnesota as part of the 1916 United States presidential election. The Republican candidate, former Associate Justice of the Supreme Court Charles Evans Hughes won the state over incumbent President Woodrow Wilson by a margin of just 392 votes, or 0.1%. Nationally, Wilson won the election, with 277 electoral votes and a tight 3.12% lead over Hughes in the popular vote. Wilson's re-election was the first time a Democratic President was elected to a second consecutive term since Andrew Jackson's 1832 re-election.

zh.t: 1916年明尼苏达州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年明尼苏达州美国总统选举于11月7日举行。休斯在该州以392票、约0.1%的差距击败威尔逊。不过，威尔逊赢得了全国选举，以277张选举人票和3.12个百分点的普选票优势获胜。这是自安德鲁·杰克逊1832年连任以来，民主党人首次连续赢得两届总统选举。

en.s: The 1916 Florida Gubernatorial Election was held on November 7, 1916 to determine the Governor for the State of Florida. Democratic incumbent Governor Park Trammell was term-limited and could not run for re-election. Sidney J. Catts, a pastor turned insurance salesman, originally entered the Democratic primary as a candidate for Governor. The state Democratic organization was not at all pleased with this challenge from a novice and 'outsider' and the primary campaign was hotly contested. Catts was initially declared the winner of the party's nomination, but the party leadership got the State Supreme Court to authorize a recount—and Catts was 'counted out.'

zh.s: 1916年佛罗里达州州长选举于11月7日举行。现任州长帕克·特拉梅尔因任期限制不能连任。牧师出身、后来从事保险销售的西德尼·J·卡茨参加了民主党初选，党内对这位局外人颇有不满。初选竞争激烈，卡茨最初被宣布获胜，但民主党领导层要求州最高法院重新计票。最终他被判定落败。

en.t: United States presidential election in Florida, 1916
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Florida took place on November 7, 1916. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1916 United States presidential election. Florida voters chose 6 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. Despite a rare four-way contest, the state was won handily by the incumbent Democratic President Woodrow Wilson. He garnered 69.34% of the vote, winning against the Republican nominee Charles Evans Hughes by a margin of 51.24%. He also won against Socialist candidate Allan L. Benson and Prohibition candidate Frank Hanly.

en.s: The 1916 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Governor of Montana Sam V. Stewart, who was first elected governor in 1912, ran for re-election. After comfortably winning the Democratic primary, he advanced to the general election, where he faced Frank J. Edwards, the former Mayor of Helena, who narrowly emerged victorious in a close Republican primary. Benefitting from then-President Woodrow Wilson's landslide victory in Montana in the presidential election that year, Stewart narrowly won re-election to his second and final term as governor.

zh.s: 1916年蒙大拿州州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党现任州长萨姆·V·斯图尔特在民主党初选中胜出，寻求连任。他在大选中面对前海伦娜市长弗兰克·J·爱德华兹；爱德华兹在竞争激烈的共和党初选中以微弱优势胜出。受益于威尔逊当年在蒙大拿州的大胜，斯图尔特赢得连任，开始第二个也是最后一个州长任期。

en.t: United States Senate election in Pennsylvania, 1916
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator George T. Oliver was not a candidate for re-election. The Republican nominee, Philander C. Knox defeated Democratic nominee Ellis C. Orvis. Knox died in October 1921, during his first term, and William E. Crow was appointed to fill the vacancy. Crow, however, also died before the expiration of the term, in August 1922. David A. Reed was appointed to fill the vacancy created by Crow's death, and was subsequently elected to complete the rest of the term expiring in March 1923 and to a full six-year term in his own right on the same day.

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1916
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 7, 1916 throughout the continuous 48 states. Voters chose 38 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, U.S. Supreme Court Justice and former New York Governor Charles Evans Hughes, over the Democratic nominee, President Woodrow Wilson.

zh.t: 1916年宾夕法尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年宾夕法尼亚州美国总统选举于11月7日举行。当时美国48个州都参加了总统选举。宾夕法尼亚州选民选出38名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。该州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、联邦最高法院大法官和纽约州前州长查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯，胜过民主党候选人、现任总统伍德罗·威尔逊。

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1916
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 7, 1916 throughout the 48 contiguous states. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Virginia voted for the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Woodrow Wilson, over the Republican nominee, former U.S. Supreme Court Justice Charles E. Hughes. Wilson ultimately won the national election with 49.24% of the vote.

zh.t: 1916年弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，当时美国48个本土州都参加了选举。弗吉尼亚州选民选出12名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。该州支持民主党籍现任总统伍德罗·威尔逊，胜过共和党候选人、联邦最高法院前大法官查尔斯·E·休斯。威尔逊最终以49.24%的普选票赢得全国选举。

en.s: On November 7, 1916, a streetcar loaded with passengers ran off the open Summer Street Bridge, a retractile bridge, into Fort Point Channel near downtown Boston, Massachusetts, United States. Forty-six passengers were killed, making it the deadliest disaster in Boston's history until surpassed by the Cocoanut Grove fire in 1942.

zh.s: 1916年11月7日，一辆载有乘客的有轨电车驶离打开状态的萨默街桥，坠入美国马萨诸塞州波士顿市中心附近的福特角水道。萨默街桥是一座可移动桥。事故造成46名乘客死亡；直到1942年椰林夜总会火灾发生前，这是波士顿历史上最严重的灾难。

en.t: 1916 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: 1916 United States House of Representatives elections were elections for the United States House of Representatives to elect members to serve in the 65th United States Congress. They were held for the most part on November 7, 1916, while Maine held theirs on September 11. They coincided with the re-election of President Woodrow Wilson. Wilson eked out a narrow re-election, but his Democratic Party lost seats to the Republican Party.

zh.s: 1916年美国众议院选举选出第65届美国国会的众议员。大多数州于1916年11月7日举行选举，缅因州则提前至9月11日。选举与伍德罗·威尔逊总统连任竞选同期举行。威尔逊以微弱优势赢得连任，但民主党失去了一些众议院席位，共和党则增加了席位。
