en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Illinois was held on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election. State voters chose 29 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Illinois was won by the Republican nominee Charles Evans Hughes with 52.56% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1916年伊利诺伊州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年伊利诺伊州美国总统选举于1916年11月7日举行，是1916年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出29名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯以52.56%的普选票赢得伊利诺伊州。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1916, in 36 states, concurrent with the House, Senate elections and presidential election, on November 7, 1916. Elections took place on September 11 in Maine. In New Mexico, the governor was elected to a two-year term for the first time, instead of a four-year term.

zh.s: 1916年，美国36个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院、参议院和总统选举同时进行，选举日为11月7日。缅因州于9月11日举行选举。新墨西哥州的州长首次改为两年一任，此前为四年一任。

en.s: The 1916 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Republican Robert Livingston Beeckman defeated Democratic nominee Addison P. Munroe with 55.92% of the vote.

zh.s: 1916年罗得岛州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。共和党现任州长罗伯特·利文斯顿·比克曼以55.92%的得票率击败民主党候选人艾迪生·P·门罗。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 10 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. In Mississippi, voters voted for electors individually instead of as a slate, as in the other states.

zh.t: 1916年密西西比州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年密西西比州美国总统选举于1916年11月7日举行，是在当时全部48个州举行的1916年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出10名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。密西西比州的选民不是像其他州那样投票给一组总统选举人，而是逐一投票给每名选举人。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Arizona
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Arizona took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arizona was won by Democratic incumbent President Woodrow Wilson, running with incumbent Vice President Thomas R. Marshall, with 57.17% of the popular vote, against Republican Associate Justice of the U.S.

zh.t: 1916年亚利桑那州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年亚利桑那州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名选举人，代表本州参加总统和副总统选举。民主党现任总统伍德罗·威尔逊与现任副总统托马斯·R·马歇尔搭档，得票率为57.17%；共和党候选人、美国最高法院大法官查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯及其竞选搭档查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯得票率为35.37%。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 7, 1916. All contemporary forty-eight states were part of the 1916 United States presidential election. State voters chose six electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.t: 1916年科罗拉多州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年11月7日，科罗拉多州举行总统选举。1916年美国总统选举在当时全部48个州举行。科罗拉多州选民选出6名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in Florida
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in Florida was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Democratic Senator Nathan Philemon Bryan ran for re-election to a second term in office, but lost the Democratic nomination to Governor of Florida Park Trammell. Trammell easily won the general election.

zh.t: 1916年佛罗里达州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年佛罗里达州联邦参议院选举于1916年11月7日举行。现任民主党参议员内森·菲利蒙·布赖恩竞选连任第二个任期，但在民主党提名中败给佛罗里达州州长帕克·特拉梅尔。特拉梅尔轻松赢得大选。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in Delaware
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in Delaware took place on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Republican Senator Henry A. du Pont ran for re-election to a third term in office, but was defeated by Democrat Josiah O. Wolcott. This was the first U.S. Senate election in Delaware in which the people directly elected a U.S. senator.

zh.t: 1916年特拉华州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年特拉华州联邦参议院选举于1916年11月7日举行。共和党现任参议员亨利·A·杜邦竞选连任第三个任期，但败给民主党人约西亚·O·沃尔科特。这是特拉华州首次由民众直接选举联邦参议员。

en.s: The 1916 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Republican nominee Albert Sleeper defeated Democratic nominee Edwin F. Sweet with 55.83% of the vote.

zh.s: 1916年密歇根州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。共和党候选人阿尔伯特·斯利珀以55.83%的得票率击败民主党候选人埃德温·F·斯威特。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Carolina was won by the Democratic nominees, incumbent Democratic President Woodrow Wilson and Vice President Thomas R.

zh.t: 1916年南卡罗来纳州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年南卡罗来纳州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年在当时美国48州举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出9名选举人，代表本州参加总统和副总统选举。民主党候选人、现任总统伍德罗·威尔逊与现任副总统托马斯·R·马歇尔大胜共和党候选人查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯及其竞选搭档查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯，得票率分别为96.71%和2.42%。

en.s: The 1916 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Democrat Moses Alexander defeated Republican nominee D. W. Davis with 47.49% of the vote.

zh.s: 1916年爱达荷州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。民主党现任州长摩西·亚历山大以47.49%的得票率击败共和党候选人D·W·戴维斯。

en.s: The 1916 New Mexico gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Democratic Governor William C. McDonald did not run for re-election but ran instead for Lieutenant Governor. Democratic nominee Ezequiel Cabeza De Baca defeated Republican nominee Holm O. Bursum.

zh.s: 1916年新墨西哥州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。民主党现任州长威廉·C·麦克唐纳没有竞选连任，转而竞选副州长。民主党候选人埃塞基耶尔·卡贝萨·德巴卡击败共和党候选人霍尔姆·O·伯瑟姆。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in Montana
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Senator Henry L. Myers was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Republican Charles N. Pray.

zh.t: 1916年蒙大拿州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年蒙大拿州联邦参议院选举于1916年11月7日举行。现任参议员亨利·L·迈尔斯连任，进入第二个任期，击败共和党人查尔斯·N·普雷。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Democratic Senator Blair Lee I ran for election to a full term in office, but was defeated in the Democratic primary by U.S. Representative David John Lewis. Lewis went on to lose the general election to Republican Joseph I. France, a professor of medicine and former state senator.

zh.t: 1916年马里兰州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年马里兰州联邦参议院选举于1916年11月7日举行。现任民主党参议员布莱尔·李一世竞选完整任期，但在民主党初选中败给联邦众议员戴维·约翰·刘易斯。刘易斯随后在大选中败给共和党人约瑟夫·I·弗朗斯；弗朗斯是医学教授，曾任州参议员。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in Connecticut was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Republican Senator George P. McLean was re-elected to a second term in office over Democratic State Attorney Homer Stille Cummings.

zh.t: 1916年康涅狄格州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年康涅狄格州联邦参议院选举于1916年11月7日举行。共和党现任参议员乔治·P·麦克莱恩击败民主党州检察长霍默·斯蒂尔·卡明斯，连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in Missouri
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in Missouri was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator James A. Reed was re-elected to a second term over Republican Walter S. Dickey.

zh.t: 1916年密苏里州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年密苏里州联邦参议院选举于1916年11月7日举行。民主党现任联邦参议员詹姆斯·A·里德击败共和党人沃尔特·S·迪基，连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election. Voters chose thirteen representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.s: 1916年11月7日，肯塔基州举行总统选举，作为1916年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出13名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa was won by Republican nominee, U.S. Supreme Court Justice Charles Evans Hughes of New York, and his running mate Senator Charles W.

zh.s: 1916年艾奥瓦州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年在当时美国48州举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出13名选举人，代表本州参加总统和副总统选举。共和党候选人、来自纽约州的美国最高法院大法官查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯，与来自印第安纳州的联邦参议员查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯搭档胜出；休斯得票率为54.25%。民主党候选人伍德罗·威尔逊与托马斯·R·马歇尔得票率为42.89%。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election in which all contemporary 48 states participated. Voters chose seven electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting Democratic incumbents Woodrow Wilson Thomas R. Marshall, against Republican challengers Associate Justice Charles Evans Hughes and his running mate, former Vice-president Charles W.

zh.s: 1916年华盛顿州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当时美国48州均参与的总统选举的一部分。选民通过普选选出7名选举人。民主党现任总统伍德罗·威尔逊与现任副总统托马斯·R·马歇尔搭档；共和党候选人、美国最高法院大法官查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯与前副总统查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯搭档。威尔逊以48.13%的得票率胜出，休斯得票率为43.89%。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election, held throughout all the contemporary 48 states. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maine was won by the Republican nominee, U.S. Supreme Court Justice Charles Evans Hughes of New York, and his running mate Senator Charles W.

zh.s: 1916年缅因州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当时美国48州均举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，代表本州参加总统和副总统选举。共和党候选人、来自纽约州的美国最高法院大法官查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯，与来自印第安纳州的联邦参议员查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯搭档胜出，得票率为50.99%。他们击败了民主党候选人、现任总统伍德罗·威尔逊及其竞选搭档托马斯·R·马歇尔。

en.s: The 1916 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916, and featured Democratic nominee Edgar Howard defeating Republican nominee Herbert P. Shumway as well as Socialist Party nominee Edmund R. Brumbaugh and Prohibition Party nominee Charles E. Smith. Incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor James Pearson sought reelection to the office of lieutenant governor but was defeated for reelection in the Democratic primary by Edgar Howard.

zh.t: 1916年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1916年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党候选人埃德加·霍华德击败了共和党候选人赫伯特·P·舒姆韦、社会党候选人埃德蒙·R·布伦博和禁酒党候选人查尔斯·E·史密斯。现任副州长詹姆斯·皮尔逊竞选连任，但在民主党初选中败给霍华德。

en.s: The 1916 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Republican Governor Charles R. Miller declined to run for re-election. At the time, the Republican Party was in the middle of a schism that had first developed during the 1912 presidential election. However, the schism did not affect the gubernatorial nomination; though there were rumors that the state party convention might seek to nominate Governor Miller for a second term, former State Representative John G.

zh.s: 1916年特拉华州州长选举于11月7日举行。时任共和党州长查尔斯·R·米勒不再竞选连任。当时共和党内部仍存在自1912年总统选举期间形成的分裂，不过这并未影响州长候选人提名。尽管曾有传闻称州党代表大会可能提名米勒连任，前州众议员约翰·G·汤森德二世仍被视为最有希望获得提名的人选。

en.s: The 1916 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Republican Arthur Capper defeated Democratic nominee W. C. Lansdon with 60.77% of the vote.

zh.s: 1916年堪萨斯州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。共和党现任州长亚瑟·卡珀以60.77%的得票率击败民主党候选人W·C·兰斯登。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Except for the Unionist Ozark counties of Newton and Searcy where Republicans controlled local government, Arkansas since the end of Reconstruction had been a classic one-party Democratic “Solid South” state.

zh.s: 1916年11月7日，阿肯色州举行总统选举，作为1916年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出9名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。自重建时期结束后，阿肯色州一直是民主党一党主导的“坚实南方”州，只有牛顿县和瑟西县这两个支持联邦的奥扎克山区县由共和党控制地方政府。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 7, 1916. Democratic incumbent and Senate majority leader John W. Kern ran for re-election to a second term in office, but he was defeated by Harry S. New, former chairman of the Republican National Committee.

zh.t: 1916年印第安纳州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年印第安纳州联邦参议院选举于1916年11月7日举行。民主党现任参议员兼参议院多数党领袖约翰·W·克恩竞选连任第二个任期，但败给共和党全国委员会前主席哈里·S·纽。

en.s: The 1916 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Democratic Governor George Washington Hays did not seek a third term. Democratic nominee Charles Hillman Brough defeated Republican nominee Wallace Townsend and Socialist nominee William Davis with 69.44% of the vote.

zh.s: 1916年阿肯色州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。民主党现任州长乔治·华盛顿·海斯没有竞选第三个任期。民主党候选人查尔斯·希尔曼·布鲁以69.44%的得票率击败共和党候选人华莱士·汤森和社会党候选人威廉·戴维斯。

en.t: 1916 United States House of Representatives election in Arizona
en.s: The 1916 United States House of Representatives elections in Arizona was held on Tuesday November 7, 1916 to elect the state's one at-large representative. incumbent democrat, Carl Hayden won re-election to a fourth term with 66 percent of the vote. Primary elections were held on September 12, 1916.

zh.t: 1916年亚利桑那州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1916年亚利桑那州联邦众议院选举于1916年11月7日星期二举行，选出该州唯一的不分区联邦众议员。现任民主党人卡尔·海登以66%的得票率连任，进入第四个任期。初选于1916年9月12日举行。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate special election in Indiana
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate special election in Indiana took place on November 7, 1916, to complete the unexpired term of Benjamin F. Shively. Interim Democratic Senator Thomas Taggart was defeated in his bid to complete the term by U.S. Representative James Eli Watson.

zh.t: 1916年印第安纳州美国联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1916年印第安纳州联邦参议院特别选举于1916年11月7日举行，以完成本杰明·F·希夫利未满的任期。临时接任的民主党参议员托马斯·塔格特竞选完成该任期，但败给联邦众议员詹姆斯·伊莱·沃森。

en.s: The 1916 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Democratic nominee James M. Cox defeated incumbent Republican Frank B. Willis in a rematch of the 1914 election with 48.40% of the vote.

zh.s: 1916年俄亥俄州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。民主党候选人詹姆斯·M·考克斯以48.40%的得票率击败共和党现任州长弗兰克·B·威利斯。这是两人继1914年选举后再次交锋。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 7, 1916. It was the first election for either class of U.S. senators held in Minnesota after the ratification of the Seventeenth Amendment to the United States Constitution, which established the popular election of United States senators. Incumbent Senator Moses E. Clapp was defeated in the Republican primary election by former American Bar Association president Frank B.

zh.t: 1916年明尼苏达州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年明尼苏达州美国参议院选举于11月7日举行。这是美国宪法第十七修正案批准后，明尼苏达州首次举行联邦参议员普选。该修正案规定联邦参议员由选民直接选举产生。共和党现任参议员摩西·E·克拉普在党内初选中败给美国律师协会前会长弗兰克·B·凯洛格。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 7, 1916. All 48 contemporary states participated in the 1916 United States presidential election. Voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Republican nominee and Supreme Court justice Charles Evans Hughes carried Delaware with 50.20% of the vote, defeating Democratic nominee and incumbent president Woodrow Wilson, who won 47.78% of the vote.

zh.s: 1916年11月7日，特拉华州举行美国总统选举。当时全部48个州都参与了1916年美国总统选举。选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、最高法院大法官查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯以50.20%的得票率赢得特拉华州，击败获得47.78%选票的民主党候选人、现任总统伍德罗·威尔逊。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose five representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island was won by the Republican nominee, U.S.

zh.s: 1916年罗得岛州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当时美国48州总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名选举人，代表本州参加总统和副总统选举。共和党候选人、美国最高法院大法官查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯及其竞选搭档、联邦参议员查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯击败民主党候选人、现任总统伍德罗·威尔逊及现任副总统托马斯·R·马歇尔。休斯以5.08个百分点的微弱优势获胜。

en.s: The 1916 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916.

zh.s: 1916年马萨诸塞州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。

en.s: The 1916 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Republican Governor Rolland H. Spaulding declined to seek re-election. Republican nominee Henry W. Keyes, the former chairman of the state Excise Commission, defeated former State Senator John C. Hutchins, the Democratic nominee, with 53 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 1916年新罕布什尔州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。现任共和党州长罗兰·H·斯波尔丁决定不竞选连任。共和党候选人亨利·W·凯斯曾任州消费税委员会主席，他以53%的得票率击败了民主党候选人、前州参议员约翰·C·哈钦斯。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in Texas
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in Texas was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Charles Culberson was re-elected to a fourth term in office. Culberson survived a challenge from former Governor Oscar Colquitt in the Democratic primary, then easily won the general election. He was challenged by Republican Alex W. Atcheson and Socialist Thomas Hickey, publisher of The Rebel.

zh.t: 1916年得克萨斯州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年得克萨斯州联邦参议院选举于1916年11月7日举行。民主党现任联邦参议员查尔斯·卡尔伯森连任，进入第四个任期。他在民主党初选中击退了前州长奥斯卡·科尔奎特的挑战，随后轻松赢得大选。他的对手包括共和党人亚历克斯·W·阿奇森和社会党人托马斯·希基；希基是《反叛者报》的出版人。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Tennessee was held on November 7, 1916. Tennessee voters chose twelve representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. For over a century after the Civil War, Tennessee was divided according to political loyalties established in that war.

zh.s: 1916年田纳西州美国总统选举于1916年11月7日举行。田纳西州选民选出12名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。南北战争结束后一个多世纪里，田纳西州一直因战争期间形成的政治立场而分化。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1916 in New Jersey was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Democratic senator James E. Martine ran for re-election to a second term in office but was defeated by Republican state senator Joseph Frelinghuysen in an election dominated by American preparedness for World War I. Primary elections were held on September 26. Senator Martine defeated a challenge from John W.

zh.t: 1916年新泽西州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年新泽西州美国参议院选举于11月7日举行。民主党现任参议员詹姆斯·E·马丁竞选第二个任期，但在这场以美国备战第一次世界大战为主要议题的选举中败给共和党州参议员约瑟夫·弗雷林海森。初选于9月26日举行。马丁在民主党初选中击败了新泽西州检察长、伍德罗·威尔逊的盟友约翰·W·韦斯科特。共和党提名则由州参议员弗雷林海森险胜前州长富兰克林·墨菲获得。这是新泽西州首次通过普选选举联邦参议员，此前已批准美国宪法第十七修正案。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in Nebraska took place on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Senator Gilbert Hitchcock, a Democrat, sought re-election in his first popular election. He won the Democratic primary and the cross-endorsement of the People's Independent party and faced former Congressman John L. Kennedy in the general election. Hitchcock won re-election as Democratic President Woodrow Wilson handily won the state in the presidential election.

zh.t: 1916年内布拉斯加州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年内布拉斯加州联邦参议院选举于1916年11月7日举行。民主党现任参议员吉尔伯特·希区柯克首次参加民众投票选举，寻求连任。他赢得民主党初选，并获得人民独立党的交叉背书，随后在大选中面对前联邦众议员约翰·L·肯尼迪。由于民主党总统伍德罗·威尔逊轻松赢得该州，希区柯克也成功连任。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 7, 1916 as part of the 1916 United States presidential election in which all contemporary forty-eight states participated. Voters chose five electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oregon had been in the 1900s solidified as a one-party Republican bastion, which it would remain at a Presidential level apart from the 1910s GOP split until Franklin D.

zh.s: 1916年俄勒冈州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当时美国48州总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名选举人，代表本州参加总统和副总统选举。20世纪初，俄勒冈州逐渐成为共和党稳固的根据地；除20世纪10年代共和党分裂时期外，这一局面一直持续到富兰克林·D·罗斯福于1932年崛起。在州级选举中，共和党优势又一直持续到新政时期短暂打破这一局面之前。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in Michigan was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Republican Senator Charles E. Townsend was re-elected to a second term in office over Democrat Lawrence Price. This was the first election in Michigan held after the passage of the Seventeenth Amendment to the United States Constitution, which required all senators to be elected by direct popular vote.

zh.t: 1916年密歇根州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年密歇根州联邦参议院选举于1916年11月7日举行。共和党现任参议员查尔斯·E·汤森德击败民主党人劳伦斯·普赖斯，连任第二个任期。这是美国宪法第十七修正案通过后密歇根州举行的首次选举；该修正案规定参议员由民众直接选举。

en.s: The 1916 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Democratic nominee Julius Caldeen Gunter defeated Republican incumbent George Alfred Carlson with 53.27% of the vote.

zh.s: 1916年科罗拉多州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。民主党候选人朱利叶斯·卡尔丁·冈特以53.27%的得票率击败共和党现任州长乔治·阿尔弗雷德·卡尔森。

en.s: The 1916 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 7, 1916, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee Frank Winton McAllister defeated Republican nominee James H. Mason and Socialist nominee Frank P. O'Hare.

zh.s: 1916年密苏里州州检察长选举于1916年11月7日举行，选出该州州检察长。民主党候选人弗兰克·温顿·麦卡利斯特击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·H·梅森和社会党候选人弗兰克·P·奥黑尔。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. In 1912, Wyoming had been the eighth-best state for embattled Republican nominee William Howard Taft.

zh.s: 1916年11月7日，怀俄明州举行总统选举，作为1916年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。1912年，怀俄明州是共和党候选人威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱支持率排名第八的州。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. With its history as a slave state and substantial historic secessionist support, Maryland had been strongly Democratic during the Third Party System despite having Federalist and Whig tendencies under previous systems.

zh.s: 1916年11月7日，马里兰州举行总统选举，作为在当时全部48个州举行的1916年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。马里兰州曾是蓄奴州，也有不少人支持脱离联邦；尽管如此，在第三党制时期，该州一直强烈支持民主党，尽管此前的政党制度中联邦党和辉格党也有影响力。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election. Voters chose 15 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Following the Panic of 1893 and the Populist movement, Michigan would turn from a competitive Republican-leaning state into a rigidly one-party polity dominated by the Republican Party.

zh.s: 1916年11月7日，密歇根州举行总统选举，作为1916年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出15名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。1893年经济恐慌和民粹主义运动之后，密歇根州从共和党占优势、竞争激烈的州，转变为共和党主导的一党州。

en.s: The 1916 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916, in order to elect the Lieutenant Governor of Missouri. Democratic nominee Wallace Crossley defeated Republican nominee Roy F. Britton, as well as several other candidates.

zh.s: 1916年密苏里州副州长选举于1916年11月7日举行，选出该州副州长。民主党候选人华莱士·克罗斯利击败共和党候选人罗伊·F·布里顿及其他几名候选人。

en.s: The 1916 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Republican nominee Lynn Frazier defeated Democratic nominee D. H. McArthur with 79.24% of the vote.

zh.s: 1916年北达科他州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。共和党候选人林恩·弗雷泽以79.24%的得票率击败民主党候选人D·H·麦克阿瑟。

en.s: The 1916 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Primary elections were held on September 5, 1916. Incumbent Republican Governor Emanuel L. Philipp won the election with 52.93% of the vote, winning his second term as governor. Philipp defeated Democratic Party candidate Burt Williams and Socialist candidate Rae Weaver.

zh.s: 1916年威斯康星州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。初选于1916年9月5日举行。共和党现任州长伊曼纽尔·L·菲利普以52.93%的得票率胜出，赢得第二个州长任期。他击败了民主党候选人伯特·威廉姆斯和社会党候选人雷·韦弗。

en.s: The 1916 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 7, 1916, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Julius A. Schmahl defeated Prohibition nominee Charles L. Johnson.

zh.s: 1916年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于1916年11月7日举行，选出该州州务卿。共和党候选人、现任州务卿朱利叶斯·A·施马尔击败禁酒党候选人查尔斯·L·约翰逊。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 7, 1916 as part of the 1916 United States presidential election in which all contemporary forty-eight states participated. State voters chose four electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. At state level, Idaho had begun in 1902 to be very much a one-party Republican state, which it has largely remained since apart from the New Deal era of the 1930s and 1940s.

zh.s: 1916年11月7日，爱达荷州举行总统选举，作为当时全部48个州参与的1916年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。爱达荷州从1902年起就已成为共和党占主导地位的一党州；除了20世纪30年代和40年代的新政时期外，此后大体一直如此。

en.s: The 1916 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1916. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate Thomas Frankson defeated Minnesota Democratic Party challenger Julius Thorson, Socialist Party of Minnesota candidate Andrew Hanson, and Prohibition Party candidate L. A. Simonson.

zh.s: 1916年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月7日举行。明尼苏达州共和党候选人托马斯·弗兰克森击败明尼苏达民主党候选人朱利叶斯·索森、明尼苏达州社会党候选人安德鲁·汉森和禁酒党候选人L·A·西蒙森。

en.s: The 1916 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Republican Governor Frank M. Byrne declined to seek re-election to a third term. Lieutenant Governor Peter Norbeck won the Republican primary to succeed him, and in the general election faced State Representative Orville V. Rinehart. Norbeck won his first term as Governor in a landslide over Rinehart.

zh.s: 1916年南达科他州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。共和党现任州长弗兰克·M·伯恩没有竞选第三个任期。副州长彼得·诺贝克赢得共和党初选，成为接替他的人选，并在大选中与州众议员奥维尔·V·莱因哈特对决。诺贝克以压倒性优势击败莱因哈特，首次当选州长。

en.s: The 1916 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Republican nominee William L. Harding defeated Democratic nominee Edwin T. Meredith with 61.03% of the vote.

zh.s: 1916年艾奥瓦州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。共和党候选人威廉·L·哈丁以61.03%的得票率击败民主党候选人埃德温·T·梅雷迪思。

en.s: The 1916 Illinois lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. It saw the election of Republican former governor John G. Oglesby to a second nonconsecutive term.

zh.s: 1916年伊利诺伊州副州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。共和党前州长约翰·G·奥格尔斯比当选，开始第二个非连续任期。

en.s: The 1916 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Republican nominee James P. Goodrich narrowly defeated Democratic nominee John A. M. Adair with 47.80% of the vote.

zh.s: 1916年印第安纳州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。共和党候选人詹姆斯·P·古德里奇以47.80%的得票率险胜民主党候选人约翰·A·M·阿代尔。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election. The Republican ticket of the former associate justice of the Supreme Court of the United States Charles Evans Hughes and the former vice president of the United States Charles W. Fairbanks defeated the Democratic ticket of the incumbent president of the United States Woodrow Wilson and the incumbent vice president Thomas R.

zh.t: 1916年印第安纳州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年11月7日，印第安纳州举行了美国总统选举。共和党候选人、美国最高法院前大法官查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯与前副总统查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯搭档，击败了民主党候选人、现任总统伍德罗·威尔逊与现任副总统托马斯·R·马歇尔。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. West Virginia was won by the Republican nominee, U.S.

zh.t: 1916年西弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年西弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当时美国48州总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名选举人，代表本州参加总统和副总统选举。共和党候选人、美国最高法院大法官查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯及其竞选搭档、联邦参议员查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯击败了民主党候选人、现任总统伍德罗·威尔逊与现任副总统托马斯·R·马歇尔。

en.s: The 1916 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Democratic governor Thomas Clarke Rye defeated Republican nominee John W. Overall with 55.04% of the vote.

zh.s: 1916年田纳西州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。民主党现任州长托马斯·克拉克·赖伊以55.04%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·W·奥弗奥尔。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Robert M. La Follette was re-elected to a third term in office over Democrat William F. Wolfe and Socialist Richard Elsner.

zh.t: 1916年威斯康星州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年威斯康星州联邦参议院选举于1916年11月7日举行。共和党现任联邦参议员罗伯特·M·拉福莱特击败民主党人威廉·F·沃尔夫和社会党人理查德·埃尔斯纳，连任第三个任期。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Oklahoma took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election. In its early years, Oklahoma was a “Solid South” Democratic state whose founding fathers like "Alfalfa Bill" Murray and Charles N. Haskell had disfranchised most of its black population via literacy tests and grandfather clauses, the latter of which would be declared unconstitutional in Guinn v.

zh.t: 1916年俄克拉何马州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年俄克拉何马州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。建州早期，俄克拉何马州是民主党占主导的“南方铁票州”。该州的建州先驱，如“苜蓿比尔”·默里和查尔斯·N·哈斯克尔，通过读写能力测试和祖父条款剥夺了大多数黑人居民的投票权；后者后来在“吉恩诉美国案”中被判违宪。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in California took place on November 7, 1916 as part of the 1916 United States presidential election. State voters chose 13 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California narrowly voted for the Democratic incumbent, Woodrow Wilson, over the Republican nominee, Associate Justice Charles Evans Hughes.

zh.t: 1916年加利福尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年11月7日，加利福尼亚州举行总统选举，作为1916年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出13名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。加利福尼亚州以微弱优势支持民主党现任总统伍德罗·威尔逊，胜过共和党候选人、最高法院大法官查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯。

en.s: The 1916 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 7, 1916, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Republican nominee George Ernst Hackman defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent state auditor John Pemberton Gordon, Socialist nominee William R. Bowden, Prohibition nominee B. F. Sapp and Socialist Labor nominee Frederick Spalti.

zh.s: 1916年密苏里州州审计长选举于1916年11月7日举行，选出该州州审计长。共和党候选人乔治·恩斯特·哈克曼击败民主党候选人、现任州审计长约翰·彭伯顿·戈登、社会党候选人威廉·R·鲍登、禁酒党候选人B·F·萨普和社会主义工党候选人弗雷德里克·斯帕尔蒂。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Kansas was held on November 7, 1916. Kansas voters chose ten electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kansas voted for the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Woodrow Wilson, over the Republican nominee, U.S. Supreme Court Justice and former New York Governor Charles Evans Hughes. Wilson won Kansas by a margin of 5.86 percentage points.

zh.s: 1916年11月7日，堪萨斯州举行总统选举。选民选出10名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。堪萨斯州支持民主党候选人、现任总统伍德罗·威尔逊，胜过共和党候选人、美国最高法院大法官和纽约州前州长查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯。威尔逊以5.86个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Ohio was held on November 7, 1916. State voters chose 24 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ohio was won by the Democratic Party candidate, incumbent President Woodrow Wilson, who won the state with 51.86 percent of the popular vote. The Republican Party candidate, Charles Evans Hughes, garnered 44.18 percent of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1916年俄亥俄州美国总统选举于1916年11月7日举行。该州选民选出24名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、现任总统伍德罗·威尔逊以51.86%的普选票赢得俄亥俄州。共和党候选人查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯获得44.18%的普选票。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 7, 1916. All contemporary forty-eight states were part of the 1916 United States presidential election. Voters chose five electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. North Dakota was won narrowly by incumbent President Woodrow Wilson (D–New Jersey), running with incumbent Vice President Thomas R.

zh.t: 1916年北达科他州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年北达科他州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当时美国48州总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名选举人，代表本州参加总统和副总统选举。民主党现任总统伍德罗·威尔逊与现任副总统托马斯·R·马歇尔搭档，以微弱优势胜出，得票率为47.84%；共和党候选人、美国最高法院大法官查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯与前副总统查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯搭档，得票率为46.34%。

en.s: The 1916 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Republican Marcus H. Holcomb defeated Democratic nominee Morris Beardsley with 51.12% of the vote.

zh.s: 1916年康涅狄格州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。共和党现任州长马库斯·H·霍尔科姆以51.12%的得票率击败民主党候选人莫里斯·比尔兹利。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Missouri was held on November 7, 1916 as part of the 1916 United States presidential election. Voters chose 18 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Missouri was won by incumbent President, Woodrow Wilson (D–New Jersey), running with Vice President Thomas R.

zh.s: 1916年密苏里州美国总统选举于1916年11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出18名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。密苏里州由时任总统伍德罗·威尔逊胜出；他的竞选搭档是副总统托马斯·R·马歇尔。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. New Hampshire was won by the Democratic nominees, incumbent Democratic President Woodrow Wilson and Vice President Thomas R.

zh.t: 1916年新罕布什尔州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年新罕布什尔州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分，共有当时的48个州参与。选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、时任总统伍德罗·威尔逊与副总统托马斯·R·马歇尔赢得该州；他们击败了共和党候选人、美国最高法院大法官查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯及其竞选搭档查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯。

en.s: The 1916 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 7, 1916, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee John Leo Sullivan defeated Republican nominee William C. Askin, Socialist nominee Otto Vierling, Prohibition nominee William M. Godwin and Socialist Labor nominee William Wesley Cox.

zh.s: 1916年密苏里州州务卿选举于1916年11月7日举行，选出该州州务卿。民主党候选人约翰·利奥·沙利文击败共和党候选人威廉·C·阿斯金、社会党候选人奥托·菲尔林、禁酒党候选人威廉·M·戈德温和社会主义工党候选人威廉·韦斯利·考克斯。

en.s: The 1916 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 7, 1916, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Lyndon A. Smith won re-election as he ran unopposed.

zh.t: 1916年明尼苏达州州检察长选举
zh.s: 1916年明尼苏达州州检察长选举于1916年11月7日举行，选出该州州检察长。共和党候选人、现任州检察长林登·A·史密斯没有对手，成功连任。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Democratic Senator Atlee Pomerene was re-elected to a second term in office over Republican former Governor and Ambassador to France Myron Herrick.

zh.t: 1916年俄亥俄州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年俄亥俄州联邦参议院选举于1916年11月7日举行。民主党现任参议员阿特利·波默伦击败共和党前州长、前驻法大使迈伦·赫里克，连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.s: 1916年11月7日，内华达州举行总统选举，作为1916年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。

en.s: The 1916 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916, and featured bank director and rancher Keith Neville, a Democrat, narrowly defeating Republican nominee, Douglas County District Judge Abraham L. Sutton.

zh.s: 1916年内布拉斯加州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。民主党银行董事和牧场主基思·内维尔以微弱优势击败共和党候选人、道格拉斯县地区法官亚伯拉罕·L·萨顿。

en.s: The 1916 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Democratic nominee Simon Bamberger defeated Republican nominee Nephi L. Morris with 55.12% of the vote. It was the first time a Democrat was elected governor of the state.

zh.s: 1916年犹他州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。民主党候选人西蒙·班伯格以55.12%的得票率击败共和党候选人内菲·L·莫里斯。这是犹他州首次选出民主党州长。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in Wyoming took place on November 7, 1916. Incumbent senator Clarence D. Clark, a Republican, sought re-election in his first popular election. He was opposed by John B. Kendrick, the incumbent governor of Wyoming and the Democratic nominee. Owing in part to President Woodrow Wilson's strong performance in the presidential election that year, Kendrick won a narrow but decisive victory over Clark, winning the first of three terms in the U.S.

zh.t: 1916年怀俄明州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年怀俄明州美国参议院选举于11月7日举行。共和党籍现任参议员克拉伦斯·D·克拉克在首次由选民直接投票的选举中寻求连任，民主党候选人是时任怀俄明州州长约翰·B·肯德里克。肯德里克部分得益于伍德罗·威尔逊在同年总统选举中的强势表现，以微弱但明确的优势击败克拉克，当选参议员；这是他三个参议员任期中的第一个。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nebraska was won by incumbent President Woodrow Wilson (D–Virginia), and incumbent Vice-president Thomas R.

zh.t: 1916年美国总统选举：内布拉斯加州
zh.s: 内布拉斯加州的1916年美国总统选举于1916年11月7日举行。选民选出8名代表（选举人）进入选举人团，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。内布拉斯加州由时任总统伍德罗·威尔逊（民主党，弗吉尼亚州）获胜，时任副总统托马斯·R。

en.s: The 1916 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Democratic nominee Thomas Walter Bickett defeated Republican nominee Frank A. Linney with 58.15% of the vote. At the time, Bickett was the state's attorney general, while Linney was an attorney and chairman of the North Carolina Republican Party.

zh.s: 1916年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。民主党候选人托马斯·沃尔特·比克特以58.15%的得票率击败共和党候选人弗兰克·A·林尼。当时，比克特是该州检察长；林尼是律师，也是北卡罗来纳州共和党主席。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in Massachusetts
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in Massachusetts was held on November 7, 1916. Republican incumbent Henry Cabot Lodge defeated Democratic Mayor of Boston John F. Fitzgerald to win election to a fifth term. This was the first United States Senate election in Massachusetts decided by popular vote, as required by the Seventeenth Amendment to the United States Constitution.

zh.t: 1916年马萨诸塞州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年马萨诸塞州联邦参议院选举于1916年11月7日举行。共和党现任参议员亨利·卡伯特·洛奇击败波士顿民主党市长约翰·F·菲茨杰拉德，赢得第五个任期。这是马萨诸塞州首次按美国宪法第十七修正案的要求，由民众投票选举联邦参议员。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in South Dakota took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election in which all contemporary forty-eight states participated. Voters chose five electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Dakota voted for the Republican nominee, Supreme Court Justice Charles Evans Hughes of New York, over the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Woodrow Wilson of New Jersey.

zh.t: 1916年南达科他州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年11月7日，南达科他州举行总统选举，作为当时全部48个州都参与的1916年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。南达科他州支持共和党候选人、来自纽约州的最高法院大法官查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯，胜过民主党候选人、现任总统伍德罗·威尔逊。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all contemporary forty-eight states. Voters chose twelve representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Like all former Confederate states, North Carolina would during its "Redemption" develop a politics based upon Jim Crow laws, disfranchisement of its African-American population and dominance of the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1916年北卡罗来纳州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年11月7日，北卡罗来纳州举行总统选举，作为在当时全部48个州举行的1916年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出12名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。和其他前邦联州一样，北卡罗来纳州在“救赎”时期形成了一套以吉姆·克劳法、剥夺非裔美国人选举权和民主党主导为基础的政治格局。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the nationwide presidential election. State voters chose twelve representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Since the 1890s, Alabama had been effectively a one-party state ruled by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1916年阿拉巴马州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年11月7日，阿拉巴马州举行总统选举，作为全国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出12名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。自19世纪90年代以来，阿拉巴马州实际上一直是由民主党主导的一党州。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in North Dakota took place on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Senator Porter J. McCumber, a Republican, sought re-election in his first popular election. He won the Republican primary with a plurality and faced former Governor John Burke, the Democratic nominee, and E. R. Fry, the Socialist nominee, in the general election.

zh.t: 1916年北达科他州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年北达科他州联邦参议院选举于1916年11月7日举行。共和党现任参议员波特·J·麦坎伯首次参加民众投票选举，寻求连任。他以相对多数赢得共和党初选，随后在大选中面对民主党候选人、前州长约翰·伯克和社会党候选人E·R·弗莱。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Utah took place on November 7, 1916. All contemporary forty-eight states were part of the 1916 United States presidential election. State voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. This was the first election featuring as a distinct voting unit Duchesne County, which had been split from Wasatch County in 1915.

zh.s: 1916年11月7日，犹他州举行总统选举。当时全部48个州都参与了1916年美国总统选举。该州选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。这是杜申县首次作为单独选举单位投票；该县于1915年从瓦萨奇县划出。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Texas
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Texas took place on November 7, 1916. All contemporary forty-eight states were part of the 1916 United States presidential election. State voters chose 20 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Texas was overwhelmingly won by incumbent president Woodrow Wilson. Wilson defeated Charles Evans Hughes by a landslide margin of 59.47 percent.

zh.t: 1916年得克萨斯州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年11月7日，得克萨斯州举行总统选举。当时全部48个州都参与了1916年美国总统选举。该州选民选出20名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。现任总统伍德罗·威尔逊以压倒性优势赢得得克萨斯州，以59.47个百分点的优势击败查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the 1916 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Connecticut was won by the Republican nominee, U.S. Supreme Court Justice Charles Evans Hughes of New York, and his running mate Senator Charles W.

zh.t: 1916年康涅狄格州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年康涅狄格州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分，共有当时的48个州参与。选民选出7名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、美国最高法院大法官查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯及其竞选搭档、联邦参议员查尔斯·W·费尔班克斯赢得该州，击败了民主党候选人、时任总统伍德罗·威尔逊与副总统托马斯·R·马歇尔。

en.s: The 1916 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 7, 1916, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee George H. Middelkamp defeated Republican nominee Lorenzo Dow Thompson, Socialist nominee J. F. Harlow and Prohibition nominee Ed Brandt.

zh.s: 1916年密苏里州州财政长选举于1916年11月7日举行，选出该州州财政长。民主党候选人乔治·H·米德尔坎普击败共和党候选人洛伦佐·道·汤普森、社会党候选人J·F·哈洛、禁酒党候选人埃德·布兰特。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate elections in Arizona took place on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Henry F. Ashurst ran for reelection to a second term, defeating Republican former Territorial Governor Joseph H. Kibbey in the general election by a comfortable margin.

zh.t: 1916年亚利桑那州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年亚利桑那州联邦参议院选举于1916年11月7日举行。民主党现任联邦参议员亨利·F·阿瑟斯特竞选连任第二个任期，在大选中以较大优势击败共和党人、前领地州长约瑟夫·H·基比。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in Tennessee was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Democratic Senator Luke Lea ran for re-election to a second term, but was defeated for the Democratic nomination by U.S. Representative Kenneth McKellar. McKellar won the general election against Republican Governor of Tennessee Ben W. Hooper. This was the first popular election for U.S.

zh.t: 1916年田纳西州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1916年田纳西州美国参议院选举于11月7日举行。民主党籍现任参议员卢克·利亚寻求连任，但在党内提名中败给联邦众议员肯尼思·麦凯勒。麦凯勒在普选中击败共和党候选人、时任田纳西州州长本·W·胡珀。这是美国宪法第十七修正案获批准后，田纳西州首次举行联邦参议员普选。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 7, 1916 as part of the 1916 United States presidential election. Voters chose ten representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since the passage of a new constitution in 1898, Louisiana had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1916年路易斯安那州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1916年11月7日，路易斯安那州举行总统选举，作为1916年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出10名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。自1898年通过新宪法后，路易斯安那州一直是民主党主导的一党州。

en.s: The 1916 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Democratic Governor Edward Fitzsimmons Dunne was defeated by Republican nominee Frank Orren Lowden.

zh.s: 1916年伊利诺伊州州长选举于1916年11月7日举行。民主党现任州长爱德华·菲茨西蒙斯·邓恩败给共和党候选人弗兰克·奥伦·洛登。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Republican Miles Poindexter was running for a second term in office over Democratic former Senator George Turner and Socialist Bruce Rogers. Primary elections were held on September 12. Poindexter overcame a strong primary challenge from U.S. Representative William E. Humphrey and college president Enoch Albert Bryan.

zh.t: 1916年美国联邦参议院华盛顿州选举
zh.s: 1916年11月7日，华盛顿州举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍现任参议员迈尔斯·波因德克斯特竞选连任第二个任期，对手包括民主党前参议员乔治·特纳和社会党候选人布鲁斯·罗杰斯。初选于9月12日举行。波因德克斯特还击败了联邦众议员威廉·E·汉弗莱和大学校长伊诺克·艾伯特·布莱恩发起的有力挑战。

en.s: The 1916 New York state election was held on November 7, 1916, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the secretary of state, the state comptroller, the attorney general, the state treasurer, the state engineer, a U.S. senator, the chief judge and an associate judge of the New York Court of Appeals, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1916年11月7日，纽约州举行州选举，选出州长、副州长、州务卿、州审计长、总检察长、州财政部长、州工程师、一名联邦参议员、纽约州上诉法院首席法官和一名副法官，以及纽约州众议院和参议院全体议员。

en.t: 1916 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1916 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 7, 1916, as part of the wider United States presidential election. Voters chose 14 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. With the exception of a handful of historically Unionist North Georgia counties – chiefly Fannin but also to a lesser extent Pickens, Gilmer and Towns – Georgia since the 1880s had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1916年美国总统选举佐治亚州投票
zh.s: 1916年11月7日，作为全美总统选举的一部分，佐治亚州举行总统选举投票。选民选出14名代表，也就是选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。自19世纪80年代以来，佐治亚州基本上是一党主导的州，由民主党控制。例外主要是佐治亚州北部少数历史上支持联邦的县，尤其是范宁县，其次还有皮肯斯县、吉尔默县和汤斯县。

en.s: The 1916 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Democrat Ernest Lister defeated Republican nominee Henry McBride with 48.10% of the vote.

zh.s: 1916年11月7日，华盛顿州举行州长选举。民主党籍现任州长欧内斯特·利斯特以48.10%的得票率击败共和党候选人亨利·麦克布莱德。

en.t: 1916 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1916 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 7, 1916. Incumbent Democratic Senator James O'Gorman chose not to seek re-election. Republican William M. Calder was elected to succeed O'Gorman, defeating Democrat William F. McCombs.

zh.t: 1916年美国联邦参议院纽约州选举
zh.s: 1916年11月7日，纽约州举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍现任参议员詹姆斯·奥戈尔曼决定不竞选连任。共和党人威廉·M·考尔德当选，接替奥戈尔曼，并击败民主党候选人威廉·F·麦库姆斯。

en.s: The 1916 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1916, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee Hugh Dorsey overwhelmingly defeated Republican nominee Roscoe Pickett and Socialist party candidate Thomas M. Taylor. It was the first gubernatorial election to be contested by the Republican Party since 1876, and the last they would contest until 1966.

zh.s: 1916年11月7日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。民主党候选人休·多尔西以压倒性优势击败共和党候选人罗斯科·皮克特和社会党候选人托马斯·M·泰勒。这是共和党自1876年以来首次参加佐治亚州州长选举，也是此后直到1966年该党再次参选前的最后一次。

en.s: The 1916 Iowa Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1916 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 30 of the senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state senate districts in the 1916 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1916年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是1916年美国两年一度选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民在州参议院50个选区中的30个选区选出参议员。州参议员任期四年。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1916年全州50个州参议院选区的地图。

en.s: The October Revolution, also known as the Great October Socialist Revolution (in Soviet historiography), October coup, Bolshevik coup, Bolshevik Revolution, and occasionally the November Revolution, was the second of two revolutions in Russia in 1917. It was led by Vladimir Lenin's Bolsheviks as part of the broader Russian Revolution of 1917–1923. It began through an insurrection in Petrograd (now Saint Petersburg) on 7 November 1917 [O.S.

zh.s: 十月革命又称“大十月社会主义革命”（苏联史学中的称呼）、“十月政变”、“布尔什维克政变”或“布尔什维克革命”，是1917年俄国两场革命中的第二场。它由列宁领导的布尔什维克发动，是1917至1923年俄国革命的一部分。起义于1917年11月7日（俄历10月25日）在彼得格勒（今圣彼得堡）爆发。

en.s: The Battle of Hareira and Sheria was fought on 6–7 November 1917 when the Egyptian Expeditionary Force attacked and captured the Yildirim Army Group's defensive systems protecting Hareira and Sheria in the centre of the Gaza to Beersheba line, during the Southern Palestine Offensive of the Sinai and Palestine Campaign in World War I.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1917年11月6日至7日，埃及远征军进攻并攻占了耶尔德勒姆集团军在哈雷拉和谢里亚的防御阵地。这两处阵地位于加沙至别尔谢巴战线中部。战役属于第一次世界大战期间的西奈及巴勒斯坦战役南巴勒斯坦攻势。

en.s: The Charge at Sheria took place on 7 November 1917 during the Battle of Hareira and Sheria when the 11th and 12th Light Horse Regiments (4th Light Horse Brigade) charged a Yildirim Army Group rearguard in support of an attack by the 60th (London) Division during the Southern Palestine Offensive of the Sinai and Palestine Campaign in World War I.

zh.s: 1917年11月7日，第一次世界大战西奈及巴勒斯坦战役南巴勒斯坦攻势期间，第4轻骑兵旅所属第11和第12轻骑兵团在谢里亚发动冲锋，攻击耶尔德勒姆集团军的后卫部队，以支援第60伦敦师的进攻。

en.s: The Passage of the Grande Honnelle was a battle between troops of the British First and Third Armies and German Empire forces during the Hundred Days Offensive of the First World War. The action took place in and around the Belgian municipality of Honnelles, between 5 and 7 November 1918.

zh.t: 格朗德奥内勒河渡河战
zh.s: 格朗德奥内勒河渡河战是第一次世界大战“百日攻势”期间，英军第一和第三集团军与德意志帝国军队之间的一场战斗。战斗于1918年11月5日至7日在比利时埃诺省昂内勒市镇及其周边地区进行。

en.t: 1918 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1918 United States Senate elections in New Jersey were held on November 7, 1918. Incumbent Democratic Senator William Hughes died in office in January. Republican governor of New Jersey Walter Evans Edge was elected to the six-year term over Democrat George LaMonte. In a special election held the same day, interim Senator David Baird Sr. (whom Edge had appointed) was elected to serve the remainder of Senator Hughes' term over Charles O'Connor Hennessy.

zh.t: 1918年新泽西州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1918年新泽西州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。现任民主党参议员威廉·休斯于1月在任内去世。共和党新泽西州州长沃尔特·埃文斯·埃奇当选，赢得六年任期，击败民主党人乔治·拉蒙特。同日还举行了一场特别选举，以填补休斯的剩余任期。埃奇任命的临时参议员老戴维·贝尔德也参加选举，并击败查尔斯·奥康纳·轩尼诗，当选填补休斯的剩余任期。

en.s: The 1918 Liechtenstein putsch (German: Novemberputsch 1918), also known as the Beck putsch, was a de facto coup d'état conducted by Wilhelm Beck, Fritz Walser, and Martin Ritter on 7 November against the government of Governor of Liechtenstein, Leopold Freiherr von Imhof. The coup forced Imhof's government to resign and established a Provisional Executive Committee in his place until 7 December.

zh.s: 1918年11月7日，威廉·贝克、弗里茨·瓦尔泽和马丁·里特发动事实上的政变，推翻列支敦士登总督利奥波德·冯·伊姆霍夫男爵领导的政府。此次政变也称“1918年十一月政变”或贝克政变。伊姆霍夫政府被迫辞职，临时执行委员会接替其职务，直至12月7日。

en.s: The Battle of Alexandropol was a conflict between the First Republic of Armenia and Turkish Revolutionaries of the Turkish National Movement which was on November 7, 1920 at Alexandropol.

zh.s: 亚历山德罗波尔战役于1920年11月7日发生在亚历山德罗波尔，是亚美尼亚第一共和国与土耳其民族运动中的土耳其革命者之间的一场冲突。

en.s: The 1922 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1922. George W. P. Hunt was Arizona's first governor, after retiring in 1919 he served as Ambassador to Siam during the tail end of the Wilson administration. After being dismissed by Harding, Hunt returned to Arizona and decided to contest his old seat. Both Hunt and Campbell faced off in 1916, the closest gubernatorial in Arizona history. This election was the highest percentage of votes Hunt ever got in his 7 gubernatorial races. Governor W. P. Hunt was sworn in for a 4th term as Governor on January 1, 1923.

zh.s: 1922年亚利桑那州州长选举于11月7日举行。乔治·W·P·亨特是亚利桑那州首任州长，1919年退休后，在威尔逊政府末期出任驻暹罗大使。哈定总统将他免职后，亨特回到亚利桑那州，决定竞选曾担任过的州长职位。亨特和坎贝尔曾在1916年交锋，那是亚利桑那州州长选举史上差距最小的一次。此次选举是亨特七次州长选举中得票率最高的一次。他于1923年1月1日宣誓就任第四个州长任期。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1922
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1922 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 7, 1922. The districts were not reapportioned after the 1920 Census (California would have gained three districts as a result of the 1920 Census), so the state's delegation remained at 11 representatives, and the partisan makeup remained unchanged, at 9 Republicans and 2 Democrats.

zh.t: 1922年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1922年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举是11月7日举行的联邦众议院普选的一部分。根据1920年人口普查，加州本可增加3个席位，但各选区没有重新划分，因此该州仍有11名联邦众议员，党派构成也没有变化：9名共和党人和2名民主党人。

en.t: United States Senate elections in Pennsylvania, 1922
en.s: (This article is about the elections held in 1922 for Pennsylvania's Class 1 Senate seat. For the special election also held that year for Pennsylvania's Class 3 Senate seat, see United States Senate special election in Pennsylvania, 1922.) The 1922 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator David A. Reed, who was appointed in August 1922 to fill the vacancy created by the death of William E. Crow, was elected both to complete the remainder of Crow's term, ending in March 1923, and to a full six-year term in his own right, beginning upon the expiration of Crow's term.

zh.t: 1922年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行，选举的是该州第一类参议员席位。共和党籍现任参议员戴维·A·里德于1922年8月获任命，填补威廉·E·克劳去世后留下的空缺。里德在选举中当选，先完成克劳剩余任期至1923年3月，之后开始自己的完整六年任期。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1922
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 7, 1922. Incumbent United States Senator Henry L. Myers, who was first elected to the Senate in 1910, and was re-elected in 1916, declined to seek re-election. Former United States Attorney Burton K. Wheeler won the Democratic primary and advanced to the general election, where he faced Carl W. Riddick, the United States Congressman from Montana's 2nd congressional district and the Republican nominee. Ultimately, Wheeler defeated Riddick comfortably and won his first term in the Senate.

zh.t: 1922年蒙大拿州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年蒙大拿州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。现任参议员亨利·L·迈尔斯于1910年首次当选、1916年连任，但决定不再竞选。前联邦检察官伯顿·K·惠勒赢得民主党初选，进入大选，对手是蒙大拿州第二国会选区联邦众议员、共和党候选人卡尔·W·里迪克。惠勒以明显优势击败里迪克，赢得他的第一个参议员任期。

en.t: United States Senate election in Vermont, 1922
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in Vermont took place on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican Carroll S. Page did not run for re-election to another term in the United States Senate. Republican candidate Frank L. Greene defeated Democratic candidate William B. Mayo to succeed him.

zh.t: 1922年佛蒙特州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年佛蒙特州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。共和党籍现任参议员卡罗尔·S·佩奇没有寻求连任。共和党候选人弗兰克·L·格林击败民主党候选人威廉·B·梅奥，接替佩奇。

en.s: The 1922 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1922. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate J. A. O. Preus defeated Farmer–Labor Party challenger Magnus Johnson.

en.s: The Vermont gubernatorial election of 1922 took place on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican James Hartness, per the "Mountain Rule", did not run for re-election to a second term as Governor of Vermont. Republican candidate Redfield Proctor, Jr. defeated Democratic candidate J. Holmes Jackson to succeed him.

zh.s: 1922年佛蒙特州州长选举于11月7日举行。按照“山地规则”，共和党籍现任州长詹姆斯·哈特内斯没有竞选第二个任期。共和党候选人雷德菲尔德·普罗克特二世击败民主党候选人J·霍姆斯·杰克逊，接替他出任州长。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1922 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 7, 1922. Democrat George Sebastian Silzer defeated Republican nominee William Nelson Runyon with 52.19% of the vote.

zh.s: 1922年新泽西州州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党候选人乔治·塞巴斯蒂安·西尔泽以52.19%的选票击败共和党候选人威廉·纳尔逊·伦扬。

en.t: United States Senate election in Virginia, 1922
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in Virginia was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Senator Claude A. Swanson was re-elected to a third term after defeating Republican J. W. McGavock. Swanson and fellow Senator Carter Glass were the first U.S. Senators to be elected by popular vote (Swanson ran unopposed in 1916) following the passage of the 17th Amendment.

zh.t: 1922年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。民主党籍现任参议员克劳德·A·斯旺森击败共和党候选人J·W·麦加沃克，连任第三届。斯旺森和同为弗吉尼亚州参议员的卡特·格拉斯，是美国宪法第十七修正案通过后首批通过普选当选的联邦参议员之一（斯旺森在1916年没有对手）。

en.s: The Pennsylvania gubernatorial election of 1922 occurred on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican governor William Sproul was not a candidate for re-election. Republican candidate Gifford Pinchot defeated Democratic candidate John A. McSparran to become Governor of Pennsylvania.

en.t: United States Senate special election in Pennsylvania, 1922
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate special election in Pennsylvania was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican Senator George Pepper, who had been appointed to the seat by Governor William Sproul following the death of Boies Penrose, was elected to fill the remaining four years on the term to which Penrose had been elected in 1920. Pepper comfortably defeated five other candidates, including Democratic nominee Fred Kerr of Clearfield County.

zh.t: 1922年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1922年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院特别选举于11月7日举行。共和党籍现任参议员乔治·佩珀曾由州长威廉·斯普劳尔任命，填补博伊斯·彭罗斯去世后留下的席位。这次选举中，佩珀当选，完成彭罗斯于1920年当选的六年任期中剩余的四年。佩珀以明显优势击败其他5名候选人，其中包括来自克利尔菲尔德县的民主党候选人弗雷德·克尔。
