en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1922, in 33 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections, on November 7, 1922. Elections took place on October 3 in Arkansas, and September 11 in Maine.

zh.s: 1922年，美国33个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院和参议院选举同时进行，选举日为11月7日。阿肯色州于10月3日举行选举，缅因州于9月11日举行。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate elections in Delaware
en.s: Two 1922 United States Senate elections in Delaware took place on November 7, 1922. The elections pitted Delaware's two most powerful families, the Republican du Ponts and the Democratic Bayards, against each other. Incumbent Democratic senator Josiah O. Wolcott resigned on July 2, 1921, to accept an appointment as Chancellor of Delaware. Governor William D. Denney appointed businessman and Republican National Committeeman T.

zh.t: 1922年特拉华州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年11月7日，特拉华州举行了两场美国参议院选举。共和党杜邦家族与民主党贝亚德家族这两个州内最有势力的家族在选举中交锋。民主党籍现任参议员约西亚·O·沃尔科特于1921年7月2日辞职，出任特拉华州衡平法院院长。州长威廉·D·丹尼任命商人兼共和党全国委员会委员T·科尔曼·杜邦接替空缺。

en.t: 1922 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico
en.s: The 1922 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on November 7, 1922, to elect the state's at-large representative. This election coincided with other state and local offices such as the concurrent Governor election. Democratic nominee John Morrow defeated Republican Adelina Otero-Warren by a margin of 8.84 percentage points, flipping this seat from Republican to Democratic.

zh.t: 1922年新墨西哥州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1922年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举于1922年11月7日举行，选出该州的不分区代表。选举与州长等其他州级和地方职位选举同时举行。民主党候选人约翰·莫罗以8.84个百分点的优势击败共和党候选人阿德丽娜·奥特罗-沃伦，使该席位从共和党转为民主党。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican Senator Joseph I. France ran for re-election to a second term in office, but was defeated by Democrat William Cabell Bruce.

zh.t: 1922年马里兰州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年马里兰州联邦参议院选举于1922年11月7日举行。共和党现任参议员约瑟夫·I·弗朗斯竞选连任第二个任期，但败给民主党人威廉·卡贝尔·布鲁斯。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 7, 1922. Farmer–Labor challenger Henrik Shipstead defeated incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Frank B. Kellogg and Democratic challenger Anna Dickie Olesen. The 1922 U.S. Senate election in Minnesota was significant for a number of reasons. Olesen was the first woman nominated by a major political party in an election to the United States Senate.

zh.t: 1922年明尼苏达州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年明尼苏达州联邦参议院选举于1922年11月7日举行。农民—劳工党候选人亨里克·希普斯特德击败共和党现任联邦参议员弗兰克·B·凯洛格和民主党候选人安娜·迪基·奥莱森。安娜·奥莱森是首位获主要政党提名竞选联邦参议员的女性，因此这场选举有多方面的意义。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate special election in Iowa
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate special election in Iowa took place on November 7, 1922. Republican Smith W. Brookhart was elected to complete the unexpired term of William S. Kenyon, defeating Democrat Clyde Herring.

zh.t: 1922年艾奥瓦州美国联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1922年艾奥瓦州联邦参议院特别选举于1922年11月7日举行。共和党人史密斯·W·布鲁克哈特当选，填补威廉·S·肯扬未满的任期，并击败民主党人克莱德·赫林。

en.s: The 1922 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1922, to elect the governor of the U.S. state of Oregon. The election matched incumbent Republican Ben W. Olcott against Democrat Walter M. Pierce. With the support of the Ku Klux Klan, then a powerful political force in the state, Pierce won the election by a wide margin.

zh.s: 1922年俄勒冈州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行，选出该州州长。共和党现任州长本·W·奥尔科特与民主党人沃尔特·M·皮尔斯对决。皮尔斯得到三K党支持；当时该组织在州内拥有强大政治影响力。皮尔斯以较大优势获胜。

en.s: The 1922 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Governor Channing H. Cox was re-elected over U.S. Representative John F. "Honey Fitz" Fitzgerald for a second term in office. This was the first gubernatorial election in which the governor's term was changed from one year to two years.

zh.s: 1922年马萨诸塞州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。现任州长钱宁·H·考克斯击败联邦众议员约翰·F·“霍尼·菲茨”·菲茨杰拉德，成功连任第二个任期。这是该州州长任期从一年改为两年后的首次州长选举。

en.s: The 1922 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922. Primary elections were held on September 5, 1922. Incumbent Republican Governor John J. Blaine won re-election to a second term, defeating Democratic nominee Arthur A. Bentley and Socialist nominee Louis A. Arnold. To date, this is the only time any gubernatorial candidate in Wisconsin has won every county in the state.

zh.s: 1922年威斯康星州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。初选于1922年9月5日举行。共和党现任州长约翰·J·布莱恩击败民主党候选人阿瑟·A·本特利和社会党候选人路易斯·A·阿诺德，成功连任第二个任期。迄今为止，这是威斯康星州州长候选人唯一一次赢得该州所有县。

en.s: The 1922 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1922, in order to elect the governor of Alabama. Democratic incumbent Thomas Kilby was term-limited, and could not seek a second consecutive term.

zh.s: 1922年阿拉巴马州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行，选出该州州长。民主党现任州长托马斯·基尔比已任满，不能竞选连续第二个任期。

en.s: The 1922 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican Lieutenant Governor C. C. Young defeated Democratic State Senator William B. Shearer with 67.28% of the vote.

zh.t: 1922年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1922年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。共和党现任副州长C·C·杨以67.28%的得票率击败民主党州参议员威廉·B·希尔。

en.s: The 1922 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican Ragnvald Nestos defeated Nonpartisan League nominee William Lemke with 57.65% of the vote.

zh.s: 1922年北达科他州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。共和党现任州长拉格瓦尔德·内斯托斯以57.65%的得票率击败无党派联盟候选人威廉·莱姆克。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1922 in New Jersey was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican senator Joseph Frelinghuysen ran for re-election to a second term in office but was defeated by Democratic governor Jersey Edward I. Edwards. Primary elections were held September 26. Frelinghuysen defeated a progressive challenger, George Record, in the Republican primary, while Edwards was unopposed for the Democratic nomination.

zh.t: 1922年新泽西州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年新泽西州联邦参议院选举于1922年11月7日举行。共和党现任参议员约瑟夫·弗雷林海森竞选连任第二个任期，但败给民主党人、州长爱德华·I·爱德华兹。初选于9月26日举行。弗雷林海森在共和党初选中击败进步派对手乔治·里科德，爱德华兹则在民主党提名中没有对手。

en.s: The 1922 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Democrat Jack C. Walton defeated Republican John Fields. Also on the ballot was O. E. Enfield of the Socialist Party.

zh.s: 1922年俄克拉何马州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行，选出该州州长。民主党人杰克·C·沃尔顿击败共和党人约翰·菲尔兹。社会党候选人O·E·恩菲尔德也列入选票。

en.s: The 1922 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican Governor Robert D. Carey ran for re-election, but was narrowly defeated for renomination by banker John W. Hay. In the Democratic primary, William B. Ross, a 1918 candidate for Governor and the former Laramie County Attorney, defeated former State Representative George Kindler and Frank McDowell.

zh.s: 1922年怀俄明州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。共和党现任州长罗伯特·D·凯里竞选连任，但在党内提名中以微弱差距败给银行家约翰·W·海。民主党初选中，1918年曾竞选州长、前拉勒米县检察官威廉·B·罗斯击败前州众议员乔治·金德勒和弗兰克·麦克道尔。

en.s: The 1922 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican Governor William H. McMaster ran for re-election to a second term. After beating back a challenge in the Republican primary from perennial candidate George W. Egan, McMaster advanced to the general election, where he faced former State Senate President Louis N.

zh.s: 1922年南达科他州州长选举于11月7日举行。共和党籍现任州长威廉·H·麦克马斯特竞选连任，争取第二个任期。他在共和党初选中击退长期参选的乔治·W·伊根的挑战，随后进入大选，对手是民主党提名的前州参议院议长路易斯·N·克里尔。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in California was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican Senator Hiram Johnson was re-elected to his second term in office. His greatest challenge came from fellow Republican Charles C. Moore, a citrus and olive rancher.

zh.t: 1922年加利福尼亚州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年加利福尼亚州联邦参议院选举于1922年11月7日举行。共和党现任参议员海勒姆·约翰逊连任，进入第二个任期。他遇到的最强劲对手是另一名共和党人查尔斯·C·摩尔，一名柑橘和橄榄种植园主。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in Tennessee was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Democratic Senator Kenneth D. McKellar was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Republican former interim Senator Newell Sanders.

zh.t: 1922年田纳西州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年田纳西州联邦参议院选举于1922年11月7日举行。民主党现任参议员肯尼思·D·麦凯勒击败共和党人、前临时参议员纽厄尔·桑德斯，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1922 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922. Democratic nominee Jonathan M. Davis defeated Republican nominee William Yoast Morgan with 50.87% of the vote.

zh.s: 1922年堪萨斯州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。民主党候选人乔纳森·M·戴维斯以50.87%的得票率击败共和党候选人威廉·约斯特·摩根。

en.s: The 1922 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922. Democratic nominee A. Victor Donahey narrowly defeated Republican nominee Carmi Thompson with 50.56% of the vote.

zh.s: 1922年俄亥俄州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。民主党候选人A·维克托·多纳希以50.56%的得票率险胜共和党候选人卡米·汤普森。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in North Dakota took place on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican Senator Porter J. McCumber sought re-election, but was defeated in the Republican primary by Lynn Frazier, the former Governor of North Dakota, who had been recalled in 1921. In the general election, Frazier faced former State Representative James Francis Thaddeus O'Connor, the Democratic nominee.

zh.t: 1922年北达科他州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年北达科他州联邦参议院选举于1922年11月7日举行。共和党现任参议员波特·J·麦坎伯竞选连任，但在共和党初选中败给前州长林恩·弗雷泽；弗雷泽于1921年被罢免。在大选中，弗雷泽面对民主党候选人、前州众议员詹姆斯·弗朗西斯·萨迪厄斯·奥康纳。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Democratic Senator Atlee Pomerene ran for re-election to a third term in office, but was defeated by Republican U.S. Representative Simeon Fess.

zh.t: 1922年俄亥俄州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年俄亥俄州联邦参议院选举于1922年11月7日举行。民主党现任参议员阿特利·波默伦竞选连任第三个任期，但败给共和党联邦众议员西缅·费斯。

en.s: The 1922 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922. Democratic nominee Austin Peay defeated incumbent Republican governor Alfred A. Taylor with 57.9% of the vote. Peay narrowly won the Democratic primary against Benton McMillin, defeating him by a little over 2%. With this win, Peay flipped the state back into Democratic control, with the state legislature also being controlled by Democrats.

zh.s: 1922年田纳西州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。民主党候选人奥斯汀·皮伊以57.9%的得票率击败共和党现任州长阿尔弗雷德·A·泰勒。皮伊在民主党初选中以略高于2个百分点的优势险胜本顿·麦克米林。皮伊胜选后，田纳西州州政府恢复由民主党掌控，州议会也由民主党控制。

en.t: 1922 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1922 United States House of Representatives elections were elections for the United States House of Representatives to elect members to serve in the 68th United States Congress. They were held for the most part on November 7, 1922, though Maine held its on September 11. They occurred in the middle of President Warren G. Harding's term.

zh.s: 1922年美国联邦众议院选举用于选出第68届国会的联邦众议员，大多于1922年11月7日举行，缅因州则于9月11日提前投票。选举在沃伦·G·哈定总统任期中举行。

en.s: The 1922 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922 in order to elect the Governor of Texas. Incumbent Democratic Governor Pat Morris Neff won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican candidate William Hawley Atwell in a landslide.

zh.s: 1922年得克萨斯州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行，选出该州州长。民主党现任州长帕特·莫里斯·内夫击败共和党候选人威廉·霍利·阿特韦尔，以压倒性优势连任，进入第二个任期。

en.s: The 1922 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922. Republican nominee Charles A. Templeton defeated Democratic nominee David Fitzgerald with 52.37% of the vote.

zh.s: 1922年康涅狄格州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。共和党候选人查尔斯·A·坦普尔顿以52.37%的得票率击败民主党候选人大卫·菲茨杰拉德。

en.s: The 1922 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922. Republican nominee Charles C. Moore defeated Progressive nominee H. F. Samuels with 39.53% of the vote.

zh.s: 1922年爱达荷州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。共和党候选人查尔斯·C·摩尔以39.53%的得票率击败进步党候选人H·F·塞缪尔斯。

en.s: The 1922 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922. Democratic nominee James G. Scrugham defeated Republican nominee John H. Miller with 53.88% of the vote.

zh.s: 1922年内华达州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。民主党候选人詹姆斯·G·斯克拉姆以53.88%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·H·米勒。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in Missouri
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in Missouri was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator James A. Reed was re-elected to a third term over Republican R. R. Brewster.

zh.t: 1922年密苏里州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年密苏里州联邦参议院选举于1922年11月7日举行。民主党现任联邦参议员詹姆斯·A·里德击败共和党人R·R·布鲁斯特，连任第三个任期。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in Connecticut was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican Senator George P. McLean was re-elected to a third term in office over Democratic attorney Thomas J. Spellacy.

zh.t: 1922年康涅狄格州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年康涅狄格州联邦参议院选举于1922年11月7日举行。共和党现任参议员乔治·P·麦克莱恩击败民主党律师托马斯·J·斯佩拉西，连任第三个任期。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in Wyoming took place on November 7, 1922. First-term Democratic Senator John B. Kendrick ran for re-election to a second term. He was opposed by Republican Congressman Frank W. Mondell, the Majority Leader of the U.S. House of Representatives. Kendrick won re-election by a wide margin, defeating Mondell, despite his long record of representing the state in Congress, with 57% of the vote to Mondell's 43%.

zh.t: 1922年怀俄明州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年怀俄明州联邦参议院选举于1922年11月7日举行。民主党参议员约翰·B·肯德里克在第一个任期结束后竞选连任。共和党对手是联邦众议员、联邦众议院多数党领袖弗兰克·W·蒙德尔。尽管蒙德尔长期代表该州在国会任职，肯德里克仍以较大优势连任，得票率为57%，蒙德尔为43%。

en.s: The 1922 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922. Democratic nominee William S. Flynn defeated Republican nominee Harold J. Gross with 51.72% of the vote.

zh.s: 1922年罗得岛州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。民主党候选人威廉·S·弗林以51.72%的得票率击败共和党候选人哈罗德·J·格罗斯。

en.s: The 1922 Connecticut Attorney General election was held on November 7, 1922, in order to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Republican nominee and incumbent Attorney General Frank E. Healy defeated Democratic nominee Benjamin Slade.

zh.t: 1922年康涅狄格州州检察长选举
zh.s: 1922年康涅狄格州州检察长选举于1922年11月7日举行，选出该州州检察长。共和党候选人、现任州检察长弗兰克·E·希利击败民主党候选人本杰明·斯莱德。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in Michigan was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican Senator Charles E. Townsend ran for re-election to a third term in office, but was defeated by Democratic former Governor Woodbridge N. Ferris. Ferris was the first Democrat popularly elected to represent Michigan in the Senate, as Democrats last won a Senate seat in 1859, and last held this seat in 1857.

zh.t: 1922年密歇根州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年密歇根州联邦参议院选举于1922年11月7日举行。共和党现任参议员查尔斯·E·汤森德竞选连任第三个任期，但败给民主党前州长伍德布里奇·N·费里斯。费里斯是首位经民众选举进入联邦参议院的密歇根州民主党人；该州民主党人上一次赢得参议院席位是在1859年，上一次占有这个席位则是在1857年。

en.s: The 1922 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican Alex J. Groesbeck defeated Democratic nominee Alva M. Cummins with 61.15% of the vote.

zh.s: 1922年密歇根州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。共和党现任州长亚历克斯·J·格罗斯贝克以61.15%的得票率击败民主党候选人阿尔瓦·M·卡明斯。

en.s: The 1922 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 7, 1922, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Mike Holm defeated Farmer–Labor nominee Susie W. Stageberg and Democratic nominee Claude Swanson.

zh.s: 1922年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于1922年11月7日举行，选出该州州务卿。共和党候选人、现任州务卿迈克·霍尔姆击败农民—劳工党候选人苏西·W·斯泰奇伯格和民主党候选人克劳德·斯旺森。

en.s: The 1922 New Mexico gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922. Democratic candidate James F. Hinkle defeated Republican nominee Charles Lee Hill with 54.57% of the vote. McKinley County, Socorro County, and Torrance County all backed a Democratic gubernatorial candidate for the first time ever in this election; the latter would not do so again until 1936.

zh.s: 1922年新墨西哥州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。民主党候选人詹姆斯·F·欣克尔以54.57%的得票率击败共和党候选人查尔斯·李·希尔。麦金莱县、索科罗县和托兰斯县在这次选举中首次支持民主党州长候选人；托兰斯县直到1936年才再次这样投票。

en.s: The 1922 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican Nathan E. Kendall defeated Democratic nominee J.R. Files with 70.54% of the vote.

zh.s: 1922年艾奥瓦州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。共和党现任州长内森·E·肯德尔以70.54%的得票率击败民主党候选人J·R·菲尔斯。

en.s: The 1922 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922. Democratic nominee Fred H. Brown defeated Republican nominee Windsor H. Goodnow with 53.28% of the vote. Brown became the first Democrat elected Governor since 1912. This was the last time until 1962 that a Democrat was elected Governor of New Hampshire.

zh.s: 1922年新罕布什尔州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。民主党候选人弗雷德·H·布朗以53.28%的得票率击败共和党候选人温莎·H·古德诺。布朗是自1912年以来首位当选州长的民主党人。直到1962年，才再次有民主党人当选新罕布什尔州州长。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in Florida
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in Florida was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Democratic Senator Park Trammell was easily re-elected to a second term in office over Independent Republican W. C. Lawson.

zh.t: 1922年佛罗里达州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年佛罗里达州联邦参议院选举于1922年11月7日举行。民主党现任参议员帕克·特拉梅尔轻松击败独立共和党人W·C·劳森，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1922 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 7, 1922, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Clifford L. Hilton defeated Farmer–Labor nominee and former member of the Wisconsin State Assembly Roy C. Smelker and Democratic nominee James E. Doran.

zh.t: 1922年明尼苏达州州检察长选举
zh.s: 1922年明尼苏达州州检察长选举于1922年11月7日举行，选出该州州检察长。共和党候选人、现任州检察长克利福德·L·希尔顿击败农民—劳工党候选人、前威斯康星州众议员罗伊·C·斯梅尔克，以及民主党候选人詹姆斯·E·多兰。

en.s: The 1922 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922, and featured Republican nominee Fred G. Johnson defeating Democratic nominee P. J. Mullin as well as Progressive nominee T. J. Ellsberry. Incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Pelham A. Barrows, a Republican, chose not to seek reelection to the office of lieutenant governor in order to run for the vacant seat of C.

zh.t: 1922年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1922年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月7日举行。共和党候选人弗雷德·G·约翰逊击败民主党候选人P·J·马林和进步党候选人T·J·埃尔斯伯里。共和党籍现任副州长佩勒姆·A·巴罗兹没有寻求连任，而是竞选C·弗兰克·里维斯留下的联邦众议员空缺席位；他未能获得共和党提名。

en.s: The 1922 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922, and featured former Mayor of Lincoln Charles W. Bryan, a Democrat and brother of William Jennings Bryan, defeating Republican nominee, state Senator Charles H. Randall.

zh.s: 1922年内布拉斯加州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。民主党人、林肯市前市长查尔斯·W·布莱恩（威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩的兄弟）击败共和党候选人、州参议员查尔斯·H·兰德尔。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Robert M. La Follette was re-elected to a fourth term in office over Democrat Jessie Jack Hooper. Off the strength of his landslide victory, La Follette launched a second campaign for President of the United States in 1924.

zh.t: 1922年威斯康星州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年威斯康星州联邦参议院选举于1922年11月7日举行。共和党现任联邦参议员罗伯特·M·拉福莱特击败民主党人杰西·杰克·胡珀，连任第四个任期。凭借压倒性优势胜选，拉福莱特于1924年再次竞选美国总统。

en.s: The 1922 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Lieutenant Governor Louis L. Collins of the Republican Party of Minnesota defeated Minnesota Farmer–Labor Party challenger Arthur A. Siegler and Minnesota Democratic Party candidate Silas M. Bryan.

zh.s: 1922年明尼苏达州副州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。明尼苏达州共和党现任副州长路易斯·L·柯林斯击败明尼苏达农民—劳工党候选人阿瑟·A·齐格勒和明尼苏达州民主党候选人塞拉斯·M·布莱恩。

en.s: The 1922 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1922. Democratic nominee William Ellery Sweet defeated Republican nominee Benjamin Griffith with 49.64% of the vote.

zh.s: 1922年科罗拉多州州长选举于1922年11月7日举行。民主党候选人威廉·埃勒里·斯威特以49.64%的得票率击败共和党候选人本杰明·格里菲斯。

en.t: 1922 United States House of Representatives election in Arizona
en.s: The 1922 United States House of Representatives elections in Arizona was held on Tuesday November 7, 1922 to elect the state's sole at-large representative. Incumbent democrat, Carl Hayden won re-election to a seventh term with 76 percent of the vote against Republican candidate, Emma Guild's 24 percent of the vote. Both nominees were unopposed in their primary elections which were held on September 12, 1922.

zh.t: 1922年亚利桑那州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1922年亚利桑那州联邦众议院选举于1922年11月7日星期二举行，选出该州唯一的不分区代表。民主党现任议员卡尔·海登以76%的得票率连任第七个任期，共和党候选人艾玛·吉尔德获得24%的选票。两位候选人在1922年9月12日举行的初选中都没有对手。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in Texas
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in Texas was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Charles Culberson ran for re-election to a fifth term, but lost the Democratic primary. A runoff was held between former Governor Pa Ferguson and Railroads Commissioner Earle Bradford Mayfield. In the runoff, Mayfield, a member of the Texas Railroad Commission defeated Ferguson for the Democratic nomination, then tantamount to election in Texas as a legacy of the American Civil War.

zh.t: 1922年得克萨斯州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年得克萨斯州联邦参议院选举于1922年11月7日举行。民主党现任联邦参议员查尔斯·卡尔伯森竞选第五个任期，但在民主党初选中落败。随后，前州长帕·弗格森与铁路委员会委员厄尔·布拉德福德·梅菲尔德进行决选。梅菲尔德本人是得克萨斯州铁路委员会委员，他在决选中击败弗格森，赢得民主党提名；由于南北战争留下的政治传统，民主党候选人基本等同于胜选者。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Harry Stewart New ran for re-election to a second term in office, but was defeated in the Republican primary by former Republican Senator Albert J. Beveridge who was seeking a comeback. In the general election, Beveridge was defeated by Democratic former Governor of Indiana Samuel M. Ralston.

zh.t: 1922年印第安纳州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1922年印第安纳州联邦参议院选举于1922年11月7日举行。共和党现任联邦参议员哈里·斯图尔特·纽竞选连任第二个任期，但在共和党初选中败给寻求东山再起的前共和党参议员阿尔伯特·J·贝弗里奇。贝弗里奇在大选中又败给民主党前州长塞缪尔·M·拉尔斯顿。

en.s: The 1922 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 7, 1922, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee Ray P. Chase defeated Farmer–Labor nominee Eliza Evans Deming and Democratic nominee John E. Casey.

zh.t: 1922年明尼苏达州州审计长选举
zh.s: 1922年明尼苏达州州审计长选举于1922年11月7日举行，选出该州州审计长。共和党候选人雷·P·蔡斯击败农民—劳工党候选人伊丽莎·埃文斯·德明和民主党候选人约翰·E·凯西。

en.s: The 1922 New York state election was held on November 7, 1922, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the Secretary of State, the state comptroller, the attorney general, the state treasurer, the state engineer and a U.S. senator, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate. Two amendments to the State Constitution were also proposed.

zh.s: 1922年11月7日，纽约州举行州选举，选出州长、副州长、州务卿、州审计长、总检察长、州财政部长、州工程师、一名联邦参议员，以及纽约州众议院和参议院全体议员。选民还就两项州宪法修正案进行表决。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican Miles Poindexter ran for a third term in office, but was defeated by Democrat Clarence C. Dill in a three-way race that also featured Farmer-Labor nominee James Duncan.

zh.t: 1922年美国联邦参议院华盛顿州选举
zh.s: 1922年11月7日，华盛顿州举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍现任参议员迈尔斯·波因德克斯特竞选第三个任期，但在包括农工党候选人詹姆斯·邓肯在内的三人角逐中败给民主党人克拉伦斯·C·迪尔。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 7, 1922. Incumbent Republican Senator William Calder ran for re-election to a second term, but was defeated by Democrat Royal Copeland.

zh.t: 1922年美国联邦参议院纽约州选举
zh.s: 1922年11月7日，纽约州举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍现任参议员威廉·考尔德竞选连任第二个任期，但败给民主党人罗亚尔·科普兰。

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in Massachusetts
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate election in Massachusetts was held on Tuesday, November 7. Incumbent Republican Senator Henry Cabot Lodge was narrowly re-elected to a sixth term in office over Democrat William A. Gaston.

zh.t: 1922年美国联邦参议院马萨诸塞州选举
zh.s: 1922年11月7日，星期二，马萨诸塞州举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍现任参议员亨利·卡伯特·洛奇以微弱优势击败民主党人威廉·A·加斯顿，连任第六个任期。

en.s: The 1922 United States Senate elections were elections that occurred in the middle of Republican President Warren G. Harding's term. The 32 seats of Class 1 were contested in regular elections, and special elections were held to fill vacancies. With the Republicans divided between conservative and progressive factions, the Democrats gained six net seats from the Republicans while the Farmer–Labor party gained one.

zh.s: 1922年美国联邦参议院选举在共和党籍总统沃伦·G·哈定任期中举行。第一类32个席位通过常规选举改选，另举行特别选举填补空缺。共和党内部的保守派与进步派发生分裂，民主党从共和党手中净增六席，农工党则增加一席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: 1922 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 1922 United States Senate elections in Arizona was held on Tuesday, November 7, to elect one United States Senator. Democratic candidate United States Senator Incumbent Henry F. Ashurst ran for reelection to a third term, defeating Republican candidate James H. McClintock in the general election by a wide margin.

zh.t: 1922年美国联邦参议院亚利桑那州选举
zh.s: 1922年11月7日，星期二，亚利桑那州举行联邦参议院选举，选出一名联邦参议员。民主党籍现任参议员亨利·F·阿什赫斯特竞选连任第三个任期，在普选中以较大优势击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·H·麦克林托克。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1922 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1922 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 21 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1922 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1922年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是1922年美国两年一度选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民在州参议院50个选区中的21个选区选出参议员。州参议员任期四年。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1922年全州50个州参议院选区的地图。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 7 November 1926. The Liberal Union emerged as the largest faction in Parliament with 108 of the 286 seats. The composition of the new parliament meant that the parties and factions had to work together to form a viable parliamentary government. On Kafandaris' initiative negotiations began among the main parties, leading to the swearing-in on the 4 December of a government under the premiership of Alexandros Zaimis who was not a member of parliament. The coalition consisted of the Liberal Union, the Democratic Union, the People's Party and the Freethinkers' Party.

zh.s: 希腊于1926年11月7日举行议会选举。自由联盟成为议会中最大的派别，在286个席位中获得108席。新议会的组成意味着各党派和派别必须合作，组建能够运作的议会政府。应卡凡达里斯倡议，主要政党开始谈判，最终于12月4日宣誓就职的新政府由不属于议会的亚历山德罗斯·扎伊米斯担任总理。联合政府由自由联盟、民主联盟、人民党和自由思想党组成。

en.t: Establishment of Museum of Modern Art
en.s: The Museum of Modern Art (MoMA) is an art museum located in Midtown Manhattan, New York City, on 53rd Street between Fifth and Sixth Avenues. MoMA's collection spans the late 19th century to the present, and includes over 200,000 works of architecture and design, drawing, painting, sculpture, photography, prints, illustrated and artist's books, film, as well as electronic media.

zh.s: 现代艺术博物馆（MoMA）位于纽约市曼哈顿中城，坐落在第五大道与第六大道之间的53街。馆藏涵盖19世纪末至今，超过20万件，涉及建筑与设计、素描、绘画、雕塑、摄影、版画、插画、艺术家书籍、电影和电子媒介。

en.s: The Battle of Kilometer 7 was a series of clashes during the Chaco War between Bolivian and Paraguayan forces from 7 November 1932 to February 1933, and ended with a Paraguayan retreat to the northeast towards Gondra, later to be the site of the Battle of Campo Jordán. The Paraguayan initiative, which had belonged to the Paraguayans since the beginning of the siege of Boquerón passed to the Bolivian army until the Second Battle of Nanawa in July.

zh.s: 查科战争期间，玻利维亚军队与巴拉圭军队于1932年11月7日至1933年2月在第7公里一带多次交战，统称第7公里战役。战役以巴拉圭军队向东北撤至贡德拉告终，贡德拉后来成为坎波霍尔丹战役的地点。博克龙围城战初期，战事主动权一直在巴拉圭一方；此后转到玻利维亚军队手中，直到7月的第二次纳纳瓦战役。

en.s: The 1933 Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1933 to elect the governor of Virginia.

zh.s: 1933年弗吉尼亚州州长选举于11月7日举行，选出弗吉尼亚州州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate special election in Virginia, 1933
en.s: The 1933 United States Senate special election in Virginia was held on November 7, 1933. Democratic former Governor Harry F. Byrd, Sr. was elected after defeating Republican Henry A. Wise. Byrd had been appointed to fill the vacany left by Claude A. Swanson after Swanson became the U.S. Secretary of the Navy earlier in the year.

zh.t: 1933年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1933年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院特别选举于11月7日举行。民主党籍前州长哈里·F·伯德击败共和党候选人亨利·A·怀斯，当选参议员。此前，伯德获任命填补克劳德·A·斯旺森留下的空缺；斯旺森当年早些时候出任美国海军部长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1933 occurred on Tuesday, November 7, 1933. Former state treasurer Frederick Mansfield defeated five other candidates to be elected Mayor of Boston. In 1918, the Massachusetts state legislature had passed legislation making the Mayor of Boston ineligible to serve consecutive terms. Thus, incumbent James Michael Curley was unable to run for re-election. Mansfield was inaugurated on Monday, January 1, 1934.

zh.s: 1933年波士顿市长选举于1933年11月7日星期二举行。前州财政长弗雷德里克·曼斯菲尔德击败另外5名候选人，当选波士顿市长。1918年，马萨诸塞州议会通过法律，规定波士顿市长不能连续任职，因此现任市长詹姆斯·迈克尔·柯利无法竞选连任。曼斯菲尔德于1934年1月1日星期一宣誓就职。

en.s: The 1933 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1933, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Virginia. Democratic nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor James Hubert Price defeated Republican nominee and former member of the Virginia Senate J. Powell Royall and Socialist nominee J. Luther Kibler.

zh.s: 1933年弗吉尼亚州副州长选举于1933年11月7日举行，选出该州副州长。民主党候选人、现任副州长詹姆斯·休伯特·普赖斯击败共和党候选人、前弗吉尼亚州参议员J·鲍威尔·罗亚尔和社会党候选人J·卢瑟·基布勒。

en.s: Elections were held on November 7, 1933, to fill the 65 seats of the New York City Board of Aldermen. Having been hitherto relegated to one seat held by Joseph Clarke of the 3rd district, Republicans were able to win 17 seats.

zh.s: 1933年11月7日举行选举，改选纽约市市参事会65个席位。共和党此前只有一个席位，由第3选区的约瑟夫·克拉克担任；此次赢得17席。

en.s: The 1933 Glasgow Corporation elections were held on 7 November 1933. The results were devastating for the Moderates, who lost control of the Corporation to Labour for the first time, despite socialist candidates making gains in Glasgow at successive general elections. Labour’s victory came as a surprise, even to the party itself, which had already begun blaming its anticipated defeat on vote-splitting caused by the presence of the ILP & the Communists.

zh.s: 1933年格拉斯哥公司选举于11月7日举行。温和派遭遇惨败，首次失去市政公司控制权，由工党接管；此前，社会主义候选人在格拉斯哥连续几次大选中逐步增加席位。工党的胜利出乎意料，连工党自己也感到惊讶；该党此前已开始把预期落败归咎于独立工党和共产党参选导致选票分散。

en.s: The New York City mayoral election of 1933 took place on November 7, 1933, in New York City. Incumbent Democratic Mayor John P. O'Brien, who was elected in a special election after the resignation of Mayor Jimmy Walker, faced Republican Congressman and 1929 mayoral candidate Fiorello La Guardia, and former acting mayor and President of the New York City Board of Aldermen Joseph V.

zh.s: 1933年纽约市市长选举于11月7日举行。民主党籍现任市长约翰·P·奥布莱恩在市长吉米·沃克辞职后的特别选举中当选；此次他面对共和党籍联邦众议员、1929年市长候选人菲奥雷洛·拉瓜迪亚，以及前代理市长、纽约市参事会主席约瑟夫·V·麦基。麦基在沃克辞职后代理市长，直到特别选举举行，并以复兴党候选人身份参选。

en.t: 1933 New York City aldermanic presidential election
en.s: An election was held on November 7, 1933, to elect the President of the New York City Board of Aldermen, along with other contests such as the mayoralty, Comptroller, and aldermen. Democratic incumbent Joseph V. McKee had resigned earlier in the year to assume the office of Mayor after Jimmy Walker had resigned that position, and the aldermanic presidential post was occupied by Dennis J.

zh.s: 1933年11月7日举行了纽约市参事会主席选举，当天还举行了市长、审计长和参事选举。民主党籍现任主席约瑟夫·V·麦基在年初辞职，接替辞职的吉米·沃克出任市长；空缺期间由丹尼斯·J·马洪代理主席。共和党候选人伯纳德·S·多伊奇击败民主党候选人米尔顿·所罗门和复兴党候选人内森·施特劳斯二世，当选主席。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1933, in the state of Virginia. Virginia holds its gubernatorial elections in odd numbered years, every 4 years, following the United States presidential election year.

zh.s: 1933年，美国州长选举只在弗吉尼亚州举行。弗吉尼亚州每四年在总统选举后的奇数年举行州长选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Cleveland mayoral election of 1933 saw former Governor Harry L. Davis unseat incumbent mayor Ray T. Miller.

zh.s: 1933年克利夫兰市长选举中，前州长哈里·L·戴维斯击败时任市长雷·T·米勒。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: General elections were held in Southern Rhodesia on 7 November 1934, fourth elections since the colony of Southern Rhodesia was granted self-government. The elections were called only a year after the previous elections when the Prime Minister, Godfrey Huggins, formed the United Party as a merger of the conservative section of his Reform Party and the former governing Rhodesia Party.

zh.s: 1934年11月7日，南罗得西亚举行大选。这是殖民地取得自治以来的第四次选举。此次选举距上次选举仅一年：总理戈弗雷·赫金斯将其改革党中的保守派与此前执政的罗得西亚党合并，组建联合党后，随即宣布举行选举。

en.t: 1937 New York City Council presidential election
en.s: An election was held on November 7, 1937, to elect the first President of the New York City Council. Republican Newbold Morris was elected over Democrat Max J. Schneider.

zh.s: 1937年11月7日举行选举，选出首任纽约市议会议长。共和党人纽博尔德·莫里斯击败民主党人马克斯·J·施奈德，当选。

en.s: The Dartford by-election of 1938 was held on 7 November 1938. The by-election was held due to the death of the incumbent Conservative MP, Frank Edward Clarke. It was won by the Labour candidate Jennie Adamson.

en.s: The Bombing of Cabra was a Republican airstrike which took place in Cabra, Córdoba, Andalusia on 7 November 1938, during the Spanish Civil War. The air raid left 109 people killed, and more than 200 wounded.

zh.s: 卡布拉轰炸事件是西班牙内战期间共和军的一次空袭，于1938年11月7日在安达卢西亚科尔多瓦的卡布拉发生。空袭造成109人死亡，200多人受伤。

en.t: 1938 United States Senate election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate election in North Carolina was held on November 7, 1938. Incumbent Democratic Senator Robert Rice Reynolds was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating U.S. Representative Franklin Wills Hancock Jr. in the Democratic primary and Republican former U.S. Representative Charles A. Jonas in the general election.

zh.t: 1938年北卡罗来纳州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1938年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举于1938年11月7日举行。民主党现任参议员罗伯特·赖斯·雷诺兹连任第二个任期，先后在民主党初选中击败联邦众议员小富兰克林·威尔斯·汉考克，又在大选中击败共和党前联邦众议员查尔斯·A·乔纳斯。

en.s: An election was held on November 7, 1939 for the members of the New York City Council. Although the results of the election were not in by the next day, The Brooklyn Citizen was willing to predict that all the candidates endorsed by Judge Samuel Seabury and Mayor Fiorello H. La Guardia were defeated as they had been in the other municipal contests that day, due in large part to the domestic popularity of President Franklin D.

zh.s: 1939年11月7日举行了纽约市议会选举。次日结果尚未全部统计完，《布鲁克林公民报》仍预测，塞缪尔·西伯里法官和市长菲奥雷洛·H·拉瓜迪亚支持的候选人都会落败；该报认为，这在很大程度上是因为富兰克林·D·罗斯福总统在国内受欢迎，而他们在当天其他市政选举中也已落败。

en.s: The 1939 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1939, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat Hugh L. White was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a second term. As was common at the time, the Democratic candidate ran unopposed in the general election so therefore the Democratic primary was the real contest, and winning the primary was considered tantamount to election.

zh.s: 1939年密西西比州州长选举于1939年11月7日举行，选出密西西比州州长。时任民主党州长休·L·怀特受任期限制，不能竞选连任第二届。按当时惯例，民主党候选人在大选中没有对手，因此民主党初选才是真正的竞争，赢得初选就被视同当选。

en.s: The 1939 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1939. Incumbent Democrat Keen Johnson defeated Republican nominee King Swope with 56.51% of the vote.

zh.s: 1939年肯塔基州州长选举于11月7日举行。时任民主党州长基恩·约翰逊以56.51%的得票率击败共和党候选人金·斯沃普。

en.s: The 1939 San Francisco mayoral election was held on November 7, 1939. Incumbent mayor Angelo Joseph Rossi was re-elected with 48% of the vote.

zh.s: 1939年11月7日，旧金山举行市长选举。时任市长安杰洛·约瑟夫·罗西以48%的得票率连任。

en.s: The Cleveland mayoral election of 1939 saw the re-election of the Republican, Harold Hitz Burton to a third term. He became the Mayor of Cleveland, over the Democratic John O'Donnell.

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1944
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 7, 1944. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1944 United States presidential election. New York voters chose 47 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New York was won by incumbent Democratic President Franklin D. Roosevelt, who was running against local Republican Governor Thomas E. Dewey. Roosevelt ran with U.S. Senator from Missouri Harry S. Truman, and Dewey ran with Ohio Governor, and opponent during the 1944 Republican primaries, John W. Bricker as Vice President.

zh.s: 1944年纽约州美国总统选举于11月7日举行。当时美国的48个州都参加了该届总统选举。纽约州选民选出47名总统选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福在纽约州获胜，他的对手是共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威。罗斯福的竞选搭档是密苏里州联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门；杜威的副总统候选人是俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克，他曾在共和党初选中与杜威竞争。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1944 was the 40th quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 7, 1944. Incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt, the Democratic nominee, sought his fourth term in office; he defeated Republican Thomas E. Dewey in the general election. The election was set against the backdrop of World War II, which was going well for the United States and its Allies. Roosevelt had already served longer than any other president, but remained popular. Unlike in 1940, there was little doubt that he would run for another term as the Democratic candidate.

zh.s: 1944年美国总统选举是美国每四年举行一次的第40届总统选举，于11月7日星期二举行。民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福竞选第四个任期，并在大选中击败共和党候选人托马斯·E·杜威。当时第二次世界大战战局对美国及其盟国有利。罗斯福的任期已经长于此前任何一位总统，但仍很受欢迎。与1940年不同，几乎没有人怀疑他会再次代表民主党竞选。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Mexico, 1944
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in New Mexico took place on November 7, 1944. All 48 States were part of the United States presidential election. New Mexico voters chose four electors to represent them in the Electoral College, which voted for President and Vice President. New Mexico was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt, against Governor of New York Thomas E. Dewey, who was making his first bid for the Presidency. Higher relative population in New Mexico increased the number of Presidential electors from the state to four, from three in the previous election cycle.

en.s: The 1944 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Governor of Montana Sam C. Ford, who was first elected Governor in 1940, ran for re-election. He won the Republican primary and moved on to the general election, where he was opposed by Leif Erickson, a former Chief Justice of the Montana Supreme Court and the Democratic nominee. Although then-President Franklin D. Roosevelt comfortably won the state in that year's presidential election, Ford defeated Erickson by a wide margin to win his second and final term as governor.

zh.s: 1944年蒙大拿州州长选举于11月7日举行。现任州长萨姆·C·福特于1940年首次当选，这次寻求连任。他赢得共和党初选后进入大选，对手是前蒙大拿州最高法院首席大法官、民主党候选人莱夫·埃里克森。尽管时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福当年在该州轻松获胜，福特仍以较大优势击败埃里克森，赢得第二个也是最后一个州长任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 1944
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 7, 1944 in Minnesota as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. The Democratic candidate, incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt won the state over New York governor Thomas E. Dewey by a margin of 62,448 votes, or 5.55%. Nationally, Roosevelt was re-elected to an unprecedented fourth term as President, with 432 electoral votes and a comfortable 7.5% lead over Dewey in the popular vote. However, Roosevelt would not serve the entirety of his fourth term, as he died within a half-year after winning his final election.

zh.t: 1944年明尼苏达州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1944年明尼苏达州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。民主党候选人、现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福以62448票、5.55%的优势击败纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威，赢得明尼苏达州。罗斯福随后以432张选举人票和7.5%的普选票优势在全国连任，史无前例地赢得第四个总统任期。不过，他在当选后不到半年便去世，未能完成这一任期。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. State voters chose 28 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Illinois was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Senator Harry S. Truman, with 51.52% of the popular vote, against Governor Thomas E.

zh.t: 1944年伊利诺伊州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1944年伊利诺伊州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出28名选举人，代表本州参加总统和副总统选举。民主党现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门搭档，得票率为51.52%；共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克搭档，得票率为48.05%。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1944, in 32 states, concurrent with the House, Senate elections and presidential election, on November 7, 1944. Elections took place on September 11 in Maine. This was the last time Idaho elected its governors to 2-year terms, switching to 4-years from the 1946 election.

zh.s: 1944年，美国32个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院、参议院和总统选举同时进行，选举日为11月7日。缅因州于9月11日举行选举。这是爱达荷州最后一次选举两年任期的州长；从1946年选举起，州长任期改为四年。

en.s: The 1944 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Democratic nominee Walter Naylor Davis defeated Republican nominee James G. Blaine with 50.85% of the vote.

zh.s: 1944年密苏里州副州长选举于1944年11月7日举行。民主党候选人沃尔特·内勒·戴维斯以50.85%的得票率击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·G·布莱恩。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. Voters chose 19 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Michigan voted narrowly for Democratic nominee, incumbent Franklin D. Roosevelt over Republican Governor of New York Thomas E. Dewey, carrying 50.19% of the vote to Dewey's 49.18%.

zh.t: 1944年美国总统选举密歇根州选情
zh.s: 1944年美国总统选举密歇根州投票于1944年11月7日举行，是1944年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出19名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。密歇根州以微弱优势支持民主党候选人、时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福；罗斯福得票率为50.19%，共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威为49.18%。

en.s: The 1944 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 7, 1944, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee Jonathan E. Taylor defeated Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Missouri Senate George H. Miller.

zh.s: 1944年密苏里州总检察长选举于1944年11月7日举行，以选出密苏里州总检察长。民主党候选人乔纳森·E·泰勒击败了共和党候选人、时任密苏里州参议员乔治·H·米勒。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate election in Arkansas took place on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Senator Hattie Caraway ran for a third term in office but was eliminated in the Democratic primary. U.S. Representative J. William Fulbright defeated Governor Homer Martin Adkins in the Democratic runoff. It is the last time where an elected incumbent Senator placed third or worse in a primary until the 2026 United States Senate election in Louisiana.

zh.t: 1944年阿肯色州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1944年阿肯色州美国联邦参议院选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任参议员哈蒂·卡罗韦竞选第三个任期，但在民主党初选中落败。美国联邦众议员J·威廉·富布赖特在民主党决选中击败州长霍默·马丁·阿德金斯。这是直到2026年路易斯安那州美国联邦参议院选举之前，最后一次有在任参议员候选人在初选中排名第三或更低。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate election in New Hampshire took place on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Republican Senator Charles W. Tobey won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 1944年新罕布什尔州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1944年新罕布什尔州美国联邦参议院选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任共和党参议员查尔斯·W·托比成功连任，进入第二个任期。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nevada was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Senator Harry S. Truman, with 54.62% of the popular vote, against Governor Thomas E.

zh.s: 1944年内华达州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门搭档，以54.62%的普选票获胜；共和党候选人、州长托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克搭档，获得45.38%。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oregon was won by then president Franklin D. Roosevelt over Governor of New York Thomas Dewey by a slim margin of 4.85%.

zh.t: 1944年美国总统选举俄勒冈州选情
zh.s: 1944年美国总统选举俄勒冈州投票于1944年11月7日举行，是1944年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福以4.85个百分点的微弱优势击败纽约州州长托马斯·杜威，赢得俄勒冈州。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate elections in Indiana
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate elections in Indiana took place on November 7, 1944. In January 1944, Democratic Senator Frederick Van Nuys died in office in January with one year remaining on his term in office. Governor Henry F. Schricker appointed Samuel D. Jackson to finish Van Nuys's term until a successor could be duly elected.

zh.t: 1944年印第安纳州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1944年印第安纳州美国联邦参议院选举于1944年11月7日举行。民主党参议员弗雷德里克·范·努伊斯于1944年1月在任内去世，当时他的任期还剩一年。州长亨利·F·施里克任命塞缪尔·D·杰克逊接完范·努伊斯的任期，直至选出继任者。

en.s: The 1944 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Democratic Governor Coke R. Stevenson defeated Republican nominee B. J. Peasley with 90.95% of the vote.

zh.s: 1944年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月7日举行。时任民主党州长科克·R·史蒂文森以90.95%的得票率击败共和党候选人B·J·皮斯利。

en.s: The 1944 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Governor Dwight H. Green, a Republican, was narrowly reelected to a second term, defeating Democratic nominee, Illinois State Senator and attorney, Thomas J. Courtney with 50.75% of the vote.

zh.s: 1944年伊利诺伊州州长选举于11月7日举行。时任共和党州长德怀特·H·格林以微弱优势连任第二届，得票率为50.75%，击败了民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州参议员兼律师托马斯·J·考特尼。

en.s: The 1944 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. It was the third consecutive gubernatorial race between the same two nominees. Incumbent Republican Raymond E. Baldwin defeated Democratic nominee Robert A. Hurley with 50.48% of the vote.

zh.s: 1944年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月7日举行。这是连续第三次由同一对候选人角逐州长。时任共和党州长雷蒙德·E·鲍德温以50.48%的得票率击败民主党候选人罗伯特·A·赫利。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Ohio was held on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. Dewey with 50.18% of the popular vote; Dewey's running mate was incumbent Ohio Governor John W.

en.s: The 1944 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Democratic nominee R. Gregg Cherry defeated Republican nominee Frank C. Patton with 69.61% of the vote.

zh.s: 1944年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党候选人R·格雷格·切里以69.61%的得票率击败共和党候选人弗兰克·C·帕顿。

en.s: The 1944 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Democrat J. Howard McGrath defeated Republican nominee Norman D. MacLeod with 60.65% of the vote.

zh.s: 1944年罗得岛州州长选举于11月7日举行。时任民主党州长J·霍华德·麦格拉思以60.65%的得票率击败共和党候选人诺曼·D·麦克劳德。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate election in Connecticut was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Republican Senator John A. Danaher ran for re-election to a second term in office but was defeated by Democratic attorney Brien McMahon.

zh.t: 1944年康涅狄格州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1944年康涅狄格州美国联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。时任共和党参议员约翰·A·丹纳赫竞选连任第二个任期，但败给了民主党律师布赖恩·麦克马洪。

en.s: The 1944 Florida gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Democratic nominee Millard Caldwell defeated Republican nominee Bert L. Acker with 78.94% of the vote.

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate election in North Carolina was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Democratic Senator Robert Rice Reynolds did not run for a third term in office. Ferree in the general election.

zh.s: 1944年北卡罗来纳州美国联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。时任民主党参议员罗伯特·赖斯·雷诺兹没有竞选第三个任期。前北卡罗来纳州州长克莱德·R·霍伊赢得这个空缺席位：他先在民主党初选中击败美国联邦众议员卡梅伦·A·莫里森，再在大选中击败共和党律师A·I·费里。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate election in Arizona took place on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Carl Hayden ran for reelection to a fourth term, defeating Republican nominee Fred Wildon Fickett Jr., in the general election.

zh.t: 1944年亚利桑那州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1944年亚利桑那州美国联邦参议院选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任民主党联邦参议员卡尔·海登竞选连任第四个任期，并在大选中击败共和党候选人弗雷德·威尔登·菲基特二世。

en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. Dewey, running with Governor of Ohio John Bricker, with 58.58% of the popular vote, against incumbent Democratic President Franklin D.

zh.t: 1944年内布拉斯加州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1944年内布拉斯加州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克搭档，以58.58%的普选票赢得该州；民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门获得41.42%。

en.s: The 1944 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1944. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate C. Elmer Anderson defeated Minnesota Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party challenger Frank Murphy.

zh.s: 1944年明尼苏达州副州长选举于1944年11月7日举行。明尼苏达州共和党候选人C·埃尔默·安德森击败明尼苏达州民主农民劳工党候选人弗兰克·墨菲。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in Florida
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate election in Florida was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Senator Claude Pepper easily won re-election to a second full term. Primary elections were held on May 2, 1944.

zh.t: 1944年佛罗里达州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1944年佛罗里达州美国联邦参议院选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任参议员克劳德·佩珀轻松连任，开始第二个完整任期。初选于1944年5月2日举行。

en.s: The 1944 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1944, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Democrat John J. Dempsey won reelection to a second term.

zh.s: 1944年新墨西哥州州长选举于1944年11月7日举行，以选出新墨西哥州州长。时任民主党州长约翰·J·登普西成功连任第二届。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate special election in Massachusetts
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate special election in Massachusetts was held on November 7, 1944 to complete the unexpired term of Henry Cabot Lodge Jr., who had resigned from the Senate to serve in World War II. Republican governor Leverett Saltonstall defeated Cambridge mayor John H. Corcoran in a landslide. Primary elections were held on July 10.

zh.t: 1944年马萨诸塞州美国联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1944年马萨诸塞州美国联邦参议院特别选举于1944年11月7日举行，以填补小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇辞职参战后留下的未满任期席位。共和党州长莱弗里特·索尔顿斯托尔以压倒性优势击败剑桥市市长约翰·H·科科伦。初选于7月10日举行。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. State voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Rhode Island voted Democratic candidate, incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt of New York, over the Republican candidate, Governor Thomas E. Dewey of New York.

zh.t: 1944年美国总统选举罗得岛州选情
zh.s: 1944年美国总统选举罗得岛州投票于1944年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出4名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。罗得岛州支持民主党候选人、纽约州籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福，胜过共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election.
