Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Senator Harry S.

zh.t: 1944年西弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1944年西弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出8名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门搭档，以54.89%的普选票获胜；共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克搭档，获得45.11%。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate election in Iowa took place on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Democratic Senator Guy M. Gillette ran for a second full term in office but was defeated by Republican Governor Bourke B. Hickenlooper. Primary elections were held on June 5. Gillette would be elected to Iowa's other Senate seat four years later and the two men would serve together as colleagues from 1949 to 1955.

zh.t: 1944年艾奥瓦州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1944年艾奥瓦州美国联邦参议院选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任民主党参议员盖伊·M·吉列竞选第二个完整任期，但败给了共和党州长伯克·B·希肯卢珀。初选于6月5日举行。四年后，吉列当选艾奥瓦州的另一个参议院席位，两人于1949至1955年间成为同事。

en.s: The 1944 Delaware lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Delaware. Democratic nominee Elbert N. Carvel defeated Republican nominee Clayton A. Bunting and Prohibition nominee J. Olan Jones.

zh.s: 1944年特拉华州副州长选举于1944年11月7日举行，以选出该州副州长。民主党候选人埃尔伯特·N·卡维尔击败共和党候选人克莱顿·A·邦廷和禁酒党候选人J·奥兰·琼斯。

en.s: The 1944 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Democratic U.S. Representative Jim Nance McCord defeated Republican Greeneville attorney John Wesley Kilgo with 62.5% of the vote. In the primary election, McCord sought his party's nomination for governor in the race to succeed the incumbent, Prentice Cooper, who was term-limited. With the support of powerful Memphis political boss, E. H.

zh.s: 1944年田纳西州州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党籍联邦众议员吉姆·南斯·麦科德以62.5%的得票率击败共和党候选人、格林维尔律师约翰·韦斯利·基尔戈。麦科德在初选中争取州长提名，以接替因任期限制不能再选的时任州长普伦蒂斯·库珀。在孟菲斯政治势力人物E·H·克朗普的支持下，麦科德在初选中以大幅优势击败诺克斯维尔法律学教授约翰·R·尼尔和纳什维尔律师雷克斯·曼宁。

en.s: The 1944 Massachusetts general election was held on November 7, 1944, throughout Massachusetts. Primary elections took place on July 11. At the federal level, Republican Governor Leverett Saltonstall was elected to the United States Senate over Cambridge mayor John H. Corcoran in a special election to fill the vacancy caused by Henry Cabot Lodge Jr.'s resignation and Republicans won ten of fourteen seats in the United States House of Representatives.

zh.s: 1944年马萨诸塞州大选于1944年11月7日在全州举行，初选于7月11日举行。在联邦层面，共和党州长莱弗里特·索尔顿斯托尔在参议院特别选举中击败剑桥市市长约翰·H·科科伦，当选联邦参议员，填补小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇辞职后留下的空缺；共和党还赢得了14个联邦众议院席位中的10席。

en.s: The 1944 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Republican Andrew Frank Schoeppel defeated Democratic nominee Robert S. Lemon with 65.73% of the vote.

zh.s: 1944年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月7日举行。时任共和党州长安德鲁·弗兰克·舍佩尔以65.73%的得票率击败民主党候选人罗伯特·S·莱蒙。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Democratic Senator Elmer Thomas ran for re-election to a fourth term. Thomas once again faced a stiff challenge in the Democratic primary, this time from Congressman Wesley E. Disney and Lieutenant Governor James E. Berry. As was the case in 1938, Thomas won renomination only with a narrow plurality.

zh.t: 1944年俄克拉何马州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1944年俄克拉何马州美国联邦参议院选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任民主党参议员埃尔默·托马斯竞选连任第四个任期。他再次在民主党初选中遭遇强劲挑战，这次对手是联邦众议员韦斯利·E·迪士尼和副州长詹姆斯·E·贝里。与1938年一样，托马斯仅以微弱优势赢得提名。

en.s: The 1944 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 7, 1944, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Mike Holm defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Emily Kneubuhl.

zh.s: 1944年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于1944年11月7日举行，以选出该州州务卿。共和党候选人、时任州务卿迈克·霍尔姆击败民主农民劳工党候选人艾米莉·克纽布尔。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in California took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. State voters chose 25 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California voted for the Democratic incumbent, Franklin Roosevelt, in a landslide over the Republican challenger, New York Governor Thomas E. Dewey.

zh.t: 1944年美国总统选举加利福尼亚州选情
zh.s: 1944年美国总统选举加利福尼亚州投票于1944年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出25名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。民主党时任总统富兰克林·罗斯福以压倒性优势击败共和党对手、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威，赢得加利福尼亚州。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate special election in Colorado took place on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Republican senator Eugene Millikin, who was first appointed to fill Alva B. Adams's seat in 1941 and re-elected at the ensuing special election in 1942, ran for re-election to his first full term. In the general election, he faced wealthy Denver attorney Barney L. Whatley.

zh.t: 1944年科罗拉多州美国联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1944年科罗拉多州美国联邦参议院特别选举于1944年11月7日举行。共和党时任参议员尤金·米利金于1941年首次获任命接替阿尔瓦·B·亚当斯，并在1942年的后续特别选举中当选；此次他竞选连任，争取自己的首个完整任期。大选中，他的对手是丹佛富有的律师巴尼·L·沃特利。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Idaho was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Senator Harry S. Truman, with 51.55% of the popular vote, against Governor Thomas E.

zh.s: 1944年爱达荷州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门搭档，以51.55%的普选票赢得爱达荷州；共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克搭档，获得48.07%。

en.s: The 1944 North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Democratic nominee Lynton Y. Ballentine defeated Republican nominee George L. Greene with 69.61% of the vote.

zh.t: 1944年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 1944年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举于1944年11月7日举行。民主党候选人林顿·Y·巴伦廷以69.61%的得票率击败共和党候选人乔治·L·格林。

en.s: The 1944 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Republican Governor Merrell Q. Sharpe ran for re-election to a second term. He was opposed by Lynn Fellows, a former State Representative from Aurora County the 1942 Democratic nominee for Attorney General, in the general election; both Sharpe and Fellows won their primaries unopposed.

zh.s: 1944年南达科他州州长选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任共和党州长梅雷尔·Q·夏普竞选连任第二届。他在大选中的对手是林恩·费洛斯。费洛斯曾任奥罗拉县州众议员，也是1942年民主党总检察长候选人。夏普和费洛斯都在初选中无人竞争，自动获得提名。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate election in Kansas was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Republican Senator Clyde M. Reed ran for re-election to a second term. He was initially challenged by former Senator George McGill, whom he had defeated in 1938. However, after winning the Democratic nomination, McGill withdrew from the race to accept an appointment to the U.S. Tariff Commission.

zh.t: 1944年堪萨斯州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1944年堪萨斯州美国联邦参议院选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任共和党参议员克莱德·M·里德竞选连任第二届。最初的挑战者是前参议员乔治·麦吉尔，里德曾在1938年击败他。不过，麦吉尔赢得民主党提名后退出竞选，接受了美国关税委员会的任命。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in South Dakota took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Dakota was won by Governor Thomas E. Dewey (R–New York), running with Governor John Bricker, with 58.33% of the popular vote, against incumbent President Franklin D.

zh.t: 1944年南达科他州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1944年南达科他州美国总统选举于11月7日举行。共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克搭档，以58.33%的普选票赢得该州；民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门获得41.67%。南达科他州是杜威得票率第三高的州，仅次于堪萨斯州和内布拉斯加州。

en.s: The 1944 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Democratic nominee Frank Lausche defeated Republican nominee James Garfield Stewart with 51.82% of the vote.

zh.s: 1944年俄亥俄州州长选举于1944年11月7日举行。民主党候选人弗兰克·劳舍以51.82%的得票率击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·加菲尔德·斯图尔特。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. State voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Colorado was won by Governor Thomas E. Dewey (R–New York), running with Governor John Bricker, with 53.21% of the popular vote, against incumbent President Franklin D.

zh.t: 1944年科罗拉多州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1944年科罗拉多州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出6名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克搭档，以53.21%的普选票获胜；民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门获得46.40%。杜威以6.8个百分点胜出，科罗拉多州相比1940年向共和党倾斜了4.3个百分点。

en.t: 1944 North Carolina Secretary of State election
en.s: The North Carolina secretary of state election of 1944 took place on November 7, 1944. The incumbent Secretary of State, Thad A. Eure, chose to run for reelection and defeated Watt Gragg with 69.99% of the vote. Eure won his third of thirteen terms.

zh.t: 1944年北卡罗来纳州州务卿选举
zh.s: 1944年北卡罗来纳州州务卿选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任州务卿萨德·A·尤尔竞选连任，并以69.99%的得票率击败沃特·格拉格。这是尤尔赢得的13个任期中的第三个。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. Alabama voters chose eleven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. In Alabama, voters voted for electors individually instead of as a slate, as in the other states.

zh.t: 1944年美国总统选举阿拉巴马州选情
zh.s: 1944年美国总统选举阿拉巴马州投票于1944年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。阿拉巴马州选民选出11名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。阿拉巴马州选民是分别投票给每位选举人，而不像其他州那样投票给一整组候选人。

en.s: The 1944 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Governor Sidney Preston Osborn ran for reelection, and easily won the Democratic primary, with only token opposition as former Governor Robert Taylor Jones declined to challenge Osborn to a rematch following two losses, in 1940 and 1942. In a virtually identical race to 1940 and 1942, Sidney Preston Osborn defeated Jerrie W.

zh.s: 1944年亚利桑那州州长选举于11月7日举行。时任州长西德尼·普雷斯顿·奥斯本竞选连任，并在民主党初选中轻松胜出；前州长罗伯特·泰勒·琼斯此前已在1940年和1942年两次败给奥斯本，因此没有再次挑战他。随后举行的大选与前两次选举情况相近，奥斯本击败杰里·W·李，并开始第三个州长任期。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate election in California was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Democratic Senator Sheridan Downey was re-elected to a second term in office over Republican Lieutenant Governor Frederick F. Houser.

zh.t: 1944年加利福尼亚州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1944年加利福尼亚州美国联邦参议院选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任民主党参议员谢里丹·唐尼击败共和党副州长弗雷德里克·F·豪瑟，连任第二届。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Delaware was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Senator Harry S. Truman, with 54.38% of the popular vote, against Governor Thomas E.

zh.s: 1944年特拉华州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门搭档，以54.38%的普选票赢得该州；共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克搭档，获得45.27%。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 7, 1944. Primaries were held April 11, 1944.

zh.s: 1944年伊利诺伊州选举于1944年11月7日（星期二）举行，初选于同年4月11日举行。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. Iowa voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa was won by Governor Thomas E. Dewey (R–New York), running with Governor John Bricker, with 51.99% of the popular vote, against incumbent President Franklin D.

zh.s: 1944年爱荷华州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。爱荷华州选民选出10名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·布里克搭档，以51.99%的普选票赢得爱荷华州；民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门搭档，获得47.49%。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. Voters chose 15 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Missouri was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Senator Harry S. Truman, with 51.37% of the popular vote, against Governor Thomas E.

zh.s: 1944年密苏里州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出15名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门搭档，以51.37%的普选票赢得该州；共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克搭档，获得48.43%。

en.s: The 1944 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944, and featured incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Roy W. Johnson, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee Edward A. Dosek.

zh.t: 1944年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1944年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任共和党副州长罗伊·W·约翰逊击败民主党候选人爱德华·A·多塞克。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. Kentucky voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kentucky was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Senator Harry S. Truman, with 54.45 percent of the popular vote, against Governor Thomas E.

zh.s: 1944年肯塔基州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。肯塔基州选民选出11名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门搭档，以54.45%的普选票赢得该州；共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克搭档，获得45.22%。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Florida was held on November 7, 1944. Voters chose eight electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Incumbent Franklin D. Roosevelt carried Florida by a landslide large margin of 40.64 percentage points, or 196,162 votes, over Republican Thomas Dewey, receiving Florida's eight electoral votes.

zh.t: 1944年美国总统选举佛罗里达州选情
zh.s: 1944年美国总统选举佛罗里达州投票于1944年11月7日举行。选民选出8名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福以压倒性优势赢得佛罗里达州，领先共和党候选人托马斯·杜威40.64个百分点，即196,162票，并获得该州的8张选举人票。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. State voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since the passage of a new constitution in 1898, Louisiana had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1944年美国总统选举路易斯安那州选情
zh.s: 1944年美国总统选举路易斯安那州投票于1944年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出10名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。自1898年通过新宪法以来，路易斯安那州一直由民主党主导，是一党制州。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Oklahoma took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. Voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oklahoma was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Senator Harry S. Truman, with 55.57% of the popular vote, against Governor Thomas E.

zh.t: 1944年俄克拉何马州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1944年俄克拉何马州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出10名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门搭档，以55.57%的普选票赢得该州；共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克搭档，获得44.20%。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate election in Illinois was held on November 7, 1944 to elect one of Illinois's members to the United States Senate. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Scott W. Lucas won reelection to a second term. The race between Lucas and Republican Richard J. Lyons was a rematch of their 1938 United States Senate race six years prior.

zh.t: 1944年伊利诺伊州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1944年伊利诺伊州美国联邦参议院选举于1944年11月7日举行，以选出一名代表伊利诺伊州的联邦参议员。时任民主党参议员斯科特·W·卢卡斯成功连任第二届。他与共和党候选人理查德·J·莱昂斯的对决，是两人六年前在1938年参议院选举中的再次交锋。

en.s: The 1944 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Republican nominee Fred G. Aandahl defeated Democratic nominee William T. DePuy with 52.02% of the vote.

zh.s: 1944年北达科他州州长选举于1944年11月7日举行。共和党候选人弗雷德·G·安达尔以52.02%的得票率击败民主党候选人威廉·T·德普伊。

en.s: The 1944 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Republican John Charles Vivian defeated Democratic nominee Roy Phelix Best with 52.40% of the vote.

zh.s: 1944年科罗拉多州州长选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任共和党州长约翰·查尔斯·维维安以52.40%的得票率击败民主党候选人罗伊·菲利克斯·贝斯特。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate special election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate special election in New Jersey was held on November 7, 1944. The election was held to fill the unexpired term of W. Warren Barbour, who died in November 1943. H. Alexander Smith was elected to the open seat over Democratic U.S. Representative Elmer H. Wene. The incumbent Democratic appointee, Arthur Walsh, did not run.

zh.t: 1944年新泽西州美国联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1944年新泽西州美国联邦参议院特别选举于1944年11月7日举行，以填补W·沃伦·巴伯于1943年11月去世后留下的未满任期席位。H·亚历山大·史密斯当选，击败民主党联邦众议员埃尔默·H·韦恩。民主党时任代理参议员阿瑟·沃尔什没有参选。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. State voters chose 8 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. For six decades South Carolina had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1944年美国总统选举南卡罗来纳州选情
zh.s: 1944年美国总统选举南卡罗来纳州投票于1944年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出8名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。此前60年里，南卡罗来纳州一直由民主党主导，是一党制州。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Incumbent Democratic President Franklin D. Roosevelt won the state over New York governor Thomas E. Dewey by a margin of 5.36%.

zh.t: 1944年美国总统选举康涅狄格州选情
zh.s: 1944年美国总统选举康涅狄格州投票于1944年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出8名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。民主党时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福以5.36个百分点的优势击败纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威，赢得该州。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arkansas was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Senator Harry S. Truman, with 69.95 percent of the popular vote, against Governor Thomas E.

zh.s: 1944年阿肯色州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出9名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门搭档，以69.95%的普选票赢得该州；共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克搭档，获得29.84%。

en.s: The 1944 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Republican Governor Leverett Saltonstall did not run for reelection, choosing instead to run in the United States Senate special election to succeed Henry Cabot Lodge Jr. In the open race to succeed him, Democratic mayor of Boston Maurice J. Tobin defeated Republican Lieutenant Governor Horace T. Cahill.

zh.s: 1944年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月7日举行。时任共和党州长莱弗里特·索尔顿斯托尔没有竞选连任，转而参加联邦参议院特别选举，以接替小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇。在继任州长的空缺席位竞选中，民主党波士顿市长莫里斯·J·托宾击败共和党副州长霍勒斯·T·卡希尔。

en.s: The 1944 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Primary elections were held on August 15, 1944. Incumbent Republican Governor Walter Samuel Goodland defeated Democratic nominee Daniel Hoan with 52.84% of the vote.

zh.s: 1944年威斯康星州州长选举于1944年11月7日举行。初选于同年8月15日举行。时任共和党州长沃尔特·塞缪尔·古德兰以52.84%的得票率击败民主党候选人丹尼尔·霍恩。

en.s: The 1944 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Republican nominee Robert D. Blue defeated Democratic nominee Richard F. Mitchell with 56.01% of the vote.

zh.s: 1944年艾奥瓦州州长选举于1944年11月7日举行。共和党候选人罗伯特·D·布卢以56.01%的得票率击败民主党候选人理查德·F·米切尔。

en.s: The 1944 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 7, 1944, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent state auditor Forrest Smith defeated Republican nominee George Metzger.

zh.s: 1944年密苏里州州审计长选举于1944年11月7日举行，以选出该州审计长。民主党候选人、时任州审计长福里斯特·史密斯击败共和党候选人乔治·梅茨格。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Millard Tydings was re-elected to a fourth term in office over Republican Blanchard Randall Jr.

zh.t: 1944年马里兰州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1944年马里兰州美国联邦参议院选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任民主党联邦参议员米勒德·泰丁斯击败共和党候选人小布兰查德·兰德尔，连任第四届。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate election in South Dakota took place on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Republican Senator Chan Gurney ran for re-election to a second term. He faced a strong challenge in the Republican primary from Lieutenant Governor A. C. Miller, who claimed that Gurney was too friendly to New Deal policies, but was defeated by Gurney by a wide margin.

zh.t: 1944年南达科他州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1944年南达科他州美国联邦参议院选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任共和党参议员钱·格尼竞选连任第二届。他在共和党初选中受到副州长A·C·米勒的强力挑战。米勒指责格尼过于支持新政政策，但最终以较大差距败给格尼。

en.s: The 1944 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Republican Governor Walter W. Bacon defeated Democratic nominee Isaac J. MacCollum with 50.52% of the vote.

zh.s: 1944年特拉华州州长选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任共和党州长沃尔特·W·培根以50.52%的得票率击败民主党候选人艾萨克·J·麦科勒姆。

en.t: 1944 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico
en.s: The 1944 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on Tuesday November 7, 1944 to elect the states two At-large representatives on a General ticket. The Democratic party retained both of their at-large members in New Mexico. This election coincided with the 1944 Presidential election and the state's Governor election. Democrats would hold both seats in the New Mexico house delegation until 1968.

zh.t: 1944年新墨西哥州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1944年新墨西哥州美国联邦众议院选举于1944年11月7日（星期二）举行，选出该州的两名不分选区联邦众议员，采用全州统一选举的方式。民主党保住了这两个席位。这次选举与1944年总统选举和该州州长选举同时举行。民主党一直保有新墨西哥州联邦众议院代表团的两个席位，直到1968年。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. North Carolina voters chose 14 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. As a former Confederate state, North Carolina had a history of Jim Crow laws, disfranchisement of its African-American population and dominance of the Democratic Party in state politics.

zh.t: 1944年美国总统选举北卡罗来纳州选情
zh.s: 1944年美国总统选举北卡罗来纳州投票于1944年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。北卡罗来纳州选民选出14名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。作为前邦联州，北卡罗来纳州曾实施种族隔离法，剥夺非裔居民的选举权，州政治也长期由民主党主导。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maryland was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Senator Harry S. Truman, with 51.85% of the popular vote, against Governor Thomas E.

zh.s: 1944年马里兰州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出8名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门搭档，以51.85%的普选票赢得该州；共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克搭档，获得48.15%。马里兰州的投票结果比全国整体更偏向共和党3.79个百分点。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Texas
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Texas took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. State voters chose 23 electors to represent the state in the Electoral College, which chose the president and vice president. Incumbent Democratic President Franklin D. Roosevelt won Texas in a landslide, taking 71.42% of the state's vote to Republican Thomas E.

zh.t: 1944年得克萨斯州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1944年得克萨斯州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出23名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福以压倒性优势赢得得州，获得71.42%的选票；共和党候选人托马斯·E·杜威获得16.64%，反对罗斯福的新政、并推出无承诺选举人名单的保守派民主党团体“得州常客”获得11.77%。

en.s: The 1944 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 7, 1944, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Joseph A. A. Burnquist defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and former member of the Minnesota Senate Erling Swenson.

zh.t: 1944年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1944年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于1944年11月7日举行，以选出该州总检察长。共和党候选人、时任总检察长约瑟夫·A·A·伯恩奎斯特击败民主农民劳工党候选人埃林·斯文森。斯文森曾任明尼苏达州参议员。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kansas was won by Governor Thomas E. Dewey (R–New York), running with Governor John Bricker, with 60.25 percent of the popular vote, against incumbent President Franklin D.

zh.s: 1944年堪萨斯州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·布里克搭档，以60.25%的普选票赢得该州；民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门搭档，获得39.18%。这是杜威在罗斯福参加的四次总统选举中，对罗斯福胜差最大的一州，尽管他在1932年和1936年也以较大优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1944 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1944 United States House of Representatives elections were elections for the United States House of Representatives to elect members to serve in the 79th United States Congress. They were held for the most part on November 7, 1944, while Maine held theirs on September 11. These elections coincided with President Franklin D. Roosevelt's re-election to a record fourth term.

zh.s: 1944年美国联邦众议院选举旨在选出第79届国会的议员。大部分选举于1944年11月7日举行，缅因州则于9月11日举行。这次选举与富兰克林·D·罗斯福总统再次当选、开启创纪录的第四个任期同时举行。

en.s: The 1944 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Republican nominee Ralph F. Gates narrowly defeated Democratic nominee Samuel D. Jackson with 50.97% of the vote.

zh.s: 1944年印第安纳州州长选举于1944年11月7日举行。共和党候选人拉尔夫·F·盖茨以微弱优势击败民主党候选人塞缪尔·D·杰克逊，得票率为50.97%。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Arizona
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Arizona took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arizona was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Senator Harry S.

zh.t: 1944年亚利桑那州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1944年亚利桑那州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门搭档，以58.80%的普选票赢得该州；共和党候选人托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克搭档，获得40.90%。截至2024年，这是民主党候选人在亚利桑那州以两位数优势获胜或多次赢得该州的最后一次。

en.s: The 1944 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Democrat Herbert B. Maw defeated Republican nominee J. Bracken Lee with 50.21% of the vote. This is the closest gubernatorial election in Utah to date. This is also the last time a Democrat was elected Governor until 1964.

zh.s: 1944年犹他州州长选举于11月7日举行。时任民主党州长赫伯特·B·莫以50.21%的得票率击败共和党候选人J·布雷肯·李。这是犹他州迄今差距最小的州长选举，也是直到1964年之前该州最后一次选出民主党州长。

en.s: The 1944 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Democratic Governor Homer Martin Adkins did not seek a third term, instead running unsuccessfully for the U.S. Senate. Democratic nominee Benjamin Travis Laney defeated Republican nominee Harley C. Stump with 85.96% of the vote.

zh.s: 1944年阿肯色州州长选举于11月7日举行。时任民主党州长霍默·马丁·阿德金斯没有竞选第三个任期，而是转而参选美国联邦参议员，但未能当选。民主党候选人本杰明·特拉维斯·莱尼以85.96%的得票率击败共和党候选人哈利·C·斯塔普。

en.s: The 1944 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Republican nominee Charles M. Dale defeated Democratic nominee James J. Powers with 53.11% of the vote.

zh.s: 1944年新罕布什尔州州长选举于1944年11月7日举行。共和党候选人查尔斯·M·戴尔以53.11%的得票率击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·J·鲍尔斯。

en.s: The 1944 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Republican Harry Kelly had defeated Democratic nominee Edward J. Fry with 54.69% of the vote.

zh.s: 1944年密歇根州州长选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任共和党州长哈里·凯利以54.69%的得票率击败民主党候选人爱德华·J·弗莱。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. Tennessee voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. For over a century after the Civil War, Tennessee was divided according to political loyalties established in that war.

zh.t: 1944年美国总统选举田纳西州选情
zh.s: 1944年美国总统选举田纳西州投票于1944年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。田纳西州选民选出12名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。南北战争结束后的一个多世纪里，田纳西州的政治分歧一直沿袭着战争时期形成的政治立场。

en.s: The 1944 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 7, 1944, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee and former state treasurer Robert W. Winn defeated Republican nominee Perry Compton, Socialist nominee Joseph G. Hodges and Socialist Labor nominee Norman Kochendorfer.

zh.s: 1944年密苏里州州财政长选举于1944年11月7日举行，以选出该州财政长。民主党候选人、前州财政长罗伯特·W·温击败共和党候选人佩里·康普顿、社会党候选人约瑟夫·G·霍奇斯和社会劳工党候选人诺曼·科亨多弗。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Utah took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. All contemporary forty-eight states took part, and state voters selected four voters to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. The Democratic Party candidate, President Franklin D. Roosevelt, won the state of Utah with 60.44 percent of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1944年美国总统选举犹他州选情
zh.s: 1944年美国总统选举犹他州投票于1944年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。当时美国的48个州都参与了选举，犹他州选民选出4名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福以60.44%的普选票赢得犹他州。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. Mississippi voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since the end of Reconstruction, Mississippi had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1944年美国总统选举密西西比州选情
zh.s: 1944年美国总统选举密西西比州投票于1944年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。密西西比州选民选出9名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。重建时期结束后，密西西比州一直由民主党主导，是一党制州。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Wyoming was won by the Republican nominee, Governor of New York Thomas Dewey, running with Governor of Ohio John W.

zh.t: 1944年美国总统选举怀俄明州选情
zh.s: 1944年美国总统选举怀俄明州投票于1944年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克搭档参选，赢得怀俄明州。

en.s: The 1944 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944, and featured incumbent Governor Dwight Griswold, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee, busboy George W. Olsen, to win a third and final two-year term in office.

zh.s: 1944年内布拉斯加州州长选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任共和党州长德怀特·格里斯沃尔德击败民主党候选人、餐厅服务员乔治·W·奥尔森，赢得第三个也是最后一个两年任期。

en.s: The 1944 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 7, 1944, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent State Treasurer of Missouri Wilson Bell defeated Republican nominee Loyd Miller, Socialist nominee Alice B. Verburg, Prohibition nominee F. H. Jackson and Socialist Labor nominee Theodore Baeff.

zh.s: 1944年密苏里州州务卿选举于1944年11月7日举行，以选出该州州务卿。民主党候选人、时任密苏里州财政长威尔逊·贝尔击败共和党候选人洛伊德·米勒、社会党候选人艾丽丝·B·弗贝格、禁酒党候选人F·H·杰克逊和社会劳工党候选人西奥多·贝夫。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Republican Senator Robert A. Taft, first elected in the Republican wave of 1938, was narrowly elected to a second term in office over Democratic former Lieutenant Governor William G. Pickrel, winning 71 of Ohio's 88 counties. Despite Pickrel winning the state's largest urban centers such as Cleveland, his margins there were overcome by Taft's strong showings in the rural areas and small towns.

zh.t: 1944年俄亥俄州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1944年俄亥俄州美国联邦参议院选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任共和党参议员罗伯特·A·塔夫脱在1938年共和党大胜中首次当选，此次以微弱优势连任第二届，击败民主党前副州长威廉·G·皮克雷尔，赢得俄亥俄州88个县中的71个。尽管皮克雷尔赢得了克利夫兰等州内最大城市，塔夫脱在乡村地区和小城镇的强势表现抵消了皮克雷尔在这些城市的领先优势。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. North Dakota was won by Governor Thomas E. Dewey (R–New York), running with Governor John Bricker, with 53.84% of the popular vote, against incumbent President Franklin D.

zh.t: 1944年北达科他州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1944年北达科他州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克搭档，以53.84%的普选票赢得该州；民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门搭档，获得45.48%。北达科他州是1940年以来向民主党倾斜的6个州之一。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. The Republican ticket of the governor of New York Thomas E. Dewey and the governor of Ohio John W. Bricker defeated the Democratic ticket of the incumbent president of the United States Franklin D. Roosevelt and the junior U.S. senator from Missouri Harry S. Truman.

zh.t: 1944年美国总统选举印第安纳州选情
zh.s: 1944年美国总统选举印第安纳州投票于1944年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克组成的竞选搭档，击败了民主党候选人、美国时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与密苏里州联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门组成的搭档。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate election in North Dakota took place on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Republican Senator Gerald Nye ran for re-election to his fourth term. He faced a serious challenge to his renomination in the Republican primary, with prominent Fargo attorney Lynn Stambaugh and Congressman Usher L. Burdick running against him. He won with one-third of the vote, defeating Shambaugh, his closest opponent, by fewer than 1,000 votes.

zh.t: 1944年北达科他州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1944年北达科他州美国联邦参议院选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任共和党参议员杰拉尔德·奈竞选连任第四届。他在共和党初选中受到严峻挑战，对手包括法戈知名律师林恩·斯坦博和联邦众议员厄舍·L·伯迪克。奈以三分之一的选票获胜，比最接近的对手斯坦博多不到1,000票。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Alexander Wiley was re-elected to a second term in office over Howard J. McMurray and Harry Sauthoff. Future Senator Joseph McCarthy challenged Wiley in the Republican primary.

zh.t: 1944年威斯康星州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1944年威斯康星州美国联邦参议院选举于1944年11月7日举行。时任共和党联邦参议员亚历山大·威利击败霍华德·J·麦克默里和哈里·索索夫，连任第二届。未来的参议员约瑟夫·麦卡锡曾在共和党初选中挑战威利。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. State voters chose five electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Maine was won by Republican Party candidate New York governor Thomas E. Dewey over Democratic candidate, incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt.

zh.t: 1944年美国总统选举缅因州选情
zh.s: 1944年美国总统选举缅因州投票于1944年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出5名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威击败民主党候选人、时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福，赢得缅因州。

en.s: The 1944 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1944. Democratic nominee Monrad Wallgren defeated incumbent Republican Arthur B. Langlie with 51.51% of the vote.

zh.s: 1944年11月7日，华盛顿州举行州长选举。民主党候选人莫纳德·沃尔格伦以51.51%的得票率击败共和党籍现任州长阿瑟·B·兰利。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Washington was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Missouri Senator Harry S. Truman, with 56.84% of the popular vote, against Governor Thomas E.

zh.s: 1944年华盛顿州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与密苏里州联邦参议员哈里·S·杜鲁门搭档，以56.84%的普选票赢得华盛顿州；共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与俄亥俄州州长约翰·W·布里克搭档，获得42.24%。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 7, 1944, as part of the wider United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. With the exception of a handful of historically Unionist North Georgia counties – chiefly Fannin but also to a lesser extent Pickens, Gilmer and Towns – Georgia since the 1880s had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1944年美国总统选举佐治亚州投票
zh.s: 1944年11月7日，作为全美总统选举的一部分，佐治亚州举行总统选举投票。选民选出12名代表，也就是选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。自19世纪80年代以来，佐治亚州基本上由民主党一党主导。例外主要是佐治亚州北部少数历史上支持联邦的县，尤其是范宁县，其次还有皮肯斯县、吉尔默县和汤斯县。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1944 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 7, 1944. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Homer Bone resigned in April, having been appointed and confirmed to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit in April. Democratic U.S. Representative Warren Magnuson won the open race over Republican mayor of Tacoma Harry Cain and was appointed to the vacant seat.

zh.t: 1944年美国联邦参议院华盛顿州选举
zh.s: 1944年11月7日，华盛顿州举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍现任参议员霍默·博恩于4月辞职，并在同月获任命、确认出任美国第九巡回上诉法院法官。民主党籍联邦众议员沃伦·马格努森在无现任议员参选的情况下，击败共和党人、塔科马市长哈里·凯恩当选，随后获任命填补空缺席位。

en.s: The 1944 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 7. Democratic nominee Charles Gossett defeated Republican nominee W. H. Detweiler for the open seat with 52.64% of the vote. Incumbent governor C. A. Bottolfsen was the Republican nominee for the United States Senate, but was defeated by Democrat Glen Taylor in the general election.

zh.s: 1944年11月7日，爱达荷州举行州长选举。民主党候选人查尔斯·戈塞特以52.64%的得票率击败共和党候选人W·H·德特韦勒，赢得空缺席位。共和党籍现任州长C·A·博特尔夫森代表共和党竞选联邦参议员，但在普选中败给民主党人格伦·泰勒。

en.s: The 1944 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1944 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 30 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. The Iowa General Assembly provides statewide maps of each district. To compare the effect of the 1944 redistricting process on the location of each district, contrast the previous map with the map used for 1944 elections.

zh.s: 1944年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是1944年美国两年一度选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民在州参议院50个选区中的30个选区选出参议员。州参议员任期四年。艾奥瓦州议会提供了各选区全州地图。若要比较1944年重新划分选区对各选区位置的影响，可以对照此前的地图和1944年选举所用的地图。

en.t: 1944 United States House of Representatives elections in Illinois
en.s: All 26 Illinois seats in the United States House of Representatives were up for election in 1944. Democrats flipped four Republican-held seats, making the composition of Illinois' House delegation 15 Republicans and 11 Democrats. The Democratic Party flipped the 3rd, 9th, 22nd, and at-large districts.

zh.t: 1944年伊利诺伊州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1944年，伊利诺伊州联邦众议院全部26个席位改选。民主党从共和党手中翻转四席，使该州联邦众议员代表团的组成变为共和党15人、民主党11人。民主党翻转了第三、第九、第二十二和全州选区的席位。

en.t: 1944 United States presidential election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1944 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 7, as part of the 1944 United States presidential election. State voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. New Hampshire was won by the Democratic candidate, incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt, who won the state over New York governor Thomas E.

zh.t: 1944年新罕布什尔州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1944年新罕布什尔州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福以4.24个百分点的微弱优势击败共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威，赢得新罕布什尔州。民主党人直到1964年才再次赢得该州总统选举。

en.s: The 1944 United States Senate elections coincided with the re-election of Franklin D. Roosevelt to his fourth term as president. The 32 seats of Class 3 were contested in regular elections, and three special elections were held to fill vacancies. The Democrats retained their large majority, although they lost a net of one seat to the Republicans.

zh.s: 1944年美国联邦参议院选举与富兰克林·D·罗斯福连任第四个总统任期同期举行。第三类32个席位通过常规选举改选，另举行三场特别选举填补空缺。民主党保住了较大的多数席位，尽管该党有一席净损失，被共和党夺走。

en.s: The Battle of Shalateng was a military engagement on 7 November 1947, during the Indo-Pakistani war of 1947–1948. It was a decisive battle that resulted in the halting of the Pakistani offensive and the beginning of the Indian counter offensive.

zh.s: 1947年11月7日，印巴战争期间，双方在沙拉坦格交战。此役具有决定性意义，巴基斯坦军队的进攻被阻止，印度军队随后开始反攻。

en.t: United States Senate election in Florida, 1950
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in Florida was a campaign characterized by accusations and mudslinging. Incumbent Senator Claude Pepper was defeated in the Democratic primary by George Smathers in what has been described as one of the "most bitter and ugly campaigns in Florida political history." Pepper was targeted for taking part in the "dump Truman" campaign, which attempted to deny incumbent Harry Truman the nomination in favor of another Democrat in the 1948 presidential election. The election is an example of the Red Scare, as Pepper was accused of having ties with Communism and the Soviet Union.

zh.t: 1950年佛罗里达州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年佛罗里达州美国参议院选举期间，候选人之间充斥指责和人身攻击。时任参议员克劳德·佩珀在民主党初选中败给乔治·斯马瑟斯；这场初选被称为佛罗里达州政治史上“最激烈、最肮脏的竞选之一”。佩珀因参与“倒杜鲁门”运动而受到攻击；该运动曾试图在1948年总统选举中阻止时任总统哈里·杜鲁门获得提名，改由另一名民主党人参选。佩珀还被指与共产主义及苏联有关联，因此这场选举也成为美国第二次红色恐慌的一个例子。

en.s: The Vermont gubernatorial election of 1950 took place on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Republican Harold J. Arthur did not run for re-election to a full term as Governor of Vermont. Republican candidate Lee E. Emerson defeated Democratic candidate J. Edward Moran to succeed him.

zh.s: 1950年佛蒙特州州长选举于11月7日举行。共和党籍现任州长哈罗德·J·亚瑟没有竞选完整任期。共和党候选人李·E·爱默生击败民主党候选人J·爱德华·莫兰，接替他出任州长。

en.s: The 1950 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1950. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate Luther Youngdahl defeated Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party challenger Harry H. Peterson.

zh.s: 1950年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月7日举行。明尼苏达州共和党候选人卢瑟·扬达尔击败明尼苏达州民主—农民—劳工党候选人哈里·H·彼得森。

en.s: The 1950 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950. Democratic incumbent Paul A. Dever defeated Republican Arthur W. Coolidge, Socialist Labor candidate Horace Hillis, and Prohibition candidate Mark R. Shaw. In the race for Lieutenant Governor, Democratic incumbent Charles F. Sullivan defeated Republican Laurence Curtis and Socialist Labor candidate Lawrence Gilfedder.

zh.s: 1950年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党籍现任州长保罗·A·德弗击败共和党候选人阿瑟·W·库利奇、社会主义工党候选人霍勒斯·希利斯和禁酒党候选人马克·R·肖。副州长选举中，民主党籍现任副州长查尔斯·F·沙利文击败共和党候选人劳伦斯·柯蒂斯和社会主义工党候选人劳伦斯·吉尔费德。

en.t: United States Senate election in Pennsylvania, 1950
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Francis J. Myers sought re-election, but was defeated by Republican nominee James H. Duff.

zh.t: 1950年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。民主党籍现任参议员弗朗西斯·J·迈尔斯寻求连任，但败给共和党候选人詹姆斯·H·达夫。

en.s: The 1950 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1950, to elect the governor of Alabama.

zh.s: 1950年阿拉巴马州州长选举于11月7日举行，选出阿拉巴马州州长。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 1950
en.s: The 1950 South Carolina United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 7, 1950 to select six Representatives for two-year terms from the state of South Carolina. Four incumbents were re-elected, but Hugo S. Sims, Jr. of the 2nd congressional district and James Butler Hare of the 3rd congressional district were defeated in the Democratic primaries.

zh.t: 1950年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1950年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举于11月7日举行，选出6名众议员，任期两年。4名现任众议员连任成功，但第2国会选区的雨果·S·西姆斯二世和第3国会选区的詹姆斯·巴特勒·黑尔在民主党初选中落败。

en.t: United States Senate election in Vermont, 1950
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in Vermont took place on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Republican George Aiken ran successfully for re-election to another term in the United States Senate, defeating Democratic challenger James E. Bigelow.

zh.t: 1950年佛蒙特州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年佛蒙特州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。共和党籍现任参议员乔治·艾肯成功连任，击败民主党挑战者詹姆斯·E·比格洛。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1950
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1950 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 7, 1950. Republicans won one Democratic-held seat.

zh.t: 1950年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1950年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举是11月7日举行的联邦众议院大选的一部分，选出代表加利福尼亚州进入联邦众议院的议员。共和党赢得了一个原由民主党控制的席位。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1950, in 33 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections, on November 7, 1950. Elections took place on September 11 in Maine. In Connecticut, the governor was elected to a 4-year term for the first time, instead of a 2-year term.

zh.s: 1950年，美国33个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院和参议院选举同时进行，选举日为11月7日。缅因州于9月11日举行选举。康涅狄格州的州长首次改为四年一任，此前为两年一任。

en.s: The 1950 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950, and featured incumbent Governor Val Peterson, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee, former state Senator Walter R. Raecke, to win a third and final two-year term in office.

zh.s: 1950年内布拉斯加州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任共和党州长瓦尔·彼得森击败民主党候选人、前州参议员沃尔特·R·雷克，赢得第三个也是最后一个两年任期。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in Nevada
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in Nevada was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Pat McCarran was re-elected to a fourth term in office over Republican George E. Marshall.

zh.t: 1950年内华达州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年内华达州美国联邦参议院选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任民主党联邦参议员帕特·麦卡伦击败共和党候选人乔治·E·马歇尔，连任第四届。

en.s: The 1950 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950. Democratic nominee Dennis J. Roberts defeated Republican nominee Eugene J. Lachapelle with 59.34% of the vote.

zh.s: 1950年罗得岛州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。民主党候选人丹尼斯·J·罗伯茨以59.34%的得票率击败共和党候选人尤金·J·拉沙佩尔。

en.s: The 1950 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Republican Governor Arthur G. Crane, who ascended to the governorship when Lester C. Hunt was elected to the Senate in 1948, declined to seek re-election. Congressman Frank A. Barrett won the Republican primary to succeed Crane and faced former State Auditor John J. McIntyre, the Democratic nominee, in the general election.

zh.s: 1950年怀俄明州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任共和党州长阿瑟·G·克兰于1948年莱斯特·C·亨特当选联邦参议员后接任州长，此次他决定不竞选连任。联邦众议员弗兰克·A·巴雷特赢得共和党初选，成为克兰的继任者候选人；大选中，他将对阵民主党候选人、前州审计长约翰·J·麦金太尔。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in North Dakota took place on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Republican Senator Milton Young ran for re-election to a second term. In the Republican primary, he faced former Lieutenant Governor Thorstein H. Thoresen, who was endorsed by the Nonpartisan League. After winning the primary in a landslide, he faced State Senator Harry O'Brien, the Democratic nominee, in the general election.

zh.t: 1950年北达科他州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年北达科他州美国联邦参议院选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任共和党参议员米尔顿·扬竞选连任第二届。在共和党初选中，他的对手是前副州长索斯坦·H·索伦森，后者得到无党派联盟支持。扬以压倒性优势赢得初选后，在大选中对阵民主党候选人、州参议员哈里·奥布莱恩。

en.s: The 1950 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Republican Governor George T. Mickelson was unable to seek re-election to a third term due to newly imposed term limits. Accordingly, a competitive race to replace him ensued. Attorney General Sigurd Anderson won a slim plurality in the Republican primary, barely exceeding 35% and narrowly avoiding having the Republican nomination sent to the state party convention.

zh.s: 1950年南达科他州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。由于新设的任期限制，时任共和党州长乔治·T·米克尔森不能竞选第三届。随后，继任者的竞争十分激烈。总检察长西于尔德·安德森在共和党初选中以微弱优势领先，得票刚超过35%，险些让共和党提名交由州党代会决定。

en.s: The 1950 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 7, 1950, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Stafford King defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Elmer A. Borgschatz.

zh.t: 1950年明尼苏达州州审计长选举
zh.s: 1950年明尼苏达州州审计长选举于1950年11月7日举行，以选出该州审计长。共和党候选人、时任州审计长斯塔福德·金击败民主农民劳工党候选人埃尔默·A·博格沙茨。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in Louisiana was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Russell B. Long won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 1950年路易斯安那州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年路易斯安那州美国联邦参议院选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任民主党联邦参议员拉塞尔·B·朗成功连任第二届。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Millard Tydings ran for a fifth term in office, but was defeated by Republican John Marshall Butler.

zh.t: 1950年马里兰州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年马里兰州美国联邦参议院选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任民主党联邦参议员米勒德·泰丁斯竞选第五个任期，但败给了共和党候选人约翰·马歇尔·巴特勒。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in North Carolina was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Democratic Senator Clyde R. Hoey was re-elected to a second term in office over Republican Halsey B. Leavitt.

zh.t: 1950年北卡罗来纳州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年北卡罗来纳州美国联邦参议院选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任民主党参议员克莱德·R·霍伊击败共和党候选人哈尔西·B·利维特，连任第二届。

en.s: The 1950 Connecticut Attorney General election was held on November 7, 1950, in order to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Republican nominee and former member of the Connecticut House of Representatives George C. Conway defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Connecticut State Senate Alfred F. Wechsler.

zh.t: 1950年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1950年康涅狄格州总检察长选举于1950年11月7日举行，以选出该州总检察长。共和党候选人、前康涅狄格州众议员乔治·C·康威击败民主党候选人、时任康涅狄格州参议员阿尔弗雷德·F·韦克斯勒。

en.s: The 1950 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 7, 1950, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent acting comptroller J. Millard Tawes won the election as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1950年马里兰州州审计长选举于1950年11月7日举行，以选出该州审计长。民主党候选人、时任代理审计长J·米勒德·托斯赢得选举，他没有对手。

en.s: The 1950 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Democratic Governor Sid McMath defeated Republican nominee Jefferson W. Speck with 84.13% of the vote.

zh.s: 1950年阿肯色州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任民主党州长西德·麦克马思以84.13%的得票率击败共和党候选人杰斐逊·W·斯佩克。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in Idaho
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in Idaho took place on November 7, 1950. One-term Democrat Glen H. Taylor lost renomination to the class 3 seat to his predecessor D. Worth Clark. Taylor had beaten Clark for the Democratic nomination in 1944, and this year Clark did the same to him. However, in the general election, Clark was easily beaten by Republican State senator Herman Welker.

zh.t: 1950年爱达荷州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年爱达荷州美国联邦参议院选举于1950年11月7日举行。只任过一届的民主党参议员格伦·H·泰勒未能赢得第三类席位的党内提名，败给了前任D·沃思·克拉克。1944年，泰勒曾在民主党提名中击败克拉克；这次克拉克以同样方式击败了他。不过，克拉克在大选中又轻松败给了共和党州参议员赫尔曼·韦尔克。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Alexander Wiley was re-elected to a third term in office over Thomas E. Fairchild.

zh.t: 1950年威斯康星州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年威斯康星州美国联邦参议院选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任共和党联邦参议员亚历山大·威利击败托马斯·E·费尔柴尔德，连任第三届。

en.s: The 1950 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950, in order to elect the Lieutenant Governor of California. Incumbent Republican Lieutenant Governor Goodwin Knight easily won re-election against Write-in candidate Monroe Deutsch.

zh.t: 1950年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1950年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于1950年11月7日举行，以选出该州副州长。时任共和党副州长古德温·奈特轻松连任，击败了登记候选人门罗·多伊奇。

en.t: 1950 New York City special mayoral election
en.s: The 1950 New York City special mayoral election was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Democratic Mayor William O'Dwyer had resigned as mayor of New York City in August 1950 to become the United States Ambassador to Mexico. As a result, fellow Democrat Vincent R. Impellitteri became acting mayor in August, having to run in the special election in November to serve out the remaining three years of O'Dwyer's term.

zh.s: 1950年纽约市市长特别选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任民主党市长威廉·奥德怀尔于1950年8月辞去纽约市市长职务，出任美国驻墨西哥大使。因此，同为民主党的文森特·R·因佩利特里于8月出任代理市长，并须在11月参加特别选举，完成奥德怀尔剩余的三年任期。

en.s: The 1950 Massachusetts general election was held on November 7, 1950, throughout Massachusetts. Primary elections took place on September 19. At the federal level, Republicans maintained their majority in the state by holding eight of fourteen seats in the United States House of Representatives. Incumbents were re-elected in each House seat. In the race for Governor, Democratic incumbent Paul Dever was re-elected over former Lieutenant Governor Arthur W.

zh.s: 1950年马萨诸塞州普选于11月7日举行，初选于9月19日举行。在联邦层面，共和党保住了州内多数席位，在联邦众议院14席中占8席，所有现任众议员均成功连任。州长选举中，民主党籍现任州长保罗·德弗击败前副州长阿瑟·W·库利奇，成功连任。民主党籍现任官员也赢得了6场全州公职选举。

en.s: The 1950 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 7, 1950, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent state auditor W. H. Holmes defeated Republican nominee William Barton, Progressive nominee Howard R. Edsell, Christian Nationalist nominee O. M. Tanner, Prohibition nominee Bertha M. Boutell, Socialist nominee Elizabeth Erbe and Socialist Labor nominee Theodore Baeff.

zh.s: 1950年密苏里州州审计长选举于1950年11月7日举行，以选出该州审计长。民主党候选人、时任州审计长W·H·霍姆斯击败共和党候选人威廉·巴顿、进步党候选人霍华德·R·埃德塞尔、基督教民族主义党候选人O·M·坦纳、禁酒党候选人伯莎·M·布特尔、社会党候选人伊丽莎白·厄布和社会劳工党候选人西奥多·贝夫。

en.s: The 1950 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Democratic Governor Allan Shivers defeated Republican nominee Ralph W. Currie with 89.93% of the vote.

zh.s: 1950年得克萨斯州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任民主党州长艾伦·希弗斯以89.93%的得票率击败共和党候选人拉尔夫·W·柯里。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate elections in Kentucky
en.s: Two United States Senate elections for the Class 3 U.S. Senate seat from Kentucky were held simultaneously on November 7, 1950. After Senator Alben Barkley resigned on January 19, 1949, to become Vice President of the United States, Governor Earle Clements appointed Garrett L. Withers to fill the vacant seat until a successor could be duly elected to complete the expired term.

zh.t: 1950年肯塔基州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年11月7日，肯塔基州同时举行了两场第三类美国联邦参议院选举。阿尔本·巴克利参议员于1949年1月19日辞职出任美国副总统后，州长厄尔·克莱门茨任命加勒特·L·威瑟斯填补空缺，直至选出继任者完成剩余任期。

en.s: The 1950 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1950. Incumbent governor Dan Edward Garvey, who originally ascended to the office of governor following the death of Sidney Preston Osborn and was later elected to a full term, lost the Democratic primary to state Auditor Ana Frohmiller. Frohmiller would become the first woman to be nominated by any party for governor in Arizona.

zh.s: 1950年亚利桑那州州长选举于11月7日举行。时任州长丹·爱德华·加维在西德尼·普雷斯顿·奥斯本去世后接任州长，之后当选完成一个完整任期。此次他在民主党初选中败给州审计长安娜·弗罗米勒。弗罗米勒后来成为亚利桑那州首位获得任何政党州长提名的女性。

en.s: The 1950 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950. Republican nominee Theodore McKeldin defeated Democratic incumbent William Preston Lane Jr. with 57.28% of the vote.

zh.s: 1950年马里兰州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。共和党候选人西奥多·麦凯尔丁以57.28%的得票率击败民主党时任州长小威廉·普雷斯顿·莱恩。

en.s: The 1950 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Democrat G. Mennen Williams defeated Republican nominee Harry Kelly with 49.76% of the vote. With a margin of only 0.06%, this is the closest gubernatorial election in Michigan's history.

zh.s: 1950年密歇根州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任民主党州长G·梅嫩·威廉姆斯以49.76%的得票率击败共和党候选人哈里·凯利。双方差距仅0.06个百分点，这是密歇根州历史上差距最小的州长选举。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Homer Capehart was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Democrat Alex Campbell.

zh.t: 1950年印第安纳州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年印第安纳州美国联邦参议院选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任共和党联邦参议员霍默·凯普哈特击败民主党候选人亚历克斯·坎贝尔，连任第二届。

en.s: The 1950 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 7, 1950, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general Hall Hammond defeated Republican nominee William A. Gunter.

zh.s: 1950年马里兰州总检察长选举于1950年11月7日举行，以选出该州总检察长。民主党候选人、时任总检察长霍尔·哈蒙德击败共和党候选人威廉·A·冈特。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in Iowa took place on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Republican Senator Bourke B. Hickenlooper was re-elected to a second term in office over Democratic U.S. Undersecretary of Agriculture Albert J. Loveland. Primary elections were held on June 5. Senator Hickenlooper faced nominal opposition for re-nomination in the Republican primary, while Loveland won a plurality over a five-man Democratic field including former Governor Nelson G.

zh.t: 1950年爱荷华州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年爱荷华州美国参议院选举于11月7日举行。共和党籍现任参议员伯克·B·希肯卢珀击败民主党候选人、美国农业部副部长阿尔伯特·J·洛夫兰，成功连任，开启第二个任期。初选于6月5日举行。希肯卢珀在共和党初选中几乎没有对手；洛夫兰则在有5名候选人的民主党初选中获得最多票，胜过前州长纳尔逊·G·克拉舍尔和前联邦众议员奥萨·韦林等人。

en.s: The 1950 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950. Republican nominee John Davis Lodge defeated Democratic incumbent Chester Bowles with 49.66% of the vote. This was the first gubernatorial election since the law was changed to have Connecticut's governors elected every four years, instead of every two years, as had been done previously. As a result, Lodge was the first Connecticut Governor to serve a four-year term.

zh.s: 1950年康涅狄格州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。共和党候选人约翰·戴维斯·洛奇以49.66%的得票率击败民主党时任州长切斯特·鲍尔斯。这是康涅狄格州修改法律、将州长选举周期从两年改为四年后的首次州长选举，因此洛奇是该州首位任期四年的州长。

en.s: The 1950 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950, and featured incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Charles J. Warner, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee Edward A. Dosek, a businessman, to win his second term as lieutenant governor.

zh.t: 1950年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1950年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任共和党副州长查尔斯·J·华纳击败民主党候选人、商人爱德华·A·多塞克，连任副州长。

en.s: The 1950 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 7, 1950, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Joseph A. A. Burnquist defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Orville Freeman.

zh.t: 1950年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1950年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于1950年11月7日举行，以选出该州总检察长。共和党候选人、时任总检察长约瑟夫·A·A·伯恩奎斯特击败民主农民劳工党候选人奥维尔·弗里曼。

en.s: The 1950 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Democrat Vail Pittman ran unsuccessfully for re-election to a second term as Governor of Nevada. He was defeated by Republican nominee Charles H. Russell with 57.65% of the vote.

zh.s: 1950年内华达州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任民主党州长维尔·皮特曼竞选连任第二届，但未能当选。他以57.65%的得票率败给了共和党候选人查尔斯·H·拉塞尔。

en.s: The 1950 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1950 to elect the governor of the U.S. state of Oregon. Incumbent Republican governor Douglas McKay defeated Democratic nominee Austin F. Flegel in a landslide, sweeping every county in the state. McKay had been elected in a 1948 gubernatorial special election to replace interim governor John Hubert Hall.

zh.s: 1950年俄勒冈州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行，以选出俄勒冈州州长。时任共和党州长道格拉斯·麦凯以压倒性优势击败民主党候选人奥斯汀·F·弗莱格尔，赢得全州每个县。麦凯在1948年州长特别选举中当选，接替临时州长约翰·休伯特·霍尔。

en.s: The 1950 Alabama Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 7, 1950, to elect 35 representatives to serve four-year terms in the Alabama Senate. The election used the same districts first drawn by the Alabama Constitution of 1901. 34 of the 35 Democratic nominees did not face any opposition in the general election. As the Democratic Party was dominant in the state, state legislative seats were generally decided at the Democratic primary election.

zh.s: 1950年阿拉巴马州参议院选举于1950年11月7日（星期二）举行，选出35名州参议员，任期四年。选举沿用1901年《阿拉巴马州宪法》划定的选区。35名民主党候选人中有34人没有大选对手。由于民主党在该州占主导地位，州议会席位通常由民主党初选决定。

en.s: The 1950 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950. Republican nominee Edward F. Arn defeated Democratic nominee Kenneth T. Anderson with 53.77% of the vote.

zh.s: 1950年堪萨斯州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。共和党候选人爱德华·F·阿恩以53.77%的得票率击败民主党候选人肯尼思·T·安德森。

en.s: The 1950 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950, to elect the next governor of Tennessee. Incumbent Democratic governor Gordon Browning defeated Independent John Randolph Neal Jr. with 78.1% of the vote, carrying every county in the state. For the first time since the Civil war, no Republican ran in the general election.

zh.s: 1950年田纳西州州长选举于11月7日举行，以选出下一任州长。时任民主党州长戈登·布朗宁以78.1%的得票率击败独立候选人小约翰·伦道夫·尼尔，赢得全州每个县。自南北战争以来，这是首次没有共和党人参加大选。

en.s: The 1950 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Republican Governor Oscar Rennebohm did not seek a third term. Republican nominee Walter J. Kohler Jr. defeated Democratic nominee Carl W. Thompson with 53.21% of the vote.

zh.s: 1950年威斯康星州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任共和党州长奥斯卡·伦内博姆没有竞选第三个任期。共和党候选人小沃尔特·J·科勒以53.21%的得票率击败民主党候选人卡尔·W·汤普森。

en.s: The 1950 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 7, 1950, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Mike Holm defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Marie F. McGuire.

zh.s: 1950年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于1950年11月7日举行，以选出该州州务卿。共和党候选人、时任州务卿迈克·霍尔姆击败民主农民劳工党候选人玛丽·F·麦圭尔。

en.s: The 1950 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950. Republican nominee Daniel I. J. Thornton defeated Democratic incumbent Walter Walford Johnson with 52.43% of the vote.

zh.s: 1950年科罗拉多州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。共和党候选人丹尼尔·I·J·桑顿以52.43%的得票率击败民主党时任州长沃尔特·沃尔福德·约翰逊。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in South Dakota took place on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Republican senator Chan Gurney ran for re-election to a third term. He was challenged in the Republican primary by Congressman Francis H. Case, who had represented the 2nd District since 1939. In the general election, Case faced John A. Engel, an attorney and the 1948 Democratic nominee for the U.S.

zh.t: 1950年南达科他州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年南达科他州美国参议院选举于11月7日举行。共和党籍现任参议员钱·格尼竞选第三个任期。曾自1939年起代表南达科他州第二选区的联邦众议员弗朗西斯·H·凯斯在共和党初选中挑战格尼。大选中，凯斯面对律师、1948年民主党参议员候选人约翰·A·恩格尔。共和党当时在全国范围内取得显著进展，凯斯最终以压倒性优势击败恩格尔。

en.s: Elections were held in the U.S. state of Illinois on Tuesday, November 7, 1950. Primaries were held April 11, 1950.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1950年11月7日（星期二）举行选举，初选于同年4月11日举行。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Senator Robert A. Taft was elected to a third term in office, defeating Democratic State Auditor and 1944 presidential candidate Joseph T. Ferguson.

zh.t: 1950年俄亥俄州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年俄亥俄州美国联邦参议院选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任参议员罗伯特·A·塔夫脱当选第三届，击败民主党州审计长、1944年总统候选人约瑟夫·T·弗格森。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate elections in Kansas
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate elections in Kansas took place on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Republican Senator Clyde M. Reed died in office on November 8, 1949. Governor Frank Carlson appointed Harry Darby to serve out the remaining year of Reed's term. Two elections for the same Senate seat were held on the same day: one as a special election to fill the remainder of Reed's six-year term, and another to elect a Senator to serve the next six-year term.

zh.t: 1950年堪萨斯州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年堪萨斯州美国联邦参议院选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任共和党参议员克莱德·M·里德于1949年11月8日在任内去世。州长弗兰克·卡尔森任命哈里·达比接完里德剩余的一年任期。同一天举行了两场针对同一参议院席位的选举：一场特别选举，用于填补里德六年任期的剩余部分；另一场则选出下一任六年任期的参议员。

en.s: The 1950 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Democrat Frank Lausche defeated Republican nominee Don H. Ebright with 52.62% of the vote.

zh.s: 1950年俄亥俄州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任民主党州长弗兰克·劳舍以52.62%的得票率击败共和党候选人唐·H·伊布赖特。

en.s: The 1950 Rhode Island Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 7, 1950, to elect 44 representatives to serve two-year terms in the Rhode Island Senate. The Democratic Party primaries were held on September 18, 1950, and the Republican Party primaries were held on September 27, 1950. Nearly every municipality elected one senator, save for Pawtucket and Providence, which elected two and five respectively due to their higher populations.

zh.s: 1950年罗得岛州参议院选举于1950年11月7日（星期二）举行，选出44名州参议员，任期两年。民主党初选于1950年9月18日举行，共和党初选于9月27日举行。除波塔基特和普罗维登斯因人口较多分别选出2名和5名参议员外，几乎每个市镇都选出1名参议员。

en.s: The 1950 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Democrat Johnston Murray defeated Republican Jo O. Ferguson. Phil Ferguson unsuccessfully sought the Democratic nomination.

zh.s: 1950年俄克拉何马州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。民主党人约翰斯顿·默里击败共和党人乔·O·弗格森。菲尔·弗格森曾竞选民主党州长提名，但未能胜出。

en.s: The 1950 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Lieutenant Governor C. Elmer Anderson defeated Minnesota Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party challenger Frank Murphy.

zh.s: 1950年明尼苏达州副州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任副州长C·埃尔默·安德森击败明尼苏达州民主农民劳工党候选人弗兰克·墨菲。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate elections in Arizona took place on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Carl Hayden ran for reelection to a fifth term, defeating Republican nominee Bruce Brockett in the general election. Brockett was formerly the Republican nominee for governor in both 1946 and 1948.

zh.t: 1950年亚利桑那州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年亚利桑那州美国联邦参议院选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任民主党联邦参议员卡尔·海登竞选连任第五届，并在大选中击败共和党候选人布鲁斯·布罗克特。布罗克特曾在1946年和1948年两度获得共和党州长候选人提名。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Republican Senator Eugene Millikin ran for re-election to his second full term. He faced a strong challenge from Congressman John A. Carroll, the Democratic nominee, in the general election. Carroll ultimately lost, but despite facing considerable headwinds nationwide, held Millikin to the narrowest victory of his career.

zh.t: 1950年科罗拉多州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年科罗拉多州美国联邦参议院选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任共和党参议员尤金·米利金竞选连任第二个完整任期。大选中，他面对民主党候选人、联邦众议员约翰·A·卡罗尔的强力挑战。卡罗尔最终落败，但尽管全国局势对他不利，他仍让米利金以职业生涯中最小的优势获胜。

en.s: The 1950 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Republican Sherman Adams defeated Democratic nominee Robert P. Bingham with 56.95% of the vote.

zh.s: 1950年新罕布什尔州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任共和党州长谢尔曼·亚当斯以56.95%的得票率击败民主党候选人罗伯特·P·宾厄姆。

en.s: The 1950 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Republican William S. Beardsley defeated Democratic nominee Lester S. Gillette with 59.10% of the vote.

zh.s: 1950年艾奥瓦州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任共和党州长威廉·S·比尔兹利以59.10%的得票率击败民主党候选人莱斯特·S·吉列。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Democratic Senator Elmer Thomas ran for re-election to a fifth term. However, though he had successfully beat back primary challengers in past elections, he was ultimately defeated by Congressman Mike Monroney. Monroney advanced to the general election, where he faced Reverend Bill Alexander, the Republican nominee.

zh.t: 1950年俄克拉何马州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年俄克拉何马州美国联邦参议院选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任民主党参议员埃尔默·托马斯竞选连任第五届。尽管他过去成功击退了初选挑战者，这次最终仍败给了联邦众议员迈克·莫诺尼。莫诺尼随后进入大选，对阵共和党候选人、牧师比尔·亚历山大。

en.s: The 1950 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1950, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Democrat Thomas J. Mabry was term-limited, and could not run for a third consecutive term. David Chávez unsuccessfully sought the Democratic nomination. Republican Edwin L. Mechem comfortably won the election, defeating former Democratic governor John E. Miles. Mechem, who is the nephew of former governor Merritt C.

zh.s: 1950年新墨西哥州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行，以选出该州州长。时任民主党州长托马斯·J·马布里受任期限制，不能连续竞选第三届。戴维·查韦斯曾竞选民主党提名，但未能胜出。共和党人埃德温·L·米彻姆轻松当选，击败民主党前州长约翰·E·迈尔斯。米彻姆是前州长梅里特·C·米彻姆的侄子。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in Connecticut was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Democratic Senator Brien McMahon was re-elected to a second term in office over Republican former U.S. Representative Joseph E. Talbot.

zh.t: 1950年康涅狄格州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年康涅狄格州美国联邦参议院选举于1950年11月7日举行。时任民主党参议员布赖恩·麦克马洪击败共和党前联邦众议员约瑟夫·E·塔尔博特，连任第二届。

en.s: The 1950 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950. Republican nominee Norman Brunsdale defeated Democratic nominee Clyde G. Byerly with 66.29% of the vote.

zh.s: 1950年北达科他州州长选举于1950年11月7日举行。共和党候选人诺曼·布伦斯代尔以66.29%的得票率击败民主党候选人克莱德·G·拜厄利。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1950 in New York was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Democratic Senator Herbert H. Lehman was re-elected to a full term in office over Republican Joe Hanley. This election is also noted for the campaign of African-American cultural and civil rights icon W. E. B. Du Bois, who ran at age 82 on the American Labor Party ticket.

zh.t: 1950年美国联邦参议院纽约州选举
zh.s: 1950年11月7日，纽约州举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍现任参议员赫伯特·H·雷曼击败共和党人乔·汉利，连任完整任期。非裔美国文化界和民权运动代表人物W·E·B·杜波依斯也参加了此次选举；他代表美国工党参选时已82岁。

en.s: The 1950 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor Marvin Griffin ran unopposed and subsequently won the election.

zh.s: 1950年11月7日，佐治亚州举行副州长选举。民主党候选人、时任副州长马文·格里芬没有对手，随后当选。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 7, 1950. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Warren Magnuson won a second term in office, defeating Republican nominee W. Walter Williams.

zh.t: 1950年美国联邦参议院华盛顿州选举
zh.s: 1950年11月7日，华盛顿州举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍现任参议员沃伦·马格努森击败共和党候选人W·沃尔特·威廉斯，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1950 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1950, to elect the Governor and Lieutenant Governor of New York. Incumbent Republican governor Thomas E. Dewey was re-elected to a third term in office, defeating Democratic U.S. Representative Walter A. Lynch. This was the final election in which the voters cast separate ballots for governor and lieutenant governor, ahead of a 1953 amendment to the New York Constitution.

zh.s: 1950年11月7日，纽约州举行州长和副州长选举。共和党籍现任州长托马斯·E·杜威击败民主党籍联邦众议员沃尔特·A·林奇，连任第三个任期。这是纽约州选民最后一次分别投票选举州长和副州长；1953年的州宪法修正案改变了这一做法。

en.s: The 1950 New York state election was held on November 7, 1950, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the state comptroller, the attorney general and a U.S. senator, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1950年11月7日，纽约州举行州选举，选出州长、副州长、州审计长、总检察长、一名联邦参议员，以及纽约州众议院和参议院全体议员。

en.s: The 1950 United States Senate elections occurred in the middle of Harry S. Truman's second term as president. The 32 seats of Class 3 were contested in regular elections, and four special elections were held to fill vacancies. As with most 20th-century second-term midterms, the party not holding the presidency made significant gains.

zh.s: 1950年美国联邦参议院选举在哈里·S·杜鲁门总统第二个任期中举行。第三类32个席位通过常规选举改选，另举行四场特别选举填补空缺。与20世纪多数总统第二任期中期选举一样，没有执政党的政党大幅增加了席位。

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in California was held on November 7 of that year, following a campaign characterized by accusations and name-calling. Republican Representative and future President Richard Nixon defeated Democrat Representative Helen Gahagan Douglas, after Democratic incumbent Sheridan Downey withdrew during the primary election campaign. Douglas and Nixon each gave up their congressional seats to run against Downey; no other representatives were willing to risk the contest.

zh.t: 1950年美国联邦参议院加利福尼亚州选举
zh.s: 1950年11月7日，加利福尼亚州举行联邦参议院选举，竞选期间双方相互指责、恶语相向。共和党联邦众议员、后来成为总统的理查德·尼克松击败民主党联邦众议员海伦·加哈根·道格拉斯。民主党籍现任参议员谢里登·唐尼在初选期间退出竞选。道格拉斯和尼克松都放弃众议员席位参选唐尼的席位，没有其他联邦众议员愿意冒险参选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1950 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 7 to elect the next governor of Idaho, alongside elections to the United States Senate, elections to the U.S. House, and other state and local elections. Idaho changed the term for governor from two to four years starting with the 1946 election, and the incumbent was not allowed to run for a second term (self-succession) until 1958.

zh.s: 1950年11月7日，爱达荷州举行州长选举，同时举行联邦参议院、联邦众议院及其他州和地方选举。爱达荷州从1946年选举起将州长任期由两年改为四年，直到1958年才允许现任州长竞选连任。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in Alabama
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in Alabama was held on Tuesday, November 7, to elect one United States Senator Democratic candidate incumbent Senator J. Lister Hill was re-elected for a third term in office, defeating retired United States Navy Rear Admiral John G. Crommelin, who ran as an independent candidate.

zh.t: 1950年美国联邦参议院阿拉巴马州选举
zh.s: 1950年11月7日，星期二，阿拉巴马州举行联邦参议院选举，选出一名联邦参议员。民主党籍现任参议员J·李斯特·希尔连任第三个任期，击败以独立候选人身份参选的约翰·G·克罗梅林。他曾任美国海军少将，现已退役。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: 1950 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 1950 United States Senate election in Illinois was held on Tuesday, November 7. Democratic incumbent Scott W. Lucas, who was also Senate majority leader, ran for a third term in office but was defeated by Republican U.S. representative Everett Dirksen. Primary elections were held on April 11. Lucas was unopposed for the Democratic Party nomination, having secured the unanimous support of his party, while Dirksen defeated William J.

zh.t: 1950年伊利诺伊州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1950年伊利诺伊州美国参议院选举于11月7日星期二举行。民主党籍现任参议员、参议院多数党领袖斯科特·W·卢卡斯竞选第三个任期，但败给共和党籍联邦众议员埃弗里特·德克森。初选于4月11日举行。卢卡斯在民主党初选中没有对手，获得全党一致支持；德克森则击败威廉·J·贝克和长期参选者拉里·戴利，赢得共和党提名。

en.s: The 1950 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1950 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 22 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1950 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1950年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是1950年美国两年一度选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民在州参议院50个选区中的22个选区选出参议员。州参议员任期四年。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1950年全州50个州参议院选区的地图。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1950 Pennsylvania gubernatorial election was held on November 7. For the twenty-second time in twenty-five elections, the Republican candidate was victorious, but by a much smaller than usual margin. Superior Court Judge John S. Fine defeated Democrat Richardson Dilworth, the City Controller of Philadelphia. This election marked the last time until 2022 that a political party would win three consecutive gubernatorial elections in Pennsylvania.

zh.s: 1950年11月7日，宾夕法尼亚州举行州长选举。在此前25次选举中的22次，获胜者都是共和党候选人；但此次共和党获胜的优势比往常小得多。高等法院法官约翰·S·芬恩击败民主党人、费城市主计长理查森·迪尔沃思。这是宾夕法尼亚州政党连续三次赢得州长选举的最后一次，直到2022年才再次出现。

en.s: The 1951 Bulgarian Cup final was the 11th final of the Bulgarian Cup (in this period the tournament was named Cup of the Soviet Army), and was contested between CSKA Sofia and Akademik Sofia on 7 November 1951 at People's Army Stadium in Sofia. CSKA won the final 1–0 after extra time.

zh.s: 1951年11月7日，索菲亚中央陆军队与索菲亚学术队在索菲亚人民军体育场举行保加利亚杯第11届决赛。当时赛事名为苏联军队杯。索菲亚中央陆军队在加时赛后以1比0获胜。

en.s: The 1954 Bulgarian Cup final was the 14th final of the Bulgarian Cup (in this period the tournament was named Cup of the Soviet Army), and was contested between CSKA Sofia and Slavia Sofia on 7 November 1954 at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. CSKA won the final 2–1, claiming their second national cup title.

zh.s: 1954年11月7日，索菲亚中央陆军队与索菲亚斯拉维亚队在索菲亚瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场举行保加利亚杯第14届决赛。当时赛事名为苏联军队杯。索菲亚中央陆军队以2比1获胜，拿下第二个国内杯赛冠军。

en.t: United States Senate election in Oregon, 1956
en.s: The 1956 Oregon United States Senate election was held on November 7, 1956 to select the U.S. Senator from the state of Oregon. Republican-turned-Independent-turned Democratic Senator Wayne Morse decided to seek re-election for his first full term as a Democrat. Morse defeated Republican candidate Douglas McKay in the hotly contested general election.

zh.t: 1956年俄勒冈州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1956年俄勒冈州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行，选出该州联邦参议员。曾先后加入共和党、转为独立人士、再加入民主党的参议员韦恩·莫尔斯决定以民主党人身份竞选第一个完整任期。他在竞争激烈的大选中击败共和党候选人道格拉斯·麦凯。

en.s: The Suez Crisis, also known as the second Arab–Israeli war, the Tripartite Aggression in the Arab world and the Sinai War in Israel, was a British–French–Israeli invasion of Egypt in 1956. Israel invaded on 29 October, with the primary objective of re-opening the Straits of Tiran and the Gulf of Aqaba as the recent tightening of the eight-year-long Egyptian blockade further prevented Israeli passage.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 苏伊士危机又称第二次阿以战争、阿拉伯世界所称的“三方侵略”，以及以色列所称的“西奈战争”，是1956年英国、法国和以色列入侵埃及的事件。以色列于10月29日发动入侵，主要目的是重新开放蒂朗海峡和亚喀巴湾；此前埃及封锁进一步收紧，阻碍了以色列通行。
