en.s: The 1957 Bulgarian Cup final was the 17th final of the Bulgarian Cup (in this period the tournament was named Cup of the Soviet Army), and was contested between Levski Sofia and Spartak Pleven on 7 November 1957 at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. Levski won the final 2–1.

zh.s: 1957年11月7日，索菲亚列夫斯基队与普列文斯巴达克队在索菲亚瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场举行保加利亚杯第17届决赛。当时赛事名为苏联军队杯。索菲亚列夫斯基队以2比1获胜。

en.s: The 1958 Bulgarian Cup final was the 18th final of the Bulgarian Cup (in this period the tournament was named Cup of the Soviet Army), and was contested between Spartak Plovdiv and Minyor Pernik on 7 November 1958 at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. Spartak won the final 1–0.

zh.s: 1958年11月7日，普罗夫迪夫斯巴达克队与佩尔尼克矿工队在索菲亚瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场举行保加利亚杯第18届决赛。当时赛事名为苏联军队杯。普罗夫迪夫斯巴达克队以1比0获胜。

en.s: The New York City mayoral election of 1961 occurred on Tuesday, November 7, 1961, with incumbent Democratic Mayor Robert F. Wagner, Jr. going on to win a decisive re-election victory for a third term in office. Wagner defeated the Republican nominee, state Attorney General Louis J. Lefkowitz, and the Citizens Party nominee, New York City Comptroller Lawrence E. Gerosa. Wagner received 51.03% of the vote to Lefkowitz's 34.46%, a Democratic victory margin of 16.57%. Gerosa finished in third, with 13.26%. Gerosa, running with the short-lived left-wing Citizens Party, billed himself as the "real Democrat" in the race, and took many liberal votes, finishing relatively strongly for a third party candidate.

zh.s: 1961年纽约市市长选举于11月7日星期二举行。民主党籍现任市长罗伯特·F·瓦格纳二世赢得决定性胜利，连任第三届。瓦格纳击败了共和党候选人、州检察长路易斯·J·莱夫科维茨，以及公民党候选人、纽约市审计长劳伦斯·E·杰罗萨。瓦格纳得票率为51.03%，莱夫科维茨为34.46%，相差16.57个百分点。杰罗萨以13.26%位居第三。他代表短暂存在的左翼公民党参选，自称“真正的民主党人”，吸引了不少自由派选票，作为第三党候选人表现相对突出。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1961 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 7, 1961. Democrat Richard J. Hughes defeated Republican nominee James P. Mitchell with 50.37% of the vote.

zh.s: 1961年新泽西州州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党候选人理查德·J·休斯以50.37%的选票击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·P·米切尔。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Mayoral election of 1961 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 7, 1961. The incumbent mayor, Joe Barr of the Democratic Party won his first full term as mayor, after achieving the position in a 1959 special election. Barr received more than twice as many votes as his Republican opponent, insurance agent William Crehan.

zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市长选举于1961年11月7日星期二举行。民主党籍现任市长乔·巴尔赢得第一个完整任期；他此前在1959年特别选举中当选并就任。巴尔的得票超过共和党对手、保险代理人威廉·克里汉的两倍。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1961 Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1961, to elect the governor of Virginia. Democratic former attorney general Albertis Harrison defeated Republican former state delegate H. Clyde Pearson. Incumbent Democratic governor J. Lindsay Almond was ineligible to seek re-election to a second term due to the state's prohibition on consecutive gubernatorial terms.

zh.s: 1961年弗吉尼亚州州长选举于1961年11月7日举行，以选出该州州长。民主党前总检察长阿尔伯蒂斯·哈里森击败共和党前州众议员H·克莱德·皮尔森。由于该州禁止州长连续任职，时任民主党州长J·林赛·阿尔蒙德不能竞选连任第二届。

en.s: The 1961 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1961, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Virginia. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Virginia Senate Mills Godwin defeated Republican nominee Hazel K. Barger.

zh.s: 1961年弗吉尼亚州副州长选举于1961年11月7日举行，以选出该州副州长。民主党候选人、时任弗吉尼亚州参议员米尔斯·戈德温击败共和党候选人黑泽尔·K·巴格。

en.s: Philadelphia's municipal election of November 7, 1961, involved the election of the district attorney, city controller, and several judgeships. Democrats swept all of the city races but saw their vote totals much reduced from those of four years earlier, owing to a growing graft scandal in city government. District Attorney James C. Crumlish, Jr. and City Controller Alexander Hemphill, both incumbents, were returned to office.

zh.s: 1961年11月7日的费城市政选举选出地方检察官、市审计长和数名法官。民主党赢得了所有市级选举，但由于市政府腐败丑闻愈演愈烈，其得票总数比四年前大幅减少。时任地方检察官小詹姆斯·C·克拉姆利什和市审计长亚历山大·亨普希尔均成功连任。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on 7 November 1961, in two states, New Jersey and Virginia. The elections did not result in any change of balance between Republican and Democratic seats.

zh.s: 1961年11月7日，美国有两个州举行州长选举，分别是新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州。选举没有改变共和党和民主党所占州长席位的比例。

en.s: The 1962 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1962. Incumbent Democratic Governor Jack R. Gage, who ascended to the governorship after his predecessor, John J. Hickey, appointed himself to the U.S. Senate in 1961, ran for re-election. After beating back a strong challenge from former Secretary of State William M.

zh.s: 1962年怀俄明州州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党籍现任州长杰克·R·盖奇在前任约翰·J·希基于1961年自行任命出任联邦参议员后接任州长，并竞选连任。他在民主党初选中击退前州务卿威廉·M·杰克的强劲挑战，随后面对共和党候选人克利福德·汉森。汉森曾任怀俄明大学董事会主席和提顿县县委员。1962年共和党表现强劲，汉森大胜盖奇；这是怀俄明州州长在任期间败选的最后一次。

en.s: The 1963 Kinross and Western Perthshire by-election of 7 November 1963 was a by-election to the UK House of Commons. It was unique among by-elections since 1918 in that one of the candidates was the sitting prime minister, Alec Douglas-Home; he was nominated for the constituency after disclaiming a peerage, as he felt he needed to be a member of the Commons rather than the House of Lords during his premiership.

zh.t: 1963年金罗斯与西珀斯郡西部补选
zh.s: 1963年11月7日举行的金罗斯与西珀斯郡西部补选是英国下议院补选。自1918年以来，这是唯一一次有现任首相参选的补选：亚历克·道格拉斯-休姆在放弃贵族头衔后获提名参加该选区选举，因为他认为担任首相期间必须是下议院议员，而非上议院议员。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Portugal on 7 November 1965.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1965年11月7日举行议会选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Ayer Itam by-election was a state assembly by-election that was held on 7 November 1965 in the state of Penang, Malaysia. The Ayer Itam seat fell vacant following the death of its MCA MLA Mr. Chor Sin Kheng Chor won the seat in 1964 Malaysian general election. Lim Kean Siew of Socialist Front, won the by election, defeating David Choong of Alliance and Tan Gim Hwa of UDP with a slim majority of 153 votes.

zh.s: 1965年11月7日，马来西亚槟城州举行亚逸依淡州议会补选。该席位原议员、马华公会的卓新清先生去世后出现空缺，他曾在1964年马来西亚大选中赢得该席位。社会主义阵线候选人林建寿以153票的微弱优势击败联盟候选人张昌和民主联合党候选人陈锦华。

en.s: General elections were held in Trinidad and Tobago on 7 November 1966. The result was a victory for the People's National Movement, which won 24 of the 36 seats. Voter turnout was 65.8%.

zh.s: 特立尼达和多巴哥于1966年11月7日举行大选。人民民族运动党获胜，在36个席位中赢得24席。投票率为65.8%。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1967 occurred on Tuesday, November 7, 1967 between Secretary of the Commonwealth Kevin White and Boston School Committee member Louise Day Hicks. White was elected to his first term. The nonpartisan municipal preliminary election was held on September 26, 1967. Hicks' victory in the preliminary election made her the first woman to be a finalist for mayor in city history.

zh.s: 1967年波士顿市长选举于11月7日星期二举行，候选人是联邦州务卿凯文·怀特和波士顿学区委员会成员路易丝·戴·希克斯。怀特当选，开始第一个任期。市政无党派初选于1967年9月26日举行。希克斯赢得初选后成为该市历史上首位进入市长决选的女性。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1967 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1967. Republican nominee Louie Nunn defeated Democratic nominee Henry Ward with 51.20% of the vote. Nunn became the first Republican elected since 1943.

zh.s: 1967年肯塔基州州长选举于1967年11月7日举行。共和党候选人路易·纳恩以51.20%的得票率击败民主党候选人亨利·沃德。纳恩是自1943年以来首位当选州长的共和党人。

en.s: The Indianapolis mayoral election of 1967 took place on November 7, 1967. Richard Lugar defeated incumbent Democratic mayor John J. Barton, becoming the first Republican to be elected mayor of Indianapolis in nearly two-decades. Democrats had long dominated mayoral elections before 1967, having won ten of the thirteen mayoral elections since 1930.

zh.t: 1967年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 1967年印第安纳波利斯市长选举于1967年11月7日举行。理查德·卢格击败时任民主党市长约翰·J·巴顿，成为近20年来首位当选印第安纳波利斯市长的共和党人。1930年以来的13次市长选举中，民主党赢了10次，此前长期占据主导地位。

en.s: The 1967 New Jersey Senate elections were held on November 7, 1967. The elections took place midway through Governor Richard J. Hughes's second term and resulted in a historic landslide for the Republican Party. The new state legislative map still elected most Senators county-wide, allowing Republicans to gain a large majority by sweeping every county except Mercer, Middlesex, and Hudson.

zh.s: 1967年新泽西州参议院选举于1967年11月7日举行。当时州长理查德·J·休斯正处于第二个任期中段，选举结果是共和党取得历史性大胜。新的州议会选区地图仍让大多数参议员按县选出，使共和党得以赢得除默瑟县、米德尔塞克斯县和哈德逊县以外的所有县，从而取得多数席位。

en.s: The 1967 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1967, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat Paul B. Johnson Jr. was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a second term.

zh.s: 1967年密西西比州州长选举于1967年11月7日举行，以选出该州州长。时任民主党州长小保罗·B·约翰逊受任期限制，不能竞选连任第二届。

en.s: The 1967 Philadelphia mayoral election was held on November 7, 1967. Incumbent mayor James Tate narrowly defeated Republican challenger Arlen Specter in the general election. In the Democratic primary, Tate successfully fended off a challenge by Alexander Hemphill, who had the backing of Philadelphia Democratic Party chair Francis R. Smith. Specter would later be elected to the U.S. Senate in 1980, where he served until 2011.

zh.s: 1967年费城市长选举于1967年11月7日举行。时任市长詹姆斯·泰特在大选中以微弱优势击败共和党挑战者阿伦·斯佩克特。民主党初选中，泰特成功击退亚历山大·亨普希尔的挑战，后者得到费城民主党主席弗朗西斯·R·史密斯支持。斯佩克特后来于1980年当选美国联邦参议员，并任职至2011年。

en.s: The 1967 San Diego mayoral election was held on November 7, 1967, to elect the mayor for San Diego. Incumbent Mayor Frank Curran stood for reelection to a second term. In the primary election, Curran and Allen Hitch received the most votes and advanced to the runoff. Curran was then reelected mayor with a majority of the votes.

zh.s: 1967年11月7日，圣迭戈举行市长选举。时任市长弗兰克·柯伦竞选连任第二个任期。初选中，柯伦和艾伦·希奇得票最多，进入决选。柯伦随后以多数票胜出，连任市长。

en.s: The 1967 San Francisco mayoral election was held on November 7, 1967.

zh.s: 1967年11月7日，旧金山举行市长选举。

en.s: The 1967 Gary, Indiana, mayoral election, held on November 7, saw the election of Richard G. Hatcher. This was, along with the coinciding election in Cleveland, Ohio, the first election of an African American as mayor of an American city with a population over 100,000. Hatcher would also become the first African-American mayor in the state of Indiana.

zh.t: 1967年印第安纳州加里市长选举
zh.s: 1967年11月7日，印第安纳州加里举行市长选举，理查德·G·哈彻当选。与同日举行的俄亥俄州克利夫兰市长选举一样，这是美国首次有一座人口超过10万的城市选出非裔市长。哈彻也将成为印第安纳州首位非裔市长。

en.s: The Columbus mayoral election of 1967 was the 73rd mayoral election in Columbus, Ohio, United States. During the primary nomination on May 2, 1967, the Columbus electorate nominated Republican Jerry Spears, Jr., a businessman from the Hilltop neighborhood, and incumbent Democratic mayor Jack Sensenbrenner to compete in the mayoral election. On Tuesday, November 7, 1967, mayor Jack Sensenbrenner defeated Jerry Spears, Jr.

zh.t: 1967年俄亥俄州哥伦布市长选举
zh.s: 1967年，俄亥俄州哥伦布举行第73次市长选举。5月2日的初选提名共和党商人杰里·斯皮尔斯二世和民主党籍时任市长杰克·森森布伦纳参选。1967年11月7日星期二，森森布伦纳击败斯皮尔斯，当选市长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Cleveland mayoral election of 1967 saw the election of Carl Stokes. Stokes was the first elected African American mayor of a major American city (Cleveland was, at the time, the ninth largest city in the United States). His election came alongside the election of Richard G. Hatcher in the 1967 Gary, Indiana, mayoral election. Together, these were the first elections of African-Americans as mayors of cities over 100,000.

zh.s: 1967年克利夫兰市长选举中，卡尔·斯托克斯当选。他是美国首位当选大城市市长的非裔美国人；当时克利夫兰是美国第九大城市。他当选的同时，理查德·G·哈彻也在1967年印第安纳州加里市长选举中当选。两次选举都是人口超过10万的城市首次选出非裔市长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Public Broadcasting Act of 1967 (47 U.S.C. § 396) issued the congressional corporate charter for the Corporation for Public Broadcasting (CPB), a private nonprofit corporation funded by taxpayers to disburse grants to public broadcasters in the United States. The act was supported by many prominent Americans, including Fred Rogers ("Mister Rogers"), NPR founder and creator of All Things Considered Robert Conley, and Senator John O.
en.n: This entry records the signing, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 《1967年公共广播法》（《美国法典》第47编第396条）为公共广播公司（CPB）颁发了国会特许状。CPB是一家由纳税人出资、向美国公共广播机构发放拨款的私人非营利公司。该法案得到许多知名人士支持，包括弗雷德·罗杰斯（“罗杰斯先生”）、NPR创办者及《All Things Considered》节目创作者罗伯特·康利，以及来自罗得岛州的参议员约翰·O·帕斯托雷；帕斯托雷当时担任参议院通信小组委员会主席，并在1967年的联邦众议院和参议院听证会上支持该法案。
zh.n: 本条目记录源信息框所列的签署日期。

en.s: Operation Sheridan Sabre was a security operation during the Vietnam War in Bình Long Province to prevent People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) infiltration from Cambodia, that took place from 7 November 1968 to 4 April 1969.

zh.s: 越南战争期间，美军于1968年11月7日至1969年4月4日在平隆省开展谢里登军刀行动，以阻止越南人民军从柬埔寨渗透。

en.t: 1969 Liberal Party of Australia leadership spill
en.s: The Liberal Party of Australia held a leadership spill on 7 November 1969, following the party's poor performance at the federal election on 25 October. Prime Minister John Gorton was re-elected as the party's leader, defeating challengers William McMahon and David Fairbairn. This is the only time that a prime minister had been challenged for the party leadership directly following on from an election.

zh.t: 1969年澳大利亚自由党领袖改选
zh.s: 1969年11月7日，澳大利亚自由党举行领袖改选。该党在10月25日联邦选举中表现不佳后，时任总理约翰·戈顿再次当选党领袖，击败挑战者威廉·麦克马洪和戴维·费尔贝恩。这是唯一一次总理在选举结束后立即遭到党内领袖职位挑战。

en.s: Operation Pipestone Canyon was a US Marine Corps, Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) and Republic of Korea Marine Corps (ROKMC) operation that took place on Go Noi Island, Quảng Nam Province, lasting from 26 May to 7 November 1969.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1969年5月26日至11月7日，美国海军陆战队、越南共和国军和韩国海军陆战队在越南广南省戈诺伊岛开展碎石峡谷行动。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: General elections were held in Belgium on 7 November 1971. The result was a victory for the Christian People's Party, which won 40 of the 212 seats in the Chamber of Representatives and 34 of the 106 seats in the Senate. Voter turnout was 91.5%. Elections to the nine provincial councils were also held. The linguistic issues led to the splitting of the major parties into separate Flemish and Francophone parties. Consequently the election returned a very fragmented parliament. The election followed the first state reform, with the creation of three cultural communities.

zh.s: 比利时于1971年11月7日举行大选。基督教人民党获胜，在212个众议院席位中赢得40席，在106个参议院席位中赢得34席。投票率为91.5%。当天还举行了9个省议会选举。语言问题导致主要政党分裂为弗拉芒语政党和法语政党，选后议会因此十分分散。此次选举是在首次国家改革、三个文化共同体成立之后举行的。

en.s: The 1972 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1972 to elect the Governor of Texas. Incumbent Democratic Governor Preston Smith was running for reelection, but was defeated in the Democratic primary by businessman Dolph Briscoe. Briscoe went on to win the election by a relatively small margin, winning 48% of the vote to Republican Henry Grover's 45%. Raza Unida candidate Ramsey Muniz won 6%. The 1972 election marked the last time that a gubernatorial election was held concurrently with a presidential election and the last time that a governor was elected for a two-year term.

zh.s: 1972年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月7日举行，选举州长。民主党籍现任州长普雷斯顿·史密斯寻求连任，但在民主党初选中败给商人多尔夫·布里斯科。布里斯科随后以较小优势赢得大选，得票率为48%；共和党候选人亨利·格罗弗获得45%，团结拉扎党候选人拉姆齐·穆尼斯获得6%。这是最后一次与总统选举同日举行的州长选举，也是最后一次由州长当选后只任两年。

en.t: United States Senate election in Delaware, 1972
en.s: The United States Senate election in Delaware, 1972 was held on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Republican United States Senator J. Caleb Boggs ran for a third term in the United States Senate. Boggs faced off against Joe Biden, a New Castle County Councilman. Though Senator Boggs was expected to easily win a third term over the then-unknown Biden, it ended up being the closest Senate election in 1972, and Biden narrowly beat out Boggs by a little over three thousand votes, winning what would be his first of seven terms.

zh.t: 1972年特拉华州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年特拉华州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。共和党籍现任参议员J·卡莱布·博格斯竞选第三个参议员任期，对手是新堡县议会议员乔·拜登。尽管外界原本认为博格斯能轻松击败当时尚不出名的拜登，但这最终成为1972年差距最小的参议院选举。拜登以略多于3000票的优势险胜，赢得他后来七个参议员任期中的第一个。

en.t: United States presidential election in Massachusetts, 1972
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 7, 1972 as part of the 1972 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all 50 states and D.C. Voters chose 14 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Massachusetts voted for the Democratic nominee, Senator George McGovern of South Dakota, over incumbent Republican President Richard Nixon of California. McGovern's running mate was U.S. Ambassador Sargent Shriver of Maryland, who had replaced Senator Thomas Eagleton during the campaign, while Nixon ran with incumbent Vice President Spiro Agnew of Maryland.

zh.t: 1972年马萨诸塞州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1972年马萨诸塞州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年在全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出14名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。马萨诸塞州支持民主党候选人、南达科他州参议员乔治·麦戈文，胜过共和党籍现任总统、加利福尼亚州人理查德·尼克松。麦戈文的竞选搭档是美国驻法国大使萨金特·施赖弗，他在竞选期间接替了参议员托马斯·伊格尔顿；尼克松则与时任副总统斯皮罗·阿格纽搭档。

en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 1972
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 7, 1972 in Minnesota as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. The Republican Party candidate, incumbent President Richard Nixon, won the state over U.S. Senator George McGovern of South Dakota by a margin of 95,923 votes, or 5.07%. Nixon went on to win the election nationally, by a landslide margin of 23.15% of the popular vote. McGovern carried only Massachusetts and the District of Columbia. The 1972 election was the last time Minnesota—historically a state which favored Republicans—was carried by a Republican.

zh.t: 1972年明尼苏达州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1972年明尼苏达州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。共和党候选人、现任总统理查德·尼克松以95923票、5.07%的优势击败南达科他州联邦参议员乔治·麦戈文，赢得明尼苏达州。尼克松随后以23.15个百分点的普选票优势在全国大胜。麦戈文只赢得马萨诸塞州和哥伦比亚特区。此次选举也是共和党人最后一次赢得明尼苏达州总统选举。

en.t: United States presidential election in Texas, 1972
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Texas was held on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Republican President Richard Nixon overwhelmingly won the state of Texas with 66.20% of the vote, to the Democratic Party candidate George McGovern's 33.24%, thus giving him the state's 26 electoral votes. This was the first time a Republican won the state of Texas since 1956. Nixon's win in Texas made him the first ever Republican presidential candidate to break 60% of the popular vote in a presidential election, surpassing former President Dwight D. Eisenhower's performance of 55.26% in 1956, and even native son Lyndon B.

zh.t: 1972年得克萨斯州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1972年得克萨斯州美国总统选举于11月7日举行。共和党现任总统理查德·尼克松以压倒性优势赢得得克萨斯州，得票率为66.20%；民主党候选人乔治·麦戈文得票率为33.24%。尼克松因此获得该州26张选举人票。这是共和党自1956年以来首次赢得得克萨斯州。尼克松在该州的胜利也使他成为首位在总统选举中得票率超过60%的共和党候选人，超过德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔1956年的55.26%，也超过得克萨斯州本地人林登·B·约翰逊1964年的63.32%。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1972
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 7, 1972. Incumbent United States Senator Lee Metcalf, who was first elected to the Senate in 1960 and was re-elected in 1966, ran for re-election. After winning the Democratic primary, he moved on to the general election, where he faced Hank Hibbard, a State Senator and the Republican nominee. Following a close campaign, Metcalf managed to narrowly win re-election to his third term in the Senate over Hibbard.

zh.t: 1972年蒙大拿州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年蒙大拿州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。现任参议员李·梅特卡夫于1960年首次当选、1966年连任，这次寻求连任。他赢得民主党初选后进入大选，对手是州参议员、共和党候选人汉克·希巴德。经过一番激烈竞争，梅特卡夫以微弱优势击败希巴德，赢得第三个参议员任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1972
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 7, 1972. All 50 states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1972 United States presidential election. Virginia voters chose 12 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President of the United States. This was also the first presidential election after the passage of the Twenty-sixth Amendment, which decreased the voting age from 21 to 18. Virginia was won by incumbent United States President Richard Nixon of California with 67.84% of the vote, who was running against U.S. Senator George McGovern of South Dakota.

zh.t: 1972年弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1972年弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了当年总统选举。弗吉尼亚州选民选出12名总统选举人，由他们投票选出美国总统和副总统。这是美国通过第二十六修正案后举行的首次总统选举，该修正案将投票年龄从21岁降至18岁。共和党籍现任总统理查德·尼克松以67.84%的选票在弗吉尼亚州获胜，对手是南达科他州联邦参议员乔治·麦戈文。

en.s: The 1972 gubernatorial elections in the United States were held in Arkansas, Delaware, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Missouri, Montana, New Hampshire, NorthCarolina, North Dakota, Rhode Island, Utah, Vermont, Washington State, West Virginia and Texas, concurrent with the presidential election. General elections were held 7 November 1972. Gubernatorial elections were also held in Iowa, Kansas, South Dakota, and Texas. In these states, they were the last elections on a two-year cycle, before switching to a four-year term for governors (see United States gubernatorial elections, 1970 for more information).

zh.s: 1972年美国州长选举在阿肯色、特拉华、伊利诺伊、印第安纳、艾奥瓦、堪萨斯、密苏里、蒙大拿、新罕布什尔、北卡罗来纳、北达科他、罗得岛、犹他、佛蒙特、华盛顿州、西弗吉尼亚和得克萨斯举行，与总统选举同期进行。大选于1972年11月7日举行。艾奥瓦、堪萨斯、南达科他和得克萨斯也举行了州长选举；这些州当时最后一次采用两年一届的选举周期，此后州长任期改为四年。

en.t: United States presidential election in South Carolina, 1972
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 7, 1972. All 50 states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1972 United States presidential election. South Carolina voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. South Carolina overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominees, incumbent President Richard Nixon of California and his running mate Vice President Spiro Agnew of Kansas. Nixon and Agnew defeated the Democratic nominees, Senator George McGovern of South Dakota and his running mate U.S. Ambassador Sargent Shriver of Maryland.

zh.t: 1972年南卡罗来纳州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1972年南卡罗来纳州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年在全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区举行的总统选举的一部分。南卡罗来纳州选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。该州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、加利福尼亚州籍现任总统理查德·尼克松及其竞选搭档、堪萨斯州籍副总统斯皮罗·阿格纽。他们击败了民主党候选人、参议员乔治·麦戈文及其竞选搭档、美国驻法国大使萨金特·施赖弗。

en.t: United States Senate election in North Carolina, 1972
en.s: The North Carolina United States Senate election of 1972 was held on 7 November 1972 as part of the nationwide elections to the Senate, and coinciding with the 1972 presidential election. The general election was fought between the Republican nominee Jesse Helms and the Democrat nominee Rep. Nick Galifianakis. Helms won the election, taking a Senate seat in North Carolina from the Democrats for the first time in the twentieth century. Three-term Representative Nick Galifianakis defeated two-term incumbent Senator B. Everett Jordan in the second ballot in the Democratic primary.

zh.t: 1972年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行，是全国参议院选举的一部分，并与当年的总统选举同时举行。大选对阵双方是共和党候选人杰西·赫尔姆斯和民主党候选人、联邦众议员尼克·加利菲亚纳基斯。赫尔姆斯赢得选举，这是20世纪以来北卡罗来纳州参议院席位首次从民主党转到共和党手中。民主党初选第二轮投票中，已任三届众议员的加利菲亚纳基斯击败了已任两届的现任参议员B·埃弗里特·乔丹。

en.t: United States presidential election in North Carolina, 1972
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 7, 1972 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 1972 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. North Carolina strongly voted for Republican nominee President Richard Nixon, over Democratic nominee Senator George McGovern. North Carolina voted overwhelmingly for President Nixon, who won 69.46% to 28.89%, one of the biggest margin's in the country.

zh.s: 1972年北卡罗来纳州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年在全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出13名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。北卡罗来纳州大力支持共和党候选人理查德·尼克松，尼克松以69.46%对28.89%的得票率获胜，差距在全国名列前茅。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Hampshire, 1972
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 7, 1972 as part of the 1972 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all 50 states and D.C. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. en.t: United States presidential election in Maine, 1972
en.s: The 1972 United States Presidential Election in Maine took place on November 7, 1972 as part of the 1972 United States Presidential Election which was held throughout all 50 states and the District of Columbia. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Maine was won by the incumbent Republican president Richard M. Nixon took 61.46% of the vote, totaling up to 256,458 votes, to McGovern's 38.48%, and 160,584 votes.

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1972
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 7, 1972. All 50 states and the District of Columbia, were part of the 1972 United States presidential election. New York voters chose forty one electors to the Electoral College, which voted for President and Vice President. New York was won by incumbent Republican President Richard Nixon, who succeeded in securing re-election against Democratic Senator George McGovern of South Dakota. en.s: The 1972 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Governor of Montana Forrest H. Anderson, who was first elected in 1968, declined to seek re-election. Thomas Lee Judge, the Lieutenant Governor of Montana, won a competitive Democratic primary, and moved on to the general election, where he faced Ed Smith, a rancher and the Republican nominee. en.s: The United States presidential election of 1972 was the 47th quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 7, 1972. The Democratic Party's nomination was eventually won by Senator George McGovern of South Dakota, who ran an anti-war campaign against incumbent Republican President Richard Nixon, but was handicapped by his outsider status, limited support from his own party, the perception of many voters that he was a left-wing extremist and the scandal that resulted from the stepping down of vice-presidential nominee Thomas Eagleton. Emphasizing a good economy and his successes in foreign affairs, such as coming near to ending American involvement in the Vietnam War and establishing relations with China, Nixon won the election in a landslide.

zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举是美国每四年举行一次的第47届总统选举，于11月7日星期二举行。民主党最终提名南达科他州参议员乔治·麦戈文。他以反战为竞选主轴，挑战共和党籍现任总统理查德·尼克松，但他被视为党外人士，党内支持有限；许多选民认为他是极左派，副总统候选人托马斯·伊格尔顿退出也给竞选带来丑闻。尼克松强调经济良好和外交成绩，例如接近结束美国对越南战争的介入、与中国建立关系，最终以压倒性优势赢得选举。

en.t: United States presidential election in Alaska, 1972
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Alaska took place on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Alaska was won by incumbent President Richard Nixon (R-California) with 58.1% of the popular vote against George McGovern (D-South Dakota) with 34.6%. Nixon ultimately won the national vote as well, defeating McGovern and winning re-election. Alaska has only voted Democratic once, and that was in the 1964 election for Lyndon B. Johnson. Representative John G. Schmitz (R-California) ran under the American Independent Party ticket.

en.t: United States presidential election in New Mexico, 1972
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in New Mexico took place on November 7, 1972. This was the 15th U.S. Presidential Election which New Mexico participated in. All 50 states and The District of Columbia, were part of the 1972 United States presidential election. New Mexico voters chose four electors to represent them in the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New Mexico was won by President Richard Nixon by a 24-point landslide. en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 1972
en.s: The 1972 South Carolina United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 7, 1972 to select six Representatives for two-year terms from the state of South Carolina. The primary elections were held on August 29 and the runoff elections were held two weeks later on September 12. Five incumbents were re-elected and the only change was in the 6th district where Republican Edward Lunn Young succeeded Democrat John L. McMillan, who was defeated in the Democratic primary. The composition of the state delegation after the elections was four Democrats and two Republicans.

zh.t: 1972年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1972年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举于11月7日举行，选出6名众议员，任期两年。两党初选于8月29日举行，第二轮初选在两周后的9月12日举行。5名现任众议员成功连任，唯一变化出现在第6选区：共和党人爱德华·伦恩·杨接替了在民主党初选中落败的约翰·L·麦克米伦。选后该州代表团由4名民主党人和2名共和党人组成。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Jersey, 1972
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 7, 1972. All fifty states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1972 United States presidential election. New Jersey voters chose 17 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New Jersey was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Richard Nixon of California and his running mate incumbent Vice President Spiro Agnew of Maryland. Nixon and Agnew defeated the Democratic nominees, Senator George McGovern of South Dakota and his running mate United States Ambassador Sargent Shriver of Maryland.

zh.s: 1972年新泽西州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了当年总统选举。新泽西州选民选出17名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、加利福尼亚州籍现任总统理查德·尼克松和竞选搭档、马里兰州籍现任副总统斯皮罗·阿格纽在该州获胜。他们击败了民主党候选人、南达科他州参议员乔治·麦戈文及其竞选搭档、美国驻法国大使萨金特·施赖弗。

en.t: United States presidential election in Maryland, 1972
en.s: The United States presidential election in Maryland, 1972 was held on November 7, 1972. Both the Democratic and Republican (Shriver and Agnew, respectively) Vice Presidential nominees were from Maryland.

He defeated his main opponent, Democratic candidate George McGovern in Illinois by an overwhelming margin of 18.52 points. Nixon also won all but one of Illinois' 102 counties.

zh.s: 1972年伊利诺伊州美国总统选举于11月7日举行。现任总统理查德·尼克松获得59%的选票，赢得伊利诺伊州及其全部26张选举人票。他以18.52个百分点的巨大优势击败主要对手、民主党候选人乔治·麦戈文。尼克松还赢得了伊利诺伊州102个县中的101个。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in the District of Columbia, 1972
en.s: The 1972 congressional election for the Delegate from the District of Columbia was held on November 7, 1972. The winner of the race was Walter E. Fauntroy (D), who won his first re-election after winning the special election in the previous year. All elected members would serve in 93rd United States Congress. The non-voting delegate to the United States House of Representatives from the District of Columbia is elected for two-year terms.

zh.s: 1972年哥伦比亚特区联邦众议院代表选举于11月7日举行，选出代表哥伦比亚特区的联邦众议院代表。民主党候选人沃尔特·E·方特罗伊胜出，在前一年特别选举中当选后首次赢得连任。所有当选的众议院代表都将在第93届美国国会任职。哥伦比亚特区选出的无投票权联邦众议院代表任期为两年。

en.t: United States presidential election in Mississippi, 1972
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Mississippi was held on November 7, 1972. Incumbent President Nixon won the state of Mississippi with 78.20% of the vote, his greatest performance in all of the 50 states, carrying 7 electoral votes. Nixon defeated McGovern by a whopping margin of 58.57 points. McGovern carried only three counties, all of which have an overwhelming majority black population: Claiborne, Holmes and Jefferson.

zh.t: 1972年密西西比州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1972年密西西比州美国总统选举于11月7日举行。现任总统理查德·尼克松获得78.20%的选票，赢得密西西比州和全部7张选举人票；这也是他在50个州中表现最好的一次。尼克松以58.57个百分点的巨大优势击败麦戈文。麦戈文只赢得3个县：克莱伯恩县、霍姆斯县和杰斐逊县，这些县的非裔人口都占压倒性多数。

en.t: United States Senate election in Virginia, 1972
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Virginia was held on November 7, 1972. Republican U.S. Representative William L. Scott defeated incumbent Democratic Senator William Spong, Jr.. Scott was the first Republican U.S. Senator from Virginia to be elected in over a century, as the most recent Republican Senator was John F. Lewis, who had held the seat during the Reconstruction era.

zh.s: 1972年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。共和党籍联邦众议员威廉·L·斯科特击败民主党籍现任参议员威廉·斯庞二世。斯科特是一个多世纪以来首位当选的弗吉尼亚州共和党籍联邦参议员；最近一位共和党籍参议员是重建时期曾担任该席位的约翰·F·刘易斯。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in California took place on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. State voters chose 45 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California voted for the Republican incumbent, Richard Nixon, over the Democratic challenger, South Dakota Senator George McGovern. Nixon took 55.00% of the vote to McGovern's 41.54%, a margin of 13.46%.

zh.t: 1972年加利福尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1972年加利福尼亚州美国总统选举于1972年11月7日举行，是1972年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出45名代表，即总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。加利福尼亚州支持共和党现任总统理查德·尼克松，胜过民主党候选人、南达科他州参议员乔治·麦戈文。尼克松获得55.00%的选票，麦戈文获得41.54%，两人相差13.46个百分点。

en.t: 1972 United States House of Representatives election in Nevada
en.s: The 1972 United States House of Representatives election in Nevada was held on Tuesday November 7, 1972, to elect the state's at-large representative. Primary elections were held on September 5, 1972. Republican nominee David Towell won the general election with 52.15% of the vote. Incumbent representative, Walter S. Baring Jr. lost the democratic primary election 52-47. Baring endorsed republican David Towell, helping him win the general election.

zh.t: 1972年内华达州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1972年内华达州美国联邦众议院选举于1972年11月7日（星期二）举行，选出该州的全州单一选区众议员。初选于1972年9月5日举行。共和党候选人大卫·托维尔以52.15%的得票率赢得大选。时任众议员小沃尔特·S·巴林在民主党初选中以52比47落败。巴林随后支持共和党人托维尔，帮助他赢得大选。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Arizona
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Arizona took place on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. State voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arizona was won by incumbent President Richard Nixon (R–California), with 61.64% of the popular vote, against George McGovern (D–South Dakota), with 30.38% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举亚利桑那州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举亚利桑那州投票于1972年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出6名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统、共和党候选人理查德·尼克松赢得亚利桑那州，得票率为61.64%；民主党候选人乔治·麦戈文得票率为30.38%。

en.s: The 1972 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1972. Democratic incumbent Cal Rampton defeated Republican nominee Nicholas L. Strike with 69.68% of the vote. Rampton's victory was despite incumbent Republican president Richard Nixon winning the state with over 67% of the vote in the concurrent presidential election. The election made Rampton the first governor to serve three terms.

zh.s: 1972年犹他州州长选举于1972年11月7日举行。民主党时任州长卡尔·拉姆普顿以69.68%的得票率击败共和党候选人尼古拉斯·L·斯特赖克。同期总统选举中，时任共和党总统理查德·尼克松在犹他州的得票率超过67%，但拉姆普顿仍赢得州长选举。拉姆普顿由此成为首位担任三届州长的人。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. State voters chose seven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Colorado voted for the Republican incumbent, Richard Nixon, over the Democratic challenger, South Dakota Senator George McGovern.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举科罗拉多州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举科罗拉多州投票于1972年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出7名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。科罗拉多州支持共和党时任总统理查德·尼克松，击败民主党挑战者、南达科他州参议员乔治·麦戈文。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. North Dakota was won by incumbent President Richard Nixon (R–California), with 62.07 percent of the popular vote, against George McGovern (D–South Dakota), with 35.79 percent of the popular vote, a 26.28 percent margin of victory.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举北达科他州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举北达科他州投票于1972年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统、共和党候选人理查德·尼克松在北达科他州得票率为62.07%，民主党候选人乔治·麦戈文为35.79%，尼克松以26.28个百分点的优势获胜。

en.t: 1972 United States House of Representatives elections in Arizona
en.s: The 1972 United States House of Representatives elections in Arizona were held on November 7, 1972, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the state of Arizona, one from each of the state's eight congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 1972 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 1972年亚利桑那州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 亚利桑那州联邦众议员选举于1972年11月7日举行，选出该州4名联邦众议员，每人代表该州8个国会选区中的一个。选举与1972年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举及各类州和地方选举同期举行。

en.s: The 1972 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1972. Republican nominee James Holshouser defeated Democratic nominee Skipper Bowles with 51% of the vote. Holshouser thus became the first Republican elected governor of the state since 1896. This election was also the first time in a century (since the 1872 election) that a Republican candidate won an outright majority of the vote.

zh.s: 1972年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于1972年11月7日举行。共和党候选人詹姆斯·霍尔斯豪瑟以51%的得票率击败民主党候选人斯基珀·鲍尔斯。霍尔斯豪瑟由此成为自1896年以来首位当选该州州长的共和党人。这也是自1872年选举以来，一个世纪内首次有共和党候选人赢得绝对多数选票。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in Alabama
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Alabama was held on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Senator John Sparkman was re-elected to a fifth full term in office over Postmaster General Winton Blount. Alabama was one of fifteen states alongside Arkansas, Colorado, Delaware, Georgia, Iowa, Louisiana, Maine, Minnesota, Mississippi, Montana, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, South Dakota and West Virginia won by Republican President Richard Nixon in 1972 that elected Democrats to the United States Senate.

zh.t: 1972年阿拉巴马州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年阿拉巴马州美国联邦参议院选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任参议员约翰·斯帕克曼击败邮政总长温顿·布朗特，连任第五个完整任期。在1972年总统选举中，共和党总统理查德·尼克松赢得15个州；阿拉巴马州以及阿肯色州、科罗拉多州、特拉华州、佐治亚州、艾奥瓦州、路易斯安那州、缅因州、明尼苏达州、密西西比州、蒙大拿州、新罕布什尔州、罗得岛州、南达科他州和西弗吉尼亚州在这些州之列，但这些州均选出民主党联邦参议员。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 7, 1972. All fifty states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1972 United States presidential election. Voters chose six electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oregon was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Richard Nixon of California and his running mate Vice President Spiro Agnew of Maryland.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举俄勒冈州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举俄勒冈州投票于1972年11月7日举行。当年美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。俄勒冈州选民选出6名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、加利福尼亚州籍时任总统理查德·尼克松与其竞选搭档、马里兰州籍副总统斯皮罗·阿格纽赢得俄勒冈州。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 7, 1972. All fifty states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1972 United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Missouri was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Richard Nixon of California and his running mate Vice President Spiro Agnew of Maryland.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举密苏里州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举密苏里州投票于1972年11月7日举行。当年美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。密苏里州选民选出12名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、加利福尼亚州籍时任总统理查德·尼克松与其竞选搭档、马里兰州籍副总统斯皮罗·阿格纽赢得密苏里州。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 7, 1972. The Republican ticket of the incumbent president of the United States Richard Nixon and the vice president of the United States Spiro Agnew defeated the Democratic ticket of the junior U.S. senator from South Dakota George McGovern and the former U.S. ambassador to France Sargent Shriver. Nixon defeated McGovern in the national election with 520 electoral votes.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举印第安纳州选情
zh.s: 1972年11月7日，印第安纳州举行总统选举，作为1972年美国总统选举的一部分。共和党候选人、美国时任总统理查德·尼克松与副总统斯皮罗·阿格纽组成的竞选搭档，击败民主党候选人、南达科他州联邦参议员乔治·麦戈文与前美国驻法国大使萨金特·施赖弗组成的搭档。尼克松在全国大选中以520张选举人票击败麦戈文。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Oklahoma was held on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oklahoma voted in a landslide for incumbent Republican President Richard Nixon over his Democratic challenger George McGovern.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举俄克拉何马州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举俄克拉何马州投票于1972年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。俄克拉何马州以压倒性优势支持时任共和党总统理查德·尼克松，击败他的民主党对手乔治·麦戈文。

en.s: The 1972 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 7, 1972, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general John Danforth defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Missouri House of Representatives James E. Spain.

zh.s: 1972年密苏里州总检察长选举于1972年11月7日举行，以选出该州总检察长。共和党候选人、时任总检察长约翰·丹佛思击败民主党候选人、时任密苏里州众议员詹姆斯·E·斯佩恩。

en.s: The 1972 Illinois gubernatorial election was held in Illinois on November 7, 1972. Incumbent first-term Republican governor Richard B. Ogilvie lost reelection in an upset to the Democratic nominee, Dan Walker. This was the first election in which each party's nominee for lieutenant governor of Illinois ran on a ticket with the gubernatorial nominee for the general election. Previously, there had been two separate elections for the two offices.

zh.s: 1972年伊利诺伊州州长选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任共和党州长理查德·B·奥格尔维在意外失利中败给民主党候选人丹·沃克。这是伊利诺伊州首次要求各党州长候选人与副州长候选人搭档参选。此前，这两个职位分别举行选举。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Mississippi was held on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator James Eastland won re-election to his sixth term. To date, this was the last time that the Democrats won the Class 2 Senate seat in Mississippi.

zh.t: 1972年密西西比州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年密西西比州美国联邦参议院选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任民主党联邦参议员詹姆斯·伊斯特兰成功连任第六届。截至目前，这是民主党最后一次赢得密西西比州第二类参议院席位。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. West Virginia voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. West Virginia was won by incumbent President Richard Nixon (R–California), with 63.61 percent of the popular vote, against George McGovern (D–South Dakota), with 36.39 percent of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举西弗吉尼亚州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举西弗吉尼亚州投票于1972年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。西弗吉尼亚州选民选出6名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统、共和党候选人理查德·尼克松在该州得票率为63.61%，民主党候选人乔治·麦戈文为36.39%。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Kansas took place on November 7, 1972, concurrently with the U.S. presidential election as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator James B. Pearson defeated Democratic nominee Arch O.

zh.t: 1972年堪萨斯州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年堪萨斯州美国参议院选举于11月7日举行，与总统选举、其他州的参议院和众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同日进行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员詹姆斯·B·皮尔逊以71.42%的得票率击败民主党候选人阿奇·O·特茨拉夫。

en.t: 1972 United States House of Representatives election in Alaska
en.s: The 1972 United States House of Representatives election in Alaska was held on November 7, 1972, to elect the United States representative from Alaska's at-large congressional district. Incumbent Democratic Representative Nick Begich Sr. went missing shortly before the general election, but still defeated Republican nominee Don Young. This was the last time that a Democrat won Alaska's House seat until 2022's special election, when Mary Peltola was elected to succeed the late Young.

zh.t: 1972年阿拉斯加州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1972年阿拉斯加州美国联邦众议院选举于1972年11月7日举行，选出该州全州单一选区的联邦众议员。时任民主党众议员老尼克·贝吉奇在大选前不久失踪，但仍击败共和党候选人唐·扬。这是直到2022年特别选举、玛丽·佩尔托拉当选接替已故的扬之前，民主党最后一次赢得阿拉斯加州联邦众议院席位。

loc: 美国华盛顿哥伦比亚特区

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia took place on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Washington, D.C. voters chose 3 electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Republican President Richard Nixon and his running mate, incumbent Vice President Spiro Agnew, against Democratic challenger and Senator George McGovern from South Dakota and his running mate, former United States Ambassador to France Sargent Shriver.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举哥伦比亚特区选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举哥伦比亚特区投票于1972年11月7日举行，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。当年50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参与选举。华盛顿特区选民通过普选选出3名选举人，进入选举人团。选举中，时任共和党总统理查德·尼克松及其竞选搭档、时任副总统斯皮罗·阿格纽，对阵民主党挑战者、南达科他州联邦参议员乔治·麦戈文及其竞选搭档、美国前驻法国大使萨金特·施赖弗。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Kentucky took place on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Republican Senator John Sherman Cooper retired, and Democratic State Senator Walter Dee Huddleston narrowly won the open seat over former Republican Governor Louie Nunn.

zh.t: 1972年肯塔基州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年肯塔基州美国联邦参议院选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任共和党参议员约翰·谢尔曼·库珀退休，民主党州参议员沃尔特·迪·赫德尔斯顿以微弱优势击败共和党前州长路易·纳恩，赢得空缺席位。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 7, 1972. All 50 states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1972 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Delaware was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Richard Nixon of California and his running mate Vice President Spiro Agnew of Maryland.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举特拉华州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举特拉华州投票于1972年11月7日举行。当年50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参与总统选举。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、加利福尼亚州籍时任总统理查德·尼克松与其竞选搭档、马里兰州籍副总统斯皮罗·阿格纽赢得特拉华州。

en.t: 1972 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware
en.s: The 1972 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware took place on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Republican, Pete du Pont won re-election over Democrat candidate Norma Handloff with 62.54% of the vote.

zh.t: 1972年特拉华州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1972年特拉华州美国联邦众议院选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任共和党众议员皮特·杜邦击败民主党候选人诺玛·汉德洛夫，成功连任，得票率为62.54%。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Arkansas took place on November 7, 1972. Incumbent U.S. Senator John L. McClellan was re-elected to a sixth term in office, defeating U.S. Representative David Pryor in a hotly contested primary. In the general election, McClellan easily defeated Republican physician Wayne Babbitt. This was McClellan's final campaign; he died in his sleep in 1977.

zh.t: 1972年阿肯色州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年阿肯色州美国联邦参议院选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任联邦参议员约翰·L·麦克莱伦成功连任第六届。他在竞争激烈的初选中击败联邦众议员戴维·普赖尔。大选中，麦克莱伦轻松击败共和党医生韦恩·巴比特。这是麦克莱伦最后一次竞选；他于1977年在睡梦中去世。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Wyoming was held on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Republican Senator Clifford Hansen ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by Democratic nominee Mike Vinich, a former aide to Congressman Teno Roncalio and a bar owner in Hudson. As Hansen ran for re-election, President Richard Nixon was overwhelmingly defeating Democratic presidential nominee George McGovern in Wyoming.

zh.t: 1972年怀俄明州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年怀俄明州美国联邦参议院选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任共和党参议员克利福德·汉森竞选连任第二届。民主党候选人迈克·维尼奇向他发起挑战。维尼奇曾担任联邦众议员特诺·朗卡利奥的助理，并在哈德逊镇经营酒吧。汉森竞选连任期间，理查德·尼克松总统在怀俄明州以压倒性优势击败民主党总统候选人乔治·麦戈文。

en.s: The 1972 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1972. Democratic nominee Philip Noel defeated Republican nominee Herbert F. DeSimone with 52.55% of the vote.

zh.s: 1972年罗得岛州州长选举于1972年11月7日举行。民主党候选人菲利普·诺埃尔以52.55%的得票率击败共和党候选人赫伯特·F·德西蒙。

en.s: The 1972 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Republican Governor Walter R. Peterson Jr. was defeated for renomination in the Republican primary. Republican nominee Meldrim Thomson Jr. defeated Democratic nominee Roger J. Crowley with 41.38% of the vote.

zh.s: 1972年新罕布什尔州州长选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任共和党州长小沃尔特·R·彼得森在共和党初选中未能获得连任提名。共和党候选人小梅尔德里姆·汤姆森以41.38%的得票率击败民主党候选人罗杰·J·克劳利。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nebraska was won by incumbent President Richard Nixon (R–California), with 70.5% of the popular vote, against George McGovern (D–South Dakota), with 29.5% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举内布拉斯加州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举内布拉斯加州投票于1972年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统、共和党候选人理查德·尼克松在内布拉斯加州得票率为70.5%，民主党候选人乔治·麦戈文为29.5%。

en.s: The 1972 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 7, 1972, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee and former member of the Missouri House of Representatives Jim Spainhower defeated Republican nominee George W. Parker.

zh.s: 1972年密苏里州州财政长选举于1972年11月7日举行，以选出该州财政长。民主党候选人、前密苏里州众议员吉姆·斯佩恩豪尔击败共和党候选人乔治·W·帕克。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 7, 1972. All fifty states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1972 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举内华达州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举内华达州投票于1972年11月7日举行。当年50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参与总统选举。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Utah took place on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Utah overwhelmingly voted for incumbent President Richard Nixon (R-California) with over 67 percent of the popular vote, beating Democratic South Dakota Senator George McGovern with a margin of over forty percent, carrying every county in the state.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举犹他州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举犹他州投票于1972年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。犹他州以压倒性优势支持时任总统理查德·尼克松，普选票得票率超过67%，领先民主党候选人、南达科他州参议员乔治·麦戈文超过40个百分点，并赢得全州每个县。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. Idaho voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Idaho was won by incumbent President Richard Nixon (R–California), with 64.2 percent of the popular vote, against George McGovern (D–South Dakota), with 26.0% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举爱达荷州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举爱达荷州投票于1972年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。爱达荷州选民选出4名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统、共和党候选人理查德·尼克松在该州得票率为64.2%，民主党候选人乔治·麦戈文为26.0%。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Iowa took place on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Jack Miller ran for re-election to a third term but was defeated by Democrat Dick Clark. Iowa was one of fifteen states alongside Alabama, Arkansas, Colorado, Delaware, Georgia, Louisiana, Maine, Minnesota, Mississippi, Montana, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, South Dakota and West Virginia that were won by Republican president Richard Nixon in 1972 that elected Democrats to the United States Senate.

zh.t: 1972年艾奥瓦州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年艾奥瓦州美国联邦参议院选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任共和党联邦参议员杰克·米勒竞选连任第三届，但败给了民主党候选人迪克·克拉克。艾奥瓦州与阿拉巴马州、阿肯色州、科罗拉多州、特拉华州、佐治亚州、路易斯安那州、缅因州、明尼苏达州、密西西比州、蒙大拿州、新罕布什尔州、罗得岛州、南达科他州和西弗吉尼亚州一样，1972年总统选举支持了共和党候选人理查德·尼克松，但同时选出了民主党联邦参议员。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. State voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arkansas was won by incumbent President Richard Nixon (R–California), with 68.82% of the popular vote, against George McGovern (D–South Dakota), with 30.71% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举阿肯色州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举阿肯色州投票于1972年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出6名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统、共和党候选人理查德·尼克松在阿肯色州得票率为68.82%，民主党候选人乔治·麦戈文为30.71%。

en.s: The 1972 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1972. The election pitted Democratic Congressman Arthur A. Link against Republican Lieutenant governor Richard F. Larsen. Link narrowly defeated Larsen by a margin of 51% to 49%.

zh.s: 1972年北达科他州州长选举于1972年11月7日举行。民主党联邦众议员亚瑟·A·林克与共和党副州长理查德·F·拉森对决。林克以51%对49%的得票率险胜拉森。

en.s: The 1972 Alabama Supreme Court election was held on November 7, 1972 to elect two justices to the Alabama Supreme Court.

zh.t: 1972年阿拉巴马州最高法院选举
zh.s: 1972年阿拉巴马州最高法院选举于1972年11月7日举行，选出两名阿拉巴马州最高法院法官。

en.s: The 1972 Arizona Senate election was held on November 7, 1972. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on September 12, 1972. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 18 seats over the Democrats' 12 seats.

zh.s: 1972年亚利桑那州参议院选举于1972年11月7日举行，选出该州30个州议会选区的州参议员，任期两年。初选于1972年9月12日举行。选举前，共和党以18席对民主党的12席占多数。

loc: 美国华盛顿哥伦比亚特区

en.t: 1972 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1972 United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 7, 1972, to elect U.S. Representatives to serve in the 93rd United States Congress. This was the first election held after the 1970 United States redistricting cycle. It coincided with the landslide reelection victory of President Richard M. Nixon. Nixon's Republican Party managed to gain a net of twelve House of Representatives seats from the Democratic Party, although the Democrats retained a majority.

zh.s: 1972年美国联邦众议院选举于1972年11月7日举行，选出第93届国会的联邦众议员。这是1970年美国重新划分选区后举行的首次选举，也与理查德·M·尼克松总统压倒性优势连任同时进行。尼克松所属的共和党净增12个众议院席位，但民主党仍保有多数。

en.s: The 1972 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Democratic Governor Dale Bumpers defeated Republican nominee Len E. Blaylock with 75.44% of the vote, despite Democratic nominee George McGovern losing the state in a landslide in the concurrent presidential election.

zh.s: 1972年阿肯色州州长选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任民主党州长戴尔·邦珀斯以75.44%的得票率击败共和党候选人伦·E·布莱洛克。同期总统选举中，民主党候选人乔治·麦戈文在阿肯色州大败，但邦珀斯仍赢得州长选举。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in South Dakota took place on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Dakota was the home state of George McGovern, the Democratic Party nominee in the 1972 United States presidential election.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举南达科他州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举南达科他州投票于1972年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。民主党总统候选人乔治·麦戈文的家乡是南达科他州。

en.s: The 1972 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Republican Robert D. Ray defeated Democratic nominee Paul Franzenburg with 58.43% of the vote. This was the last gubernatorial election in Iowa in which either party won every county. It was also the last election for a two-year term, with Iowa (alongside Arkansas, Kansas, Rhode Island, South Dakota, Texas and, as of date, Vermont and New Hampshire) being one of the last states to maintain two-year, as opposed to four-year gubernatorial terms.

zh.s: 1972年艾奥瓦州州长选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任共和党州长罗伯特·D·雷以58.43%的得票率击败民主党候选人保罗·弗兰岑伯格。这是艾奥瓦州最后一次有政党赢得全州每个县的州长选举，也是该州最后一次举行两年任期的州长选举。当时艾奥瓦州与阿肯色州、堪萨斯州、罗得岛州、南达科他州、得克萨斯州，以及截至原文撰写时的佛蒙特州和新罕布什尔州一样，是最后一批仍实行两年而非四年州长任期的州。

en.t: 1972 United States House of Representatives elections in New Mexico
en.s: The 1972 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on Tuesday November 7, 1972 to elect the state's two representatives to serve in the United States House of Representatives. This election coincided with other state local offices such as the presidential election and the state's concurrent senate election. Neither seats changed partisan control.

zh.t: 1972年新墨西哥州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1972年新墨西哥州美国联邦众议院选举于1972年11月7日（星期二）举行，选出该州两名联邦众议员。这次选举与其他州及地方职位选举同时进行，包括总统选举和该州同期举行的参议院选举。两席的党派归属都没有变化。

en.s: The 1972 North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1972. Democratic nominee Jim Hunt defeated Republican nominee John A. Walker with 56.69% of the vote.

zh.t: 1972年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 1972年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举于1972年11月7日举行。民主党候选人吉姆·亨特以56.69%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·A·沃克。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Michigan was held on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator and Senate Minority Whip Robert P. Griffin won a second full term against Democratic nominee and Michigan Attorney General Frank J. Kelley by 6%. Despite President Richard Nixon’s landslide victory in Michigan and the rest of the country, Griffin’s margin of victory decreased from the previous election.

zh.t: 1972年密歇根州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年密歇根州美国联邦参议院选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任共和党联邦参议员、参议院少数党党鞭罗伯特·P·格里芬击败民主党候选人、密歇根州总检察长弗兰克·J·凯利，以6个百分点的优势赢得第二个完整任期。尽管总统理查德·尼克松在密歇根州和全国都以压倒性优势获胜，格里芬的领先幅度仍比上次选举缩小。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Tennessee took place on November 7, 1972, concurrently with the U.S. presidential election as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Howard Baker won re-election to a second term, becoming the first Republican Senator in the state to ever do so.

zh.t: 1972年田纳西州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年田纳西州美国联邦参议院选举于1972年11月7日举行，与美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。时任共和党联邦参议员霍华德·贝克成功连任第二届，成为该州首位成功连任的共和党参议员。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. Voters chose 21 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Michigan was won by incumbent President Richard Nixon (R–California), with 56.20% of the popular vote, against George McGovern (D–South Dakota), with 41.81% of the popular vote—a victory margin of 14.4%.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举密歇根州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举密歇根州投票于1972年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出21名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统、共和党候选人理查德·尼克松在密歇根州得票率为56.20%，民主党候选人乔治·麦戈文为41.81%，尼克松以14.4%的优势获胜。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in West Virginia took place on November 7, 1972. West Virginia was one of fifteen states alongside Alabama, Arkansas, Colorado, Delaware, Georgia, Iowa, Louisiana, Maine, Minnesota, Mississippi, Montana, New Hampshire, Rhode Island and South Dakota that were won by Republican President Richard Nixon in 1972 that elected a Democrat to the United States Senate. Incumbent Democratic U.S.

zh.t: 1972年西弗吉尼亚州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年西弗吉尼亚州美国参议院选举于11月7日举行。西弗吉尼亚州与其他14州一样，在共和党总统理查德·尼克松获胜的同时选出了一名民主党联邦参议员。民主党籍现任参议员詹宁斯·伦道夫击败路易丝·伦纳德，以压倒性优势连任第四个任期；这是他的第三个完整任期。这是西弗吉尼亚州唯一一次伦道夫得票率超过60%的参议院选举。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Illinois took place on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Republican United States Senator Charles H. Percy sought re-election to the United States Senate. Percy was opposed by Democratic nominee Roman Pucinski, a United States Representative from the Northwest Side of Chicago, whom he was able to defeat handily to win a second term.

zh.t: 1972年伊利诺伊州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年伊利诺伊州美国联邦参议院选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任共和党联邦参议员查尔斯·H·珀西竞选连任。民主党候选人罗曼·普钦斯基是芝加哥西北区的联邦众议员，珀西轻松击败他，赢得第二个任期。

en.s: The 1972 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 7, 1972, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent secretary of state James Kirkpatrick defeated Republican nominee Harold Kuehle.

zh.s: 1972年密苏里州州务卿选举于1972年11月7日举行，以选出该州州务卿。民主党候选人、时任州务卿詹姆斯·柯克帕特里克击败共和党候选人哈罗德·库勒。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 7, 1972. The incumbent Democratic Senator, Fred R. Harris, had retired to run for president. The open seat was won by Republican Dewey F. Bartlett, who defeated Democratic nominee Ed Edmondson. However, his victory underperformed that of President Richard Nixon in the concurrent presidential election, which saw Nixon defeat George McGovern by 49.7% in the state.

zh.t: 1972年俄克拉何马州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年俄克拉何马州美国联邦参议院选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任民主党参议员弗雷德·R·哈里斯退休并竞选总统。共和党候选人杜威·F·巴特利特赢得空缺席位，击败民主党候选人埃德·埃德蒙森。不过，他的胜选幅度低于理查德·尼克松在同期总统选举中的表现：尼克松在该州以49.7个百分点的优势击败乔治·麦戈文。

en.s: The 1972 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1972. Although during the same election cycle Indiana voters approved a constitutional amendment allowing the governor to serve in office for eight out of 12 years, incumbent Republican Governor Edgar Whitcomb was term-limited due to having been elected under the prior version of the constitution. Republican nominee, Speaker of the Indiana House of Representatives Otis Bowen defeated Democratic nominee Former Governor (1961–1965) Matthew E.

zh.s: 1972年印第安纳州州长选举于11月7日举行。印第安纳州选民当年通过宪法修正案，允许州长在12年内累计任职8年；但共和党籍现任州长埃德加·惠特科姆因依据修正案通过前的规定当选，仍受任期限制，不能再选。共和党候选人、印第安纳州众议院议长奥蒂斯·鲍恩以56.77%的得票率击败民主党候选人、曾于1961至1965年任州长的马修·E·韦尔什。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. Kentucky voters chose 9 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kentucky was won by incumbent President Richard Nixon (R–California) with 63.77 percent of the popular vote against Senator George McGovern (D–South Dakota) with 34.77%.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举肯塔基州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举肯塔基州投票于1972年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。肯塔基州选民选出9名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统、共和党候选人理查德·尼克松以63.77%的普选票赢得肯塔基州；民主党候选人、参议员乔治·麦戈文得票率为34.77%。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 7, 1972. All 50 states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1972 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Wyoming was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Richard Nixon of California and his running mate Vice President Spiro Agnew of Maryland.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举怀俄明州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举怀俄明州投票于1972年11月7日举行。当年50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参与总统选举。怀俄明州选民选出3名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、加利福尼亚州籍时任总统理查德·尼克松与其竞选搭档、马里兰州籍副总统斯皮罗·阿格纽赢得怀俄明州。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in South Dakota took place on November 7, 1972, concurrently with the U.S. presidential election as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Karl E.

zh.t: 1972年南达科他州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年南达科他州美国参议院选举于11月7日举行，与总统选举、其他州的参议院和众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同日进行。共和党籍现任参议员卡尔·E·蒙特因健康状况未竞选第五个任期，民主党候选人詹姆斯·阿布雷兹克接替了他。尽管阿布雷兹克以14个百分点的优势当选，民主党总统候选人、后来也成为南达科他州联邦参议员的乔治·麦戈文仍在同期总统选举中以8.6个百分点之差输掉家乡州。南达科他州是尼克松获胜、但选出民主党参议员的15个州之一。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in Oregon
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Oregon took place on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Republican Senator Mark Hatfield was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Democrat Wayne Morse.

zh.t: 1972年俄勒冈州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年俄勒冈州美国联邦参议院选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任共和党参议员马克·哈特菲尔德击败民主党候选人韦恩·莫斯，成功连任第二届。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Walter Mondale won re-election. Minnesota was one of fifteen states alongside Alabama, Arkansas, Colorado, Delaware, Georgia, Iowa, Louisiana, Maine, Mississippi, Montana, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, South Dakota and West Virginia that were won by Republican President Richard Nixon in 1972 that elected Democrats to the United States Senate.

zh.t: 1972年明尼苏达州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年明尼苏达州美国联邦参议院选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任民主党联邦参议员沃尔特·蒙代尔成功连任。明尼苏达州与阿拉巴马州、阿肯色州、科罗拉多州、特拉华州、佐治亚州、艾奥瓦州、路易斯安那州、缅因州、密西西比州、蒙大拿州、新罕布什尔州、罗得岛州、南达科他州和西弗吉尼亚州一样，1972年总统选举支持了共和党总统理查德·尼克松，但同时选出了民主党联邦参议员。

en.s: The 1972 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1972. Democratic nominee Sherman W. Tribbitt defeated incumbent Republican Governor Russell W. Peterson with 51.27% of the vote. This was the last time a Democrat won a gubernatorial election in Delaware until 1992, when Tom Carper (future U.S. Senator) won the gubernatorial election over Republican B. Gary Scott.

zh.s: 1972年特拉华州州长选举于1972年11月7日举行。民主党候选人谢尔曼·W·特里比特以51.27%的得票率击败时任共和党州长拉塞尔·W·彼得森。这是民主党人直到1992年才再次赢得特拉华州州长选举；当年汤姆·卡珀（后来成为联邦参议员）击败共和党候选人B·加里·斯科特当选州长。

en.s: The 1972 Delaware lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1972, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Delaware. Republican nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor Eugene Bookhammer defeated Democratic nominee Clifford B. Hearn, American nominee William D. Drummond and Prohibition nominee Earl F. Dawson.

zh.s: 1972年特拉华州副州长选举于1972年11月7日举行，以选出该州副州长。共和党候选人、时任副州长尤金·布克哈默击败民主党候选人克利福德·B·赫恩、美国党候选人威廉·D·德拉蒙德和禁酒党候选人厄尔·F·道森。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in New Hampshire took place on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Democratic Senator Thomas J. McIntyre won re-election to a third term. Democrats would not win this seat again until 2008. This was the first time Democrats were re-elected to any Senate seat in New Hampshire.

zh.t: 1972年新罕布什尔州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年新罕布什尔州美国联邦参议院选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任民主党参议员托马斯·J·麦金太尔成功连任第三届。民主党人直到2008年才再次赢得这个席位。这也是民主党人首次在新罕布什尔州赢得任何一个参议院席位的连任。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 7, 1972. Republican candidate and Incumbent United States Senator Gordon Allott ran for re-election to a fourth term, but was narrowly defeated by Democratic candidate and former State Representative Floyd Haskell. This would be the last time until 2008 that a Democrat was elected to the Class 2 Senate seat from Colorado.

zh.t: 1972年科罗拉多州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年科罗拉多州美国联邦参议院选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任共和党联邦参议员戈登·阿洛特竞选连任第四届，但以微弱差距败给民主党候选人、前州众议员弗洛伊德·哈斯克尔。直到2008年，民主党人才再次赢得科罗拉多州第二类参议院席位。

en.s: The 1972 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1972. Republican nominee Bill Phelps narrowly defeated Democratic nominee Jack J. Schramm with 50.14% of the vote.

zh.s: 1972年密苏里州副州长选举于1972年11月7日举行。共和党候选人比尔·菲尔普斯以50.14%的得票率险胜民主党候选人杰克·J·施拉姆。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in New Jersey was held on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Republican Clifford P. Case defeated Democratic nominee Paul J. Krebs with 62.46% of the vote. Primary elections were held on June 6. Case turned away a challenge from conservative doctor James Ralph. Krebs won a large plurality in the Democratic primary over Daniel Gaby and Joseph Karcher.

zh.t: 1972年新泽西州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年新泽西州美国联邦参议院选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任共和党参议员克利福德·P·凯斯以62.46%的得票率击败民主党候选人保罗·J·克雷布斯。初选于6月6日举行。凯斯击退了保守派医生詹姆斯·拉尔夫的挑战。克雷布斯在民主党初选中以较大票数领先丹尼尔·盖比和约瑟夫·卡彻。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. Tennessee voters chose 10 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Tennessee was won by incumbent President Richard Nixon (R–California), with 67.70% of the popular vote, against George McGovern (D–South Dakota), with 29.75% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举田纳西州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举田纳西州投票于1972年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。田纳西州选民选出10名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统、共和党候选人理查德·尼克松在田纳西州得票率为67.70%，民主党候选人乔治·麦戈文为29.75%。

en.s: The 1972 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Democrat Robert Docking defeated Republican nominee Morris Kay with 62.0% of the vote.

zh.s: 1972年堪萨斯州州长选举于1972年11月7日举行。时任民主党州长罗伯特·多金以62.0%的得票率击败共和党候选人莫里斯·凯。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Washington voted for the Republican incumbent, Richard Nixon, over the Democratic challenger, South Dakota Senator George McGovern.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举华盛顿州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举华盛顿州投票于1972年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出9名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。华盛顿州支持共和党时任总统理查德·尼克松，击败民主党挑战者、南达科他州参议员乔治·麦戈文。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in Alaska
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Alaska was held on November 7, 1972. Republican U.S. Senator Ted Stevens, who was first appointed & elected to complete the unexpired term of Bob Bartlett was re-elected to his second term (a full term) in office, over Democrat Gene Guess.

zh.t: 1972年阿拉斯加州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1972年阿拉斯加州美国联邦参议院选举于1972年11月7日举行。共和党参议员泰德·史蒂文斯最初获任命接替鲍勃·巴特利特，之后当选完成其未满任期；此次他击败民主党候选人吉恩·盖斯，成功连任第二届完整任期。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island voted for the Republican incumbent, Richard Nixon, over the Democratic challenger, South Dakota Senator George McGovern.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举罗得岛州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举罗得岛州投票于1972年11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出4名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。罗得岛州支持共和党时任总统理查德·尼克松，击败民主党挑战者、南达科他州参议员乔治·麦戈文。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 7, 1972. Primaries were held on March 21, 1972.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1972年11月7日（星期二）举行选举，初选于同年3月21日举行。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 7, 1972. All 50 states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1972 United States presidential election. Iowa voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Richard Nixon of California and his running mate Vice President Spiro Agnew of Maryland.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举艾奥瓦州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举艾奥瓦州投票于1972年11月7日举行。当年50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参加了总统选举。艾奥瓦州选民选出8名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、加利福尼亚州籍时任总统理查德·尼克松与其竞选搭档、马里兰州籍副总统斯皮罗·阿格纽赢得艾奥瓦州。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 7, 1972. All 50 states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1972 United States presidential election. State voters chose ten electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Louisiana was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Richard Nixon of California and his running mate Vice President Spiro Agnew of Maryland.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举路易斯安那州选情
zh.s: 1972年美国总统选举路易斯安那州投票于1972年11月7日举行。当年50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参加了总统选举。该州选民选出10名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、加利福尼亚州籍时任总统理查德·尼克松与其竞选搭档、马里兰州籍副总统斯皮罗·阿格纽赢得路易斯安那州。

en.s: The 1972 Arizona House of Representatives elections were held on November 7, 1972. Voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve a two-year term. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including U.S. House and State Senate. Primary elections were held on September 12, 1972. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 34 seats over the Democrats' 26 seats.

zh.s: 1972年亚利桑那州众议院选举于1972年11月7日举行，选出州众议院全部60名议员，任期两年，采用多议员选区。选举与其他公职选举同时举行，包括联邦众议院和州参议院选举。初选于1972年9月12日举行。选举前，共和党以34席对民主党的26席占多数。

en.t: 1972 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas
en.s: The 1972 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas occurred on November 7, 1972, to elect the members of the state of Texas's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Texas had twenty-four seats in the House, up one from the 1960s, apportioned according to the 1970 United States census. Texas Democrats maintained their governmental trifecta after the 1970 elections.

zh.t: 1972年得克萨斯州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1972年得克萨斯州美国联邦众议院选举于1972年11月7日举行，选出该州联邦众议院代表团的成员。根据1970年美国人口普查重新分配席位后，得克萨斯州共有24个众议院席位，比1960年代增加1席。1970年选举后，得克萨斯州民主党继续同时控制州长职位和州议会两院。

en.s: The 1972 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1972. Incumbent Governor of Washington Daniel J. Evans, who was first elected eight years earlier, and then re-elected in 1968, was eligible for re-election, as Washington does not have gubernatorial term limits. On election day, Evans defeated former governor Albert D. Rosellini by a comfortable margin of 117,212 votes, in a rematch of the 1964 contest.

zh.s: 1972年11月7日，华盛顿州举行州长选举。时任州长丹尼尔·J·埃文斯八年前首次当选，并于1968年连任。由于华盛顿州没有州长任期限制，他有资格再次参选。选举日，埃文斯以117,212票的优势击败前州长阿尔伯特·D·罗塞利尼。这是两人继1964年后再次交手。

en.t: 1972 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1972 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 7, 1972, as part of the 1972 United States presidential election. Georgia voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Georgia was won by incumbent President Richard Nixon (R–California), with 75.04% of the popular vote, against George McGovern (D–South Dakota), with 24.65% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1972年美国总统选举佐治亚州投票
zh.s: 1972年11月7日，佐治亚州举行1972年美国总统选举投票。选民选出12名代表，也就是选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。共和党籍现任总统理查德·尼克松（来自加利福尼亚州）在佐治亚州以75.04%的普选票获胜，民主党候选人乔治·麦戈文（来自南达科他州）获得24.65%。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate elections in Georgia
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Georgia took place on November 7, 1972, as one of that year's United States Senate elections. It was held concurrently with the 1972 presidential election. This seat had opened up following the death of Richard B. Russell in 1971. Shortly thereafter, Governor of Georgia Jimmy Carter appointed David H. Gambrell to fill Russell's vacant seat.

zh.t: 1972年美国联邦参议院佐治亚州选举
zh.s: 1972年11月7日，佐治亚州举行联邦参议院选举，这是当年全美参议院选举的一部分，并与总统选举同期举行。理查德·B·罗素于1971年去世后，这个席位出现空缺。不久后，佐治亚州州长吉米·卡特任命戴维·H·甘布雷尔填补该席位。

en.s: Comptroller was a newly formed office, created by the 1970 Constitution of Illinois to replace the office of Auditor of Public Accounts, of which the outgoing incumbent was Democrat Michael Howlett, who instead opted to run for Secretary of State. Republican George W. Lindberg was elected the inaugural Illinois Comptroller.

zh.s: 州审计长是1970年《伊利诺伊州宪法》创设的新职位，取代公共账目审计官一职。即将卸任的民主党籍审计官迈克尔·豪利特决定改竞选州务卿。共和党人乔治·W·林德伯格当选伊利诺伊州首任审计长。

en.t: 1972 United States Senate election in Idaho
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate election in Idaho took place on November 7; incumbent Len Jordan did not run for re-election. Republican U.S. Representative Jim McClure was elected to succeed him over Democrat Bud Davis.

zh.t: 1972年美国联邦参议院爱达荷州选举
zh.s: 1972年11月7日，爱达荷州举行联邦参议院选举。时任参议员伦·乔丹没有竞选连任。共和党联邦众议员吉姆·麦克卢尔当选接替他，击败民主党人巴德·戴维斯。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1972 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1972 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in all of the state senate's 50 districts—the 25 even-numbered seats were up for regularly scheduled four-year terms and, due to the oddities of redistricting following the 1970 Census, the 25 odd-numbered seats were up for shortened two-year terms.

zh.s: 1972年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是该州1972年两年一度选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民改选州参议院50个选区的全部席位。其中，25个偶数编号选区按计划选出四年任期的议员；由于1970年人口普查后的选区重划带来特殊情况，25个奇数编号选区则选出仅任两年的议员。

en.s: The 1972 United States Senate elections were held on November 7, with the 33 seats of Class 2 contested in regular elections. They coincided with the landslide re-election of Republican President Richard Nixon. Despite Nixon's landslide victory, Democrats increased their majority by two seats. The Democrats picked up open seats in Kentucky and South Dakota, and defeated four incumbent senators: Gordon Allott of Colorado, J.

zh.s: 1972年美国参议院选举于11月7日举行，第二类的33个席位均进行常规改选。选举与共和党总统理查德·尼克松压倒性连任同期举行。尽管尼克松大胜，民主党仍将参议院多数席位增加了2席：民主党赢得肯塔基州和南达科他州的空缺席位，并击败4名现任参议员——科罗拉多州的戈登·阿洛特、特拉华州的J·卡莱布·博格斯、艾奥瓦州的杰克·米勒和缅因州的玛格丽特·蔡斯·史密斯。共和党赢得新墨西哥州、北卡罗来纳州和俄克拉何马州的空缺席位，并击败弗吉尼亚州现任参议员威廉·B·斯蓬。选后，民主党有56席，共和党有42席，另有1名保守党和1名独立参议员。由于1971年通过第二十六修正案，这是首次所有年满18岁的公民（而非21岁及以上）都能参加的参议院选举。

en.s: The War Powers Resolution (also known as the War Powers Resolution of 1973 or the War Powers Act) (50 U.S.C. ch. 33) is a federal law intended to check the U.S. president's power to commit the United States to an armed conflict without the consent of the U.S. Congress. The resolution was adopted in the form of a United States congressional joint resolution.
en.n: This entry records the entry into force, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 《战争权力决议》（也称《1973年战争权力决议》或《战争权力法》，编入《美国法典》第50编第33章）是一项联邦法律，旨在限制美国总统未经国会同意就让美国卷入武装冲突的权力。该决议以美国国会联合决议的形式通过。它规定，总统只有在获得国会法定授权，或美国、其领土和属地或武装部队遭到攻击而出现国家紧急状态时，才能派遣美军采取军事行动。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 1978
en.s: The 1978 South Carolina United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 7, 1978 to select six Representatives for two-year terms from the state of South Carolina. The primary elections for the Democrats and the Republicans were held on June 13. All five incumbents who ran were re-elected, but the open seat in the 4th congressional district was taken by the Republicans from the Democrats. The composition of the state delegation after the elections was four Democrats and two Republicans.

zh.t: 1978年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1978年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举于11月7日举行，选出6名众议员，任期两年。民主党和共和党初选于6月13日举行。所有参选的5名现任众议员都成功连任，但第4国会选区的空缺席位由共和党人从民主党手中夺走。选后该州代表团由4名民主党人和2名共和党人组成。
