en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1978
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 7, 1978. Following the death of United States Senator Lee Metcalf on January 12, 1978, Montana Supreme Court Chief Justice Paul G. Hatfield was appointed to serve for the remainder of Metcalf's term. Hatfield opted to run for re-election, but was overwhelmingly defeated in the Democratic primary by United States Congressman Max Baucus of the 1st congressional district. Baucus advanced to the general election, where he was opposed by Larry R. Williams, an author and the Republican nominee.

zh.t: 1978年蒙大拿州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1978年蒙大拿州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。联邦参议员李·梅特卡夫于1978年1月12日去世后，蒙大拿州最高法院首席大法官保罗·G·哈特菲尔德获任命，接替他完成剩余任期。哈特菲尔德随后竞选连任，但在民主党初选中被第一国会选区联邦众议员马克斯·鲍卡斯以压倒性优势击败。鲍卡斯进入大选，对手是作家、共和党候选人拉里·R·威廉姆斯。

en.t: United States Senate election in Illinois, 1978
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in Illinois took place on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Republican United States Senator Charles H. Percy ran for re-election to a third term in the United States Senate. Percy was opposed by Democratic nominee Alex Seith, an attorney who had been appointed to several local government positions. Though Percy had been expected to coast to re-election over Seith, a first-time candidate, the election quickly became competitive. In the last few days of the campaign, a desperate Percy ran a television advertisement that featured him apologizing and acknowledging that, "I got your message and you're right."

zh.t: 1978年伊利诺伊州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1978年伊利诺伊州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。共和党籍现任参议员查尔斯·H·珀西竞选第三个参议员任期，对手是民主党候选人亚历克斯·塞思，一名曾获任命担任多个地方政府职务的律师。尽管外界原本认为珀西能轻松连任，击败首次参选的塞思，但竞争很快变得激烈。竞选最后几天，珀西在一则电视广告中道歉并承认：“我听到了你们的意见，你们说得对。”

en.s: The 1978 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1978 for the post of Governor of Arizona. Democrat Bruce Babbitt defeated Republican nominee Evan Mecham. Babbitt was the former Attorney General of Arizona, but after the death of Governor Wesley Bolin, Babbit became Governor. Bolin himself ascended to office from the position of Secretary of State, meaning his replacement, Rose Mofford was not eligible to the office as she was not elected. This drama of exchanging office would continue after Babbitt's term came to an end, as Mofford would become Governor and succeeded Evan Mecham, Babbitt's challenger, in 1988.

zh.s: 1978年亚利桑那州州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党候选人布鲁斯·巴比特击败共和党候选人埃文·梅查姆。巴比特曾任亚利桑那州检察长；州长韦斯利·博林去世后，他接任州长。博林此前从州务卿职位升任州长，因此接替他的罗斯·莫福德因未经选举当选，不具备担任州长的资格。巴比特任期结束后，这场职位更替仍在继续：1988年，莫福德成为州长，接替了击败巴比特的埃文·梅查姆。

en.t: United States Senate election in North Carolina, 1978
en.s: The North Carolina United States Senate election of 1978 was held on 7 November 1978 as part of the nationwide elections to the Senate. The general election was fought between the Republican incumbent Jesse Helms and the Democrat nominee John Ingram. Helms won re-election, by a slightly wider margin than in 1972.

zh.t: 1978年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1978年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行，是全国参议院选举的一部分。大选对阵双方是共和党籍现任参议员杰西·赫尔姆斯和民主党候选人约翰·英格拉姆。赫尔姆斯成功连任，胜差比1972年略大。

en.t: United States Senate election in Minnesota, 1978
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in Minnesota was held on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Wendell Anderson was defeated by Republican challenger Rudy Boschwitz.

zh.t: 1978年明尼苏达州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1978年明尼苏达州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。共和党挑战者鲁迪·博斯维茨击败了民主党籍现任参议员温德尔·安德森。

en.s: The 1978 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Republican Jim Rhodes defeated Democratic nominee Dick Celeste with 49.31% of the vote.

zh.s: 1978年俄亥俄州州长选举于1978年11月7日举行。时任共和党州长吉姆·罗兹以49.31%的得票率击败民主党候选人迪克·塞莱斯特。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 7, 1978. Primaries were held on March 21, 1978. This was the first election that the 1970 Constitution of Illinois' change took effect that all statewide executive offices would be elected in national midterm years.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1978年11月7日（星期二）举行选举，初选于同年3月21日举行。这是1970年《伊利诺伊州宪法》关于全州行政职位在全国中期选举年份举行选举的改动首次生效。

en.s: The 1978 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 7, 1978, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent attorney general Warren Spannaus defeated Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Minnesota Senate Howard A. Knutson and American Party nominee Arnold P. Olsen.

zh.t: 1978年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1978年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于1978年11月7日举行，以选出该州总检察长。民主农民劳工党候选人、时任总检察长沃伦·斯潘诺斯击败共和党候选人、时任明尼苏达州参议员霍华德·A·克努森，以及美国党候选人阿诺德·P·奥尔森。

en.s: The 1978 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 7, 1978, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Joan Growe defeated Independent-Republican nominee Gerald Brekke and American Party nominee Dianna Jenkins.

zh.s: 1978年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于1978年11月7日举行，以选出该州州务卿。民主农民劳工党候选人、时任州务卿琼·格罗韦击败独立共和党候选人杰拉尔德·布雷克和美国党候选人戴安娜·詹金斯。

en.s: The 1978 Connecticut Attorney General election took place on November 7, 1978, to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Carl R. Ajello won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican nominee Peter C. Dorsey.

zh.t: 1978年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1978年康涅狄格州总检察长选举于1978年11月7日举行。时任民主党总检察长卡尔·R·阿耶洛击败共和党候选人彼得·C·多尔西，连任第二届。

en.s: The 1978 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1978. Republican nominee Mike Curb defeated Democratic incumbent Mervyn Dymally with 51.64% of the vote. As of 2026, this was the last time a Republican was elected lieutenant governor of California.

zh.t: 1978年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1978年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于1978年11月7日举行。共和党候选人迈克·柯布以51.64%的得票率击败民主党时任副州长默文·戴马利。截至2026年，这是共和党人最后一次当选加利福尼亚州副州长。

en.t: 1978 United States Senate election in Alaska
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in Alaska was held on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Ted Stevens was re-elected to a third term (a second full term) in office, defeating Democrat Donald Hobbs.

zh.t: 1978年阿拉斯加州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1978年阿拉斯加州美国联邦参议院选举于1978年11月7日举行。时任共和党联邦参议员泰德·史蒂文斯击败民主党候选人唐纳德·霍布斯，连任第三届（第二个完整任期）。

en.s: The Maryland county executive elections of 1978 took place on November 7, 1978. Anne Arundel County, Baltimore County, Harford County, Howard County, Montgomery County, and Prince George's County elected county executives.

zh.t: 1978年马里兰州县行政长官选举
zh.s: 1978年马里兰州县行政长官选举于1978年11月7日举行。安妮阿伦德尔县、巴尔的摩县、哈福德县、霍华德县、蒙哥马利县和乔治王子县选出了县行政长官。

en.s: The 1978 New Hampshire gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Republican governor Meldrim Thomson Jr., who defeated former governor Wesley Powell for the Republican nomination, ran for a fourth term in office, but was defeated by former State Representative Hugh Gallen.

zh.s: 1978年新罕布什尔州州长选举于1978年11月7日举行。时任共和党州长小梅尔德里姆·汤姆森击败前州长韦斯利·鲍威尔，赢得共和党提名，竞选第四个任期，但最终败给了前州众议员休·加伦。

en.t: 1978 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Democratic Senator Floyd Haskell ran for re-election to a second term, but was soundly defeated by Republican U.S. Representative William L. Armstrong.

zh.t: 1978年科罗拉多州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1978年科罗拉多州美国联邦参议院选举于1978年11月7日举行。时任民主党参议员弗洛伊德·哈斯克尔竞选连任第二届，但被共和党联邦众议员威廉·L·阿姆斯特朗大败。

en.s: The 1978 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1978, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Due to term limits, incumbent Democrat Jerry Apodaca was ineligible to seek a second term as governor. Bruce King, a member of the Democratic Party who had previously served as governor from 1971 to 1975, won the open seat.

zh.s: 1978年新墨西哥州州长选举于1978年11月7日举行，以选出该州州长。由于任期限制，时任民主党州长杰里·阿波达卡不能竞选连任第二届。民主党人布鲁斯·金曾于1971至1975年担任州长，此次赢得空缺席位。

en.s: The 1978 Wisconsin Secretary of State election took place on November 7, 1978, to elect the Secretary of State of Wisconsin. Incumbent Democrat Doug La Follette declined to seek re-election, instead running in the primary for Lieutenant Governor. Milwaukee Alderwoman and civil rights activist Vel Phillips was nominated in a field of 9 candidates and defeated Republican Frederic A. Seefeldt.

zh.s: 1978年威斯康星州州务卿选举于1978年11月7日举行。时任民主党州务卿道格·拉福莱特决定不竞选连任，转而参加副州长初选。密尔沃基市女议员、民权活动人士维尔·菲利普斯在9名候选人中获得提名，并击败共和党候选人弗雷德里克·A·西费尔特。

en.t: 1978 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Republican Senator Dewey F. Bartlett retired, leaving the seat vacant. He was succeeded by popular Democratic Governor David Boren. Boren won a competitive Democratic primary against former U.S. Representative Ed Edmondson and State Senator Gene Stipe, then defeated Edmondson in a run-off election. Boren easily defeated Republican nominee Robert B.

zh.t: 1978年俄克拉何马州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1978年俄克拉何马州美国参议院选举于11月7日举行。共和党籍现任参议员杜威·F·巴特利特退休，留下空缺席位；民主党籍州长戴维·博伦接替了他。博伦在竞争激烈的民主党初选中击败前联邦众议员埃德·埃德蒙森和州参议员吉恩·斯泰普，随后在决选中再次击败埃德蒙森。大选中，博伦轻松击败共和党候选人罗伯特·B·卡姆。

en.s: The 1978 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1978, and featured U.S. Representative Charles Thone, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee, Lieutenant Governor Gerald Whelan. Incumbent Governor J. James Exon, a Democrat, was barred from seeking a third term. Exon was elected to the U.S. Senate that same day.

zh.s: 1978年内布拉斯加州州长选举于1978年11月7日举行。共和党联邦众议员查尔斯·索恩击败民主党候选人、时任副州长杰拉尔德·惠兰。民主党时任州长J·詹姆斯·埃克森因任期限制不能竞选第三届，并于同一天当选联邦参议员。

en.s: The 1978 Montana House of Representatives election took place on November 7, 1978, with the primary election held on June 6, 1978. Montana voters elected all 100 members of the Montana House of Representatives to serve two-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Montana state elections, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and Montana Senate. Following the previous election in 1976, Democrats held a 57-to-43-seat majority over Republicans.

zh.s: 1978年蒙大拿州众议院选举于1978年11月7日举行，初选于同年6月6日举行。蒙大拿州选民选出州众议院全部100名成员，任期两年。选举与美国全国选举和蒙大拿州选举同时进行，包括联邦参议院、联邦众议院和蒙大拿州参议院选举。1976年上次选举后，民主党以57席对共和党的43席占多数。

en.s: The 1978 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday, November 7, 1978. Republican James R. Thompson easily won a second term in office, defeating Democratic nominee Michael Bakalis by 596,550 votes.

zh.s: 1978年伊利诺伊州州长选举于1978年11月7日（星期二）举行。共和党人詹姆斯·R·汤普森轻松连任第二届，以596,550票的优势击败民主党候选人迈克尔·巴卡利斯。

en.s: The 1978 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Democratic Governor Edgar Herschler ran for re-election to a second term. After winning a contested Democratic primary, he advanced to the general election, where he faced former State Senator John C. Ostlund, the Republican nominee. Despite the strong Republican performance nationwide, Herschler's personal popularity allowed him to narrowly win re-election to Ostlund, making him the first Democratic Governor to win re-election since Lester C.

zh.s: 1978年怀俄明州州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党籍现任州长埃德加·赫施勒竞选连任，争取第二个任期。他在竞争激烈的民主党初选中胜出，随后面对共和党候选人、前州参议员约翰·C·奥斯特伦。尽管共和党在全国选举中表现强劲，赫施勒凭借个人声望以微弱优势连任，成为自1946年莱斯特·C·亨特以来首位成功连任的民主党籍怀俄明州州长。

en.t: 1978 United States Senate election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in Arkansas took place on November 7, 1978. Incumbent U.S. Senator John L. McClellan, who announced his retirement, had died the previous November, leaving the seat vacant. Interim appointee Kaneaster Hodges Jr. did not run to the full seat, and was succeeded by Governor of Arkansas David Pryor. Pryor won a highly-competitive three-way primary against U.S.

zh.t: 1978年阿肯色州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1978年阿肯色州美国参议院选举于11月7日举行。宣布退休的现任联邦参议员约翰·L·麦克莱伦于前一年11月去世，留下空缺席位。临时接任的凯恩斯特·霍奇斯二世没有竞选完整任期，后来由阿肯色州州长戴维·普赖尔接替。普赖尔在竞争激烈的三人民主党初选中击败联邦众议员吉姆·盖伊·塔克和雷·桑顿，随后在决选中击败塔克。获得民主党提名后，普赖尔轻松击败共和党候选人托马斯·凯利和独立候选人约翰·布莱克。

en.s: The 1978 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 7, 1978, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee and former United States Attorney for the District of Maryland Stephen H. Sachs defeated Republican nominee Warren K. Rich.

zh.s: 1978年马里兰州总检察长选举于1978年11月7日举行，以选出该州总检察长。民主党候选人、前马里兰联邦检察官斯蒂芬·H·萨克斯击败共和党候选人沃伦·K·里奇。

en.t: 1978 United States Virgin Islands general election
en.s: The 1978 United States Virgin Islands general election took place on November 7, 1978, to elect public officials in the United States Virgin Islands. Losing candidates often did not have their political affiliations listed on election returns.

zh.s: 1978年11月7日，美属维尔京群岛举行大选，选出公职人员。败选候选人的党派有时没有列在选举结果中。

en.s: The 1978 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1978. In a rematch of the 1974 contest, Republican nominee Victor Atiyeh defeated Democratic incumbent Robert Straub. As of 2026, this is the last Oregon gubernatorial race where the incumbent was defeated.

zh.s: 1978年俄勒冈州州长选举于1978年11月7日举行。共和党候选人维克托·阿提耶击败民主党时任州长罗伯特·斯特劳布，这是对1974年选举的再次对决。截至2026年，这是俄勒冈州最近一次州长竞选中时任州长落败。

en.t: 1978 United States Senate election in Alabama
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in Alabama was held on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator John Sparkman decided to retire and Alabama Supreme Court Chief Justice Howell Heflin was elected to succeed him. Heflin won the Democratic primary against Rep. Walter Flowers and faced only nominal opposition from Prohibition Party nominee Jerome Couch in the general election.

zh.t: 1978年阿拉巴马州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1978年阿拉巴马州美国联邦参议院选举于1978年11月7日举行。时任民主党联邦参议员约翰·斯帕克曼决定退休，阿拉巴马州最高法院首席大法官豪厄尔·赫夫林当选接替他。赫夫林在民主党初选中击败联邦众议员沃尔特·弗劳尔斯，大选中只遇到禁酒党候选人杰罗姆·库奇象征性的挑战。

en.s: The 1978 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday, November 7, 1978. Incumbent Democrat Ella Grasso and running mate Bill O'Neill defeated Republican candidate Ronald A. Sarasin and running mate Lewis Rome with 59.15% of the vote.

zh.s: 1978年康涅狄格州州长选举于1978年11月7日（星期二）举行。民主党时任州长埃拉·格拉索与竞选搭档比尔·奥尼尔以59.15%的得票率击败共和党候选人罗纳德·A·萨拉辛及其竞选搭档刘易斯·罗姆。

en.t: 1978 United States Senate special election in Alabama
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate special election in Alabama was held on November 7, 1978. It was a special election to fill the seat which had been held by Senator Jim Allen, who died on June 1. His widow Maryon was appointed on June 8 by governor George Wallace to fill the vacancy until a special election could be held. Democratic state senator Donald W.

zh.t: 1978年阿拉巴马州美国参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1978年阿拉巴马州美国参议院特别选举于11月7日举行，以填补参议员吉姆·艾伦于6月1日去世后留下的席位。艾伦的遗孀玛丽恩于6月8日由州长乔治·华莱士任命，暂时接替该席位，直到举行特别选举。民主党籍州参议员唐纳德·W·斯图尔特先在党内初选中击败艾伦，随后又击败前共和党联邦众议员詹姆斯·D·马丁，完成剩余两年的任期。

en.t: 1978 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in Kansas took place on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Republican Senator James B. Pearson did not run for re-election to a third full term. Nancy Landon Kassebaum, the daughter of former Governor Alf Landon, won the election, defeating a large field of Republican candidates in the primary and Democratic former U.S. Representative William R. Roy in the general election.

zh.t: 1978年堪萨斯州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1978年堪萨斯州美国联邦参议院选举于1978年11月7日举行。时任共和党参议员詹姆斯·B·皮尔森没有竞选第三个完整任期。前州长阿尔夫·兰登的女儿南希·兰登·卡斯鲍姆在共和党初选中击败众多候选人，并在大选中击败民主党前联邦众议员威廉·R·罗伊，当选参议员。

en.s: A Massachusetts general election was held on November 7, 1978 in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. The election included: statewide elections for United States Senator, Governor, Lieutenant Governor, Attorney General, Secretary of the Commonwealth, Treasurer, and Auditor; district elections for U.S. Representatives, State Representatives, State Senators, and Governor's Councillors; and ballot questions at the state and local levels. Democratic and Republican candidates were selected in party primaries held September 14, 1978.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于1978年11月7日举行大选。选举包括全州公职选举：联邦参议员、州长、副州长、总检察长、州务卿、州财政长和州审计长；选区选举：联邦众议员、州众议员、州参议员和州长委员会成员；以及州和地方层级的公投提案。民主党和共和党候选人分别在1978年9月14日举行的党内初选中产生。

en.t: 1978 United States House of Representatives election in Nevada
en.s: The 1978 United States House of Representatives election in Nevada was held on Tuesday November 7, 1978, to elect the state's at-large representative. Primary elections were held on September 12, 1978. Incumbent representative, James David Santini easily won re-election to a third term. He won every county except for Douglas County with over 60 percent of the vote.

zh.t: 1978年内华达州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1978年内华达州美国联邦众议院选举于1978年11月7日（星期二）举行，选出该州的全州单一选区众议员。初选于1978年9月12日举行。时任众议员詹姆斯·戴维·桑蒂尼轻松连任第三届，得票率超过60%，赢得除道格拉斯县以外的每个县。

en.t: 1978 United States Senate special election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate special election in Minnesota was held on November 7, 1978. Democratic candidate Bob Short was defeated by Republican candidate David Durenberger.

zh.t: 1978年明尼苏达州美国联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1978年明尼苏达州美国联邦参议院特别选举于1978年11月7日举行。民主党候选人鲍勃·肖特败给了共和党候选人大卫·杜伦伯格。

en.t: 1978 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in Tennessee took place on November 7, 1978, to elect the U.S. Senator from the state of Tennessee. Two-term popular incumbent Republican U.S. Senator, Howard Baker, who had served as United States Senate Minority Leader since 1977, won re-election over first-time candidate and Democratic Party activist Jane Eskind.

zh.t: 1978年田纳西州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1978年田纳西州美国联邦参议院选举于1978年11月7日举行，以选出代表田纳西州的联邦参议员。深受欢迎、已任两届的共和党时任参议员霍华德·贝克自1977年起担任参议院少数党领袖，他击败了首次参选的民主党活动人士简·埃斯金德，成功连任。

en.s: The 1978 Florida gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1978. Democratic nominee Bob Graham was elected, defeating Republican nominee Jack Eckerd with 55.59% of the vote.

zh.s: 1978年佛罗里达州州长选举于1978年11月7日举行。民主党候选人鲍勃·格雷厄姆当选，以55.59%的得票率击败共和党候选人杰克·埃克德。

en.t: 1978 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in Iowa took place on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Democratic Senator Dick Clark ran for re-election to a second term but was defeated by Republican former Lieutenant Governor Roger Jepsen. This was the last time until 2014 that a Republican would win Iowa's Class II Senate seat.

zh.t: 1978年艾奥瓦州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1978年艾奥瓦州美国联邦参议院选举于1978年11月7日举行。时任民主党参议员迪克·克拉克竞选连任第二届，但败给共和党前副州长罗杰·杰普森。这是直到2014年之前，共和党最后一次赢得艾奥瓦州第二类参议院席位。

en.t: 1978 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1978 United States House of Representatives elections was an election for the United States House of Representatives on November 7, 1978, to elect members to serve in the 96th United States Congress. They occurred in the middle of Democratic President Jimmy Carter's term, amidst an energy crisis and rapid inflation. The Democratic Party lost a net of 15 seats to the Republican Party, and thus lost their two-thirds supermajority, but still maintained a large 277-seat majority.

zh.s: 1978年美国联邦众议院选举于1978年11月7日举行，选出第96届国会的议员。当时民主党总统吉米·卡特的任期过半，美国正经历能源危机和快速通胀。民主党净失去15个席位给共和党，因此失去三分之二的绝对多数，但仍以277席保持明显多数。

en.t: 1978 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in Wyoming was held on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Republican Senator Clifford Hansen declined to seek a third term in office. Former State Representative Alan K. Simpson, the son of former Senator Milward Simpson, won a contested Republican primary and faced Raymond B. Whitaker, the 1960 Democratic nominee for the Senate, in the general election.

zh.t: 1978年怀俄明州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1978年怀俄明州美国联邦参议院选举于1978年11月7日举行。时任共和党参议员克利福德·汉森没有竞选第三届。前州众议员艾伦·K·辛普森是前参议员米尔沃德·辛普森的儿子，他在竞争激烈的共和党初选中胜出，并在大选中对阵民主党候选人雷蒙德·B·惠特克。惠特克曾于1960年获得民主党参议员候选人提名。

en.s: The 1978 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 7, 1978, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Minnesota House of Representatives Arne Carlson defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent state auditor Robert W. Mattson Jr. and Communist nominee Helen S. Kruth.

zh.t: 1978年明尼苏达州州审计长选举
zh.s: 1978年明尼苏达州州审计长选举于1978年11月7日举行，以选出该州审计长。共和党候选人、明尼苏达州众议院时任议员阿恩·卡尔森击败了民主农民劳工党候选人、时任州审计长小罗伯特·W·马特森和共产党候选人海伦·S·克鲁思。

en.s: The 1978 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 7, 1978, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller Louis L. Goldstein defeated Republican nominee Donald J. Devine.

zh.s: 1978年马里兰州州审计长选举于1978年11月7日举行，以选出该州审计长。民主党候选人、时任审计长路易斯·L·戈德斯坦击败共和党候选人唐纳德·J·德瓦恩。

en.t: 1978 United States Senate election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in West Virginia took place on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Jennings Randolph was re-elected to a fifth term and a fourth full term in office, narrowly defeating Republican former Governor Arch Moore. Despite his defeat, Moore's daughter, Shelley Moore Capito, would later win election to this seat in 2014, becoming the first female Senator from the state.

zh.t: 1978年西弗吉尼亚州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1978年西弗吉尼亚州美国联邦参议院选举于1978年11月7日举行。时任民主党联邦参议员詹宁斯·伦道夫以微弱优势击败共和党前州长阿奇·摩尔，连任第五届，也是第四个完整任期。尽管摩尔落败，他的女儿谢莉·摩尔·卡皮托后来于2014年赢得这个席位，成为该州首位女性参议员。

en.s: The 1978 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Democrat Richard Lamm defeated Republican nominee Ted L. Strickland with 58.76% of the vote.

zh.s: 1978年科罗拉多州州长选举于1978年11月7日举行。民主党时任州长理查德·拉姆以58.76%的得票率击败共和党候选人泰德·L·斯特里克兰。

en.s: The 1978 Michigan Secretary of State election was held on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Democrat Richard H. Austin defeated Republican nominee Melvin L. Larsen with 65.57% of the vote. Larsen conceded the election early, before 10% of the return votes were counted.

zh.s: 1978年密歇根州州务卿选举于1978年11月7日举行。民主党时任州务卿理查德·H·奥斯汀以65.57%的得票率击败共和党候选人梅尔文·L·拉森。计票未达到10%时，拉森便提前承认败选。

en.t: 1978 United States Senate election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in Mississippi was held on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator James Eastland decided to retire. Republican Thad Cochran won the open seat, becoming the first Republican to win a U.S. Senate election in Mississippi since the end of Reconstruction in 1881. It was also the first time since 1877 that a Republican won this Senate seat.

zh.t: 1978年密西西比州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1978年密西西比州美国联邦参议院选举于1978年11月7日举行。时任民主党联邦参议员詹姆斯·伊斯特兰决定退休。共和党候选人萨德·科克伦赢得空缺席位，成为1881年重建时期结束以来首位在密西西比州美国联邦参议院选举中获胜的共和党人。这也是自1877年以来共和党首次赢得该参议院席位。

en.s: The 1978 California Attorney General election was held on November 7, 1978. Republican nominee George Deukmejian defeated Democratic nominee Yvonne Brathwaite Burke with 52.88% of the vote.

zh.t: 1978年加利福尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1978年加利福尼亚州总检察长选举于1978年11月7日举行。共和党候选人乔治·德克梅吉安以52.88%的得票率击败民主党候选人伊冯娜·布拉思韦特·伯克。

en.t: 1978 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in New Jersey was held on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Senator Clifford P. Case ran for re-election to a fifth term in office, narrowly losing the Republican primary by anti-tax conservative Jeff Bell, who lost the general election to Democrat Bill Bradley. Bell was the unsuccessful Republican nominee for this seat again in 2014. Primary elections were held on June 6, 1978.

zh.t: 1978年新泽西州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1978年新泽西州美国联邦参议院选举于1978年11月7日举行。时任参议员克利福德·P·凯斯竞选连任第五届，但在共和党初选中以微弱差距败给反税保守派杰夫·贝尔。贝尔随后在大选中败给民主党人比尔·布拉德利。2014年，贝尔再次代表共和党竞选这个席位，但仍未当选。初选于1978年6月6日举行。

en.s: The 1978 Michigan Attorney General election was held on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Democrat Frank J. Kelley defeated Republican nominee Stephen C. Bransdorfer with 67.50% of the vote. Bransdorfer conceded the election early, before 10% of the return votes were counted.

zh.s: 1978年密歇根州总检察长选举于1978年11月7日举行。民主党时任总检察长弗兰克·J·凯利以67.50%的得票率击败共和党候选人斯蒂芬·C·布兰斯多弗。计票未达到10%时，布兰斯多弗便提前承认败选。

en.s: The 1978 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1978, to elect the next governor of Tennessee. Although the Tennessee State Constitution had been amended in early 1978 to allow a governor to succeed himself, Incumbent Democratic governor Ray Blanton chose not to seek re-election amid several scandals. Republican Lamar Alexander once again ran for governor. In the general election, Alexander defeated Democratic nominee Jake Butcher with 55.8% of the vote.

zh.s: 1978年田纳西州州长选举于1978年11月7日举行，以选出下一任州长。田纳西州宪法于1978年初修订，允许州长连任，但时任民主党州长雷·布兰顿因多起丑闻决定不竞选连任。共和党人拉马尔·亚历山大再次竞选州长，并在大选中以55.8%的得票率击败民主党候选人杰克·布彻。

en.t: 1978 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas
en.s: The 1978 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas occurred on November 7, 1978, to elect the members of the state of Texas's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Texas had twenty-four seats in the House apportioned according to the 1970 United States census. These elections occurred simultaneously with the United States Senate elections of 1978, the United States House elections in other states, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 1978年得克萨斯州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1978年得克萨斯州美国联邦众议院选举于1978年11月7日举行，选出该州联邦众议院代表团成员。根据1970年美国人口普查重新分配后，得克萨斯州有24个联邦众议院席位。这些选举与1978年联邦参议院选举、其他州的联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 1978 United States Senate election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in Kentucky took place on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Senator Walter Dee Huddleston won reelection to a second term. As of 2026, this is the last time a Democrat has won Kentucky's Class 2 Senate seat, which has been held by Mitch McConnell since his victory over Huddleston in 1984.

zh.t: 1978年肯塔基州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1978年肯塔基州美国联邦参议院选举于1978年11月7日举行。时任参议员沃尔特·迪·赫德尔斯顿成功连任第二届。截至2026年，这是民主党最后一次赢得肯塔基州第二类参议院席位。米奇·麦康奈尔于1984年击败赫德尔斯顿，此后一直保有该席位。

en.s: The 1978 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1978, to elect the next governor of Oklahoma. Incumbent Democratic governor David Boren chose not to run for re-election to a second term in office. Instead, Boren decided to run for the United States Senate. Former governor, and sitting lieutenant governor George Nigh was elected, defeating Republican nominee Ron Shotts.

zh.s: 1978年俄克拉何马州州长选举于1978年11月7日举行，以选出下一任州长。时任民主党州长戴维·博伦决定不竞选连任第二届，而是改为参选美国联邦参议员。前州长、时任副州长乔治·奈当选，击败共和党候选人罗恩·肖茨。

en.t: 1978 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in South Dakota was held on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator James Abourezk did not run for re-election to a second term, but was succeeded by his political rival, Republican U.S. Representative Larry Pressler.

zh.t: 1978年南达科他州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1978年南达科他州美国联邦参议院选举于1978年11月7日举行。时任民主党联邦参议员詹姆斯·阿布雷兹克没有竞选连任第二届，由他的政治对手、共和党联邦众议员拉里·普雷斯勒接任。

en.s: On November 7, 1978, Washington, D.C., held the second election for its mayor as a result of the District of Columbia Home Rule Act. The primary election of the Democratic Party (the most important contest in the race, as 90% of the District's voters were registered Democrats) took place on Tuesday, September 12, with At-Large Councilman Marion Barry defeating incumbent mayor Walter E.

zh.t: 1978年华盛顿哥伦比亚特区市长选举
zh.s: 1978年11月7日，华盛顿哥伦比亚特区举行了《哥伦比亚特区自治法》实施后的第二次市长选举。民主党初选于9月12日举行，是选举中最关键的一环，因为特区90%的选民登记为民主党人。特区议会议员马里昂·巴里击败时任市长沃尔特·E·华盛顿和议会主席斯特林·塔克，赢得民主党提名。随后，巴里在11月的大选中击败共和党候选人阿瑟·弗莱彻及另外两名候选人。

en.s: The 1978 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Democrat J. Joseph Garrahy defeated Republican nominee and future governor Lincoln Almond with 62.79% of the vote.

zh.s: 1978年罗得岛州州长选举于1978年11月7日举行。时任民主党州长J·约瑟夫·加拉希以62.79%的得票率击败共和党候选人、未来的州长林肯·阿尔蒙德。

en.s: The 1978 Arizona Senate election was held on November 7, 1978. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on September 12, 1978. Prior to the elections, the Democrats held a majority of 16 seats over the Republicans' 14 seats.

zh.s: 1978年亚利桑那州参议院选举于1978年11月7日举行，选出该州30个州议会选区的州参议员，任期两年。初选于1978年9月12日举行。选举前，民主党以16席对共和党的14席占多数。

en.s: The 1978 Texas lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1978, to elect the lieutenant governor of Texas. The incumbent, William P. Hobby Jr. ran for re-election to his third term, he was elected against Republican, Gaylord Marshall, whom he had beaten four years earlier. Hobby won the election with 65% of the vote to Marshall's 34%, and was sworn in on January 16, 1979, alongside Texas' first Republican governor since Reconstruction, Bill Clements who had won the concurrent gubernatorial election.

zh.s: 1978年得克萨斯州副州长选举于1978年11月7日举行，以选出该州副州长。时任副州长小威廉·P·霍比竞选第三届，并击败共和党候选人盖洛德·马歇尔。四年前，霍比也曾击败马歇尔。霍比以65%的得票率对34%胜出，并于1979年1月16日宣誓就职。同日宣誓就任州长的比尔·克莱门茨是重建时期结束以来得克萨斯州首位共和党州长。

en.s: The 1978 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1978 to elect the Governor and Lieutenant Governor of New York. Incumbent Democratic governor Hugh Carey was reelected, making this the first reelection of a Democratic governor in New York since Herbert H. Lehman in 1938.

zh.s: 1978年11月7日，纽约州举行州长和副州长选举。民主党籍现任州长休·凯里成功连任。这是纽约州自1938年赫伯特·H·雷曼连任以来，首次有民主党籍州长成功连任。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 7, 1978, in 36 states and two territories. The Republicans had a net gain of six seats, Democrats sustained a net loss of five seats, and there would be no governors of any other parties following these elections. This was the first year in which Illinois held a gubernatorial election in a midterm election year since 1846.

zh.s: 1978年11月7日，美国36个州和两个属地举行州长选举。共和党净增6席，民主党净失5席；选举后不再有其他党派的州长。伊利诺伊州此前只在1846年于国会中期选举年份举行过州长选举，这是该州此后首次在中期选举年份举行州长选举。

en.t: 1978 United States Senate election in Georgia
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in Georgia was held on November 7, 1978. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Sam Nunn won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 1978年美国联邦参议院佐治亚州选举
zh.s: 1978年11月7日，佐治亚州举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍现任参议员萨姆·纳恩成功连任，开始第二个任期。

en.s: The 1978 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1978. George Busbee was re-elected, the first time a governor of Georgia was re-elected for a second four-year term under the amendment made to the constitution in 1976, and the first time overall after serving a complete first four-year term.

zh.s: 1978年11月7日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。乔治·巴斯比成功连任。这是1976年州宪法修正案通过后，佐治亚州首次有州长连任第二个四年任期，也是该州首次有州长完整任满第一个四年任期后再度连任。

en.s: The 1978 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1978, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor Zell Miller defeated Republican nominee James W. Webb II.

zh.s: 1978年11月7日，佐治亚州举行副州长选举。民主党候选人、时任副州长泽尔·米勒击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·W·韦布二世。

en.s: The 1978 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1978 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in half of the state senate's districts—the 25 odd-numbered state senate districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate, with half of the seats up for election each cycle. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the year 1978 is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1978年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是该州1978年两年一度选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民改选州参议院50个选区中的一半，即25个奇数编号选区的议员。州参议员任期四年，每轮选举有一半席位改选。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1978年全州50个州参议院选区的地图。

en.s: Incumbent Comptroller Michael Bakalis, a Democrat, did not seek a second term, instead opting to run for governor. Democrat Roland Burris was elected to succeed him. In winning the election, Burris became the first American American to be elected to statewide office in Illinois.

zh.t: 1978年伊利诺伊州州务审计长选举
zh.s: 民主党籍现任州务审计长迈克尔·巴卡利斯没有竞选第二个任期，而是选择竞选州长。民主党人罗兰·伯里斯当选，接替了他。伯里斯因此成为首位当选伊利诺伊州全州公职的非裔美国人。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1978 United States Senate elections were held on November 7, in the middle of Democratic President Jimmy Carter's term. The 33 seats of Class 2 were contested in regular elections. Special elections were also held to fill vacancies. Thirteen seats changed hands between parties, resulting in a net gain of three seats for the Republicans allowing them to break the Democrats' filibuster-proof majority.

zh.s: 1978年11月7日，美国举行联邦参议院选举，时任民主党总统吉米·卡特正处于任期中段。第二类33个席位通过常规选举改选，另举行特别选举填补空缺。两党共有13席易手，共和党净增三席，使民主党失去可打破阻挠议事的多数。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1978 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday, November 7, and incumbent Democrat John Evans defeated Republican nominee Allan Larsen with 58.75% of the vote. It was the third consecutive win for the Democrats (1970, 1974, 1978), but the only significant victory for the party in Idaho in 1978.

zh.s: 1978年11月7日星期二，爱达荷州举行州长选举。民主党籍现任州长约翰·埃文斯以58.75%的得票率击败共和党候选人艾伦·拉森。这是民主党连续第三次赢得爱达荷州州长选举（1970年、1974年和1978年），但也是该党1978年在爱达荷州唯一一项重要胜利。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Elections are held in Jerusalem to elect the city's mayor. Currently, such elections are regularly scheduled to elect mayors to five-year terms.

zh.s: 耶路撒冷举行选举，选出该市市长。目前，此类选举通常定期举行，市长任期为五年。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: 1978 United States Senate election in Idaho
en.s: The 1978 United States Senate election in Idaho took place on November 7. Incumbent Republican Senator Jim McClure was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating little-known Democrat Dwight Jensen, a journalist and television news anchor in Boise.

zh.t: 1978年美国联邦参议院爱达荷州选举
zh.s: 1978年11月7日，爱达荷州举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍现任参议员吉姆·麦克卢尔击败知名度不高的民主党候选人德怀特·詹森，连任第二个任期。詹森是博伊西的记者和电视新闻主播。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1978 Arkansas gubernatorial election, held on November 7, was the first time that future president Bill Clinton was elected Governor of Arkansas.

zh.s: 1978年11月7日举行的阿肯色州州长选举，是比尔·克林顿首次当选阿肯色州州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1978 San Jose mayoral election was held to elect the mayor of San Jose, California. It saw an initial election held on June 6, 1978, followed by a runoff election on November 7, 1978, after no candidate managed to obtain a majority in the initial election. The runoff was won by incumbent mayor Janet Gray Hayes.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1978年6月6日，圣何塞举行市长选举首轮投票。由于没有候选人获得过半选票，11月7日举行决选。时任市长珍妮特·格雷·海斯赢得决选。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框中标注的决选日期。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Madagascar on 7 November 1982. Incumbent President Didier Ratsiraka of AREMA won with over 80% of the vote. Voter turnout was 86.75% of the 4,749,054 registered voters.

zh.s: 马达加斯加于1982年11月7日举行总统选举。争取连任的现任总统迪迪埃·拉齐拉卡代表AREMA党，获得超过80%的选票。登记选民共4749054人，投票率为86.75%。

en.s: The 1982 Upper Voltan coup d'état took place in the Republic of Upper Volta (today Burkina Faso) on 7 November 1982. The coup, led by Colonel Gabriel Somé Yorian and a slew of other junior officers within the military, many of them political radicals, overthrew the regime of Colonel Saye Zerbo. Zerbo had previously taken power just under two years prior to his own downfall.

zh.s: 1982年11月7日，上沃尔特共和国（今布基纳法索）发生政变。政变由加布里埃尔·索梅·约里安上校及一批军中低级军官发动，其中许多人是政治激进分子。他们推翻了萨耶·泽博上校的政权。不到两年前，泽博曾通过政变掌权。

en.s: The 1983 U.S. Senate bombing was a terrorist attack that took place at the United States Senate on November 7, 1983, as a protest against United States military involvement in Lebanon and Grenada. The attack led to heightened security in the DC metropolitan area, and the inaccessibility of certain parts of the Senate Building.

zh.s: 1983年美国参议院爆炸案是1983年11月7日发生在美国参议院的一起恐怖袭击，作案者以抗议美国军事介入黎巴嫩和格林纳达为由发动袭击。事件后，华盛顿特区都会区加强了安保，参议院大楼部分区域也变得无法进入。

en.s: Able Archer 83 was a military exercise conducted by NATO that took place in November 1983, as part of the annual Able Archer exercise. It simulated a period of heightened nuclear tensions between NATO and the Warsaw Pact, leading to concerns that it could have been mistaken for a real attack by the Soviet Union.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: Able Archer 83是北约于1983年举行的一次军事演习，属于年度Able Archer演习的一部分。演习模拟了北约与华约之间核紧张局势升级的情形，因此有人担心苏联可能将其误判为真实袭击。
zh.n: 本条目记录源信息框所列的开始日期。

en.t: United States Senate election in Maine, 1984
en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in Maine was held on November 7, 1984. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator William Cohen won re-election to a second term.

zh.s: 1984年缅因州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。共和党籍现任参议员威廉·科恩成功连任第二届。

en.s: The Wrestling Classic was a 1985 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It took place on November 7, 1985, at the Rosemont Horizon in the Chicago suburb of Rosemont, Illinois. It was the promotion's second-ever pay-per-view, after WrestleMania earlier that year in March. In the main event, WWF World Heavyweight Champion Hulk Hogan defeated "Rowdy" Roddy Piper by disqualification to retain the title.

zh.s: 摔角经典赛是世界摔角联合会（WWF，现为WWE）于1985年举办的职业摔角付费收看赛事。赛事于1985年11月7日在伊利诺伊州芝加哥郊区罗斯蒙特的罗斯蒙特地平线体育馆举行，是该联盟当年的第二场付费收看赛事，此前同年3月曾举行摔角狂热赛。主赛中，WWF世界重量级冠军胡克·霍根（Hulk Hogan）因对手“狂人”罗迪·派珀（“Rowdy” Roddy Piper）犯规而获胜，保住冠军头衔。

en.s: The Palace of Justice siege was an attack carried out in Bogotá, Colombia, on November 6–7, 1985, in which a guerrilla commando of the 19th of April Movement (M-19) took over the Palace of Justice, housing the Supreme Court and the Council of State. The guerrillas held roughly 350 people hostage, among them Supreme Court justices, councilors of state, judicial staff, employees, and visitors.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1985年11月6日至7日，哥伦比亚波哥大发生司法宫围困事件。4月19日运动（M-19）的一支游击队突袭并占领司法宫，那里设有最高法院和国务委员会。游击队挟持约350名人质，其中包括最高法院法官、国务委员、司法工作人员、雇员和访客。

en.t: The Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) system in Singapore opens for passenger service
en.s: The Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) is a rapid transit system in Singapore and the island country's principal mode of railway transportation. After two decades of planning, the system commenced operations in November 1987 with an initial 6 km (3.7 mi) stretch consisting of five stations.

zh.t: 新加坡地铁（MRT）开始载客运营
zh.s: 新加坡地铁（MRT）是新加坡的快速轨道交通系统，也是这个岛国的主要铁路交通方式。经过20年的规划，地铁于1987年11月开始运营，初期线路长6公里，设有5座车站。

en.t: Accession of Zine El Abidine Ben Ali
en.s: Zine El Abidine Ben Ali (Arabic: زَيْن الْعَابِدِين بْن عَلِيّ, romanized: Zayn al-ʿĀbidīn bin ʿAliyy, Tunisian Arabic: Zīn il-ʿĀbdīn bin ʿAlī; 3 September 1936 – 19 September 2019), commonly known as Ben Ali or Ezzine, was a Tunisian politician, military officer and dictator who served as the second president of Tunisia from 1987 to 2011. In that year, during the Tunisian revolution, he was overthrown and fled to Saudi Arabia.

zh.t: 宰因·阿比丁·本·阿里上台
zh.s: 宰因·阿比丁·本·阿里（阿拉伯语：زَيْن الْعَابِدِين بْن عَلِيّ；突尼斯阿拉伯语：Zīn il-ʿĀbdīn bin ʿAlī；1936年9月3日—2019年9月19日）是突尼斯政治人物、军官和独裁者，1987年至2011年担任突尼斯第二任总统。他在突尼斯革命期间被推翻，随后逃往沙特阿拉伯。

en.s: Operation Ghashey (Arrow in Pashto) was a military offensive launched by Mujahideen forces against positions held by the army of the Republic of Afghanistan between October 23 and November 7, 1988. The aim of the operation was to seize and hold a portion of the Kabul-Jalalabad highway for a short period of time, an action that was aimed at weakening the hold of the Afghan government over Jalalabad.

zh.s: “加希行动”（普什图语意为“箭行动”）是圣战者武装于1988年10月23日至11月7日发动的一次军事攻势，目标是打击阿富汗共和国军队的阵地。行动意在短期内夺取并控制喀布尔—贾拉拉巴德公路的一段，以削弱阿富汗政府对贾拉拉巴德的控制。

en.s: The New York City mayoral election of 1989 occurred on Tuesday, November 7, 1989, with Democratic candidate, Manhattan Borough President David Dinkins, narrowly defeating U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of New York, Rudolph Giuliani, the Republican nominee. They also faced several third party candidates. Dinkins replaced outgoing Democratic incumbent mayor Ed Koch; Dinkins had defeated Koch in the Democratic primary. Dinkins won with 50.42% of the vote to Giuliani's 47.84%. Whereas the two preceding mayoral elections of the 1980s had been Democratic landslide victories, with all five boroughs voting to re-elect incumbent Ed Koch, the 1989 election was a closely contested race that finished with a narrow 2.58% margin of victory for David Dinkins.

zh.s: 1989年纽约市市长选举于11月7日星期二举行。民主党候选人、曼哈顿区区长戴维·丁金斯以微弱优势击败共和党候选人、纽约南区联邦检察官鲁迪·朱利安尼。两人还面对多名第三党候选人。丁金斯接替即将卸任的民主党籍市长埃德·科赫；他此前已在民主党初选中击败科赫。丁金斯获得50.42%的选票，朱利安尼获得47.84%，丁金斯以2.58个百分点的微弱优势获胜。20世纪80年代前两次市长选举中，科赫都以压倒性优势获胜，五个行政区也都支持他连任。

en.s: The Houston Mayoral Election of 1989 took place on November 7, 1989. Incumbent Mayor Kathy Whitmire was re-elected to a fifth term. It was the last election of someone over three terms. (Before the Term Limits).

zh.s: 1989年休斯敦市长选举于11月7日举行。现任市长凯西·惠特迈尔赢得第五个任期。这是任期限制实施前，候选人最后一次连任超过三届。

en.s: The United States gubernatorial elections of 1989 were held on November 7, 1989. Two states, New Jersey and Virginia, voted to select a governor, as well as other statewide offices and members of state legislatures. Democrats picked up the open seat in New Jersey formerly held by a Republican while keeping another open seat in Virginia held by a Democrat.

zh.s: 1989年美国州长选举于11月7日举行。新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州举行州长选举，并同时改选其他州级公职和州议会议员。民主党从共和党手中赢得新泽西州空缺的州长职位，并保住弗吉尼亚州一个由民主党控制的空缺职位。

en.s: The Mayoral election of 1989 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 7, 1989. The incumbent mayor, Sophie Masloff of the Democratic Party chose to run for her first full term after having ascended the mayor's office from the position of President of City Council upon the death of long-time mayor Richard Caliguiri.

zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市长选举于1989年11月7日星期二举行。民主党籍现任市长苏菲·马斯洛夫决定竞选第一个完整任期。她此前在长期任职的市长理查德·卡利吉里去世后，从市议会主席升任市长。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1989 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 7, 1989. Incumbent Republican Governor Thomas Kean was term-limited having been elected to served two consecutive terms. Democrat James Florio, a U.S. Representative from the 1st district and a two-time unsuccessful candidate for Governor, defeated 12th district Republican Representative Jim Courter in a 24-point landslide.

zh.s: 1989年新泽西州州长选举于11月7日举行。共和党籍现任州长托马斯·基恩受任期限制不能连任；他此前已连续当选两届。民主党候选人詹姆斯·弗洛里奥是联邦众议员，代表该州第1选区，也曾两次竞选州长但未成功。这次他以24个百分点的巨大优势击败了来自第12选区的共和党众议员吉姆·库特。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1989 Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1989. Incumbent Democratic governor Jerry Baliles was unable to seek a second term due to term limits. Democratic nominee and Lieutenant Governor L. Douglas Wilder went against former attorney general of Virginia J. Marshall Coleman in one of the closest elections in Virginia history.

zh.s: 1989年弗吉尼亚州州长选举于1989年11月7日举行。民主党时任州长杰里·巴莱尔斯因任期限制不能竞选连任第二届。民主党候选人、副州长L·道格拉斯·怀尔德对阵弗吉尼亚州前总检察长J·马歇尔·科尔曼，双方差距是弗吉尼亚州历史上最小的之一。

en.s: The 1989 Dayton mayoral election took place on November 7, 1989. Incumbent Mayor Donna Owens ran for re-election to a fourth term. She was challenged by John McHugh, the former Chairman of the county Democratic Party. In the primary election, McHugh placed first by a wide margin, winning 69 percent of the vote to Owens's 31 percent.

zh.t: 1989年俄亥俄州托莱多市长选举
zh.s: 代顿市长选举于1989年11月7日举行。时任市长唐娜·欧文斯竞选连任第四届，前县民主党主席约翰·麦克休向她发起挑战。初选中，麦克休以明显优势位居第一，得票率为69%，欧文斯为31%。

en.s: The 1989 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 1989. As incumbent Lieutenant Governor Douglas Wilder chose to not seek re-election and instead ran successfully for 1989 Virginia gubernatorial election. Democratic nominee Don Beyer defeated Republican nominee Edwina P. Dalton with 54.14% of the vote.

zh.s: 1989年弗吉尼亚州副州长选举于1989年11月7日举行。时任副州长道格拉斯·怀尔德决定不竞选连任，而是转而参加1989年弗吉尼亚州州长选举并成功当选。民主党候选人唐·拜尔以54.14%的得票率击败共和党候选人埃德薇娜·P·道尔顿。

en.s: The 1989 New Jersey General Assembly election was held on November 7, 1989. The elections coincided with Jim Florio's landslide election as Governor of New Jersey. As a result, Democrats won back the Assembly for the first time since 1983. Democrats flipped one seat in districts 2, 10, 11, 21, and 34.

zh.s: 1989年新泽西州州议会选举于1989年11月7日举行，与吉姆·弗洛里奥压倒性当选新泽西州州长同时进行。民主党因此自1983年以来首次重新赢得州众议院。民主党在第2、10、11、21和34选区各赢得一个席位。

en.s: The 1989 Cleveland mayoral election took place on November 7, 1989, to elect the Mayor of Cleveland, Ohio. The election was officially nonpartisan, with the top two candidates from the October 3 primary advancing to the general election. Both candidates who advanced to the runoff were African American and Democrats.

zh.s: 1989年11月7日，俄亥俄州克利夫兰举行市长选举。该选举名义上不设党派，10月3日初选中得票最多的两名候选人进入普选决选。进入决选的两人都是非裔美国人，也都是民主党人。

en.s: The 1989 Allentown mayoral election was a municipal election to determine the mayor of Allentown, Pennsylvania. Two-term Democratic mayor Joseph S. Daddona sought re-election to a third term, receiving both the Democratic and Republican nominations, but was challenged by an Independent campaign from a Democratic councilwoman Emma Tropiano.

zh.t: 1989年宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦市长选举
zh.s: 1989年，宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦举行市政选举，选出市长。民主党籍连任两届的市长约瑟夫·S·达多纳竞选第三个任期，同时获得民主党和共和党提名；民主党籍市议员艾玛·特罗皮亚诺则作为独立候选人挑战他。

en.s: The Virginia House of Delegates election of 1989 was held on Tuesday, November 7. Primary elections were held on June 13, 1989.

zh.s: 1989年11月7日星期二，弗吉尼亚州举行众议院选举。初选于1989年6月13日举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1990 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1990. Democratic nominee Barbara Roberts defeated Republican David B. Frohnmayer and Independent Al Mobley to win the election.

zh.s: 1990年俄勒冈州州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党候选人芭芭拉·罗伯茨击败共和党候选人大卫·B·弗罗恩迈尔和独立候选人阿尔·莫布利，赢得选举。

en.s: The Irish presidential election of 1990 was the tenth presidential election to be held in Ireland, and only the fifth to be contested by more than one candidate and the first to have a female candidate. It was held on Wednesday, 7 November 1990.

zh.s: 1990年爱尔兰总统选举是爱尔兰举行的第十次总统选举，也是第五次有多名候选人参选的选举，并首次出现女性候选人。选举于1990年11月7日星期三举行。

en.s: The Langbaurgh by-election, 1991 was a by-election held on 7 November 1991 for the British House of Commons constituency of Langbaurgh, in the former county of Cleveland in North East England. It was the final by-election of the 1987-1992 parliament, and was held just five months before the 1992 general election. The seat had become vacant on the death of the Conservative Member of Parliament Richard Holt on 20 September 1991. Holt had held the seat since the 1983 general election. The by-election was won by the Labour candidate, Ashok Kumar.

zh.s: 1991年朗巴罗补选于11月7日举行，选出英国下议院朗巴罗选区的议员。该选区位于英格兰东北部、前克利夫兰郡境内。这是1987至1992年议会任期内最后一次补选，距1992年大选仅五个月。保守党议员理查德·霍尔特于1991年9月20日去世后，席位空缺；他自1983年大选以来一直代表该选区。工党候选人阿肖克·库马尔赢得补选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Kincardine and Deeside by-election was a parliamentary election held in Kincardine and Deeside, Scotland, on 7 November 1991, caused by the death of its Conservative Member of Parliament (MP), Alick Buchanan-Smith on 29 August 1991. The result was a Liberal Democrat gain from the Conservatives, with Nicol Stephen elected as the new MP. Stephen held the seat until the 1992 general election when it was regained by the Conservatives. The Labour candidate, Malcolm Savidge, who came fourth in this by-election, went on to be elected MP for Aberdeen North in the 1997 general election.

zh.s: 金卡丁和迪赛德补选于1991年11月7日在苏格兰举行。保守党议员艾利克·布坎南-史密斯于1991年8月29日去世后，该选区议席空缺。自由民主党候选人尼科尔·斯蒂芬当选，替保守党赢得该席位。斯蒂芬一直任职到1992年大选，届时保守党重新赢回该席位。工党候选人马尔科姆·萨维奇在此次补选中排名第四，后来于1997年当选为阿伯丁北区议员。

en.s: The Hemsworth by-election, 1991 was a parliamentary by-election held in England on 7 November 1991 for the House of Commons constituency of Hemsworth in West Yorkshire. The seat had become vacant on the death of the Labour Member of Parliament George Buckley (British politician), who had held the seat since the 1987 general election. The Labour candidate, Derek Enright, held the seat for his party.

zh.s: 1991年赫姆斯沃思补选于11月7日在英格兰举行，选出西约克郡赫姆斯沃思选区的下议院议员。工党议员乔治·巴克利去世后，席位出现空缺；他自1987年大选以来一直代表该选区。工党候选人德里克·恩赖特赢得补选，为工党保住席位。

en.s: The 1992 West Virginia gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1992. Incumbent Democratic Governor Gaston Caperton won re-election by defeating former Republican U.S. Representative Cleve Benedict and Democratic State Senator Charlotte Pritt, who ran as an independent write-in candidate after losing to Caperton in the Democratic primary election.

zh.s: 1992年西弗吉尼亚州州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党籍现任州长加斯顿·卡珀顿击败前共和党联邦众议员克利夫·本尼迪克特，成功连任。民主党州参议员夏洛特·普里特也参选，她在民主党初选中败给卡珀顿后，以独立填入式候选人身份参加大选。

en.s: A leadership election for the Civic Democratic Party (ODS) was held on 7 November 1992 during the party's Congress in Prague. It was held prior to expected dissolution of Czechoslovakia and following to 1992 legislative election in which the Civic Democratic Party was victorious. The incumbent leader Václav Klaus was reelected as party's leader. Klaus was unopposed and received votes of 333 delegates while only 8 delegates voted against him.

zh.s: 1992年11月7日，公民民主党在布拉格举行党代表大会期间选举党主席。选举在捷克斯洛伐克预计解体之前举行，且此前公民民主党在1992年议会选举中获胜。时任党主席瓦茨拉夫·克劳斯成功连任。他没有对手，获得333名代表投票支持，仅有8名代表投反对票。

en.s: A by-election for the seat of Arafura in the Northern Territory Legislative Assembly was held on 7 November 1992. The by-election was triggered by the death of Labor (ALP) member Stan Tipiloura, who had held the seat since 1987. The ALP selected Maurice Rioli, a former professional Australian Rules player, as its candidate. The CLP candidate was Bernard Tipiloura, with an independent candidacy of Colin Newton.

zh.s: 1992年11月7日，澳大利亚北领地立法议会阿拉弗拉选区举行补选。工党议员斯坦·蒂皮卢拉于1987年当选后去世，触发此次补选。工党提名曾参加职业澳式足球比赛的莫里斯·里奥利为候选人。乡村自由党候选人为伯纳德·蒂皮卢拉，科林·牛顿则以独立候选人身份参选。

en.t: United States Senate election in West Virginia, 1994
en.s: The 1994 United States Senate election in West Virginia took place on November 7, 1994. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Robert Byrd won re-election to a seventh term. He won every county and congressional district in the state.

zh.t: 1994年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1994年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。民主党籍现任参议员罗伯特·伯德成功连任第七届，赢得该州每个县和国会选区。

en.s: The 1994 Kazakhstan Cup final was the third final of the Kazakhstan Cup. The match was contested by Vostok and Aktyubinets at Central Stadium in Almaty. The match was played on 7 November 1994 and was the final match of the competition.

zh.s: 1994年11月7日，东方队与阿克托别内茨队在阿拉木图中央体育场举行第三届哈萨克斯坦杯决赛。这也是该届赛事的最后一场比赛。

en.s: The 1995 Kentucky gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1995. Incumbent Governor Brereton Jones was not eligible to run for a second term due to term limits established by the Kentucky Constitution, creating an open seat. At the time, Kentucky and Virginia were the only states that prohibited their Governors from serving immediate successive terms. The Democratic nominee, Lieutenant Governor Paul E.

zh.s: 1995年肯塔基州州长选举于11月7日举行。时任州长布雷雷顿·琼斯受州宪法任期限制，不能竞选连任，因而州长席位成为开放席位。当时，肯塔基州和弗吉尼亚州是仅有的两个禁止州长连续连任的州。民主党候选人、时任副州长保罗·E·帕顿赢得选举。

en.s: The 1995 United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 7, 1995, in three states — Kentucky, Louisiana, and Mississippi. Prior to the elections, Democrats held two seats and Republicans one. With the Republican gain of the open seat in Louisiana, Republicans held two seats and Democrats one following the elections.

zh.s: 1995年美国州长选举于11月7日在肯塔基州、路易斯安那州和密西西比州举行。选举前，民主党占据两个州长职位，共和党占据一个。共和党赢得路易斯安那州的空缺职位后，选举结束时共和党拥有两个州长职位，民主党拥有一个。

en.s: The 1995 Tucson mayoral election occurred on November 7, 1995, to elect the mayor of Tucson, and occurred coinciding with the elections to the Tucson City Council wards 1, 2 and 4. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor George Miller.

zh.s: 1995年图森市长选举于1995年11月7日举行，同时改选图森市议会第1、2和4选区席位。时任市长乔治·米勒成功连任。

en.s: The 1995 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 1995 to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Republican Kirk Fordice won reelection to a second term. This is the last time that a gubernatorial nominee and a lieutenant gubernatorial nominee of different political parties were elected governor and lieutenant governor in Mississippi.

zh.s: 1995年密西西比州州长选举于1995年11月7日举行，以选出该州州长。时任共和党州长柯克·福迪斯成功连任第二届。这是密西西比州最后一次由不同政党的州长候选人和副州长候选人分别当选州长和副州长。

en.s: The Indianapolis mayoral election of 1995 took place on November 7, 1995. Incumbent Republican mayor Stephen Goldsmith was easily reelected to a second term. His Democratic opponent, Zilthia Mae Jimison, was the first African-American nominated for mayor of Indianapolis by a major political party. Goldsmith would run unsuccessfully for governor in 1996, narrowly losing to Democrat Frank O’Bannon.

zh.t: 1995年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 1995年印第安纳波利斯市长选举于1995年11月7日举行。时任共和党市长斯蒂芬·戈德史密斯轻松连任第二届。他的民主党对手齐尔西亚·梅·吉米森是首位获主要政党提名竞选印第安纳波利斯市长的非裔美国人。戈德史密斯于1996年竞选州长，但以微弱差距败给民主党人弗兰克·奥班农。

en.s: The 1995 Snohomish County Executive election took place on November 7, 1995, to elect the county executive of Snohomish County, Washington. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Bob Drewel ran for re-election to a second term. Drewel was challenged for re-election by Republican Doug Smith, an attorney who had unsuccessfully run for County Executive in 1991.

zh.t: 1995年斯诺霍米什县行政长官选举
zh.s: 1995年11月7日，华盛顿州斯诺霍米什县举行行政长官选举。民主党籍现任行政长官鲍勃·德鲁埃尔竞选连任第二个任期，共和党人道格·史密斯向他发起挑战。史密斯是一名律师，曾在1991年竞选该县行政长官但未能当选。

en.s: The 1995 San Francisco mayoral election was held on November 7, 1995, with a runoff election held on December 12, 1995. Former Speaker of the California State Assembly Willie Brown defeated incumbent mayor Frank Jordan in a runoff election to become the 41st Mayor of San Francisco.

zh.s: 1995年11月7日，旧金山举行市长选举，并于同年12月12日举行决选。前加利福尼亚州众议院议长威利·布朗在决选中击败时任市长弗兰克·乔丹，当选旧金山第41任市长。

en.s: The 1995 Durham mayoral election was held on November 7, 1995, to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Sylvia Kerckhoff.

en.s: The Virginia Senate election of 1995 was held on Tuesday, November 7. en.s: ADC Airlines Flight 086 (ADK086) was a Nigerian domestic flight operated by ADC Airlines from Port Harcourt to Lagos. On the afternoon of 7 November 1996, the crew of the Boeing 727-231 operating the flight lost control of the aircraft while avoiding a mid-air collision on approach; the aircraft crashed inverted at a very high speed into a lagoon, killing all 144 passengers and crew on board.

zh.s: ADC航空086号航班（ADK086）是尼日利亚国内航班，由ADC航空运营，航线从哈科特港飞往拉各斯。1996年11月7日下午，执飞的波音727-231客机在进近时为躲避空中相撞而失控，随后倒扣着以极高速度坠入泻湖，机上144名乘客和机组人员全部遇难。

en.s: Mars Global Surveyor (MGS) was an American robotic space probe developed by NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory. It was launched on November 7, 1996, and collected data in orbit around Mars from 1997 to 2006. MGS was a global mapping mission that examined the entire planet, from the ionosphere down through the atmosphere to the surface.

zh.t: 火星全球探勘者号发射
zh.s: 火星全球探勘者号（MGS）是美国喷气推进实验室研制的机器人探测器，于1996年11月7日发射。它于1997年至2006年在火星轨道上收集数据，开展全球测绘，研究范围从电离层、大气层一直到火星表面。

en.t: United States presidential election in Idaho, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 7, 2000 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2000 United States presidential election. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Idaho has become one of the most reliable red states in the country, and in 2000 Governor George W. Bush easily won the state, every congressional district, and county except Blaine County. In fact, the only other county in the state that Gore received at least 40% from was Shoshone County.

zh.s: 2000年爱达荷州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年在全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。爱达荷州已成为美国最稳定支持共和党的州之一。州长乔治·W·布什轻松赢得全州、所有国会选区和除布莱恩县以外的所有县。戈尔在该州也只有肖肖尼县的得票率达到40%。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in North Dakota, 2000
en.s: The 2000 U.S. House of Representatives election for the state of North Dakota's At-large congressional district was held November 7, 2000. The incumbent, Democratic-NPL Congressman Earl Pomeroy was re-elected to his fifth term, defeating Republican candidate John Dorso. Only Pomeroy filed as a Dem-NPLer, and the endorsed Republican candidate was John Dorso, who was serving as the North Dakota House Majority Leader. Pomeroy and Dorso won the primary elections for their respective parties. While the election was the closest for Pomeroy since 1994, Dorso was unable to defeat the four-term congressman. Dorso's father, Carmen Dorso, died during the campaign after a battle with leukemia.

zh.t: 2000年北达科他州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2000年北达科他州联邦众议院选举于11月7日举行，选出该州单一国会选区的众议员。民主党—无党派联盟籍现任众议员厄尔·波默罗伊击败共和党候选人约翰·多尔索，连任第五届。波默罗伊是唯一登记参加民主党—无党派联盟初选的候选人；共和党背书的候选人多尔索当时担任北达科他州众议院多数党领袖。两人都赢得各自政党的初选。此次选举是波默罗伊自1994年以来差距最小的一次，但多尔索仍未能击败这位已任四届的众议员。竞选期间，多尔索的父亲卡门·多尔索因白血病去世。

en.t: United States presidential election in West Virginia, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 7, 2000 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2000 United States presidential election. Voters chose 5 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. West Virginia gave its 5 electoral votes to Governor George W. Bush, the first time a Republican carried this state since 1984. Bush won the statewide results by a margin of 6.3%.

zh.t: 2000年西弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 2000
en.s: The 2000 South Carolina United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 7, 2000 to select six Representatives for two-year terms from the state of South Carolina. The primary elections for the Democrats and the Republicans were held on June 13 and the runoff elections were held two weeks later on June 27. All five incumbents who ran were re-elected and the open seat in the 1st congressional district was retained by the Republicans. The composition of the state delegation remained four Republicans and two Democrats.

zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举于2000年11月7日举行，偶数号选区席位参与改选。州参议员任期四年，每两年改选一半席位。2000年当选者的任期从2001年1月3日持续至2004年11月30日。相关初选于2004年4月27日举行。选举后参议院党派席位构成没有变化。民主党人迈克·斯塔克在第5选区击败时任共和党人弗兰克·A·萨尔瓦托。共和党人唐纳德·C·怀特击败民主党提名人，接替即将退休的帕特里克·J。

en.t: United States presidential election in Louisiana, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 7, 2000 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2000 United States presidential election. Voters chose 9 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Louisiana was won by Governor George W. Bush, a dramatic swing from the statewide results in 1996 when Democrat President Bill Clinton carried the state with 52% of the vote and with a double digit margin of victory. Bush was the first Republican to carry the state since 1988.

en.t: United States presidential election in Hawaii, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Hawaii was part of the 2000 United States presidential election which took place on November 7, 2000. Voters chose 4 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Hawaii was won by Vice President Al Gore by an 18.3% margin of victory. Gore also was victorious in every county and congressional districts of the state. Governor George W. en.t: United States presidential election in Maine, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 7, 2000 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2000 United States presidential election. Maine is one of two states in the U.S. that instead of all of the state's 4 electors of the Electoral College to vote based upon the statewide results of the voters, two of the individual electors vote based on their congressional district because Maine has two congressional districts. en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 7, 2000 as part of the 2000 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all 50 states and D.C. Voters chose 10 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Minnesota was won by Vice President Al Gore by a 2.4% margin of victory, a much weaker performance than President Bill Clinton had in 1996, when he carried the state with 51% of the vote and a 16% margin of victory. Despite winning the state, Gore lost most of the counties and congressional districts in the state.

zh.t: 2000年明尼苏达州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2000年明尼苏达州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年在全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出10名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。副总统阿尔·戈尔以2.4个百分点的优势赢得明尼苏达州，但表现远不如比尔·克林顿在1996年的成绩：克林顿当年以51%的得票率和16个百分点的优势赢下该州。尽管戈尔赢得全州，他在大多数县和国会选区落败。

en.t: United States presidential election in Florida, 2000
en.s: (Main article: United States presidential election, 2000) The 2000 United States presidential election in Florida took place on November 7, 2000 as part of the greater 2000 United States presidential election. Florida, a swing state, had a major recount dispute that took center stage in the election. Thus, the outcome of the 2000 United States presidential election was not known for more than a month after balloting, because of the extended process of counting and then recounting of Florida presidential ballots. State results tallied on election night gave 246 electoral votes to Republican nominee Texas Governor George W.

en.t: United States presidential election in New Mexico, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in New Mexico took place on November 7, 2000 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2000 United States presidential election. Voters chose five electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New Mexico was won by Vice President Al Gore by less than a 0.1% margin. en.t: United States presidential election in Ohio, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Ohio took place on November 7, 2000 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2000 United States presidential election. Voters chose 21 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Ohio was won by Governor George W. Bush by a 3.51% margin of victory. en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 7, 2000 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2000 United States presidential election. Voters chose 23 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania was won by Vice President Al Gore by a 4.17% margin of victory. However, voter enthusiasm for both candidates was generally low throughout the campaign. Gore failed to capture Clinton's appeal in strongly Democratic regions such as Pittsburgh and Scranton, and thus carried these areas by a smaller number than his precessor.

zh.t: 2000年宾夕法尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2000年宾夕法尼亚州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出23名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。副总统阿尔·戈尔以4.17个百分点的优势赢得宾夕法尼亚州。不过，整个竞选期间，两位候选人都未能激起选民太多热情。戈尔未能在匹兹堡、斯克兰顿等民主党票仓复制克林顿的号召力，因此他在这些地区的优势小于前任总统。

en.s: Pennsylvania's State Treasurer election was held November 7, 2000. Incumbent Republican Barbara Hafer won a narrow reelection. Her Democratic opponent was Catherine Baker Knoll, a former two-term treasurer. Hafer and Knoll, both of whom faced no primary opposition, ran a campaign marked by personal attacks. The two candidates had previously been involved in a very public feud because of events surrounding the 1996 election for this office; in that year, the term limited Knoll endorsed her daughter as successor. However, Hafer had questioned the residency status of Mina Knoll, an attack that the older Knoll believed was disingenuous and clouded her daughter's candidacy.

zh.t: 2000年宾夕法尼亚州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州州财政部长选举于2000年11月7日举行。共和党籍现任州财政部长芭芭拉·哈弗以微弱优势连任。她的民主党对手是曾任两届州财政部长的凯瑟琳·贝克·诺尔。两人都没有初选对手，竞选期间却相互进行人身攻击。1996年该职位选举期间发生的事情曾让两人公开交恶：受任期限制的诺尔支持女儿接替自己，但哈弗质疑米娜·诺尔的居住资格。年长的诺尔认为这一指控不诚恳，也损害了女儿的参选机会。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Hampshire, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on Election Day on November 7, 2000. The two major candidates were Texas Governor George W. Bush of the Republican Party and sitting Vice President Al Gore of the Democratic Party. When all votes were tallied, Bush was declared the winner with a plurality of the vote over Gore, receiving 48% of the vote to Gore's 47%, while Green Party candidate Ralph Nader received almost 4% of the vote in the state. zh.s: 2000年新罕布什尔州美国总统选举于11月7日选举日举行。两位主要候选人是共和党候选人、得克萨斯州州长乔治·W·布什和民主党候选人、时任副总统阿尔·戈尔。全部选票统计完成后，布什以48%对47%的得票率领先戈尔，获得最多选票并被宣布获胜；绿党候选人拉尔夫·纳德在该州获得近4%的选票。布什随后赢得全国选举。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Florida, 2000
en.s: The 2000 congressional elections in Florida were held on November 7, 2000, to determine who would represent the state of Florida in the United States House of Representatives. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected served in the 107th Congress from January 3, 2001, until January 3, 2003. The election coincided with the 2000 United States presidential election. At the time, Florida had twenty-three seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1990 United States Census. Its delegation to the 106th Congress of 1999-2001 consisted of fifteen Republicans and eight Democrats.

en.t: United States Senate election in Connecticut, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States Senate election in Connecticut took place on November 7, 2000 in conjunction with the 2000 U.S. presidential election, other elections to the United States Senate in other states, as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Joe Lieberman won re-election to a third term. While running for re-election, he was also Al Gore's running mate in the 2000 presidential campaign, with Gore losing the presidency to George W. Bush. Had the Gore-Lieberman ticket won, Lieberman would have become U.S.

zh.t: 2000年康涅狄格州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2000年康涅狄格州美国参议院选举于11月7日举行，与当年总统选举、其他州的联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期举行。民主党现任联邦参议员乔·利伯曼成功连任，开启第三个六年任期。竞选连任期间，他也作为民主党副总统候选人，与总统候选人阿尔·戈尔搭档。戈尔败给乔治·W·布什后，利伯曼回到参议院并继续任职12年，随后退休。如果戈尔—利伯曼组合胜选，利伯曼本会辞去参议员职务，出任美国副总统。

en.t: United States Senate election in New York, 2000
en.s: The United States Senate election in New York in 2000 was held on November 7, 2000. First Lady of the United States Hillary Rodham Clinton, the first First Lady to run for political office, defeated Congressman Rick Lazio. The general election coincided with the U.S. presidential election. The race began in November 1998 when four-term incumbent New York Senator Daniel Patrick Moynihan announced his retirement. Both the Democratic Party and Republican Party sought high-profile candidates to compete for the open seat. By early 1999 Clinton and Mayor of New York City Rudolph Giuliani were the likely respective nominees.

zh.s: 2000年纽约州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。美国第一夫人希拉里·罗德姆·克林顿成为首位竞选公职的第一夫人，她击败了联邦众议员里克·拉齐奥。这场大选与美国总统选举同日举行。竞选于1998年11月开始，当时已任四届的纽约州联邦参议员丹尼尔·帕特里克·莫伊尼汉宣布退休。民主、共和两党都在寻找知名候选人争夺空缺席位。到1999年初，克林顿和纽约市市长鲁迪·朱利安尼分别被视为最有可能的候选人。

en.t: United States presidential election in Illinois, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 7, 2000 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2000 United States presidential election. Voters chose 22 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Illinois was easily won by sitting Vice President Al Gore by a safe margin of victory, unlike other states in the Midwest, such as nearby Iowa, Minnesota and Wisconsin, which Gore won, albeit by very small margins. Bush didn't perform terribly at the county level, as he obtained less than 40% of the vote in only three counties.

zh.t: 2000年伊利诺伊州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2000年伊利诺伊州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出22名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。副总统阿尔·戈尔以明显优势轻松赢得伊利诺伊州。与邻近的爱荷华州、明尼苏达州和威斯康星州不同，戈尔在这些州也获胜，但优势很小。布什在各县的表现并不差，只有3个县的得票率低于40%。

en.s: The 2000 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 2000. Incumbent Governor of Montana Marc Racicot, who was first elected in 1992 and was re-elected in 1996, was unable to seek re-election due to term limits. Judy Martz, the Lieutenant Governor of Montana under Racicot for four years, won the Republican primary and advanced to the general election, where she faced Mark O'Keefe, the Montana State Auditor and Democratic nominee. Despite the fact that George W. Bush, the Republican nominee for president in 2000, won the state in a landslide, the race between Martz and O'Keefe was close.

zh.s: 2000年蒙大拿州州长选举于11月7日举行。现任州长马克·拉西科特于1992年首次当选、1996年连任，但因任期限制不能再竞选。曾担任拉西科特四年副州长的朱迪·马茨赢得共和党初选，进入大选，对手是蒙大拿州审计长、民主党候选人马克·奥基夫。尽管共和党总统候选人乔治·W·布什以压倒性优势赢得该州，马茨和奥基夫的州长选举竞争仍十分激烈。

en.t: United States presidential election in Michigan, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 7, 2000 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2000 United States presidential election. Voters chose 18 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Michigan was won by Vice President Al Gore by a small margin of 5.2%. The western part of the state, which is more rural, was overwhelmingly Republican and Bush won most of the congressional districts and counties in that region of the state. His best performance was in Ottawa County, where he won with over 70%.

zh.s: 2000年密歇根州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出18名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。副总统阿尔·戈尔以5.2个百分点的微弱优势赢得密歇根州。该州西部农村地区强烈支持共和党，布什赢得了该地区大多数国会选区和县。他表现最好的县是奥塔瓦县，得票率超过70%。

en.t: United States presidential election in Montana, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Montana took place on November 7, 2000 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2000 United States presidential election. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Montana was won by Governor George W. Bush. Bush won most of the counties in the state, and only obtained less than 40% in three counties. Bush won the highest populated county, Yellowstone County with exactly 59% of the vote. Gore won a total of five counties, and did the best in Deer Lodge County.

zh.s: 2000年蒙大拿州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。州长乔治·W·布什赢得蒙大拿州，并拿下该州大多数县。他在3个县的得票率低于40%。布什在人口最多的黄石县获得正好59%的选票。戈尔共赢得5个县，其中表现最好的是迪尔洛奇县。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Jersey, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 7, 2000 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2000 United States presidential election. Voters chose 15 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. The major contenders were Democratic Vice President Al Gore and Republican Governor of Texas George W. Bush, with Green Party candidate Ralph Nader running a distant third. New Jersey was actually considered by some to be a potential swing state in 2000, as some polls were neck-in-neck, causing both campaigns to advertise here, although the state had been trending to the Democratic Party in recent years.

zh.s: 2000年新泽西州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出15名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。主要候选人是民主党副总统阿尔·戈尔和共和党候选人、得克萨斯州州长乔治·W·布什，绿党候选人拉尔夫·纳德远远落后。2000年时，有些人认为新泽西州可能成为摇摆州，因为部分民调显示双方难分高下，两党竞选团队都在该州投放广告。不过，近年来该州一直越来越倾向民主党。

en.s: The 2000 California State Assembly elections were held November 7, 2000. California's State Assembly in its entirety comes up for election in even numbered years. Each seat has a two-year term and members are limited to three 2-year terms (six years). All 80 biennially elected seats in the Assembly were up for election this year. Democrats retained control of the Assembly, expanding their majority by two and defeating independent Audie Bock, who previously won a special election to her seat as a Green.

zh.t: 2000年加利福尼亚州州众议院选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州州众议院选举于2000年11月7日举行。该州每逢偶数年都会改选全部州众议院议席。每个席位任期两年，议员最多可任三届、共六年。此次选举改选了80个两年一届的席位。民主党保住州众议院控制权，并将多数席位增加了两席；该党还击败了独立候选人奥迪·博克。博克此前以绿党身份通过特别选举赢得该席位。

en.t: United States presidential election in Kentucky, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 7, 2000 as part of the 2000 United States presidential election, which included elections in all 50 states and D.C.. Voters chose 8 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Kentucky was won by Governor George W. Bush. He won most of the counties and congressional districts in the state. Bush dominated among the rural areas of the state. The only congressional district Gore won was the third district, which is a part of Jefferson County, Kentucky, the highest populated county in the state.

zh.s: 2000年肯塔基州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年在全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。州长乔治·W·布什赢得肯塔基州的大多数县和国会选区，并在该州农村地区占据明显优势。戈尔只赢得了第3国会选区，该选区位于肯塔基州人口最多的杰斐逊县内。

en.t: United States presidential election in Tennessee, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 7, 2000 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2000 United States presidential election. Voters chose 11 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Tennessee was won by Governor George W. Bush by a 3.87% margin of victory, despite having voted for Clinton in 1992 & 1996 and being the home state of Vice President Al Gore. Therefore, if Vice President Gore had carried his home state, he, instead of Bush, would have been elected President.

zh.s: 2000年田纳西州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出11名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。州长乔治·W·布什以3.87个百分点的优势赢得田纳西州，尽管该州在1992和1996年都支持克林顿，而且还是副总统阿尔·戈尔的家乡。如果戈尔赢得自己的家乡州，他就会当选总统，而不是布什。

en.s: The 2000 United States House of Representatives election for the 1st district in Illinois took place on November 7, 2000 to elect a representative from Illinois's 1st congressional district for the 107th United States Congress. Incumbent Democratic Representative Bobby Rush faced a primary challenge from Barack Obama. Rush defeated Obama 61 percent to 30 percent, with other candidates combining for the remaining nine percent. Rush then defeated his Republican opponent, Raymond Wardingley, 87 percent to 12 percent, ensuring his reelection. Subsequent to this election Obama was elected to the United States Senate in 2004.

zh.t: 2000年伊利诺伊州第1国会选区联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2000年伊利诺伊州第1国会选区联邦众议院选举于11月7日举行，选出代表该选区进入第107届国会的众议员。民主党籍现任众议员鲍比·拉什在民主党初选中遭到巴拉克·奥巴马挑战，最终以61%对30%击败奥巴马，其他候选人合计获得9%。拉什随后以87%对12%击败共和党对手雷蒙德·沃德林利，成功连任。奥巴马后来于2004年当选联邦参议员。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 2000 was the 54th quadrennial presidential election. It was held on Tuesday, November 7, 2000. The contest was between Republican candidate George W. Bush, the incumbent governor of Texas and son of former president George H. W. Bush; Democratic candidate Al Gore, the incumbent vice president; and various third-party candidates including Ralph Nader. The 2000 presidential election was the fourth election in U.S. history and the first in 112 years in which the eventual winner failed to win the popular vote (after the elections of 1824, 1876, and 1888).

zh.s: 2000年美国总统选举是美国每四年举行一次的第54届总统选举，于11月7日星期二举行。候选人包括共和党人乔治·W·布什（得克萨斯州现任州长、前总统乔治·H·W·布什之子）、民主党人阿尔·戈尔（现任副总统）以及多名第三党候选人，其中包括拉尔夫·纳德。这是美国历史上第四次出现最终胜选者未能赢得普选票的总统选举，也是112年来首次出现这种情况；此前三次分别是1824年、1876年和1888年。

en.t: United States presidential election in Delaware, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 7, 2000, part of the 2000 United States presidential election in all 50 states and D.C.. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Delaware was won by Vice President Al Gore by a 13.1% margin of victory. From 1952-1996, it gave the winning presidential candidate its electoral votes every single time. Gore won only one of Delaware's 3 counties, but he won New Castle County with almost 60% of the vote, and was able to carry the state because of the county's large population.

zh.s: 2000年特拉华州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年在全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。副总统阿尔·戈尔以13.1个百分点的优势赢得特拉华州。1952至1996年间，该州每次都把选举人票投给最终赢得总统选举的候选人。戈尔只赢得了特拉华州三个县中的一个，但他在新堡县获得近60%的选票，凭借该县人口众多赢得了全州。

en.t: United States presidential election in Maryland, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 7, 2000. Maryland participated in the 2000 presidential election along with the 49 other U.S. states and Washington, D.C. Voters chose 10 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for the President and Vice President. Maryland was easily won by Vice President Al Gore by a safe margin of victory. Gore's victory in the state is contributed to his strong performance the highest populated counties of the states, which is the home of many urban and African American communities.

zh.s: 2000年马里兰州美国总统选举于11月7日举行。马里兰州与其他49个州和华盛顿特区一同参加了当年总统选举。选民选出10名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。副总统阿尔·戈尔以明显优势轻松赢得马里兰州。他在该州人口最多的县表现突出，这些县聚集了许多城市社区和非裔美国人社区。

en.t: United States presidential election in Massachusetts, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 7, 2000 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2000 United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Massachusetts is one of the most reliable blue states in the nation: no Republican has won the state since 1984. The 2000 Presidential election featured Democratic United States Vice President Al Gore versus Republican Texas Governor George W. Bush. Despite Bush's tight victory nationwide, Gore handily won Massachusetts, with a 27% margin of victory against George W.

zh.t: 2000年马萨诸塞州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2000年马萨诸塞州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出12名选举人，代表该州参加总统和副总统选举。马萨诸塞州长期稳定支持民主党，自1984年以来没有共和党候选人赢得该州。民主党候选人阿尔·戈尔以27个百分点的优势赢得马萨诸塞州；共和党候选人乔治·W·布什虽在全国范围内险胜，但在该州落败。

en.t: United States presidential election in Washington (state), 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 7, 2000 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2000 United States presidential election. Voters chose 11 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Washington was considered to be a competitive swing state in 2000, and both campaigns sent advertisements into the state. On election day, Gore won the state with a margin of 5%. Gore's best performance in the state was in King County, also the largest populated county, which he won with 60% of the vote.

zh.s: 2000年华盛顿州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年在全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出11名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。2000年，华盛顿州被视为竞争激烈的摇摆州，两党竞选团队都在该州投放广告。投票日当天，戈尔以5个百分点的优势赢得该州。他表现最好的是人口最多的金县，得票率为60%。

en.s: The 2000 Vermont gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 2000. Incumbent Governor Howard Dean won re-election. The campaign was dominated by the fallout from the passage of a civil union bill and the subsequent backlash encapsulated by the slogan Take Back Vermont. Ruth Dwyer, the Republican nominee, was closely tied to the Take Back Vermont movement which Howard Dean, the Democratic governor, opposed.

zh.s: 2000年佛蒙特州州长选举于11月7日举行。现任州长霍华德·迪恩成功连任。竞选焦点是民事结合伴侣法案通过后的反弹，反对者以“夺回佛蒙特”为口号。共和党候选人露丝·德怀尔与这一运动关系密切，而民主党籍州长迪恩反对该运动。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan, 2000
en.s: The 2000 congressional elections in Michigan was held on November 7, 2000 to determine who would represent the state of Michigan in the United States House of Representatives. Michigan had sixteen seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1990 United States Census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 2000年密歇根州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2000年密歇根州联邦众议院选举于11月7日举行，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。根据1990年美国人口普查，密歇根州有16个众议院席位。众议员任期为两年。
