en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Kansas, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States House of Representatives elections in Kansas were held on November 7, 2000 to determine who will represent the state of Kansas in the United States House of Representatives. Kansas has four seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1990 United States Census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 2000年堪萨斯州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2000年堪萨斯州联邦众议院选举于11月7日举行，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。根据1990年美国人口普查，堪萨斯州有4个众议院席位。众议员任期为两年。

en.s: The North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election of 2000 was held on 7 November 2000, as part of the elections to the Council of State. North Carolina also held a gubernatorial election on the same day, but the offices of Governor and Lieutenant Governor are elected independently. The election was won by Democrat Beverly Perdue, who succeeded fellow Democrat Dennis A. Wicker.

zh.t: 2000年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 2000年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举于11月7日举行，是州政务委员会选举的一部分。北卡罗来纳州同日还举行州长选举，但州长和副州长分别选举。民主党候选人贝弗利·珀杜获胜，接替同为民主党人的丹尼斯·A·威克。

en.t: United States Senate election in West Virginia, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States Senate election in West Virginia took place on November 7, 2000. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Robert Byrd won re-election to an eighth term. He won every county and congressional district in the state.

zh.t: 2000年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2000年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。民主党籍现任参议员罗伯特·伯德赢得第八个任期，成功连任。他赢得该州每个县和国会选区。

en.s: The 2000 West Virginia gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 2000 for the post of Governor of West Virginia. Democratic Member of the United States House of Representatives Bob Wise defeated incumbent Republican Governor Cecil Underwood. Concurrently, the state voted the opposite way federally, choosing Republican U.S. Presidential nominee, George W. Bush over Democratic nominee Al Gore in the Presidential election that year.

zh.s: 2000年西弗吉尼亚州州长选举于11月7日举行，选出该州州长。民主党联邦众议员鲍勃·怀斯击败共和党籍现任州长塞西尔·安德伍德。当年总统选举中，西弗吉尼亚州则支持共和党候选人乔治·W·布什，和该州州长选举的结果相反。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Colorado, 2000
en.s: The 2000 United States House of Representatives elections in Colorado were held on November 7, 2000, with all seven House seats up for election. The winners served from January 3, 2001 to January 6, 2003.

en.s: The 2000 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 2000. Incumbent Governor Frank O'Bannon, a Democrat, was re-elected over Republican David M. McIntosh with 57% of the vote. Libertarian Andrew Horning also ran and received 2% of the vote. O'Bannon's victory was the fourth consecutive election in which a Democrat was elected Governor of Indiana, the longest winning streak for that party in the state since the Civil War.

zh.s: 2000年印第安纳州州长选举于2000年11月7日举行。现任民主党州长弗兰克·奥班农以57%的选票击败共和党人大卫·M·麦金托什，成功连任。自由意志党候选人安德鲁·霍宁也参加竞选，获得2%的选票。这是民主党连续第四次赢得印第安纳州州长选举，是该党自南北战争以来在该州最长的连胜纪录。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in Alaska, 2000
en.s: The Alaska Congress election of 2000 was held on Tuesday, November 7, 2000. The term of the state's sole Representative to the United States House of Representatives expired on January 3, 2001. The winning candidate would serve a two-year term from January 3, 2001, to January 3, 2003. Alaska allows the political party to select the person who can appear for party primary.

zh.t: 2000年阿拉斯加州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2000年阿拉斯加州国会选举于2000年11月7日星期二举行。该州唯一一名联邦众议员的任期于2001年1月3日届满。胜选者将于2001年1月3日至2003年1月3日任职，任期两年。阿拉斯加州允许政党自行选择可参加该党初选的人选。

en.s: The 2000 Wisconsin Fall General Election was held in the U.S. state of Wisconsin on November 7, 2000. One of Wisconsin's U.S. Senate seats was up for election, as well as Wisconsin's nine seats in the United States House of Representatives, the sixteen even-numbered seats in the Wisconsin State Senate, and all 99 seats in the Wisconsin State Assembly.

zh.s: 2000年威斯康星州秋季大选于11月7日举行。该州一个联邦参议院席位、9个联邦众议院席位、州参议院16个偶数编号席位，以及州众议院全部99个席位都进行改选。

en.s: The 2000 North Dakota gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 2000 for the post of Governor of North Dakota. Incumbent Republican governor Ed Schafer decided not to run for reelection. Republican nominee John Hoeven won the election over Democratic State Attorney General Heidi Heitkamp. Heitkamp had led in the polls until early October, when reports indicated that she had breast cancer, and would undergo surgery.

zh.s: 2000年北达科他州州长选举于2000年11月7日举行，以选出该州州长。时任共和党州长埃德·谢弗决定不竞选连任。共和党候选人约翰·霍文击败民主党候选人、州总检察长海蒂·海特坎普当选。10月初之前，海特坎普在民调中一直领先；随后媒体报道她患有乳腺癌，并将接受手术。

en.t: 2000 San Juan, Puerto Rico, mayoral election
en.s: San Juan, Puerto Rico, held an election for mayor on November 7, 2000. It was held as part of the 2000 Puerto Rican general election. It saw the election of Jorge Santini, a member of the New Progressive Party. Incumbent mayor Sila María Calderón, a member of the Popular Democratic Party, did not seek reelection to a second term, and instead ran for governor.

zh.t: 2000年波多黎各圣胡安市长选举
zh.s: 波多黎各圣胡安于2000年11月7日举行市长选举，是2000年波多黎各大选的一部分。新进步党成员豪尔赫·桑蒂尼当选。人民民主党籍时任市长西拉·玛丽亚·卡尔德龙没有竞选连任第二届，而是转而参选州长。

en.t: 2000 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota
en.s: The 2000 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota took place on Tuesday, November 7, 2000, with a primary election on June 6. Voters selected a representative for their single at-large district, who ran on a statewide ballot. Incumbent Republican representative John Thune won the race by a wide margin, outrunning the Republican candidate for president George W. Bush by 13 points in the state.

zh.t: 2000年南达科他州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2000年南达科他州美国联邦众议院选举于2000年11月7日（星期二）举行，初选于6月6日举行。选民为该州全州单一选区选出一名联邦众议员。时任共和党众议员约翰·图恩以较大优势获胜，在该州的得票率比共和党总统候选人乔治·W·布什高13个百分点。

en.s: The 2000 North Carolina Attorney General election was held on November 7, 2000, concurrently with the 2000 North Carolina gubernatorial election and the 2000 United States presidential election, to elect the attorney general of North Carolina. The North Carolina Senate Majority leader Democrat Roy Cooper won the election, and assumed office on January 6, 2001.

zh.t: 2000年北卡罗来纳州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2000年北卡罗来纳州总检察长选举于2000年11月7日举行，与该州州长选举和美国总统选举同时进行，以选出该州总检察长。北卡罗来纳州参议院多数党领袖、民主党人罗伊·库珀赢得选举，并于2001年1月6日就职。

en.s: The 2000 West Virginia Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 7, 2000. State senate seats in West Virginia are staggered, with senators serving 4-year terms. 18 of the 34 state senate seats were up for election, with 17 regular elections and with SD 11 holding an additional special election for Randy Schoonover, who resigned on September 7, 1999. The election took place concurrently with the presidential, U.S.

zh.t: 2000年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 2000年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举于11月7日星期二举行。该州州参议员任期错开，每届任期4年；34个席位中有18席改选，其中包括17场常规选举，以及第11选区为填补兰迪·舍恩诺弗于1999年9月7日辞职留下的空缺而举行的一场特别选举。选举与总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州长选举同期举行。尽管共和党总统候选人乔治·W·布什赢得该州，民主党州参议员候选人仍获得超过70%的选票，并保住州议会上院的绝对多数。

en.t: 2000 United States House of Representatives elections in Minnesota
en.s: The 2000 congressional elections in Minnesota were held on November 7, 2000 to determine who would represent the state of Minnesota in the United States House of Representatives. Minnesota had eight seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1990 United States census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected served in the 107th Congress from January 3, 2001 until January 3, 2003.

zh.t: 2000年明尼苏达州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2000年明尼苏达州联邦众议院选举于2000年11月7日举行，选出代表明尼苏达州的联邦众议员。根据1990年美国人口普查，明尼苏达州有8个众议院席位。众议员任期为两年，此次当选者于2001年1月3日至2003年1月3日在第107届国会任职。

en.t: 2000 United States House of Representatives elections in Washington
en.s: The 2000 House elections in Washington occurred on November 7, 2000, to elect the members of the State of Washington's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Washington has nine seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1990 United States census. This election saw the Democrats flip one Republican-held open seat. These elections occurred alongside Al Gore's victory in the state over George W.

zh.t: 2000年华盛顿州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2000年华盛顿州联邦众议员选举于11月7日举行，选出该州在美国联邦众议院的代表。根据1990年人口普查，华盛顿州在众议院有9个席位。民主党在此次选举中翻转了一个原由共和党占据的空缺席位。选举同期举行的总统选举中，阿尔·戈尔在华盛顿州击败乔治·W·布什。

en.s: General elections were held in American Samoa on November 7, 2000, to elect the Governor of American Samoa, members of the Fono and the congressional delegate. Incumbent governor, Tauese Sunia of the Democratic Party, was narrowly re-elected against Independent candidate Lealaifuaneva Peter Reid in a rematch of the previous election.

zh.s: 美属萨摩亚于2000年11月7日举行大选，选出州长、富努议会议员和联邦国会代表。时任民主党州长陶埃塞·苏尼亚以微弱优势击败独立候选人莱阿拉伊富阿内瓦·彼得·里德，成功连任。这是两人继上次选举后的再次交锋。

en.s: The 2000 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 7, 2000, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Missouri House of Representatives Matt Blunt defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent speaker of the Missouri House of Representatives Steve Gaw, Libertarian nominee Jane Spence Southard, Green nominee Paula Elias, Constitution nominee Donna L.

zh.s: 2000年密苏里州州务卿选举于11月7日举行。共和党候选人、时任密苏里州众议员马特·布朗特击败民主党候选人、时任州众议院议长史蒂夫·高，以及自由党候选人简·斯彭斯·索瑟德、绿党候选人宝拉·埃利亚斯、宪法党候选人唐娜·L·伊万诺维奇、改革党候选人马瓦琳·潘基和自然法党候选人洛伊丝·本格，当选州务卿。

en.t: 2000 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia
en.s: The 2000 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia took place on November 7, 2000, to elect a shadow member to the United States Senate to represent the District of Columbia. The member was only recognized by the District of Columbia and not officially sworn or seated by the United States Senate. Incumbent Shadow Senator Florence Pendleton won reelection to a third term with virtually no opposition.

zh.t: 2000年哥伦比亚特区影子联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2000年哥伦比亚特区影子联邦参议员选举于2000年11月7日举行，选出一名代表哥伦比亚特区的影子参议员。该职位仅获哥伦比亚特区承认，不会由美国联邦参议院正式宣誓就职或安排席位。时任影子参议员弗洛伦斯·彭德尔顿几乎没有遇到对手，成功连任第三届。

loc: 美国华盛顿哥伦比亚特区

en.t: 2000 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia took place on November 7, 2000, as part of the 2000 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. The District of Columbia voted by an extremely large margin in favor of the D.C. born, Democratic candidate Al Gore with 85.16% of the vote.

zh.t: 2000年美国总统选举哥伦比亚特区选情
zh.s: 2000年美国总统选举哥伦比亚特区投票于2000年11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名总统选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。哥伦比亚特区以极大的优势支持民主党候选人、出生于特区的阿尔·戈尔，得票率为85.16%。

en.t: 2000 United States House of Representatives elections in Missouri
en.s: The 2000 House elections in Missouri occurred on November 7, 2000 to elect the members of the State of Missouri's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Missouri had nine seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1990 United States census.

zh.t: 2000年密苏里州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2000年密苏里州联邦众议院选举于2000年11月7日举行，选出该州联邦众议院代表团成员。根据1990年美国人口普查，密苏里州有9个联邦众议院席位。

en.t: 2000 United States Shadow Representative election in the District of Columbia
en.s: On November 7, 2000, the District of Columbia held a U.S. House of Representatives election for its shadow representative. Unlike its non-voting delegate, the shadow representative is only recognized by the district and is not officially sworn or seated. One-term incumbent Tom Bryant declined to run for reelection and was succeeded by fellow Democrat Ray Browne.

zh.t: 2000年哥伦比亚特区影子联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2000年11月7日，哥伦比亚特区举行美国联邦众议院选举，选出该区影子众议员。与没有投票权的国会代表不同，影子众议员仅获特区承认，不会正式宣誓就职或获得席位。时任影子众议员汤姆·布莱恩特已任一届，他决定不竞选连任，由同为民主党人的雷·布朗接任。

en.t: 2000 United States House of Representatives elections in Kentucky
en.s: The 2000 United States House of Representatives elections in Kentucky were held on November 7, 2000, to elect the six U.S. representatives from the state of Kentucky, one from each of the state's six congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2000 U.S. presidential election, other elections to the House of Representatives, and other elections held in Kentucky. Primary elections were held on May 16, 2000.

zh.t: 2000年肯塔基州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2000年肯塔基州美国联邦众议院选举于2000年11月7日举行，选出该州6个国会选区各自的联邦众议员。选举与2000年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院选举以及肯塔基州的其他选举同时举行。初选于2000年5月16日举行。

en.s: An election was held on November 7, 2000 to elect all 100 members to Montana's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, Governor and State Senate. The primary election was held on June 6, 2000. Republicans retained control of the House despite a net loss of one seat, winning 58 seats compared to 42 seats for the Democrats.

zh.s: 2000年11月7日举行选举，改选蒙大拿州众议院全部100名议员。选举与其他公职选举同时举行，包括美国总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州长和州参议院选举。初选于2000年6月6日举行。共和党净失去1席，但仍保有众议院控制权，以58席对民主党的42席占多数。

en.s: The 2000 Arizona Senate election was held on November 7, 2000. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on September 12, 2000. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 16 seats over the Democrats' 14 seats.

zh.s: 2000年亚利桑那州参议院选举于2000年11月7日举行，选出该州30个州议会选区的州参议员，任期两年。初选于2000年9月12日举行。选举前，共和党以16席对民主党的14席占多数。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on November 7, 2000. Primaries were held on March 21, 2000.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于2000年11月7日举行选举，初选于同年3月21日举行。

en.t: 2000 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma
en.s: The 2000 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma were held on November 7, 2000, to elect the six U.S. representatives from the state of Oklahoma, one from each of the state's six congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2000 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2000年俄克拉何马州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2000年俄克拉何马州美国联邦众议院选举于2000年11月7日举行，选出该州6个国会选区各自的联邦众议员。选举与2000年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: Elections to state legislatures were held on November 7, 2000, simultaneously with the 2000 United States presidential election. Elections were held for 86 legislative chambers in 44 states, simultaneous to those states' gubernatorial elections. Election occurred in both chambers of each state's legislature, except for Alabama, Louisiana, Maryland, Mississippi, New Jersey, and Virginia. Michigan held elections for the lower house.

zh.s: 美国各州州议会选举于2000年11月7日举行，与2000年美国总统选举同时进行。44个州的86个议会院进行选举，并与这些州的州长选举同时举行。除阿拉巴马州、路易斯安那州、马里兰州、密西西比州、新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州外，各州州议会两院均举行了选举。密歇根州只改选州众议院。

en.s: The 2000 Utah gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 2000. Incumbent Republican Mike Leavitt won reelection to a third term.

zh.s: 2000年犹他州州长选举于2000年11月7日举行。时任共和党州长迈克·利维特成功连任第三届。

en.s: The 2000 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 2000. Democratic nominee Joe Maxwell defeated Republican nominee Wendell Bailey with 52.14% of the vote. As of 2025, this remains the last time a Democrat was elected Lieutenant Governor of Missouri.

zh.s: 2000年密苏里州副州长选举于2000年11月7日举行。民主党候选人乔·麦克斯韦以52.14%的得票率击败共和党候选人温德尔·贝利。截至2025年，这是密苏里州最后一次选出民主党副州长。

en.t: 2000 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Oregon was held on Tuesday, November 7, 2000, as part of the concurrent United States presidential election. Voters chose seven electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, to vote for the next president and vice president of the United States. The state of Oregon voted for Democrat Al Gore over Republican George W.

zh.s: 2000年俄勒冈州美国总统选举于11月7日星期二举行，是同期美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举美国总统和副总统。俄勒冈州选民投票支持民主党候选人阿尔·戈尔，胜过共和党候选人乔治·W·布什。

en.s: The 2000 North Carolina Senate election were held on November 7, 2000, to elect members to all fifty seats in the North Carolina Senate. The election coincided with the elections for other offices including the presidency, governorship, U.S. House of Representatives, Council of State, and state house. The primary election was held on May 2, 2000.

zh.t: 2000年北卡罗来纳州参议院选举
zh.s: 2000年北卡罗来纳州参议院选举于2000年11月7日举行，改选州参议院全部50个席位。选举与其他公职选举同时举行，包括总统、州长、联邦众议院、州务委员会和州众议院选举。初选于2000年5月2日举行。

en.s: The 2000 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 7, 2000, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee and former member of the Missouri House of Representatives Nancy Farmer defeated Republican nominee Todd Graves, Libertarian nominee Arnold J. Trembley, Green nominee Ray Vanlandingham, Reform nominee Terrence D. Frank, Constitution nominee Kerry Culligan and Natural Law nominee Marvin Carter.

zh.s: 2000年密苏里州州财政长选举于2000年11月7日举行，以选出该州财政长。民主党候选人、前密苏里州众议员南希·法默击败共和党候选人托德·格雷夫斯、自由党候选人阿诺德·J·特伦布莱、绿党候选人雷·范兰丁厄姆、改革党候选人特伦斯·D·弗兰克、宪法党候选人克里·卡利根和自然法党候选人马文·卡特。

en.t: 2000 United States House of Representatives elections in Tennessee
en.s: The 2000 congressional elections in Tennessee was held on November 7, 2000, to determine who will represent the state of Tennessee in the United States House of Representatives. Following the 2000 elections, no seats changed hands, leaving the Tennessee delegation at a 5-4 Republican majority.

zh.t: 2000年田纳西州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2000年田纳西州联邦众议院选举于2000年11月7日举行，决定谁将代表该州进入联邦众议院。选举后没有席位易手，田纳西州联邦众议院代表团仍由共和党以5席对4席占多数。

en.s: The 2000 Delaware lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 2000, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Delaware. Democratic nominee John Carney defeated Republican nominee Dennis J. Rochford.

zh.s: 2000年特拉华州副州长选举于2000年11月7日举行，以选出该州副州长。民主党候选人约翰·卡尼击败共和党候选人丹尼斯·J·罗奇福德。

en.s: The 2000 Delaware House of Representatives election was held on November 7, 2000, to elect all 41 members of Delaware's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, Governor, Lieutenant Governor, and state senate. The primary election was held on September 9, 2000.

zh.s: 2000年特拉华州众议院选举于2000年11月7日举行，选出州众议院全部41名议员。选举与其他公职选举同时举行，包括美国总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州长、副州长和州参议院选举。初选于2000年9月9日举行。

en.s: The 2000 Florida Education Commissioner special election, triggered by the resignation of Education Commissioner Tom Gallagher, took place on November 7, 2000, to elect the Education Commissioner of Florida for the remainder of Gallagher's term. The election was won by future Governor Charlie Crist, who took office on January 3, 2001.

zh.t: 2000年佛罗里达州教育专员特别选举
zh.s: 佛罗里达州教育专员汤姆·加拉格尔辞职后，触发了2000年佛罗里达州教育专员特别选举。选举于2000年11月7日举行，选出接替加拉格尔、完成其剩余任期的教育专员。未来的州长查理·克里斯特赢得选举，并于2001年1月3日就职。

en.t: 2000 West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals election
en.s: The 2000 West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals election took place on November 7, 2000, to elect two Justices of the Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia for the next 12 years. The electoral system requires voters to vote for no more than two candidates. Both Democratic candidates, former Justice Joseph Albright and incumbent Justice Robin Davis, were the top two vote-getters with 41.0% and 34.6% of the vote, respectively.

zh.t: 2000年西弗吉尼亚州最高上诉法院法官选举
zh.s: 2000年西弗吉尼亚州最高上诉法院法官选举于2000年11月7日举行，选出两名法官，任期12年。选举规则规定，选民最多只能投给两名候选人。两名民主党候选人、前法官约瑟夫·奥尔布赖特和时任法官罗宾·戴维斯得票最高，得票率分别为41.0%和34.6%。

en.t: 2000 North Carolina House of Representatives election
en.s: An election was held on November 7, 2000, to elect all 120 members to North Carolina's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including the Presidency, Governorship, U.S. House of Representatives, Council of State, and state senate. The primary election was held on May 2, 2000.

zh.t: 2000年北卡罗来纳州众议院选举
zh.s: 2000年11月7日举行选举，改选北卡罗来纳州众议院全部120名议员。选举与其他公职选举同时举行，包括总统、州长、联邦众议院、州务委员会和州参议院选举。初选于2000年5月2日举行。

en.s: The 2000 Delaware Senate election was held on November 7, 2000, to elect 11 of the 21 members to Delaware's Senate. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, Governor, Lieutenant Governor, and state house. The primary election was held on September 9, 2000.

zh.s: 2000年特拉华州参议院选举于2000年11月7日举行，改选州参议院21个席位中的11席。选举与其他公职选举同时举行，包括美国总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州长、副州长和州众议院选举。初选于2000年9月9日举行。

en.t: 2000 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 2000 United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 7, 2000, to elect U.S. Representatives to serve in the 107th United States Congress. They coincided with the election of George W. Bush as President of the United States. The Republican Party won 221 seats, while the Democratic Party won 212 and independents won two.

zh.s: 2000年美国联邦众议院选举于2000年11月7日举行，选出第107届国会的议员，与乔治·W·布什当选美国总统同时进行。共和党赢得221席，民主党赢得212席，独立人士赢得2席。

en.s: The 2000 Utah Attorney General election was held on November 7, 2000. Republican Mark Shurtleff, a member of the Salt Lake County Commission, was elected to his first term in office, defeating Reed M. Richards. As of 2024, this is the last time the position of attorney general changed partisan affiliation.

zh.s: 2000年犹他州总检察长选举于2000年11月7日举行。共和党人马克·舒特尔夫曾任盐湖县委员会委员，此次当选并开始首个任期，击败了里德·M·理查兹。截至2024年，这是该职位最后一次改变党派归属。

en.s: The 2000 Arizona House of Representatives election took place on Tuesday, November 7, 2000, with the primary election held on Tuesday, September 12, 2000. Arizona voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve two-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Arizona state elections, including U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and Arizona Senate.

zh.s: 2000年亚利桑那州众议院选举于2000年11月7日（星期二）举行，初选于同年9月12日（星期二）举行。亚利桑那州选民选出州众议院全部60名议员，任期两年，采用多议员选区。选举与美国全国选举和亚利桑那州选举同时进行，包括总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院和亚利桑那州参议院选举。

en.s: The 2000 Wyoming Senate election was held on November 7, 2000, to elect members to the Wyoming Senate for its 56th session as part of the 2000 United States elections. Partisan primaries were held on August 22. All even-numbered seats were up for election. Neither party made any gains in the chamber. Of the fifteen seats up for election, seven went to either party unopposed.

zh.s: 2000年怀俄明州参议院选举于2000年11月7日举行，选出该州第56届州议会的州参议员，是2000年美国选举的一部分。党派初选于8月22日举行。所有偶数编号席位均进行改选。两党在州参议院都没有增加席位。改选的15个席位中，有7个席位的候选人无人竞争，来自两党。

en.s: Elections for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives were held on November 7, 2000, with all districts being contested. State Representatives are elected for two-year terms, with the entire House of Representatives up for a vote every two years. The term of office for those elected in 2000 ran from January 3, 2001, until November 30, 2002. Necessary primary elections were held on April 4, 2000.

zh.t: 2000年宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举于2000年11月7日举行，所有选区均有候选人参选。州众议员任期两年，每两年改选众议院全部席位。2000年当选议员的任期从2001年1月3日持续至2002年11月30日。初选于2000年4月4日举行。

en.s: The 2000 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 7, 2000, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general Jay Nixon defeated Republican nominee Sam Jones and Libertarian nominee Mitchell J. Moore.

zh.s: 2000年密苏里州总检察长选举于2000年11月7日举行，以选出该州总检察长。民主党候选人、时任总检察长杰伊·尼克松击败共和党候选人萨姆·琼斯和自由党候选人米切尔·J·摩尔。

en.t: 2000 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 7, 2000, and was part of the 2000 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island voted for the Democratic Party's candidate, then Vice President Al Gore of Tennessee, over the Republican Party's candidate, Governor George W.

zh.s: 2000年罗得岛州美国总统选举于11月7日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。罗得岛州选民支持民主党候选人、时任副总统阿尔·戈尔；他击败了共和党候选人、得克萨斯州州长乔治·W·布什。

en.t: 2000 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 7, 2000, as part of the 2000 United States presidential election. Voters chose eleven electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Prior to the election, Missouri was widely considered to be a critical swing state. Governor of Texas George W.

zh.s: 2000年密苏里州美国总统选举于11月7日举行。选民选出11名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。选举前，密苏里州普遍被视为关键摇摆州。最终，得克萨斯州州长乔治·W·布什以略高于3个百分点的优势击败时任副总统阿尔·戈尔，赢得该州。

en.t: 2000 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 2000 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 7, 2000, and was part of the 2000 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Georgia was won by Governor George W. Bush (R-TX) by an 11.7% margin of victory. He won a majority of the popular vote, counties, and congressional districts.

zh.t: 2000年美国总统选举佐治亚州投票
zh.s: 2000年11月7日，作为全美总统选举的一部分，佐治亚州举行总统选举投票。选民选出13名代表，也就是选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、得克萨斯州州长乔治·W·布什在佐治亚州以11.7%的优势获胜，并赢得普选票、县和国会选区的多数。

en.s: The 2000 Washington Secretary of State election took place on November 7, 2000. Republican Sam Reed was elected to succeed retiring incumbent Ralph Munro.

zh.s: 2000年11月7日，华盛顿州举行州务卿选举。共和党人萨姆·里德当选，接替退休的时任州务卿拉尔夫·芒罗。

en.s: The 2000 New Castle County Executive election was held on November 7, 2000. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Thomas P. Gordon, who was first elected in 1996, ran for re-election to a second term. He faced no challengers in the primary, and no Republicans ran against him. Gordon's only opponent was Green Party nominee Craig Shumaker, a research engineer.

zh.s: 2000年11月7日，新堡县举行行政长官选举。民主党籍现任行政长官托马斯·P·戈登于1996年首次当选，此次竞选连任第二个任期。他在初选中没有对手，也没有共和党人参选。他的唯一对手是绿党候选人克雷格·舒梅克，一名研究工程师。

en.s: The 2000 Salt Lake County Council election was held on Tuesday, November 7, 2000, to elect the first members of the newly formed Salt Lake County Council. The election coincided with other elections, such as county mayor, presidential and governor.

zh.s: 2000年11月7日，星期二，盐湖县举行选举，选出新成立的盐湖县议会首批成员。本次选举与县长、总统和州长等选举同期举行。

en.s: The 2000 Salt Lake County mayoral election was the first election held to elect the first Mayor of Salt Lake County, Utah on November 7, 2000, alongside the presidential, House of Representatives, Senate and gubernatorial elections.

zh.s: 2000年11月7日，犹他州盐湖县举行首次县长选举，选出该县首任县长。本次选举与总统、联邦众议院、联邦参议院和州长选举同期举行。

en.t: 2000 San Francisco Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2000 San Francisco Board of Supervisors elections occurred on November 7, 2000, with a runoff election held on December 12, 2000. All eleven seats were contested. Elections to odd-numbered districts were to four-year terms, while elections to even-numbered districts were to transitional two-year terms, then four-year terms thereafter. This election was the first following the reintroduction of electoral districts for the Board of Supervisors in 2000; previously, except for a short period of time, supervisors were elected at-large.

zh.s: 2000年11月7日，旧金山监事会举行选举，全部11个席位均有竞争，并于12月12日举行决选。奇数选区的监事任期为四年；偶数选区当选者先任过渡性的两年，之后任期为四年。2000年重新设立监事会选区后的首次选举就是本次选举。此前除一段短暂时期外，监事均由全市选民选举产生。

en.s: The 2000 Baton Rouge mayoral election was held on October 7 and November 7, 2000, to elect the mayor-president of Baton Rouge, Louisiana. It saw the election of Bobby Ray Simpson. This was the last time a Republican was elected mayor-president until 2024.

zh.s: 2000年10月7日和11月7日，路易斯安那州巴吞鲁日举行市长兼县行政长官选举。鲍比·雷·辛普森当选。这是共和党人最后一次当选巴吞鲁日市长兼县行政长官；该党直到2024年才再次胜出。

en.s: The 2000 Washington Attorney General election, took place on November 7, 2000. Incumbent attorney general and future governor, Christine Gregoire, was re-elected by a wide margin in a victory over Republican and perennial candidate Richard Pope.

zh.s: 2000年11月7日，华盛顿州举行总检察长选举。时任总检察长、后来出任州长的克里斯汀·格雷瓜尔大幅领先共和党候选人、屡次参选的理查德·波普，成功连任。

en.t: 2000 United States House of Representatives elections in New York
en.s: The 2000 United States House of Representatives elections in New York were held on November 7, 2000, to elect the 31 United States representatives from the State of New York, one from each of the state's 31 congressional districts. The elections were held concurrently with other elections in the state for president and vice president, U.S. Senate, state senate, state assembly, state supreme court, ballot proposition one, and various other local offices.

zh.s: 2000年11月7日，纽约州举行联邦众议院选举，改选该州31个国会选区的31名联邦众议员。本次选举与该州的总统和副总统、联邦参议院、州参议院、州众议院、州最高法院、第一号公投提案及其他地方职位选举同期举行。

en.s: The 2000 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 2000. Incumbent Democratic governor Gary Locke defeated the Republican candidate John Carlson for his second term in a landslide. As of 2024, this was the earliest gubernatorial election in Washington in which both candidates are currently still living. This is the last time a Democratic nominee for governor outperformed the Democratic nominee for president in Washington.

zh.s: 2000年11月7日，华盛顿州举行州长选举。民主党籍现任州长骆家辉以压倒性优势击败共和党候选人约翰·卡尔森，赢得第二个任期。截至2024年，这是华盛顿州最早一场两名候选人目前都仍在世的州长选举。这也是民主党州长候选人最后一次在华盛顿州的得票表现超过民主党总统候选人。

en.s: The 2000 United States Senate elections were held on November 7, 2000. The elections coincided with other federal and state elections, including the presidential election which was won by Republican George W. Bush. These elections took place 6 years after Republicans had won a net gain of eight seats in Senate Class 1. Despite George W.

zh.s: 2000年美国参议院选举于11月7日举行，与其他联邦和州选举同期进行，包括由共和党人乔治·W·布什获胜的总统选举。此次选举距共和党在1994年参议院第一类席位选举中净增8席已过去6年。尽管布什赢得总统选举，共和党仍失去4个参议院席位；这是自1913年第十七修正案通过以来，总统获胜政党在参议院选举中损失最多的一次。民主党击败特拉华州、密歇根州、明尼苏达州、密苏里州和华盛顿州的共和党现任参议员，并赢得佛罗里达州的共和党空缺席位；共和党则在弗吉尼亚州击败民主党现任参议员查克·罗布，并赢得内华达州空缺席位。乔治亚州共和党参议员保罗·科弗戴尔当年早些时候去世，由民主党籍临时任命参议员泽尔·米勒接替；米勒随后赢得特别选举。选后两党各有50席，副总统投下打破平局的一票。这是继1880年后第二次出现参议院两党席位平分。新一届国会于2001年1月3日开会后，副总统阿尔·戈尔仍兼任参议院议长，因此民主党短暂掌控参议院17天；1月20日副总统迪克·切尼就职后，共和党重新取得多数。

en.s: The 2000 San Diego mayoral election was held on Tuesday, November 7, 2000, to elect the mayor of San Diego. Incumbent mayor Susan Golding was ineligible to run for reelection due to term limits. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, though some candidates do receive funding and support from various political parties. The non-partisan primary was held Tuesday, March 7, 2000.

zh.s: 2000年11月7日，圣迭戈举行市长选举。受任期限制，时任市长苏珊·戈尔丁不能竞选连任。加利福尼亚州的市政选举在法律上不设党派，但部分候选人会获得政党的资金和支持。无党派初选于2000年3月7日星期二举行。

en.t: 2000 United States Senate special election in Georgia
en.s: The 2000 United States Senate special election in Georgia was held on November 7, 2000. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Zell Miller, who was appointed by Governor Roy Barnes to replace the deceased Paul Coverdell, overwhelmingly won election to serve the remainder of the term. Miller defeated Republican Mack Mattingly, a former U.S. Senator in a landslide of over 20 points, carrying 149 of the state's 159 counties.

zh.t: 2000年美国联邦参议院佐治亚州特别选举
zh.s: 2000年11月7日，佐治亚州举行联邦参议院特别选举。民主党籍现任参议员泽尔·米勒由州长罗伊·巴恩斯任命，接替去世的保罗·科弗戴尔；此次选举中，他以压倒性优势获胜，完成剩余任期。米勒以超过20个百分点的差距大胜前联邦参议员、共和党人麦克·马特林利，并赢得佐治亚州159个县中的149个。

en.s: The 2000 Summit County, Ohio Executive election was held on November 7, 2000. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Tim Davis, who was under federal investigation over bribery allegations, declined to seek re-election to a fourth term. Two candidates ran to succeed him in the Democratic primary: County Auditor James McCarthy and former Akron City Councilman Warner Mendenhall.

zh.t: 2000年俄亥俄州萨米特县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2000年11月7日，俄亥俄州萨米特县举行行政长官选举。民主党籍现任县行政长官蒂姆·戴维斯因涉嫌受贿而接受联邦调查，他决定不再竞选第四个任期。民主党初选中有两名继任候选人：县审计长詹姆斯·麦卡锡和前阿克伦市议员沃纳·门德尔霍尔。

en.s: The 2000 Oakland County Executive election was held on November 7, 2000. Incumbent County Executive L. Brooks Patterson ran for re-election to a third term. He won the Republican primary uncontested and faced Gary Kohut, the Chairman of the county Democratic Party, in the general election. Patterson won the election in a landslide, receiving 59 percent of the vote to Kohut's 38 percent and Libertarian Paul Champion's 3 percent.

zh.s: 2000年11月7日，奥克兰县举行行政长官选举。时任县行政长官L·布鲁克斯·帕特森竞选第三个任期。他在共和党初选中无人竞争，并在普选中对阵县民主党主席加里·科胡特。帕特森以压倒性优势获胜，得票率为59%；科胡特获得38%，自由意志党候选人保罗·钱皮恩获得3%。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election was held on November 7, 2000. Primaries were held March 21, 2000. Elections were held for Clerk of the Circuit Court, Recorder of Deeds, State's Attorney, four seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships on the Circuit Court of Cook County.

zh.s: 2000年11月7日，伊利诺伊州库克县举行普选，初选于同年3月21日举行。本次选举涉及巡回法院书记官、契据登记官、州检察官、水资源回收区委员会的四个席位，以及库克县巡回法院法官职位。

en.t: 2000 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 2000 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 7, 2000. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Slade Gorton was seeking reelection to a third consecutive term, and a fourth overall, but he was unseated for a second time by a very narrow margin (the first time being in 1986) by former Congresswoman Maria Cantwell. The race was the most expensive contest in the state's history at the time.

zh.t: 2000年美国联邦参议院华盛顿州选举
zh.s: 2000年11月7日，华盛顿州举行联邦参议院选举。共和党籍现任参议员斯莱德·戈顿竞选连续第三个任期、总计第四个任期，但以微弱差距败给前联邦众议员玛丽亚·坎特韦尔。这是戈顿继1986年后再次落选。此次选战当时是该州历史上花费最高的竞选。

en.s: The 2000 Texas House of Representatives elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state representatives in all 150 State House of Representatives districts. The winners of this election served in the 77th Texas Legislature. State representatives serve for two-year terms. There was no net change in seat control, leaving Democrats with their majority of 78 out of 150 seats.

zh.s: 2000年得克萨斯州众议院选举是美国两年一度选举的一部分。得克萨斯州选民改选州众议院全部150个选区的议员，当选者组成第77届得克萨斯州议会。州众议员任期两年。本次选举后席位控制没有变化，民主党仍以78席对72席占多数。

en.s: The 2000 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 2000 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in half of the state senate's districts—the 25 even-numbered state senate districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate, with half of the seats up for election each cycle. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the year 2000 is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 2000年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是该州2000年两年一度选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民改选州参议院50个选区中的一半，即25个偶数编号选区的议员。州参议员任期四年，每轮选举改选一半席位。艾奥瓦州议会提供了2000年全州50个州参议院选区的地图。

en.t: Mayoral elections in Santa Ana, California
en.s: Elections are currently held every two years to elect the mayor of Santa Ana, California.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州圣安娜市每两年举行一次市长选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2000 New Mexico Senate election took place as part of the biennial United States elections. New Mexico voters elected state senators in all 42 of the state senate's districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the New Mexico Senate. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including U.S. president, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and state house.

zh.s: 2000年新墨西哥州参议院选举是美国两年一度选举的一部分。新墨西哥州选民改选州参议院全部42个选区的议员。州参议员任期四年。本次选举与其他职位选举同期举行，包括美国总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州众议院选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2000 Texas Senate elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state senators in 15 State Senate districts. All of the seats up for this election were for two-year terms, with senators up for re-election in the 2002 elections. State senators typically serve four-year terms in the Texas State Senate, but all Senators come up for election in the cycles following each decennial redistricting.

It does not cast direct electoral votes for president and vice president. Texas Governor George W.

zh.t: 2000年关岛美国总统非约束性民调
zh.s: 2000年关岛美国总统非约束性民调于11月7日举行。关岛是属地而非美国州，因此没有资格选出选举人团成员；它会在总统大选期间举行不具约束力的总统民意调查，不直接投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、得克萨斯州州长乔治·W·布什击败民主党候选人、副总统阿尔·戈尔，得票率超过51%。

en.s: The 2003 United States state legislative elections were held on November 7, 2003, alongside other elections. Elections were held for 8 legislative chambers in four states. Both chambers of the Northern Mariana Islands legislature were up. Partisan change only occurred in one chamber, as Democrats won control of the New Jersey Senate, which was previously tied.

zh.s: 2003年11月7日，美国举行州议会选举，并与其他选举同时进行。4个州的8个州议会院举行了选举。北马里亚纳群岛议会两院席位均改选。只有一个议会院发生党派控制权变化：民主党赢得新泽西州参议院，此前该院席位两党持平。

en.s: The 2005 New Jersey General Assembly elections were held on November 7, 2003, for all 80 seats in the lower house of the New Jersey Legislature. The election was held during Democratic Governor Jim McGreevey's term. Democrats held a 44-36 majority in the lower house prior to the election. The members of the New Jersey Legislature are chosen from 40 electoral districts.

zh.s: 新泽西州州议会下院全部80个席位于2003年11月7日举行选举。选举期间，州长为民主党人吉姆·麦格里维。选举前，民主党在下院以44席对36席占多数。新泽西州议会成员从40个选区中选出。

en.s: The 2003 Durham mayoral election was held on November 7, 2003, to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Bill Bell.

zh.s: 2003年11月7日，北卡罗来纳州达勒姆举行市长选举。时任市长比尔·贝尔连任。

en.s: The 2004 Scottish Challenge Cup final, also known as the Bell's Cup final for sponsorship reasons, was an association football match between Falkirk and Ross County on 7 November 2004 at McDiarmid Park in Perth. It was the 14th final of the Scottish Challenge Cup since it was first organised in 1990 to celebrate the centenary of the Scottish Football League.

zh.s: 2004年11月7日，福尔柯克队与罗斯郡队在珀斯的麦克迪尔米德公园球场举行2004年苏格兰挑战杯决赛。该赛事因赞助原因也称贝尔杯决赛。这是苏格兰挑战杯自1990年创办以来的第14届决赛；赛事创办是为庆祝苏格兰足球联赛成立100周年。

en.s: The 2004 Victory Road was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA), which took place on November 7, 2004, at the TNA Impact! Zone in Orlando, Florida. It was the first event under the Victory Road chronology, which became an annual event in 2006. Nine matches were featured on the event's card.

zh.s: 2004年11月7日，全面不间断动作摔角联盟（TNA）在佛罗里达州奥兰多的TNA Impact! Zone场馆举办《胜利之路》职业摔角付费收看赛事。这是该系列的首场赛事；该赛事系列于2006年起成为年度赛事。本场共安排九场比赛。

en.s: The 2004 Norwegian Football Cup final was the final match of the 2004 Norwegian Football Cup, the 99th season of the Norwegian Football Cup, the premier Norwegian football cup competition organized by the Football Association of Norway (NFF). The match was played on 7 November 2004 at the Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo, and opposed two Tippeligaen sides Brann and Lyn.

zh.s: 2004年11月7日，布兰队与林队在奥斯陆乌勒瓦尔球场举行2004年挪威足球杯决赛。这是第99届挪威足球杯的决赛，该赛事是由挪威足球协会组织的挪威顶级杯赛。

en.s: In 2004, an armed conflict took place between French and Côte d'Ivoire forces. On 6 November 2004, two Ivorian Air force Su-25 attack fighters launched an air attack on French peacekeepers in the northern part of Côte d'Ivoire who were stationed there as part of Opération Licorne (Unicorn), the French military operation in support of the United Nations Operation in Côte d'Ivoire (UNOCI).

zh.s: 2004年，法国军队与科特迪瓦军队发生武装冲突。11月6日，科特迪瓦空军两架苏-25攻击机空袭了驻扎在该国北部的法国维和人员；这些部队参加了法国支持联合国科特迪瓦行动的独角兽行动。

en.s: The 2006 Iowa Senate election was held on November 7, 2006. The Senate seats for the twenty-five odd-numbered districts were up for election. Senate terms are staggered such that half the membership is elected every two years. Senators serve four-year terms. Prior to the election, the Senate was evenly divided between Republicans and Democrats. Following the election, the Democrats were in the majority - this marked the first time in 42 years that the Democrats had controlled both branches of the Iowa General Assembly and the Governor's Office.

zh.s: 2006年爱荷华州参议院选举于11月7日举行，改选第25、27等奇数编号选区的席位。州参议员任期四年，每两年改选一半席位。选举前，参议院由共和党和民主党平分。选举后民主党成为多数党，这是42年来民主党首次同时控制爱荷华州议会两院和州长职位。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Wisconsin, 2006
en.s: The 2006 congressional elections in Wisconsin were held on November 7, 2006 to determine who would represent the state of Wisconsin in the United States House of Representatives. Representatives were elected for two-year terms; those elected served in the 110th Congress from January 3, 2007 until January 3, 2009. The election coincided with the 2006 U.S. senatorial election and the 2006 Wisconsin gubernatorial election. Wisconsin has eight seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. Its 2006-2007 congressional delegation consisted of four Democrats and four Republicans.

zh.t: 2006年威斯康星州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2006年威斯康星州联邦众议院选举于11月7日举行，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。众议员任期两年，当选者于2007年1月3日至2009年1月3日在第110届国会任职。此次选举与2006年美国参议院选举和威斯康星州州长选举同时举行。根据2000年美国人口普查，威斯康星州有8个众议院席位。该州2006至2007年的联邦众议员代表团由4名民主党人和4名共和党人组成。

en.s: The 2006 San Diego City Council election occurred on November 7, 2006. The primary election was held on June 6, 2006. Four of the eight seats of the San Diego City Council were contested. All four incumbent council members stood for reelection. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, although most candidates do identify a party preference. A two-round system was used for the election, starting with a primary in June followed by a runoff in November between the top-two candidates if no candidate received a majority of the votes in the first round.

zh.s: 2006年圣迭戈市议会选举于11月7日举行，初选则于同年6月6日举行。市议会八个席位中有四席改选，四名现任议员均参加连任。加利福尼亚州的市政选举在法律上不设党派标签，不过大多数候选人会表明自己的党派倾向。选举采用两轮制：6月举行初选；若无人获得过半选票，得票最高的两名候选人将在11月角逐。不过，四名现任议员都在6月初选中获得过半选票，因此11月没有举行市议会决选。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in New Hampshire, 2006
en.s: The 2006 House of Representatives elections in New Hampshire took place on November 7, 2006 to determine who would represent the state of New Hampshire in the United States House of Representatives during the 110th Congress from January 3, 2007 until January 3, 2009. New Hampshire had historically been a stronghold of the Republican Party. Both congressional seats were held by Republicans going into the election, in addition to most state and local offices. However, New Hampshire gave its four electoral votes to John Kerry in 2004 and to Bill Clinton in 1992 and 1996.

zh.t: 2006年新罕布什尔州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2006年新罕布什尔州联邦众议院选举于11月7日举行，选出代表该州进入第110届国会的众议员，任期为2007年1月3日至2009年1月3日。新罕布什尔州历来是共和党的稳固票仓，选举前，该州两个联邦众议院席位都由共和党人占据，多数州和地方公职也由共和党人担任。不过，该州在2004年总统选举中将4张选举人票投给了约翰·克里，1992和1996年则支持比尔·克林顿。

en.s: The 2006 Minnesota House of Representatives election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 7, 2006, to elect members to the House of Representatives of the 85th Minnesota Legislature. A primary election was held in several districts on September 12, 2006. The Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL) won a majority of seats, defeating the Republican Party of Minnesota, which had a majority since defeating the DFL in the 1998 election. The new Legislature convened on January 3, 2007.

zh.s: 2006年明尼苏达州众议院选举于11月7日举行，选出第85届明尼苏达州议会的众议员。部分选区于2006年9月12日举行初选。明尼苏达州民主—农民—劳工党赢得多数席位，击败了自1998年战胜该党后一直占多数的明尼苏达州共和党。新一届州议会于2007年1月3日召开。

en.t: United States Senate election in Missouri, 2006
en.s: The 2006 United States Senate election in Missouri was held on November 7, 2006, to decide who would serve as senator for Missouri between January 3, 2007, and January 3, 2013. The incumbent was Republican Jim Talent. Talent was elected in a special election in 2002 when he narrowly defeated incumbent Democrat Jean Carnahan. Carnahan had been appointed to the Senate seat following the posthumous election of her husband Mel Carnahan, who had died in a plane crash shortly before the 2000 election. Talent's Democratic opponent was Missouri State Auditor Claire McCaskill.

zh.t: 2006年密苏里州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2006年密苏里州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行，选出2007年1月3日至2013年1月3日期间担任该州参议员的人选。共和党籍现任参议员吉姆·塔伦特于2002年特别选举中当选，当时他以微弱优势击败了民主党籍现任参议员珍·卡纳汉。此前，珍的丈夫梅尔·卡纳汉在2000年选举前不久因飞机失事去世，但仍在身后当选参议员，珍随后获任命填补席位。塔伦特的民主党对手是密苏里州审计长克莱尔·麦卡斯基尔。

en.s: The Massachusetts gubernatorial election of 2006 was held on November 7, 2006. Former US Assistant Attorney General Deval Patrick was elected to a four-year term, from January 4, 2007 until January 6, 2011. In his first elected office, Patrick is the second African-American governor in the United States since Reconstruction. Every four years, Massachusetts holds elections for Governor and Lieutenant Governor, as part of the general statewide election. The Primary election was September 19, 2006. One-term Republican governor Mitt Romney did not seek re-election; his term ended January 4, 2007.

zh.s: 2006年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月7日举行。前美国助理司法部长德瓦尔·帕特里克当选，任期四年，从2007年1月4日至2011年1月6日。这是帕特里克首次当选公职；他是重建时期以来美国第二位非裔州长。马萨诸塞州每四年举行一次州长和副州长选举，并与全州大选同时进行。该届初选于2006年9月19日举行。共和党籍州长米特·罗姆尼只任一届，未寻求连任，任期于2007年1月4日结束。

en.t: United States Senate election in New Jersey, 2006
en.s: The 2006 United States Senate election in New Jersey was held on November 7, 2006. Incumbent Democrat U.S. Senator Bob Menendez was elected to represent New Jersey in the United States Senate for a six-year term which ended in January 2013. The seat was previously held by Democratic Governor of New Jersey Jon Corzine. After he stepped down from his Senate seat and was sworn in Governor, Corzine appointed Rep. Menendez, who was sworn in on January 18, 2006. Menendez was challenged by Republican Thomas Kean, Jr. and seven other candidates. Filing for the primary closed on April 10, 2006.

zh.t: 2006年新泽西州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2006年新泽西州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。民主党籍现任参议员鲍勃·梅嫩德斯当选，代表新泽西州在联邦参议院任职六年，任期于2013年1月结束。该席位此前由民主党籍新泽西州州长乔恩·科尔津担任。科尔津辞去参议员职务并宣誓就任州长后，任命众议员梅嫩德斯接替自己；梅嫩德斯于2006年1月18日宣誓就职。他的对手是共和党候选人托马斯·基恩二世和另外7名候选人。初选候选人登记于2006年4月10日截止。

en.s: The Connecticut Senate election, 2006 was held on November 7, 2006 to elect Senators to the Connecticut State Senate for the term which began in January 2007 and ended in January 2009. It occurred on the same date as other federal and state elections, including the state's gubernatorial election. The election saw the election or re-election of 24 Democrats and 12 Republicans to fill the Senate's 36 seats. The incumbent party in each district held onto control of their respective seats in the election, except for two seats which changed control – one from Democratic to Republican, and one from Republican to Democratic.

zh.s: 2006年康涅狄格州参议院选举于11月7日举行，选出康涅狄格州参议员，任期从2007年1月至2009年1月。此次选举与州长选举等联邦和州选举同日举行。在参议院36个席位中，民主党赢得或连任24席，共和党赢得或连任12席。除两个席位易主外，各选区现任政党的控制权都得以保留；易主席位中，一个从民主党转到共和党，另一个从共和党转到民主党。

en.s: The 2006 Florida gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 2006. Governor Jeb Bush was term-limited, and could not run for re-election. Republican Charlie Crist, the state's Attorney General, won the election. The election was notable in that for the first time, the state elected a Republican governor in three consecutive elections. Turnout for the 2006 election was down 8.5% from 2002 and down 2.7% from 1998. With Republicans holding the seat, the state avoided the wave in which Democrats netted a gain of six governorships across the nation.

zh.s: 2006年佛罗里达州州长选举于11月7日举行。州长杰布·布什受任期限制，不能竞选连任。共和党候选人、州检察长查理·克里斯特赢得选举。佛罗里达州首次连续三届选出共和党州长。2006年投票率比2002年低8.5%，比1998年低2.7%。共和党保住州长职位，佛罗里达州也避开了民主党在全国范围内净增6个州长职位的选举浪潮。

en.t: United States Senate election in Tennessee, 2006
en.s: The 2006 United States Senate election in Tennessee was held on November 7, 2006. The election winner, Bob Corker, served his term between January 3, 2007 and January 3, 2013. Corker replaced Republican Bill Frist in the Senate, who retired upon the end of his second term in 2007. Corker was the Republican nominee, and the Democratic nominee was Harold Ford, Jr.. The race between Ford and Corker was one of the most competitive Senate races of 2006, with Corker winning the race by less than three percent of the vote. Corker was the only non-incumbent Republican to win a U.S.

zh.t: 2006年田纳西州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2006年田纳西州美国参议院选举于11月7日举行。共和党现任参议员、参议院多数党领袖比尔·弗里斯特任满两届后退休，空出的席位由共和党候选人鲍勃·科克赢得；他击败了民主党候选人哈罗德·福特二世。科克与福特之间的竞争是2006年最激烈的参议院选战之一，科克以不到3个百分点的优势获胜。科克是2006年唯一赢得联邦参议院席位的非现任共和党候选人。自1995年以来，共和党一直占有田纳西州两个联邦参议院席位。

en.s: The Maine gubernatorial election of 2006 took place on November 7, 2006. Incumbent Democrat John Baldacci was re-elected to his second term. In the general election, Baldacci, Woodcock, Green Independent Party candidate Pat LaMarche, and independents Barbara Merrill and Phillip Morris Napier appeared on the ballot. Woodcock never gained trust among the state's moderates and independents due to his socially conservative positions on a variety of issues. Woodcock struggled to focus on his plans for taxes and the economy such as combining the positions of registered nurse and dental hygienist, and imposing punitive "tax flourishes" upon small business owners, which Republicans believed would resonate harder with voters.

zh.s: 2006年缅因州州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党籍现任州长约翰·巴尔达奇赢得第二个任期。大选选票上有巴尔达奇、伍德科克、绿党独立候选人帕特·拉马什，以及独立候选人芭芭拉·梅里尔和菲利普·莫里斯·内皮尔。伍德科克在社会议题上的保守立场使他难以获得该州温和派和独立选民的信任。他也难以集中阐述自己的税收和经济计划，例如合并注册护士与牙科卫生师的职位，以及对小企业加征惩罚性“税收花招”；共和党人认为这类主张会更能引起选民共鸣。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in New York, 2006
en.s: On November 7, 2006, New York, along with the rest of the country held elections for the United States House of Representatives. Democrats picked up 3 House seats, the 19th, the 20th, and the 24th. In federal elections, the Empire State has consistently handed its vote to Democratic candidates. Of New York's twenty-nine congressional districts, all but ten are centered on heavily liberal and Democratic New York City and its surrounding suburbs, including Long Island and Westchester County. In addition, Democrats were also predicting easy victories in the double digits for its gubernatorial candidate, New York State Attorney General Eliot Spitzer, and Senator Hillary Clinton.

zh.s: 2006年11月7日，纽约州与全国其他地区同时举行联邦众议院选举。民主党赢得3个席位：第19、第20和第24选区。纽约州在联邦选举中一贯支持民主党候选人。该州29个国会选区中，除10个以外，其余都集中在纽约市及周边的自由派和民主党票仓，包括长岛和韦斯特切斯特县。此外，民主党人还预计，其州长候选人、纽约州检察长埃利奥特·斯皮策和参议员希拉里·克林顿都将以两位数优势轻松获胜。

en.s: The 2006 Elections for the Pennsylvania State Senate were held on November 7, 2006, with even-numbered districts being contested. Necessary primary elections were held on May 16, 2006. State Senators are elected for four-year terms, with half of the Senate seats up for a vote every two years. Members elected in 2006 were inaugurated on January 2, 2007. The Senate elections saw no seats change parties, with the Republicans holding onto an eight-seat majority. Senate Republican floor leader, David J. Brightbill, was defeated for in the primary election by tire salesman Mike Folmer. President pro tempore Robert C.

zh.t: 2006年宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 2006年宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举于11月7日举行，偶数编号选区进行改选。初选于同年5月16日举行。州参议员任期四年，每两年改选半数席位。2006年当选的议员于2007年1月2日就职。选举后两党席位没有变化，共和党继续保持八席多数。共和党参议院党团领袖戴维·J·布赖特比尔在初选中败给轮胎销售员迈克·福尔默。参议院临时议长罗伯特·C·朱贝利尔也在共和党初选中落败。

en.s: The Wisconsin gubernatorial election of 2006 was held on November 7, 2006. Incumbent Democratic Governor of Wisconsin Jim Doyle ran for a second term as governor. Doyle was unopposed in his party's primary, and he faced United States Representative Mark Green, who won the Republican Party primary unopposed, in the general election. The campaign between Doyle and Green was competitive and hotly contested, but Doyle, whose approval ratings hovered around 50%, had the upper hand. In the end, Doyle defeated Green by a fairly comfortable margin, improving on his 2002 victory in the process.

zh.s: 2006年威斯康星州州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党籍现任州长吉姆·道尔竞选第二个任期。他在民主党初选中没有对手；共和党候选人、联邦众议员马克·格林也在无人竞争的初选中胜出。道尔与格林的竞选竞争激烈。道尔的支持率一直在50%左右，占据上风，最终以相当明显的优势击败格林，得票表现也好于2002年。

en.t: United States Senate election in Rhode Island, 2006
en.s: The 2006 United States Senate election in Rhode Island was held on November 7, 2006. The election was won by Sheldon Whitehouse whose term in the United States Senate ran from January 3, 2007, to January 3, 2013. He was reelected in 2012 and will serve until January 3, 2019.Republican Lincoln Chafee was seeking re-election to the seat he had held since 1999, when he was appointed to fill the vacancy created by the death of his father John Chafee. Lincoln Chafee won election to the seat in 2000.

zh.t: 2006年罗得岛州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2006年罗得岛州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行，民主党候选人谢尔登·怀特豪斯获胜，任期从2007年1月3日至2013年1月3日。他于2012年连任，原定任职至2019年1月3日。共和党籍参议员林肯·查菲寻求连任。他自1999年以来一直担任该席位，当年他获任命填补其父约翰·查菲去世后留下的空缺。林肯·查菲于2000年当选该席位。

en.t: United States Senate election in Vermont, 2006
en.s: The 2006 United States Senate election in Vermont was held on November 7, 2006. Incumbent independent Senator Jim Jeffords decided to retire rather than seek re-election to a fourth term in office and Bernie Sanders was elected to succeed him. Sanders represented Vermont's at-large House district as an independent, won the Democratic primary and then dropped out to run as an independent. Many Democratic politicians across the country endorsed Sanders, and no Democrat was on the ballot. The state committee of the Vermont Democratic Party voted unanimously to endorse Sanders. Sanders won the open seat with 65% of the vote.

zh.t: 2006年佛蒙特州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2006年佛蒙特州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。独立派现任参议员吉姆·杰福兹决定退休，不再竞选第四个任期，伯尼·桑德斯当选接替他。桑德斯以独立人士身份代表佛蒙特州不分区众议院选区；他赢得民主党初选后退出，改以独立候选人身份参选。全美许多民主党政治人物为桑德斯背书，选票上没有民主党候选人。佛蒙特州民主党委员会一致投票支持桑德斯。他以65%的选票赢得空缺席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2006 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 2006. Incumbent Tim Pawlenty was endorsed by the state Republican convention on June 2, 2006, while the state Democratic–Farmer–Labor convention endorsed Mike Hatch on June 10, 2006. The statewide party primaries took place on September 12, 2006, with Hatch defeating DFL challengers Becky Lourey and Ole Savior and incumbent Pawlenty defeating Sue Jeffers. In the November 7 general election Pawlenty received a plurality of the votes, defeating Hatch by a margin of one percent.

zh.s: 2006年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月7日举行。共和党州代表大会于2006年6月2日支持现任州长蒂姆·波伦蒂；州民主—农民—劳工党代表大会于6月10日支持迈克·哈奇。全州政党初选于9月12日举行，哈奇击败该党挑战者贝基·卢里和奥勒·萨维尔，波伦蒂击败苏·杰弗斯。在11月7日大选中，波伦蒂获得最多选票，以1个百分点的优势击败哈奇。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2006 Maryland Attorney General election was held on November 7, 2006. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General of Maryland J. Joseph Curran declined to seek a sixth term in office, prompted by the fact that his son-in-law, Martin O'Malley was running for Governor and wanted to avoid a conflict of interest. Montgomery County State's Attorney Doug Gansler won the Democratic primary to succeed Curran and faced off against Scott Rolle, the Frederick County State's Attorney who was unopposed in the Republican primary. Ultimately, Gansler crushed Rolle in a landslide and became the Attorney General of Maryland.

zh.s: 2006年马里兰州检察长选举于11月7日举行。民主党籍现任检察长J·约瑟夫·柯伦决定不竞选第六个任期，原因之一是女婿马丁·奥马利竞选州长，他希望避免利益冲突。蒙哥马利县检察官道格·甘斯勒赢得民主党初选，争取接替柯伦；他的对手是弗雷德里克县检察官斯科特·罗尔，后者在共和党初选中无人挑战。甘斯勒最终以压倒性优势击败罗尔，成为马里兰州检察长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Ohio gubernatorial election of 2006 was held on November 7, 2006, and was a race for the Governor and Lieutenant Governor of Ohio. Incumbent Governor Bob Taft could not run for re-election, because Ohio governors are limited to two consecutive terms in office. The general election for governor pitted Ohio Secretary of State Ken Blackwell, the Republican nominee, against United States Congressman Ted Strickland of Ohio's 6th congressional district, the Democratic nominee. Their running mates were former Ohio Attorney General Lee Fisher on the Democratic ticket and State Representative Tom Raga on the Republican ticket.

zh.s: 2006年俄亥俄州州长选举于11月7日举行，同时选出州长和副州长。现任州长鲍勃·塔夫脱受任期限制，不能竞选连任。大选对阵双方是共和党候选人、俄亥俄州州务卿肯·布莱克韦尔，以及民主党候选人、俄亥俄州第6国会选区联邦众议员泰德·斯特里克兰。两党的竞选搭档分别是前俄亥俄州检察长李·费舍尔和州众议员汤姆·拉加。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2006 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 2006. Incumbent Democratic Governor of Oregon Ted Kulongoski ran for a second and final term as governor. Kulongoski faced several challengers in his primary, whom he dispatched to win his party's nomination a second time, while Republican nominee Ron Saxton, the former Chair of the Portland Public Schools Board and a candidate for Governor in 2002 emerged from a crowded primary. Kulongoski and Saxton were initially going to be challenged in the general election by State Senator Ben Westlund, but Westlund withdrew his candidacy before the general election.

zh.s: 2006年俄勒冈州州长选举于11月7日举行。民主党籍现任州长泰德·库隆戈斯基竞选第二个也是最后一个任期。他在民主党初选中击败多名挑战者，再次获得提名。共和党候选人罗恩·萨克斯顿曾任波特兰公立学校董事会主席，并于2002年竞选过州长；他从竞争激烈的初选中胜出。州参议员本·韦斯特伦原本也准备在大选中挑战库隆戈斯基和萨克斯顿，但他在大选前退出。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2006 South Carolina State Elections took place on November 7, 2006, and included the gubernatorial election. All nine popularly elected constitutional officers were up for reelection, and all races except the Attorney General's were contested. The entire South Carolina House of Representatives, one state senator and six state circuit solicitors were also up for election. Several constitutional amendments were also on the ballot. Filing for the major parties closed on March 28, 2006, and filing for minor parties closed on August 15. The primaries for both parties were held on June 13, and run-offs were held June 27.

zh.s: 2006年南卡罗来纳州州级选举于11月7日举行，其中包括州长选举。9个由选民选出的州级宪制职位都进行改选，除检察长职位外，其他职位都有人竞争。州众议院全部席位、一个州参议院席位和6个州巡回法院检察官职位也进行改选。选票上还有多项州宪法修正案。主要政党的候选人登记于2006年3月28日截止，小党候选人登记于8月15日截止。两党初选于6月13日举行，第二轮初选于6月27日举行。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections, 2006
en.s: The 2006 United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 7, 2006 to elect members to the United States House of Representatives. It took place in the middle of President George W. Bush's second term in office. All 435 seats of the House were up for election. Those elected served in the 110th United States Congress from January 3, 2007 until January 3, 2009. The incumbent majority party, the Republicans, had won majorities in the House consecutively since 1994, and were defeated by the Democrats who won a majority in the chamber, ending 12 years in opposition.

zh.s: 2006年美国联邦众议院选举于11月7日举行，选出联邦众议员。当时正值乔治·W·布什总统第二个任期中期，众议院全部435个席位都进行改选。当选者于2007年1月3日至2009年1月3日在第110届国会任职。共和党自1994年以来连续赢得众议院多数席位，但在此次选举中败给民主党。民主党赢得多数席位，结束了12年的在野状态。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Arizona, 2006
en.s: The 2006 congressional elections in Arizona were elections for Arizona's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred along with congressional elections nationwide on November 7, 2006. Arizona has eight seats, as apportioned during the 2000 United States Census. Prior to the election, Republicans held six of the eight seats and Democrats held two. In the 8th district, Republican Congressman Jim Kolbe retired, leaving an open seat. Following the elections, Democrats gained two seats at the expense of the Republicans, who lost two.

zh.t: 2006年亚利桑那州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2006年亚利桑那州联邦众议院选举与全国各地的国会选举同时举行，日期为11月7日。亚利桑那州有8个众议院席位，席位数根据2000年美国人口普查确定。选举前，共和党占据其中6席，民主党占据2席。第8选区共和党众议员吉姆·科尔贝退休，留下一个空缺席位。选举后，民主党从共和党手中赢得两席。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Florida, 2006
en.s: The 2006 Florida U.S. House elections took place on November 7, 2006. Elections were held in Florida's 1st through 25th congressional districts. Florida is known to be a moderate-to-conservative state, with more liberals residing in South Florida, and moderates and conservatives dominating both the northern and central regions of Florida, as well as a strong Republican base in Cuban-American portions of Miami. A former Florida Secretary of State made famous in the 2000 presidential election challenged incumbent Senator Bill Nelson, and ended up losing to Nelson.

zh.t: 2006年佛罗里达州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 佛罗里达州联邦众议员选举于2006年11月7日举行，涉及该州第1至第25国会选区。佛罗里达州通常被视为温和至保守的州：自由派更多居住在南佛罗里达，温和派和保守派主导该州北部和中部，迈阿密古巴裔社区则是共和党的重要支持基础。曾因2000年总统选举而出名的前佛罗里达州务卿挑战时任参议员比尔·纳尔逊，但最终败给纳尔逊。

en.s: The 2006 California gubernatorial election occurred on November 7, 2006. The primary elections took place on June 6, 2006. The incumbent Republican Governor, Arnold Schwarzenegger, won re election for his first full term. His main opponent was California State Treasurer Phil Angelides, the California Democratic Party nominee. Peter Camejo was the California Green Party nominee, Janice Jordan was the Peace and Freedom Party nominee, Art Olivier was the California Libertarian Party nominee, and Edward C. Noonan was the California American Independent Party nominee. Under the California Constitution, the Governor serves a four-year term, with a maximum limit of two consecutive terms.

zh.s: 2006年加利福尼亚州州长选举于11月7日举行。初选于2006年6月6日举行。共和党籍现任州长阿诺德·施瓦辛格成功连任，开始他的第一个完整任期。主要对手是加州民主党提名的州财政部长菲尔·安杰利德斯。加州绿党候选人是彼得·卡梅霍，和平与自由党候选人是珍妮丝·乔丹，加州自由党候选人是阿特·奥利维耶，加州美国独立党候选人是爱德华·C·努南。根据加州宪法，州长任期四年，最多可连续任两届。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in North Dakota, 2006
en.s: The 2006 U.S. House of Representatives election for the state of North Dakota's At-large congressional district was held November 7, 2006. The incumbent, Democratic-NPL Congressman Earl Pomeroy was re-elected to his eighth term, defeating Republican candidate Matt Mechtel. Only Pomeroy filed as a Dem-NPLer, and the endorsed Republican candidate was Matt Mechtel of Fargo, North Dakota. Pomeroy and Mechtel won the primary elections for their respective parties. Pomeroy increased his margin over his opposition for the third year in a row since 2002. This was because Mechtel was not known well throughout the state, and that the Republican Party itself was beginning to slump.

zh.t: 2006年北达科他州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2006年北达科他州联邦众议院选举于11月7日举行，改选该州单一国会选区的众议员。民主党—无党派联盟籍现任众议员厄尔·波默罗伊击败共和党候选人马特·梅克特尔，赢得第八个任期。波默罗伊是唯一登记参加民主党—无党派联盟初选的候选人；共和党背书的候选人梅克特尔来自北达科他州法戈。两人都赢得各自政党的初选。从2002年起，波默罗伊连续第三次扩大对手的落后差距，原因是梅克特尔在全州知名度不高，而且共和党本身也开始走下坡路。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in Vermont, 2006
en.s: The United States House of Representatives election in Vermont, 2006 was held on November 7, 2006 for representation of Vermont's at-large congressional district in the United States House of Representatives from January 3, 2007 to January 3, 2009. Incumbent Congressman Bernie Sanders, an independent member of Congress who caucused with the Democrats, did not seek a ninth term in the House, instead embarking on a successful run for the United States Senate. To replace Congressman Sanders, Democrat Peter Welch defeated Republican Martha Rainville by a surpisingly narrow margin in staunchly-liberal Vermont.

zh.t: 2006年佛蒙特州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2006年佛蒙特州联邦众议院选举于11月7日举行，选出代表佛蒙特州不分区国会选区的众议员，任期从2007年1月3日至2009年1月3日。现任众议员伯尼·桑德斯是与民主党共同参与议事的独立派议员，他没有寻求第九个众议员任期，而是转而竞选联邦参议员并成功当选。为了接替桑德斯，民主党候选人彼得·韦尔奇击败了共和党候选人玛莎·雷恩维尔，差距比这个坚定支持自由派的州通常预期的更小。

en.s: The Connecticut gubernatorial election of 2006 occurred on November 7, 2006. The incumbent, Jodi Rell, became governor when John G. Rowland resigned in 2004. Rell, whose approval rating as of October 19, 2006 was 70% and her "net" approval rating (approval percentage less disapproval percentage) was 43% led DeStefano by a near 30-point margin, consistent with opinion polls leading up to the election. On November 7 the results were final Jodi Rell was elected Governor of Connecticut. DeStefano defeated Stamford Mayor Dan Malloy in the Connecticut Democratic gubernatorial primary on August 8.

zh.s: 2006年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月7日举行。现任州长乔迪·雷尔于2004年接替辞职的约翰·G·罗兰。2006年10月19日，雷尔的支持率为70%，支持率减去反对率后的净支持率为43%；她领先德斯特凡诺近30个百分点，与此前民调一致。11月7日计票结果确认，雷尔当选州长。德斯特凡诺此前于8月8日举行的康涅狄格州民主党州长初选中击败了斯坦福市市长丹·马洛伊。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in North Carolina, 2006
en.s: The United States House of Representative elections of 2006 in North Carolina were held on 7 November 2006 as part of the biennial election to the United States House of Representatives. All thirteen seats in North Carolina, and 435 nationwide, were elected. The Democrats gained a seat, becoming the largest party in terms of both representatives and popular vote. All incumbents ran again, with twelve of the thirteen winning re-election. Republican incumbent Charles H. Taylor lost the 11th district, while fellow Republican Robin Hayes came close to losing in the 8th.

zh.t: 2006年北卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2006年北卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举于11月7日举行，是联邦众议院每两年一次选举的一部分。北卡罗来纳州的13个席位都进行改选，全国共改选435席。民主党赢得一个席位，成为众议员人数和普选票数最多的政党。所有现任议员都寻求连任，13人中有12人成功。共和党籍现任众议员查尔斯·H·泰勒在第11选区落败；同党议员罗宾·海斯也险些失去第8选区席位。

en.s: The 2006 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 2006 elect the Governor of Texas. The election was a rare four-way race, with incumbent Republican Governor Rick Perry running for reelection against Democrat Chris Bell and Independents Carole Keeton Strayhorn and Kinky Friedman. Perry was reelected to a second full term in office, winning 39% of the vote to Bell's 30%, Strayhorn's 18% and Friedman's 12%. Perry carried 209 out of the state's 254 counties, while Bell carried 39 and Strayhorn carried 6. Exit polls revealed that Perry won the Anglo vote with 46%, while Bell got 22%, Strayhorn got 16% and Friedman got 15%.

zh.s: 2006年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月7日举行。共和党籍现任州长里克·佩里寻求连任，对手是民主党候选人克里斯·贝尔，以及两名独立候选人卡罗尔·基顿·斯特雷霍恩和金基·弗里德曼。这是一场少见的四人竞争。佩里赢得第二个完整任期，得票率为39%；贝尔获得30%，斯特雷霍恩18%，弗里德曼12%。佩里赢得全州254个县中的209个，贝尔赢得39个，斯特雷霍恩赢得6个。出口民调显示，佩里获得46%的白人选票，贝尔、斯特雷霍恩和弗里德曼分别获得22%、16%和15%。

en.t: United States Senate election in Pennsylvania, 2006
en.s: The 2006 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on November 7, 2006. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Rick Santorum ran for re-election to a third term, but was defeated by Bob Casey, Jr. Casey was elected to serve between January 3, 2007 and January 3, 2013. Santorum trailed Casey in every public poll taken during the campaign. Casey's margin of victory (nearly 18% of those who voted) was the largest ever for a Democratic Senate nominee in Pennsylvania, and the largest margin of victory for a Senate challenger in the 2006 elections.

zh.t: 2006年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2006年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院选举于11月7日举行。共和党籍现任参议员里克·桑托勒姆竞选第三个任期，但败给了鲍勃·凯西二世。凯西当选，任期从2007年1月3日至2013年1月3日。竞选期间所有公开民调都显示桑托勒姆落后于凯西。凯西以近18个百分点的优势获胜，这是宾夕法尼亚州民主党参议员候选人有史以来最大的胜选差距，也是2006年参议员挑战者中胜差最大的一次。

en.s: The 2006 South Carolina gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 2006. Incumbent Republican Governor Mark Sanford was running for re-election against Democratic State Senator Tommy Moore and became only the third Republican governor in South Carolina to win a second term (Robert Kingston Scott and Carroll A. Campbell, Jr. were the others). Sanford started the campaign with a double-digit edge over Moore and he maintained that lead to election day. During the course of the campaign, Sanford's approval rating averaged in the mid fifties. In Sanford's re-election victory, he also garnered 22 percent of the African American vote, which was considered very high for a Republican statewide candidate.

en.s: The Idaho gubernatorial election of 2006 was held on November 7, 2006. Incumbent Governor Jim Risch succeeded Dirk Kempthorne, who resigned May 26 to become Secretary of the Interior. Risch served as Governor until the end of the term, but had committed to a reelection campaign for Lieutenant Governor before Kempthorne's appointment and subsequent resignation.

zh.s: 2006年爱达荷州州长选举于2006年11月7日举行。现任州长吉姆·里施接替迪克·坎普索恩；坎普索恩于5月26日辞职，出任美国内政部长。里施担任州长直至本届任期结束，但在坎普索恩获任命并辞职之前，他已承诺竞选副州长连任。

en.s: The election to choose County Executives in Maryland occurred on Tuesday, November 7, 2006. The U.S. House election, 2006, U.S. Senate election, 2006, Maryland gubernatorial election, 2006, and Maryland General Assembly Election, 2006 took place on the same day. Seven charter counties elected a County Executive: Anne Arundel County, Baltimore County, Harford County, Howard County, Montgomery County, Prince George's County, and Wicomico County.

zh.t: 2006年马里兰州县行政长官选举
zh.s: 马里兰州县行政长官选举于2006年11月7日星期二举行。同日还举行了2006年美国联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举、马里兰州州长选举和州议会选举。7个实行自治章程的县选出县行政长官：安妮阿伦德尔县、巴尔的摩县、哈福德县、霍华德县、蒙哥马利县、乔治王子县和威科米科县。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma, 2006
en.s: The 2006 congressional elections in Oklahoma were held on November 7, 2006 to determine who would represent the state of Oklahoma in the United States House of Representatives. Oklahoma has five seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected served in the 110th Congress from January 4, 2009 until January 3, 2011.

zh.t: 2006年俄克拉何马州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 俄克拉何马州国会选举于2006年11月7日举行，以选出代表该州进入美国众议院的议员。俄克拉何马州在众议院有5个席位，按2000年美国人口普查结果分配。当选众议员任期两年，并在2009年1月4日至2011年1月3日期间于第110届国会任职。

en.t: United States Senate election in Wyoming, 2006
en.s: The 2006 United States Senate election in Wyoming was held on November 7, 2006. The primaries were on August 22, 2006, in which both candidates were unopposed. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Craig Thomas won re-election to a third term. Thomas died 5 months into his term on June 4, 2007 after battling leukemia.

en.s: The California state elections, 2006 took place on November 7, 2006. Necessary primary elections were held on June 6. Votes on retention of two Supreme Court justices and various Courts of Appeal judges were also held.

The Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL) won a majority of seats, remaining the majority party, followed by the Republican Party of Minnesota.

zh.t: 2006年加利福尼亚州保险专员选举
zh.s: 2006年加利福尼亚州保险专员选举于2006年11月7日举行。初选于2006年6月6日举行。共和党候选人、商人史蒂夫·波伊兹纳击败民主党候选人、副州长克鲁兹·布斯塔曼特，赢得此前由民主党人约翰·加拉门迪担任的职位。加拉门迪因任期限制不能连任，转而竞选副州长。

The winning candidates served a two-year term from January 3, 2007, to January 3, 2009. The primary elections were held on Tuesday, June 13, 2006.

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in Delaware, 2006
en.s: The Delaware United States House election for 2006 was held on November 7, 2006. Delaware has a single seat in the United States House of Representatives which incumbent Michael N. Castle was defending. Castle was re-elected.

zh.s: 2006年特拉华州联邦众议院选举于2006年11月7日举行。特拉华州在联邦众议院只有一个席位，由现任议员迈克尔·N·卡斯尔竞选连任。卡斯尔成功连任。

en.s: The 2006 United States House of Representatives elections in Colorado were held on November 7, 2006, with all seven House seats up for election. The winners served from January 3, 2007 to January 6, 2009.

zh.s: 科罗拉多州联邦众议院全部7个席位于2006年11月7日举行选举。当选者的任期从2007年1月3日至2009年1月6日。
