en.s: An election was held on November 7, 2006 to elect all 100 members to Montana's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives and State Senate. The primary election was held on June 6, 2006. A net loss of one seat by the Democrats resulted in the Democrats winning 49 seats compared to 50 seats for the Republicans.

zh.s: 2006年11月7日举行选举，改选蒙大拿州众议院全部100名议员。选举与其他公职选举同时举行，包括联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州参议院选举。初选于2006年6月6日举行。民主党净失去1席，最终赢得49席，共和党赢得50席。

en.s: The 2006 Washington State House elections took place on November 7, 2006. Voters in all 49 of Washington's legislative districts voted for their representatives. Washington State Senate elections were also held on November 7.

zh.s: 2006年华盛顿州众议院选举于2006年11月7日举行。华盛顿州全部49个州议会选区的选民都投票选出州众议员。华盛顿州参议院选举也于11月7日举行。

en.t: 2006 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming
en.s: The 2006 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming was held on November 7, 2006. Incumbent Republican Congresswoman Barbara Cubin ran for re-election. Despite Wyoming's historic tendency to favor Republican candidates, Cubin faced a difficult challenge from businessman Gary Trauner, the Democratic nominee. Cubin ultimately won re-election by a 0.5 percent margin, defeating Trauner by just 1,012 votes.

zh.t: 2006年怀俄明州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2006年怀俄明州美国联邦众议院选举于2006年11月7日举行。时任共和党联邦女众议员芭芭拉·库宾竞选连任。尽管怀俄明州历来倾向支持共和党候选人，库宾仍面临民主党候选人、商人加里·特劳纳的强劲挑战。库宾最终以0.5个百分点的微弱优势连任，仅以1,012票击败特劳纳。

en.s: An election was held on November 7, 2006, to elect all 41 members to Delaware's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and state senate. The primary election was held on September 12, 2006.

zh.s: 2006年11月7日举行选举，改选特拉华州众议院全部41名议员。选举与其他公职选举同时举行，包括联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州参议院选举。初选于2006年9月12日举行。

en.s: The 2006 Texas lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 2006, to elect the Lieutenant Governor of Texas. The incumbent, Republican David Dewhurst, was reelected in a landslide over Democrat Maria Luisa Alvarado. Dewhurst became the first Republican to be re-elected as lieutenant governor.

zh.s: 2006年得克萨斯州副州长选举于2006年11月7日举行，以选出该州副州长。时任共和党副州长戴维·杜赫斯特以压倒性优势击败民主党候选人玛丽亚·路易莎·阿尔瓦拉多，成功连任。杜赫斯特成为首位成功连任的共和党副州长。

en.t: 2006 North Carolina House of Representatives election
en.s: An election was held on November 7, 2006 to elect all 120 members to North Carolina's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including the U.S. House of Representatives, and state senate. The primary election was held on May 2, 2006 with primary run-offs held on May 30, 2006 and September 12, 2006.

zh.t: 2006年北卡罗来纳州众议院选举
zh.s: 2006年11月7日举行选举，改选北卡罗来纳州众议院全部120名议员。选举与其他公职选举同时举行，包括美国联邦众议院和州参议院选举。初选于2006年5月2日举行，初选决选分别于2006年5月30日和9月12日举行。

en.s: The 2006 Oklahoma Senate election was held on November 7, 2006. Senators in 24 out of 48 districts were up for election. Going into the election, Democrats had a narrow 2 seat majority with 26 seats, compared to Republicans 22 seats. Their majority was reduced to 25-23 after the January 2006 death of Senator Robert M. Kerr and Republican Mike Schulz's victory in the subsequent special election.

zh.t: 2006年俄克拉何马州参议院选举
zh.s: 2006年俄克拉何马州参议院选举于2006年11月7日举行，改选48个选区中的24席。选举前，民主党以26席对共和党的22席仅占微弱多数。2006年1月参议员罗伯特·M·克尔去世，随后共和党人迈克·舒尔茨在特别选举中获胜，使民主党的多数缩小到25席对23席。

en.t: 2006 United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan
en.s: The 2006 congressional elections in Michigan was held on November 7, 2006, to determine who would represent the state of Michigan in the United States House of Representatives. Michigan had fifteen seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms. All fifteen incumbents ran for re-election, and all of them were re-elected except Joe Schwarz, who lost his primary.

zh.t: 2006年密歇根州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2006年密歇根州联邦众议院选举于2006年11月7日举行，选出代表密歇根州进入联邦众议院的议员。根据2000年美国人口普查，密歇根州有15个众议院席位。众议员任期两年。15名时任众议员都竞选连任，除乔·施瓦茨在初选中落败外，其余人均成功连任。

en.t: 2006 United States House of Representatives election in Montana
en.s: The 2006 United States House of Representatives election in Montana was held on November 7, 2006 to determine who would represent the state of Montana in the United States House of Representatives. Montana had one, at-large district in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States census, due to its low population. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 2006年蒙大拿州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2006年蒙大拿州美国联邦众议院选举于2006年11月7日举行，选出代表蒙大拿州进入联邦众议院的议员。由于人口较少，根据2000年美国人口普查重新分配席位后，蒙大拿州只有一个全州单一选区众议院席位。众议员任期两年。

en.s: The 2006 Connecticut State Treasurer election took place on November 7, 2006, to elect the Connecticut State Treasurer. Incumbent Democratic State Treasurer Denise L. Nappier won re-election to a third term, defeating Republican nominee Linda Roberts.

zh.t: 2006年康涅狄格州州财政长选举
zh.s: 2006年康涅狄格州州财政长选举于2006年11月7日举行。民主党时任州财政长丹尼斯·L·纳皮尔击败共和党候选人琳达·罗伯茨，连任第三届。

en.s: The 2006 Arizona House of Representatives election took place on Tuesday, November 7, 2006, with the primary election held on Tuesday, September 12, 2006. Arizona voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve two-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Arizona state elections, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House, Arizona governor, and Arizona Senate.

zh.s: 2006年亚利桑那州众议院选举于2006年11月7日（星期二）举行，初选于同年9月12日（星期二）举行。亚利桑那州选民选出州众议院全部60名议员，任期两年，采用多议员选区。选举与美国全国选举和亚利桑那州选举同时进行，包括联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州长和亚利桑那州参议院选举。

en.t: 2006 Connecticut Secretary of the State election
en.s: The 2006 Connecticut Secretary of the State election took place on November 7, 2006, to elect the Secretary of the State of Connecticut. Incumbent Democrat Susan Bysiewicz won re-election to a third term, defeating Republican nominee Richard J. Abbate.

zh.s: 2006年康涅狄格州州务卿选举于2006年11月7日举行。时任民主党州务卿苏珊·拜西维奇击败共和党候选人理查德·J·阿巴特，连任第三届。

en.s: The 2006 Michigan Attorney General election took place on November 7, 2006, to elect the Attorney General of Michigan. Incumbent Mike Cox became the first Republican in over 50 years to be elected attorney general and was seeking to become the first Republican since the amending of the Michigan Constitution to be re-elected.

zh.s: 2006年密歇根州总检察长选举于2006年11月7日举行，以选出该州总检察长。时任总检察长迈克·考克斯成为50多年来首位当选总检察长的共和党人，并竞选成为修改密歇根州宪法后首位成功连任的共和党总检察长。

en.s: General elections were held in Guam on November 7, 2006, in order to elect the governor, all 15 seats in the Legislature and the federal delegate. There was also a double referendum on legalise slot machines at racing tracks and raising the age at which citizens could purchase and consume alcohol to 21. Whilst Felix Perez Camacho of the Republican Party was re-elected as governor, the Democratic Party won a majority of seats in the legislature.

zh.s: 关岛于2006年11月7日举行大选，选出州长、立法机关全部15个席位和联邦国会代表。选民还就两项议题举行公投：是否允许在赛马场设置老虎机，以及是否将购买和饮用酒精饮料的法定年龄提高到21岁。共和党籍州长费利克斯·佩雷斯·卡马乔成功连任，民主党则赢得立法机关多数席位。

en.s: The 2006 United States state legislative elections were held on November 7, 2006, halfway through President George W. Bush's second term in office. This election was a wave elections in the United States election, and saw Democrats simultaneously reclaim both houses of Congress and pick up six governorships. Elections were held for 90 legislative chambers, with all states but Louisiana, Mississippi, New Jersey, and Virginia holding elections in at least one house.

zh.s: 2006年11月7日，美国举行州议会选举，当时乔治·W·布什总统的第二个任期过半。这是美国选举中的一场浪潮式选举，民主党同时重新赢得国会两院多数，并增加了6个州长席位。90个州议会院举行选举，除路易斯安那州、密西西比州、新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州外，其他州至少有一个议会院举行选举。

en.s: The 2006 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 7, 2006, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee Susan Montee defeated Republican nominee Sandra Thomas, Libertarian nominee Charles Baum and Progressive nominee Terry Bunker.

zh.s: 2006年密苏里州州审计长选举于2006年11月7日举行，以选出该州审计长。民主党候选人苏珊·蒙蒂击败共和党候选人桑德拉·托马斯、自由党候选人查尔斯·鲍姆和进步党候选人特里·邦克。

en.t: 2006 United States House of Representatives elections in Idaho
en.s: The 2006 congressional elections in Idaho were held on November 7, 2006, and determined who would represent the state of Idaho in the United States House of Representatives. Idaho has two seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; the winners served in the 110th Congress from January 3, 2007 until January 3, 2009.

zh.t: 2006年爱达荷州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2006年爱达荷州联邦众议院选举于2006年11月7日举行，选出代表爱达荷州进入联邦众议院的议员。根据2000年美国人口普查，爱达荷州有两个众议院席位。众议员任期两年，此次胜选者于2007年1月3日至2009年1月3日在第110届国会任职。

en.s: The 2006 Maryland House of Delegates elections were held on November 7, 2006, as part of the 2006 United States elections, including the 2006 Maryland gubernatorial election. All 141 of Maryland's state delegates were up for reelection. Democrats gained six seats in the House of Delegates, retaining supermajority control of the chamber.

zh.s: 2006年马里兰州州众议院选举于2006年11月7日举行，是2006年美国选举的一部分，也包括2006年马里兰州州长选举。州众议院全部141个席位均进行改选。民主党增加6席，并继续控制众议院三分之二多数。

en.s: The 2006 elections for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives were held on November 7, 2006, with all districts being contested. Necessary primary elections were held on May 16, 2006. Members elected in 2006 were inaugurated on January 2, 2007. State Representatives are elected for two-year terms, with the entire House of Representatives up for a vote every two years.

zh.t: 2006年宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举于2006年11月7日举行，所有选区均有候选人参选。初选于2006年5月16日举行。2006年当选议员于2007年1月2日宣誓就职。州众议员任期两年，每两年改选众议院全部席位。

en.t: 2006 United States Senate election in Maine
en.s: The 2006 United States Senate election in Maine was held November 7, 2006. Incumbent Republican Olympia Snowe won re-election to a third term, defeating Democrat Jean Hay Bright and independent candidate Bill Slavick. As of 2024, this was the last time Republicans won the Class 1 U.S. Senate seat in Maine.

zh.t: 2006年缅因州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2006年缅因州美国联邦参议院选举于2006年11月7日举行。时任共和党参议员奥林匹娅·斯诺以第三届连任击败民主党候选人让·海·布赖特和独立候选人比尔·斯拉维克。截至2024年，这是共和党最后一次赢得缅因州第一类联邦参议院席位。

en.s: The 2006 Indiana Elections was held on November 7, 2006, as part of the 2006 midterm elections.

zh.s: 2006年印第安纳州选举于2006年11月7日举行，是2006年美国中期选举的一部分。

en.t: 2006 United States House of Representatives elections in Hawaii
en.s: The 2006 congressional elections in Hawaii were held on November 7, 2006, to determine who was to represent the state of Hawaii in the United States House of Representatives for the 111th Congress. Hawaii has two seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 2006年夏威夷州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2006年夏威夷州联邦众议院选举于2006年11月7日举行，决定谁将代表夏威夷州进入第111届国会。根据2000年美国人口普查，夏威夷州有两个众议院席位。众议员任期两年。

en.s: The 2006 Illinois elections were held on November 7, 2006. On that date, registered voters in the State of Illinois elected officeholders for U.S. Congress, to six statewide offices (Governor/Lieutenant Governor, Attorney General, Secretary of States, Treasurer and Comptroller), as well as to the Illinois Senate and Illinois House. The incumbent Treasurer Judy Baar Topinka, previously the only Republican elected statewide, made an unsuccessful run for governor rather than stand for re-election.

zh.s: 2006年伊利诺伊州选举于2006年11月7日举行。当天，该州登记选民选出联邦国会议员和6个全州公职的当选人：州长和副州长、总检察长、州务卿、州财政长及州审计长；同时选举伊利诺伊州参议院和众议院议员。时任州财政长朱迪·巴尔·托宾卡此前是唯一一位当选全州公职的共和党人；她决定竞选州长，而不是竞选连任，但未能当选。

en.s: The 2006 Maryland Senate elections were held on November 7, 2006, as part of the 2006 United States elections, including the 2006 Maryland gubernatorial election. All 47 of Maryland's state senators were up for reelection. Neither party netted seats, allowing Democrats to retain supermajority control of the chamber.

zh.s: 2006年马里兰州参议院选举于2006年11月7日举行，是2006年美国选举的一部分，也包括2006年马里兰州州长选举。州参议院全部47个席位均进行改选。两党席位总数都没有增加，民主党继续控制参议院三分之二多数。

en.s: The Oklahoma state elections were held on November 7, 2006. The primary election was held on July 25. The runoff primary election was held August 22.

zh.s: 俄克拉何马州选举于2006年11月7日举行。初选于7月25日举行，初选决选于8月22日举行。

en.s: The 2006 Texas Attorney General election took place on November 7, 2006, to elect the attorney general of Texas. Incumbent Republican attorney general Greg Abbott successfully ran for re-election and defeated Democratic attorney David Van Os with 59.51% of the vote to his second term as attorney general.

zh.t: 2006年得克萨斯州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2006年得克萨斯州总检察长选举于2006年11月7日举行。共和党时任总检察长格雷格·阿博特竞选连任，并以59.51%的得票率击败民主党律师戴维·范奥斯，成功连任。

en.s: The 2006 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 7, 2006, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Mark Ritchie defeated Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Mary Kiffmeyer, For Independent Voters nominee Bruce D. Kennedy and Independence nominee Joel Spoonheim.

zh.s: 2006年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于2006年11月7日举行，以选出该州州务卿。民主农民劳工党候选人马克·里奇击败共和党候选人、时任州务卿玛丽·基夫迈耶、独立选民党候选人布鲁斯·D·肯尼迪和独立党候选人乔尔·斯普恩海姆。

en.s: The 2006 Texas General Election was held on Tuesday, 7 November 2006, in the U.S. state of Texas. Voters statewide elected the Governor, Lieutenant Governor, Attorney General, Comptroller of Public Accounts, Commissioner of the Texas General Land Office, Commissioner of Agriculture, and one Railroad Commissioner. Statewide judicial offices up for election were the chief justice and four justices of the Texas Supreme Court, and the presiding judge and two judges of the Texas Court of Criminal Appeals.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州于2006年11月7日（星期二）举行大选。全州选民选出州长、副州长、总检察长、公共账户审计长、州土地总局局长、农业专员和一名铁路专员。全州司法职位选举包括得克萨斯州最高法院首席大法官及4名法官、得克萨斯州刑事上诉法院首席法官及2名法官。

en.s: On November 7, 2006, Washington, D.C., held an election for its mayor. It determined the successor to two-term mayor Anthony A. Williams, who did not run for re-election. The Democratic primary was held on September 12. The winner of both was Adrian Fenty, the representative for Ward 4 on the D.C. Council. He took office on January 2, 2007, becoming the sixth directly elected mayor since the establishment of home rule in the District.

zh.s: 2006年11月7日，华盛顿特区举行市长选举，选出两届市长安东尼·A·威廉姆斯的继任者。威廉姆斯没有竞选连任。民主党初选于9月12日举行，同一候选人赢得初选和大选：特区议会第4选区议员阿德里安·芬蒂。他于2007年1月2日就职，成为特区实行自治以来第六位由选民直接选出的市长。

en.s: The 2006 Connecticut Attorney General election took place on November 7, 2006, to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Richard Blumenthal won re-election to an unprecedented fifth term, defeating Republican nominee and state representative Robert Farr, who lost every single county in the state and only carried the staunchly conservative town of New Canaan.

zh.t: 2006年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2006年康涅狄格州总检察长选举于2006年11月7日举行。民主党时任总检察长理查德·布卢门撒尔成功连任，开始前所未有的第五个任期，击败共和党候选人、州众议员罗伯特·法尔。法尔输掉了该州每个县，只在保守派势力稳固的新迦南镇获胜。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Wyoming on Tuesday, November 7, 2006. All of the state's executive officers—the Governor, Secretary of State, Auditor, Treasurer, and Superintendent of Public Instruction—were up for election.

zh.s: 怀俄明州于2006年11月7日（星期二）举行大选。该州全部行政官员职位均进行选举，包括州长、州务卿、审计长、州财政长和公立教育总监。

en.s: Elections for the Massachusetts House of Representatives were held on November 7, 2006, with all of the 160 seats in the House up for election. The term of Representatives elected is two years, January 2007 until January 2009. The 2006 Massachusetts Senate election occurred on the same day as the House election, along with Federal and Gubernatorial elections.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州众议院选举于2006年11月7日举行，众议院全部160个席位均进行改选。州众议员任期两年，2006年当选者任期从2007年1月至2009年1月。2006年马萨诸塞州参议院选举也在同一天举行，同时进行的还有联邦和州长选举。

en.t: 2006 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia
en.s: The 2006 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia took place on November 7, 2006, to elect a shadow member to the United States Senate to represent the District of Columbia. The member was only recognized by the District of Columbia and not officially sworn or seated by the United States Senate.

zh.t: 2006年哥伦比亚特区影子联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2006年哥伦比亚特区影子联邦参议员选举于2006年11月7日举行，选出一名代表哥伦比亚特区的影子参议员。该职位仅获哥伦比亚特区承认，不会由美国联邦参议院正式宣誓就职或安排席位。

en.s: The 2006 Texas Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 7, 2006. Fifteen of the sixteen elections for the Texas Senate were contested to some extent. The winners of this election served in the 80th Texas Legislature. Five Senators chose to not run or were defeated in the primaries.

zh.s: 2006年得克萨斯州参议院选举于2006年11月7日（星期二）举行。得州参议院16场选举中，有15场存在不同程度的竞争。胜选者进入得克萨斯州第80届立法机关。5名参议员决定不参选或在初选中落败。

en.s: The 2006 Wyoming Senate election was held on November 7, 2006, to elect members to the Wyoming Senate for its 59th session as part of the 2006 United States elections. Partisan primaries were held on August 22. Neither party gained any seats in the legislature.

zh.s: 2006年怀俄明州参议院选举于2006年11月7日举行，选出该州第59届州议会的州参议员，是2006年美国选举的一部分。党派初选于8月22日举行。两党在州议会都没有赢得新增席位。

en.s: The 2006 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on Tuesday, November 7, 2006 to elect the Minnesota attorney general for a four-year term. DFL incumbent Mike Hatch chose to run for governor instead of reelection. Lori Swanson of the Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL) won election to her first term.

zh.t: 2006年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2006年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于2006年11月7日（星期二）举行，选出任期四年的州总检察长。民主农民劳工党籍时任总检察长迈克·哈奇决定竞选州长，而不是竞选连任。该党候选人洛丽·斯旺森当选，开始首个任期。

en.s: The 2006 North Carolina Senate election was held on November 7, 2006, to elect members to all fifty seats in the North Carolina Senate. The election coincided with the elections for other offices, including the U.S. House of Representatives and state house. The primary election was held on May 2, 2006, with primary run-offs occurring on May 30 and September 12, 2006.

zh.t: 2006年北卡罗来纳州参议院选举
zh.s: 2006年北卡罗来纳州参议院选举于2006年11月7日举行，改选州参议院全部50个席位。选举与其他公职选举同时举行，包括联邦众议院和州众议院选举。初选于2006年5月2日举行，初选决选于5月30日和9月12日举行。

en.s: The 2006 Texas 22nd congressional district election for the 110th Congress was held on November 7, 2006, and attracted considerable attention because this district was represented by former House Majority Leader Tom DeLay, a prominent member of the Republican Party, who resigned after being indicted and subsequently winning the Republican primary.

zh.t: 2006年得克萨斯州第22国会选区选举
zh.s: 2006年得克萨斯州第22国会选区联邦众议员选举于2006年11月7日举行，选出第110届国会议员。由于该选区由共和党重要人物、前众议院多数党领袖汤姆·迪莱代表，此次选举受到广泛关注。迪莱被起诉后辞职，但随后赢得共和党初选。

en.t: 2006 United States House of Representatives elections in Rhode Island
en.s: The 2006 United States House of Representatives elections in Rhode Island were held on November 7, 2006, to determine who will represent the state of Rhode Island in the United States House of Representatives. Rhode Island has two seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 2006年罗得岛州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2006年罗得岛州美国联邦众议院选举于2006年11月7日举行，选出代表罗得岛州进入联邦众议院的议员。根据2000年美国人口普查，罗得岛州有两个众议院席位。众议员任期两年。

en.s: The 2006 Tennessee House of Representatives election was held on November 7, 2006, to elect 99 seats for the Tennessee House of Representatives. The elections coincided with the Governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State Senate elections. The primary elections were held on August 3, 2006. Neither party gained seats in this election, keeping the number of seats in the House the same as in the last election, and resulting in the Democrats retaining their majority.

zh.s: 2006年田纳西州众议院选举于2006年11月7日举行，改选州众议院99个席位。选举与州长、联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州参议院选举同时举行。初选于2006年8月3日举行。两党都没有增加席位，众议院席位分布与上次选举相同，民主党继续占多数。

en.s: The 2006 Massachusetts general election was held on November 7, 2006, throughout Massachusetts. At the federal level, Ted Kennedy was re-elected to the United States Senate, and all ten seats in the United States House of Representatives were won by incumbent Democratic Party candidates. Incumbent Republican Governor Mitt Romney did not run for re-election and was succeeded by Democrat Deval Patrick. Martha Coakley was elected Attorney General.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于2006年11月7日举行大选。联邦层面，泰德·肯尼迪连任联邦参议员，联邦众议院全部10个席位均由时任民主党议员赢得。时任共和党州长米特·罗姆尼没有竞选连任，由民主党人德瓦尔·帕特里克接任。玛莎·科克利当选总检察长。

en.s: The 2006 West Virginia Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 7, 2006, to elect members to the 78th and 79th Legislature. 17 of the 34 state senate seats were up for election. State senate seats in West Virginia are staggered, with senators serving 4-year terms. The election took place concurrently with the U.S. House and U.S. Senate elections.

zh.t: 2006年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 2006年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举于2006年11月7日（星期二）举行，选出该州第78届和第79届立法机关的州参议员。34个州参议院席位中有17席进行改选。西弗吉尼亚州参议员任期交错，任期四年。选举与联邦众议院和参议院选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2006 Arizona Senate election was held on November 7, 2006. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on September 12, 2006. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 18 seats over the Democrats' 12 seats.

zh.s: 2006年亚利桑那州参议院选举于2006年11月7日举行，选出该州30个州议会选区的州参议员，任期两年。初选于2006年9月12日举行。选举前，共和党以18席对民主党的12席占多数。

en.s: The 2006 Delaware Senate election was held on November 7, 2006, to elect 11 of the 21 members to Delaware's Senate. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and state house. The primary election was held on September 12, 2006.

zh.s: 2006年特拉华州参议院选举于2006年11月7日举行，改选州参议院21个席位中的11席。选举与其他公职选举同时举行，包括联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州众议院选举。初选于2006年9月12日举行。

en.t: 2006 United States Shadow Representative election in the District of Columbia
en.s: On November 7, 2006, the District of Columbia held a U.S. House of Representatives election for its shadow representative. Unlike its non-voting delegate, the shadow representative is only recognized by the district and is not officially sworn or seated. Incumbent Shadow Representative Ray Browne did not run for reelection and fellow Democrat Mike Panetta was elected in his place.

zh.t: 2006年哥伦比亚特区影子联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2006年11月7日，哥伦比亚特区举行联邦众议院选举，选出该区影子众议员。与没有投票权的国会代表不同，影子众议员仅获该区承认，不会正式宣誓就职或获得席位。时任影子众议员雷·布朗没有竞选连任，同为民主党人的迈克·帕内塔当选接替他。

en.t: 2006 United States House of Representatives elections in Kansas
en.s: The 2006 United States House of Representatives elections in Kansas were held on November 7, 2006, to determine who will represent the state of Kansas in the United States House of Representatives. Kansas has four seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 2006年堪萨斯州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2006年堪萨斯州美国联邦众议院选举于2006年11月7日举行，选出代表堪萨斯州进入联邦众议院的议员。根据2000年美国人口普查，堪萨斯州有4个众议院席位。众议员任期两年。

en.s: The 2006 Alabama Senate election was held on November 7, 2006. Voters in all 35 districts of the Alabama Senate voted for their senators. The Democratic Party retained their majority in the Senate, losing two seats to the Republican Party. To date, this is the last time that the Democratic Party has won a majority in the Alabama Senate.

zh.s: 2006年阿拉巴马州参议院选举于2006年11月7日举行。阿拉巴马州参议院全部35个选区的选民都投票选出州参议员。民主党保住参议院多数，但有2席转为共和党。截至目前，这是民主党最后一次在阿拉巴马州参议院占多数。

en.s: The 2006 United States Senate elections were held on November 7, 2006, with all 33 Class 1 Senate seats being contested. The term of office for those elected in 2006 ran from January 3, 2007, to January 3, 2013. Before the election cycle, the Republican Party controlled 55 of the 100 Senate seats.

zh.s: 2006年美国联邦参议院选举于2006年11月7日举行，全部33个第一类参议院席位均进行改选。2006年当选者的任期从2007年1月3日至2013年1月3日。选举周期开始前，共和党控制了100个参议院席位中的55席。

en.s: The 2006 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 2006. Georgia incumbent Republican governor Sonny Perdue ran for re-election to a second and final term as governor. Governor Perdue was renominated by the Republican Party, defeating a minor opponent in the process, while Lieutenant Governor Mark Taylor narrowly emerged victorious from a competitive Democratic primary.

zh.s: 2006年11月7日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。共和党籍现任州长桑尼·珀杜竞选连任第二个、也是最后一个任期。他再次获得共和党提名，并击败了一名实力较弱的对手。副州长马克·泰勒则在竞争激烈的民主党初选中险胜。

en.s: The 2006 Georgia's 4th congressional district election was an election for the United States House of Representatives. The general election was held on November 7, 2006. However, the 4th was a heavily Democratic district, with the Democratic primary viewed as the more important contest. In that primary, DeKalb County Commissioner Hank Johnson upset the incumbent, Cynthia McKinney.

zh.t: 2006年佐治亚州联邦众议院第四选区选举
zh.s: 2006年11月7日，佐治亚州联邦众议院第四选区举行普选。该选区由民主党占明显优势，因此民主党初选被视为更重要的竞争。在初选中，迪卡尔布县委员汉克·约翰逊击败了时任众议员辛西娅·麦金尼。

en.t: 2006 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 2006 United States Senate election in Washington was held November 7, 2006. Incumbent Democrat Maria Cantwell won reelection to a second term.

zh.t: 2006年美国联邦参议院华盛顿州选举
zh.s: 2006年11月7日，华盛顿州举行联邦参议院选举。民主党籍现任参议员玛丽亚·坎特韦尔成功连任，开始第二个任期。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 7, 2006, in 36 states and two territories. The elections coincided with the midterm elections of the United States Senate and the United States House of Representatives. Democrats won open Republican-held governorships in Arkansas, Colorado, Massachusetts, New York, and Ohio; and they defeated Republican incumbent Bob Ehrlich in Maryland while retaining all of their seats, including their lone open seat in Iowa.

zh.s: 2006年11月7日，美国36个州和两个属地举行州长选举，与美国联邦参议院和众议院中期选举同期进行。民主党赢得阿肯色州、科罗拉多州、马萨诸塞州、纽约州和俄亥俄州原由共和党占据的州长职位，并击败马里兰州共和党籍现任州长鲍勃·埃利希，同时保住所有原有席位，包括艾奥瓦州唯一一个空缺席位。

en.s: The 2006 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 2006, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Georgia. Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Georgia State Senate Casey Cagle defeated Democratic nominee and former member of the Georgia House of Representatives Jim Martin and Libertarian nominee Allen Buckley.

zh.s: 2006年11月7日，佐治亚州举行副州长选举。共和党候选人、时任州参议员凯西·凯格尔击败民主党候选人、前州众议员吉姆·马丁和自由意志党候选人艾伦·巴克利。

en.s: The 2006 San Jose mayoral election was held on June 6 and November 7, 2006, to elect the Mayor of San Jose, California. It saw the election of Chuck Reed. Incumbent mayor Ron Gonzales was term limited. Because no candidate managed to receive a majority of the vote in the initial round of the election, a runoff election was held between the first round's top-two finishers.

zh.t: 2006年加利福尼亚州圣何塞市长选举
zh.s: 2006年6月6日和11月7日，圣何塞举行市长选举。查克·里德当选。时任市长罗恩·冈萨雷斯受任期限制，不能参选。由于首轮无人获得过半选票，得票最高的两名候选人进入决选。

en.s: The 2006 Anaheim mayoral election was held on November 7, 2006, to elect the mayor of Anaheim, California. It saw the reelection of Curt Pringle.

zh.s: 2006年11月7日，阿纳海姆举行市长选举。柯特·普林格尔连任。

en.t: 2006 San Francisco Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2006 San Francisco Board of Supervisors elections occurred on November 7, 2006. Five of the eleven seats were contested in this election. Four of the five incumbents ran for reelection, while one sought another elected office. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, though most candidates in San Francisco do receive funding and support from various political parties.

zh.s: 2006年11月7日，旧金山监事会举行选举，11个席位中有5席改选。五名现任监事中，四人竞选连任，一人转而竞选其他民选职位。加利福尼亚州的市政选举在法律上不设党派，但旧金山大多数候选人会获得各政党的资金和支持。

en.s: The 2006 St. Charles County Executive election took place on November 7, 2006. Incumbent County Executive Joe Ortweth declined to seek re-election. Former State Senator Steve Ehlmann, the County's Director of Administration, won the Republican primary unopposed and faced marketing manager Jim Rutherford, the Democratic nominee, in the general election. The St. Louis Post-Dispatch endorsed Ehlmann over Rutherford, praising his "experience and temperament" and his promise of "a gentler, less combative administration."

zh.t: 2006年圣查尔斯县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2006年11月7日，密苏里州圣查尔斯县举行行政长官选举。时任行政长官乔·奥特韦思决定不竞选连任。前州参议员、县行政主管史蒂夫·埃尔曼在共和党初选中无人竞争，并在普选中对阵民主党候选人、市场经理吉姆·卢瑟福。《圣路易斯邮讯报》支持埃尔曼，称赞他的“经验和处事方式”，以及他承诺建立“更温和、冲突更少的政府”。

en.s: The 2006 New York Comptroller election took place on November 7, 2006. Incumbent Democrat Alan Hevesi won against Republican challenger Chris Callaghan. Hevesi was plagued by scandals during the campaign involving misuse of state funds, and resigned a few days before his second term would have begun.

zh.s: 2006年11月7日，纽约州举行州审计长选举。民主党籍现任审计长艾伦·赫维西击败共和党挑战者克里斯·卡拉汉，成功连任。竞选期间，赫维西因滥用州政府资金卷入丑闻，并在第二个任期开始前几天辞职。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election was held on November 7, 2006. Primaries were held March 21, 2006. Elections were held for Assessor, Clerk, Sheriff, Treasurer, President of the Cook County Board of Commissioners, all 17 seats of the Cook County Board of Commissioners, Cook County Board of Review districts 1 and 2, three seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, judgeships in the Circuit Court of Cook County.

zh.s: 2006年11月7日，伊利诺伊州库克县举行普选，初选于同年3月21日举行。本次选举涉及县估价官、书记官、警长、财务主管、县委员会议长、县委员会议会全部17个席位、县复核委员会第一和第二选区、水资源回收区委员会的三个席位，以及库克县巡回法院法官职位。

en.s: The 2006 Louisville mayoral election was the second quadrennial Louisville Metro mayoral election, held on November 7, 2006. Incumbent mayor Jerry Abramson was re-elected to his second term in office.

zh.s: 2006年11月7日，路易斯维尔举行第四年一度的市长选举。这是路易斯维尔都会区的第二次市长选举。时任市长杰里·亚伯拉姆森成功连任，开始第二个任期。

en.s: The 2006 New York gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 2006, to elect the governor and lieutenant governor of New York. Then-incumbent Republican governor George Pataki chose not to run for re-election in a fourth term. Democrat Eliot Spitzer, the New York Attorney General, won the election over former Republican state Assembly minority leader John Faso. Primary elections were held on September 12.

zh.s: 2006年11月7日，纽约州举行州长和副州长选举。时任共和党州长乔治·帕塔基决定不竞选第四个任期。民主党人、纽约州总检察长埃利奥特·斯皮策击败共和党前州众议院少数党领袖约翰·法索，当选州长。初选于9月12日举行。

en.s: The 2006 St. Louis County Executive election took place on November 7, 2006. Incumbent County Executive Charlie Dooley, who was elected to serve out the remainder of former Executive Buzz Westfall's term, ran for re-election to a full term. After defeating two little-known candidates in the Democratic primary, Dooley advanced to the general election, where was challenged by Joe Passanise, a retired engineer and the 1998 Republican nominee for County Executive.

zh.t: 2006年圣路易斯县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2006年11月7日，密苏里州圣路易斯县举行行政长官选举。时任行政长官查理·杜利此前当选，接替前任巴兹·韦斯特福尔未完成的任期，此次竞选完整任期。杜利在民主党初选中击败两名知名度不高的对手，进入普选，对手是退休工程师、1998年共和党县行政长官候选人乔·帕萨尼斯。

en.s: The 2006 New York Attorney General election took place on November 7, 2006. Democrat Andrew Cuomo was elected to replace Eliot Spitzer (who became Governor) as the Attorney General of New York.

zh.s: 2006年11月7日，纽约州举行总检察长选举。民主党人安德鲁·科莫当选，接替埃利奥特·斯皮策；斯皮策随后出任州长。

en.t: 2006 Cook County Board of Commissioners election
en.s: The 2006 Cook County Board of Commissioners election was held on November 7, 2006. It was preceded by a primary election held on March 21, 2006. It coincided with other 2006 Cook County, Illinois, elections (including the election for president of the Cook County Board of Commissioners). It saw all seventeen seats of the Cook County Board of Commissioners up for election to four-year terms.

zh.s: 2006年11月7日，库克县举行委员会议会选举。初选于2006年3月21日举行。本次选举与伊利诺伊州库克县其他2006年选举同期举行，包括县委员会议长选举。委员会议会17个席位全部改选，任期四年。

en.s: Oregon's 2006 statewide election included a May 16 primary election and a November 7 general election. Ten statewide ballot measures were on the November ballot. The following offices were up for election: Governor, Supreme Court Position 6 (to succeed Wallace P. Carson, Jr.), and numerous seats in the state legislature (House of Representatives and Senate), the state Circuit Courts, and the District Attorney's offices.

zh.s: 俄勒冈州2006年全州选举包括5月16日的初选和11月7日的普选。11月选票上有十项全州公投提案。改选职位包括州长、州最高法院第六席位（接替华莱士·P·卡森二世），以及州议会众议院和参议院、州巡回法院和地方检察官办公室的多个席位。

en.t: 2006 United States House of Representatives elections in Washington
en.s: Elections were held in Washington state in 2006 for seats in the United States House of Representatives. Of the nine congressional districts, six were won by Democrats and three by Republicans, with the Democrats taking 64% of the vote.

zh.t: 2006年华盛顿州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2006年，华盛顿州举行联邦众议院选举。该州九个国会选区中，民主党赢得六席，共和党赢得三席；民主党获得64%的选票。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Illinois House of Representatives elections of 2006 determined the membership of the lower house of the 95th General Assembly. The Democratic Party increased its majority.

zh.s: 2006年伊利诺伊州众议院选举决定了第95届州议会下院的席位组成。民主党扩大了多数优势。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: 2006 New Mexico House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2006 New Mexico House of Representatives election took place as part of the biennial United States elections. New Mexico voters elected state representatives in all 70 of the state house's districts. State representatives serve two-year terms in the New Mexico House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and Governor.

zh.s: 2006年新墨西哥州众议院选举是美国两年一度选举的一部分。新墨西哥州选民在州众议院全部70个选区选出议员。州众议员任期两年。本次选举与其他职位选举同期举行，包括联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州长选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: As a result of the Massachusetts general election, 2006, the Democrats picked up one open seat in the Massachusetts State Senate, the only change from the previous session. The current session began in January, 2007, and consists of 35 Democrats and 5 Republicans. The 2006 Massachusetts House election was held on the same date as the Senate election, as well as Federal and Gubernatorial elections (see Massachusetts general election, 2006).

zh.s: 在2006年马萨诸塞州普选中，民主党从一个空缺席位中赢得州参议院的一席，这是与上一届相比唯一的变化。新一届州参议院于2007年1月开始组成，共有35名民主党人和5名共和党人。马萨诸塞州众议院选举与参议院选举在同一天举行，也与联邦和州长选举同期举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2006 Arizona 8th congressional district election was an election for the United States House of Representatives for the open seat of incumbent Republican Jim Kolbe, who was not running for re-election. The primary was held on September 12, 2006, and the two major party winners were Republican Randy Graf, a former state Representative who challenged Kolbe for the GOP nomination in 2004, and former State Senator Gabby Giffords.

zh.t: 2006年亚利桑那州第八国会选区联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2006年亚利桑那州第八国会选区举行联邦众议员选举，争夺共和党籍现任众议员吉姆·科尔贝不再竞选连任后留下的空缺席位。初选于9月12日举行，两大党候选人分别是共和党人兰迪·格拉夫（曾任州众议员，2004年曾挑战科尔贝党内提名）和前州参议员加比·吉福兹。自由党候选人戴维·“戴夫”·诺兰在党内初选中没有对手，也参加了11月7日的大选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2006 Minnesota's 5th congressional district election was an election for the United States House of Representatives for the open seat of incumbent Martin Olav Sabo (DFL), who retired after serving the Minneapolis-based district for 28 years. Sabo, who had rarely faced a serious electoral challenge, won reelection with 70% of the vote in 2004 in a district that went for John Kerry by 71% in the presidential election.

zh.t: 2006年明尼苏达州第五国会选区联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2006年明尼苏达州第五国会选区联邦众议员选举争夺由马丁·奥拉夫·萨博留下的空缺席位。萨博代表以明尼阿波利斯为中心的选区达28年后退休。萨博过去很少遇到有力挑战，2004年以70%的得票率连任；该选区在同年总统选举中以71%的得票率支持约翰·克里。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2006 Elections in Washington include races for the US Senate, US House and Washington State Legislature. This page tracks incumbents and challengers for the Washington State Senate.

zh.s: 2006年华盛顿州选举包括联邦参议院、联邦众议院和华盛顿州议会的选举。本页记录华盛顿州参议院现任议员和挑战者。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: In the 2006 Georgia elections, Incumbent Governor Sonny Perdue, the first Republican Governor of Georgia since reconstruction, was re-elected over then-Lieutenant Governor Mark Taylor (D). Prior to the elections, though Republicans held the Governor's mansion and majorities in both houses of the Georgia General Assembly, Democrats then-held five of the eight statewide offices.

zh.s: 在2006年佐治亚州选举中，共和党籍现任州长桑尼·珀杜连任，击败时任副州长、民主党人马克·泰勒。珀杜是佐治亚州重建时期以来首位共和党州长。选举前，尽管共和党控制州长官邸，并在州议会两院占多数，民主党仍掌握全州八个民选职位中的五个。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: There were two sets of 2006 Iowa House of Representatives elections. The first, the general election, was held on November 7. The second, a special election for District 52, was held on December 12. The representatives-elect from both sets of elections were inaugurated on January 3, 2007. The Iowa House, like the United States House of Representatives, is up for re-election in its entirety every two years.

zh.s: 2006年艾奥瓦州众议院选举分为两轮。第一轮是11月7日举行的普选；第二轮是12月12日举行的第52选区特别选举。两轮选举中当选的议员均于2007年1月3日宣誓就职。与美国联邦众议院一样，艾奥瓦州众议院每两年全部改选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Vermont Election in 2006 consisted of elections for federal, state, and local elections. All state offices were for two years; all terms expired in 2006. Elections included the gubernatorial, all state offices, including all state senators and representatives, the federal Congress and the U.S. Senate. A primary election in August determined which candidates parties would choose to run in the general election in November.

zh.s: 佛蒙特州2006年的选举涉及联邦、州和地方职位。州内所有职位任期均为两年，现有任期都在2006年届满。选举涉及州长、所有州级职位（包括州参议员和州众议员）、联邦众议院和联邦参议院。8月举行的初选决定各党派推举哪些候选人参加11月普选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2006 Minnesota's 6th congressional district election was an election for the United States House of Representatives. State senator Michele Bachmann of the Republican Party defeated child safety advocate Patty Wetterling of the Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party, and project co-ordinator John Binkowski of the Independence Party.

zh.t: 2006年明尼苏达州联邦众议院第六选区选举
zh.s: 2006年，明尼苏达州联邦众议院第六选区举行选举。共和党州参议员米歇尔·巴赫曼击败民主党—农工党儿童安全倡导者帕蒂·韦特灵和独立党项目协调员约翰·宾科夫斯基。

en.s: The 2006 Texas House of Representatives elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state representatives in all 150 State House of Representatives districts. The winners of this election served in the 80th Texas Legislature. State representatives serve for two-year terms. Republicans maintained control of the House, losing five seats to the Democrats.

zh.s: 2006年得克萨斯州众议院选举是美国两年一度选举的一部分。得克萨斯州选民改选州众议院全部150个选区的议员，当选者组成第80届得克萨斯州议会。州众议员任期两年。共和党保住对众议院的控制权，但失去五席，民主党获得这五席。

en.s: The 2006 United Nations Security Council election began on 16 October 2006 during the 61st session of the United Nations General Assembly, held at United Nations Headquarters in New York City. The elections were for five non-permanent seats on the Security Council for two-year mandates commencing on 1 January 2007.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2006年联合国安全理事会选举于10月16日在纽约联合国总部举行的第61届联合国大会期间开始，为安理会选出5个非常任理事国席位，任期两年，自2007年1月1日开始。

en.s: The first round of the Louisiana House election of 2006 were held on Tuesday, November 7, 2006.

en.s: The 2006 Shreveport mayoral election resulted in the election of Democrat Cedric Glover who defeated Republican Jerry Jones in the runoff in the open race to succeed outgoing mayor Keith Hightower. The nonpartisan blanket primary was held on September 30, 2006, and as no candidate obtained the required majority, the general election followed on November 7, 2006.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2006年9月30日，什里夫波特举行无党派综合初选。由于没有候选人获得规定的多数票，11月7日举行普选。民主党人塞德里克·格洛弗在普选中击败共和党人杰里·琼斯，当选，接替即将卸任的市长基思·海托尔。

en.s: The Richmond, California 2006 city election decided the mayor, four council members, and one measure submitted to the voters of Richmond, California on November 7, 2007. The election also elected the first Green Party mayor of this city, and made Richmond the largest city in the United States to have a Green mayor. Furthermore, it unseated an incumbent mayor from a major political party by one from a minor third party.

zh.t: 2006年加利福尼亚州里士满市选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州里士满市于2007年11月7日举行2006年城市选举，选出市长、4名市议员，并就一项提交选民表决的提案作出决定。选举还选出了该市首位绿党市长，使里士满成为美国拥有绿党市长的最大城市。此外，一位来自主要政党的在任市长被来自第三小党的候选人击败。

en.s: On 7 November 2007, a mass shooting occurred at Jokela High School in the town of Jokela, Tuusula, Finland. The gunman, 18-year-old Pekka-Eric Auvinen, entered the school that morning armed with a semi-automatic pistol. He killed eight people and wounded one before shooting himself in the head; twelve others were also injured by flying glass or by spraining their ankles during the ensuing chaos.

zh.s: 2007年11月7日，芬兰图苏拉市约凯拉镇的约凯拉高中发生大规模枪击事件。18岁的枪手佩卡-埃里克·奥维宁当天早晨持半自动手枪进入学校。他杀死8人、打伤1人，随后朝自己头部开枪；另有12人因飞溅的玻璃受伤，或在混乱中扭伤脚踝。

en.s: The 2007 Saskatchewan general election was held on November 7, 2007 to determine the composition of the 26th Legislative Assembly of Saskatchewan. The Saskatchewan New Democratic Party government of Premier Lorne Calvert was defeated by the Saskatchewan Party, led by Brad Wall. It was only the third time in the province's history that a centre-right party had won power.

zh.s: 2007年11月7日，萨斯喀彻温省举行大选，选出第26届省议会成员。省长洛恩·卡尔弗特领导的新民主党政府败给布拉德·沃尔领导的萨斯喀彻温党。这是该省历史上中右翼政党第三次赢得执政权。

en.s: Operation Mountain Storm (Macedonian: Операција Планинска бура) was carried out on 7 November 2007 by special police forces of the Republic of Macedonia against an armed ethnic Albanian group in the Šar Mountains of Brodec above Tetovo region.

zh.s: 2007年11月7日，马其顿共和国特种警察部队在泰托沃地区布罗德茨上方的沙尔山脉开展山地风暴行动，打击一支武装阿尔巴尼亚族团体。

en.s: The 2008 Bangladesh–Myanmar naval standoff was a naval conflict between the Bangladesh Navy and the Myanmar Navy over disputed territory in the northeastern Bay of Bengal. The standoff ended after diplomatic negotiations. In 2012, the two countries resolved their maritime boundary disputes at an international tribunal.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2008年孟加拉国—缅甸海军对峙是孟加拉国海军与缅甸海军之间的一场海上冲突，双方因孟加拉湾东北部的一片争议海域发生对峙。双方经外交谈判后结束对峙。2012年，两国通过国际法庭解决了海上边界争端。
zh.n: 本条目记录源信息框所列对峙的结束日期。

en.s: Strikeforce/M-1 Global: Fedor vs. Rogers was a mixed martial arts event held on November 7, 2009 promoted by Strikeforce in association with M-1 Global. It was the first MMA event on network television since the now-defunct EliteXC promotion broadcast its final event, EliteXC: Heat, on CBS on October 4, 2008. The event had a four-fight main card with a broadcasting team of Gus Johnson, Frank Shamrock and Mauro Ranallo. The event drew an estimated 4,040,000 viewers, with a peak at 5,460,000 on CBS.

zh.s: Strikeforce/M-1 Global：费多尔对阵罗杰斯综合格斗赛事于2009年11月7日举行，由Strikeforce与M-1 Global联合主办。这是自已停办的EliteXC推广机构于2008年10月4日在CBS播出最后一场赛事“EliteXC：Heat”以来，首次在电视网络频道播出的综合格斗赛事。主赛共有4场比赛，由格斯·约翰逊、弗兰克·沙姆洛克和毛罗·拉纳洛担任解说。赛事估计吸引了404万名观众，在CBS上的收视峰值达到546万人。

en.s: The 2009 Air New Zealand Cup Final was a rugby union match played on Saturday 7 November 2009. It was the fourth Air New Zealand Cup final to determine the winner of the 2009 Air New Zealand Cup and the 33rd winner of New Zealand's premier provincial rugby competition. It was the last Air New Zealand Cup Final with the competition structure set to change for the 2010 season.

zh.s: 2009年11月7日，星期六，双方举行橄榄球联盟比赛，决出2009年新西兰航空杯冠军。这是该项赛事的第四场决赛，也是新西兰顶级省际橄榄球赛事的第33届决赛。随着赛事结构于2010年调整，这也是最后一场以原结构举办的新西兰航空杯决赛。

en.s: The 2009 Svenska Cupen Final took place on November 7, 2009 at Råsunda Stadium in Solna. The match was contested between recently crowned Allsvenskan champions AIK and Allsvenskan runners-up IFK Göteborg, The two teams actually met in the last and crucial league match of the season, just six days before the cup final, where AIK won 2-1 and became league champions.

zh.s: 2009年11月7日，AIK队与IFK哥德堡队在索尔纳的罗斯温达球场举行瑞典杯决赛。AIK刚刚夺得瑞典足球超级联赛冠军，IFK哥德堡则获得联赛亚军。两队在杯赛决赛前六天刚在联赛最后一轮交手，AIK以2比1获胜并夺得联赛冠军。

en.s: The 2009 AFC Champions League final was a football match which was played on Saturday, 7 November 2009. It was the 28th final of the AFC Champions League, Asia's premier club football tournament, and the first single match final since 2002 when the competition was known as the Asian Club Championship. The match was played at the National Stadium in Tokyo between Al-Ittihad of Saudi Arabia and Pohang Steelers of South Korea.

zh.s: 2009年11月7日，双方举行足球比赛，争夺亚足联冠军联赛冠军。这是亚足联冠军联赛第28届决赛，也是该赛事自2002年仍称亚洲俱乐部锦标赛以来首次以单场比赛决出冠军。比赛在东京国家体育场举行，由沙特阿拉伯的伊蒂哈德队对阵韩国的浦项制铁队。

en.s: The 2009 Malagasy political crisis began on 26 January 2009 with the political opposition movement led by Antananarivo mayor Andry Rajoelina, which sought to oust President Marc Ravalomanana from the presidency. The crisis reached its climax in the 2009 Malagasy coup d'état led by Colonel Noël Rakotonandrasana when Andry Rajoelina was declared the president of the High Transitional Authority of Madagascar on 21 March 2009, five days after Ravalomanana transferred his power to a military council and fled to South Africa.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2009年马达加斯加政治危机于1月26日爆发，起因是由塔那那利佛市长安德里·拉乔利纳领导的反对派运动试图推翻总统马克·拉瓦卢马纳纳。危机在2009年马达加斯加政变中达到高潮：拉乔利纳领导的政变由诺埃尔·拉科托南德拉萨纳上校指挥，拉瓦卢马纳纳于3月16日将权力移交军事委员会并逃往南非，5天后拉乔利纳被宣布为马达加斯加最高过渡当局总统。
zh.n: 本条目记录源信息框所列危机的结束日期。

en.s: A general election was held in Myanmar on 7 November 2010, in accordance with the new constitution which was approved in a referendum held in May 2008. The date of the election, 7 November, was announced by the SPDC on 13 August. The general election forms the fifth step of the seven-step "roadmap to democracy" proposed by the State Peace and Development Council (SPDC) in 2003, the sixth and seventh steps being the convening of elected representatives and the building of a modern, democratic nation, respectively. However, the National League for Democracy boycotted the election.

zh.s: 缅甸于2010年11月7日举行大选。选举依据新宪法举行，该宪法于2008年5月的公投中通过。国家和平与发展委员会于8月13日宣布选举日期。此次大选是该委员会于2003年提出的“民主路线图”七个步骤中的第五步；第六和第七步分别是召集民选代表，以及建设一个现代民主国家。不过，缅甸全国民主联盟抵制了此次选举。

en.s: Turning Point (2010) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA), that took place on November 7, 2010 at the Impact Zone in Orlando, Florida. It was the seventh event under the Turning Point chronology. The main event featured Jeff Hardy defending the TNA World Heavyweight Championship against Matt Morgan, which Hardy won following the Twist of Hate. Rob Van Dam versus Tommy Dreamer in a No Disqualification match was also featured on the card. Van Dam defeated Dreamer in the contest.

zh.s: “转折点”（2010）是全面不间断动作摔角（TNA）主办的一场职业摔角付费观看赛事，于2010年11月7日在佛罗里达州奥兰多的Impact Zone举行。这是“转折点”系列赛事中的第七场。主赛中，杰夫·哈迪卫冕TNA世界重量级冠军，对手是马特·摩根；哈迪使用“仇恨扭转”招式获胜。罗布·范·达姆还在一场无取消资格赛中对阵汤米·德里默，并击败了他。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Comoros on 7 November 2010, with a second round on 26 December, alongside gubernatorial elections for the three main islands. The result was a victory for Ikililou Dhoinine, who received 61% of the vote.

zh.s: 科摩罗于2010年11月7日举行总统选举，第二轮投票于12月26日举行；三座主要岛屿也同时举行州长选举。伊基利卢·多伊宁以61%的得票率胜出。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2010–2012 Myanmar border clashes were a series of skirmishes between the Tatmadaw (Myanmar Armed Forces) on one side, and the DKBA-5 and the Karen National Liberation Army (KNLA) on the other. The clashes erupted along the border with Thailand shortly after Myanmar's general election on 7 November 2010. An estimated 10,000 refugees have fled into nearby neighbouring Thailand to escape the violent conflict.

zh.s: 2010至2012年缅甸边境冲突是缅甸武装部队与民主克伦佛教军第五旅、克伦民族解放军之间的一系列交火。冲突于2010年11月7日缅甸大选后不久，在缅泰边境爆发。据估计，约有1万名难民为躲避暴力冲突逃往邻近的泰国。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Guinea in 2010. They were held under the two-round system, with the first round taking place on 27 June 2010 and the second round on 7 November, after an initial date of 18 July and several other postponements. Alpha Condé was declared the winner, with 52.52% of the votes in the second round. He assumed office on 21 December 2010.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2010年，几内亚举行总统选举，采用两轮投票制。首轮投票于6月27日举行；经过多次延期后，第二轮最终于11月7日举行，最初定于7月18日。阿尔法·孔戴以52.52%的第二轮选票获胜，并于2010年12月21日就任。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第二轮投票日期。

en.s: The British Virgin Islands general election, 2011 was held in the British Virgin Islands on 7 November 2011. The result was a decisive victory for the opposition National Democratic Party (NDP) led by Orlando Smith over the incumbent Virgin Islands Party (VIP), led by Premier Ralph T. O'Neal. No minor parties or independent candidates won any seats.

zh.s: 英属维尔京群岛于2011年11月7日举行大选。由奥兰多·史密斯领导的反对党国家民主党（NDP）大获全胜，击败由首席部长拉尔夫·T·奥尼尔领导的执政维尔京群岛党（VIP）。没有小党或独立候选人赢得席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2011 Saskatchewan general election was held on November 7, 2011, to elect 58 members of the Legislative Assembly of Saskatchewan (MLAs). The election was called on October 10 by the Lieutenant Governor of Saskatchewan, on the advice of Premier Brad Wall. Wall's Saskatchewan Party government was re-elected with an increased majority of 49 seats, the third-largest majority government in the province's history.

zh.s: 2011年11月7日，萨斯喀彻温省举行大选，选出省议会58名议员。省督根据省长布拉德·沃尔的建议，于10月10日宣布举行选举。沃尔领导的萨斯喀彻温党政府成功连任，并将多数席位增加到49席，这是该省历史上第三大的多数政府。

en.s: The 2012 CSL All-Stars Game was the 6th CSL All-Stars Game, an annual football match contested by the winners of the Super League and a team of the CSL top players from other clubs. The match was played at the Tianhe Stadium on 7 November 2012, and contested by league winner Guangzhou Evergrande and CSL All-Stars Team. All-Stars Team won the match 1–0.

zh.t: 2012年中国足球超级联赛全明星赛
zh.s: 2012年11月7日，广州恒大队与中超全明星队在天河体育场举行第六届中超全明星赛。比赛由中超联赛冠军对阵其他俱乐部球员组成的全明星队。全明星队以1比0获胜。

en.s: The Rif Dimashq offensive (November 2012–February 2013) refers to a rebel offensive during the Syrian Civil War in the Rif Dimashq Governorate (which surrounds Damascus) which started in November 2012, and a subsequent attempted Syrian Army counterattack in January 2013. Thomson Reuters described rebels as "ramping up attacks on Damascus" in late November and BBC News described the 29 November government counterattack as "an unprecedented offensive against rebel-held districts in the east of the city".
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2012年11月至2013年2月里夫大马士革省攻势
zh.s: 里夫大马士革省攻势（2012年11月至2013年2月）是叙利亚内战期间反政府武装在里夫大马士革省（环绕大马士革）发动的一次攻势，随后叙利亚政府军于2013年1月尝试反攻。路透社在11月下旬称，反政府武装正在“加大对大马士革的攻击”；BBC则将政府军11月29日的反攻称为针对该市东部反政府武装控制区的“前所未有的攻势”。
zh.n: 本条目记录源信息框所列攻势的开始日期。

en.s: The 2012 Supercopa Argentina Final was the 1st edition of the Supercopa, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Argentine Primera División and Copa Argentina competitions. The match was held in the Estadio Bicentenario of Catamarca, where Arsenal de Sarandí beat Boca Juniors via penalty shoot-out, winning their first Supercopa title.

zh.s: 2012年阿根廷超级杯决赛是首届超级杯赛事。这项年度足球赛由上赛季阿根廷甲级联赛冠军对阵阿根廷杯冠军。比赛在卡塔马卡百年体育场举行，萨兰迪兵工厂队在点球大战中击败博卡青年队，首次赢得超级杯冠军。

en.s: The 2012 Guatemala earthquake occurred on November 7 at 10:35:45 local time. The shock had a moment magnitude of 7.4 and a maximum Mercalli Intensity of VII (Very strong). The epicenter was located in the Pacific Ocean, 35 kilometres (22 mi) south of Champerico in the department of Retalhuleu. The affected region is earthquake-prone, where the Cocos plate is being subducted along the Middle America Trench beneath the North American and the Caribbean plates, near their triple junction.
en.n: This entry records the local date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2012年11月7日当地时间10时35分45秒，危地马拉发生地震，矩震级为7.4级，麦加利烈度最高达到VII级（很强）。震中位于太平洋上，距雷塔卢莱乌省钱佩里科以南35公里。该地区地震频繁；科科斯板块在中美洲海沟俯冲到北美板块和加勒比板块之下，震中附近正处于三大板块交界处。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的当地日期。
