loc: 福克兰群岛（马尔维纳斯群岛）

en.s: The Falkland Islands general election of 2013 was held on Thursday 7 November 2013 to elect all eight members of the Legislative Assembly (five from the Stanley constituency and three from the Camp constituency) through universal suffrage using block voting, with each Stanley constituent having up to 5 votes and each Camp constituent having up to 3 votes. A total of 1,046 ballots (4,750 votes) were cast in Stanley, representing a turn-out of 75.4%, and 242 ballots (675 votes) in Camp, representing a turn-out of 85.5%. As no political parties are active in the Falklands, all the candidates stood as Independents.

zh.s: 福克兰群岛于2013年11月7日星期四举行大选，以普选和全票制选出立法议会全部8名议员，其中斯坦利选区选出5名，坎普选区选出3名。斯坦利投出1046张选票、共4750票，投票率为75.4%；坎普投出242张选票、共675票，投票率为85.5%。福克兰群岛没有活跃的政党，因此所有候选人都以独立人士身份参选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2014 Indonesia Super League final was the final match of the 2014 Indonesia Super League which took place on 7 November 2014 at Jakabaring Stadium in Palembang and was contested by Persipura and Persib. Persib won the match 5–3 on penalties, following a 2–2 draw after extra time, for their first Indonesia Super League title.

zh.t: 2014年印度尼西亚超级联赛决赛
zh.s: 2014年印度尼西亚超级联赛决赛于2014年11月7日在巨港的雅加巴林体育场举行，由佩西普拉和万隆队交锋。双方在加时赛后以2比2战平，万隆队随后在点球大战中以5比3获胜，首次夺得印度尼西亚超级联赛冠军。

en.s: The 2015 FFA Cup final was the second final of the FFA Cup (now known as the Australia Cup), the premier soccer knockout cup competition in Australia. The match was held on 7 November 2015 at AAMI Park. The final was held on a Saturday night for the first time. Adelaide United were the defending champions, though they were knocked out of the competition at the Quarter-Final stage by rivals Melbourne Victory.

zh.s: 2015年澳大利亚足总杯决赛是澳大利亚顶级足球淘汰赛、澳大利亚足总杯（现称澳大利亚杯）的第二场决赛。比赛于2015年11月7日在AAMI公园举行，这是决赛首次在周六夜间进行。卫冕冠军阿德莱德联队在四分之一决赛中被对手墨尔本胜利队淘汰。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Belfort vs. Henderson 3
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Belfort vs. Henderson 3 (also known as UFC Fight Night 77) was a mixed martial arts event held on November 7, 2015, at the Ginásio do Ibirapuera in São Paulo, Brazil.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：贝尔福特对阵亨德森（三番战）
zh.s: 2015年11月7日，终极格斗冠军赛在巴西圣保罗的伊比拉普埃拉体育馆举办了UFC格斗之夜：贝尔福特对阵亨德森（三番战）赛事，也称UFC格斗之夜77。这是一场综合格斗赛事。

en.s: The 2016 general election in Yukon, Canada, took place on November 7, 2016, to return members to the 34th Yukon legislative assembly. The election was fought over issues relating to the economy, the environment, First Nations reconciliation, fracking, and the merits of a territorial carbon tax. Sandy Silver's Liberal Party won an upset victory over the incumbent Yukon Party government led by Darrell Pasloski, who lost his own seat in the riding of Mountainview.

zh.s: 加拿大育空地区于2016年11月7日举行大选，选出第34届育空立法会成员。竞选议题包括经济、环境、原住民和解、压裂开采以及地区碳税的利弊。桑迪·西尔弗领导的自由党意外击败达雷尔·帕斯洛斯基领导的时任育空党政府。帕斯洛斯基本人也在山景选区失去席位。

en.s: St. Petersburg, Florida, held a general election for mayor on August 29 and November 7, 2017, with a primary election which took place on August 29, 2017. Incumbent mayor Rick Kriseman, a Democrat, opted to seek re-election. His opponent in the runoff was Republican former mayor Rick Baker (2001–2010). The election was officially non-partisan. Incumbent Rick Kriseman won re-election.

zh.t: 2017年佛罗里达州圣彼得堡市长选举
zh.s: 佛罗里达州圣彼得堡于2017年8月29日和11月7日举行市长大选，初选于2017年8月29日举行。现任民主党市长里克·克里斯曼决定竞选连任。他在决选中的对手是共和党人、前市长里克·贝克（2001—2010年任职）。这场选举正式上不分党派，现任市长克里斯曼成功连任。

en.s: The 2017 United States state legislative elections were held on November 7, 2017. Three legislative chambers in two states held regularly scheduled elections. These off-year elections coincided with other state and local elections, including gubernatorial elections in two states. Democrats won control of the Washington Senate through a special election for a seat previously held by a Republican, ending Republican-led coalition control there.

zh.s: 2017年美国州议会选举于2017年11月7日举行。两个州的3个州议会院按计划举行选举。这些非总统选举年份的选举与其他州和地方选举同时进行，包括两个州的州长选举。民主党在特别选举中赢得华盛顿州参议院一个原由共和党占据的席位，从而结束了共和党主导的联合执政。

en.s: The 2017 Flint mayoral recall election took place on November 7, 2017. Incumbent Mayor Karen Weaver ran to retain her seat after opponents, alleging corruption, gathered signatures to force a recall election two years into Weaver's term as Mayor. Seventeen opponents filed to run against Weaver in the election, the most prominent of which was City Councilman Scott Kincaid.

zh.s: 2017年弗林特市长罢免选举于2017年11月7日举行。时任市长凯伦·韦弗竞选留任。任期刚过两年，反对者指控她腐败并收集签名，要求举行罢免选举。共有17名反对者登记参选，是韦弗的对手，其中最知名的是市议员斯科特·金凯德。

en.s: The 2017 Virginia Attorney General election was held on November 7, 2017. The incumbent attorney general, Democrat Mark Herring, was expected to run for governor, but announced he would run for re-election instead. As only Herring and Republican John Adams qualified for their respective party primaries, the two automatically became their parties' nominees. In the general election, Herring defeated Adams to win a second term as Attorney General of Virginia.

zh.t: 2017年弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2017年弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举于2017年11月7日举行。时任民主党总检察长马克·赫林原本预计会竞选州长，但后来宣布改为竞选连任。由于只有赫林和共和党人约翰·亚当斯符合各自政党的初选资格，两人自动获得各自政党的提名。大选中，赫林击败亚当斯，赢得第二个总检察长任期。

en.s: The 2017 Hialeah mayoral election took place on November 7, 2017. Incumbent Mayor Carlos Hernández ran for re-election to a second full term. Former interim Mayor Julio Martínez, one of Hernández's opponents in 2013, challenged Hernández's eligibility to run, arguing that the city charter's term limits counted the partial term he served from 2011 to 2013 as a full term.

zh.s: 2017年海厄利亚市长选举于2017年11月7日举行。时任市长卡洛斯·埃尔南德斯竞选连任第二个完整任期。前代理市长胡利奥·马丁内斯曾在2013年与埃尔南德斯竞争，此次质疑埃尔南德斯参选资格，认为市宪章规定的任期限制应把他2011至2013年担任的部分任期算作一个完整任期。

en.s: After previously stating that he would not run for re-election, Jason Chaffetz announced on May 19 that he was resigning his seat in the House, effective June 30. A special election was called to replace him with a filing period opening on May 19 and closing by June 30, an expected primary date of August 15, and an election day of November 7. A crowded field of candidates emerged to compete for spots in their respective parties' primaries. 15 Republicans, 4 Democrats, 2 Independent American Party members and 1 Libertarian declared their candidacy. Candidates could qualify for the primary ballot by either being nominated by delegates at their party's convention or gathering 7,000 signatures from registered voters. Those gathering signatures could also seek nomination at their party's convention. The Republican and Democratic parties held conventions June 17 to select a nominee from the declared. The primary election to determine the Republican Party's candidate for the general election was held on August 15. In addition to the partisan candidates, one unaffiliated candidate appeared on the general election ballot and two candidates ran as a write-in. The general election was held on Tuesday, November 7, 2017.

zh.t: 2017年犹他州第三国会选区联邦众议员特别选举
zh.s: 杰森·查菲茨此前曾表示不会竞选连任，后于5月19日宣布辞去联邦众议员职务，6月30日生效。随后举行特别选举填补该席位，提名登记期从5月19日开始、于6月30日截止，原定8月15日举行初选，正式选举日为11月7日。共有15名共和党人、4名民主党人、2名美国独立党成员和1名自由党人宣布参选。共和党和民主党于6月17日召开党代表大会选出候选人；8月15日举行了共和党初选。

en.s: The 2017 Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 2017, to elect the next governor of Virginia. The election was held concurrently with other elections for Virginia's statewide offices, the House of Delegates, and other United States' offices. Incumbent Democratic governor Terry McAuliffe was ineligible to run for re-election, as the Constitution of Virginia prohibits its governors from serving consecutive terms.

zh.s: 2017年弗吉尼亚州州长选举于2017年11月7日举行，以选出下一任州长。选举与弗吉尼亚州其他全州公职、州众议院及其他美国公职选举同时进行。由于弗吉尼亚州宪法禁止州长连续任期，时任民主党州长特里·麦考利夫不能竞选连任。

en.s: Elections for members of the New York City Council were held on November 7, 2017. Primary elections were held on September 12 for all 51 districts of the city council.

zh.s: 纽约市议会成员选举于2017年11月7日举行。市议会全部51个选区的初选均于9月12日举行。

loc: 美国宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦

en.s: The 2017 mayoral election in Allentown, Pennsylvania was held on November 7, 2017, and resulted in the incumbent mayor Ed Pawlowski, a member of the Democratic Party, being re-elected to a fourth term over Republican Party candidate Nat Hyman.

zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦市长选举于2017年11月7日举行。民主党籍时任市长埃德·帕夫洛夫斯基击败共和党候选人纳特·海曼，成功连任第四届。

en.s: The 2017 New Jersey State Senate elections were held on November 7, 2017, to elect senators for all 40 legislative districts across New Jersey. These elections coincided with the election of Governor Phil Murphy. The winners of this election would serve in the 218th New Jersey Legislature, with seats apportioned based on the 2010 United States census.

zh.s: 2017年新泽西州参议院选举于2017年11月7日举行，改选新泽西州全部40个立法选区的参议员。选举与菲尔·墨菲当选州长同时举行。胜选者进入新泽西州第218届立法机关，席位分配依据2010年美国人口普查。

en.s: The 2017 New Jersey General Assembly elections were held on November 7, 2017, to elect members to all 80 seats of the New Jersey General Assembly. Prior to the elections, Democrats held a 52–28 majority in the lower house. Overall, the Democrats increased their majority by 2 to a super-majority at 54–26, due to holding all their seats as well as picking up open seats in District 2 and District 16.

zh.s: 2017年新泽西州州议会选举于2017年11月7日举行，改选新泽西州州议会全部80个席位。选举前，民主党在州众议院以52席对28席占多数。民主党保住所有原有席位，并赢得第2和第16选区的空缺席位，总席位增加2席，以54席对26席取得三分之二多数。

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 2017 was held on Tuesday, November 7, 2017, to elect the mayor of Boston, Massachusetts. Incumbent Democratic mayor Marty J. Walsh won re-election to a second term, defeating District 7 City Councilor Tito Jackson, and two long-shot candidates, Robert Cappucci and Joseph Wiley. A non-partisan preliminary election was held on Tuesday, September 26, 2017, with Walsh and Jackson advancing into a November runoff election.

zh.s: 2017年波士顿市长选举于2017年11月7日（星期二）举行。民主党籍时任市长马蒂·J·沃尔什以击败第7选区市议员蒂托·杰克逊以及两名胜算较低的候选人罗伯特·卡普奇和约瑟夫·威利，成功连任第二届。无党派初选于2017年9月26日（星期二）举行，沃尔什和杰克逊进入11月决选。

en.s: The 2017 New Jersey gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 2017, to elect the governor of New Jersey. Incumbent Republican governor Chris Christie was term-limited and ineligible to seek re-election to a third consecutive term. Former U.S. Ambassador to Germany, Phil Murphy and former Speaker of the Assembly Sheila Oliver won the gubernatorial election in a landslide, defeating incumbent lieutenant governor Kim Guadagno and the incumbent Mayor of Woodcliff Lake Carlos Rendo by a wide margin of 14.14%.

zh.s: 2017年新泽西州州长选举于2017年11月7日举行，以选出该州州长。时任共和党州长克里斯·克里斯蒂受任期限制，不能竞选连续第三届。前美国驻德国大使菲尔·墨菲和州议会前议长谢拉·奥利弗组成的民主党搭档以压倒性优势赢得州长选举，以14.14个百分点的差距击败时任副州长金·瓜达尼奥和伍德克利夫湖市时任市长卡洛斯·伦多组成的搭档。

en.s: An election for Mayor of New York City was held on November 7, 2017. Incumbent Democratic Mayor Bill de Blasio won re-election to a second term with 66.2% of the vote against Republican Nicole Malliotakis.

zh.s: 纽约市市长选举于2017年11月7日举行。民主党籍时任市长比尔·白思豪以66.2%的得票率击败共和党候选人妮可·马利奥塔基斯，成功连任第二届。

en.s: The 2017 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 2017. After the party primary elections were held, the major party nominees were Jill Vogel (Republican) and Justin Fairfax (Democrat). The incumbent lieutenant governor, Democrat Ralph Northam, declined to run for re-election in order to run for governor. In the general election on November 7, 2017, Democratic nominee Justin Fairfax defeated Republican state senator Jill Vogel to become the 41st lieutenant governor of Virginia.

zh.s: 2017年弗吉尼亚州副州长选举于2017年11月7日举行。政党初选结束后，主要政党的候选人分别是共和党人吉尔·沃格尔和民主党人贾斯汀·费尔法克斯。民主党籍时任副州长拉尔夫·诺瑟姆放弃竞选连任，转而竞选州长。大选中，费尔法克斯击败共和党州参议员沃格尔，当选弗吉尼亚州第41任副州长。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of New Jersey on November 7, 2017. Primary elections were held on June 6. All elected offices at the state level were on the ballot in this election cycle, including Governor and Lieutenant Governor for four-year terms, all 80 seats in the New Jersey General Assembly for two-year terms, and all 40 seats in the State Senate for four-year terms.

zh.s: 新泽西州于2017年11月7日举行大选。初选于6月6日举行。本轮选举改选所有州级公职，包括任期四年的州长和副州长、任期两年的州议会全部80个席位，以及任期四年的州参议院全部40个席位。

en.s: A general election was held in Minneapolis on November 7, 2017. Minneapolis's mayor was up for election as well as all the seats on the City Council, the two elected seats on the Board of Estimate and Taxation, and all the seats on the Park and Recreation Board. Voters were able to rank up to three candidates for each office in order of preference.

zh.s: 明尼阿波利斯于2017年11月7日举行大选，选举市长、市议会全部席位、估价与税收委员会两个民选席位，以及公园和娱乐委员会全部席位。选民可以按照偏好顺序为每个职位最多排列3名候选人。

en.s: The Hoboken mayoral election of 2017 was an election to determine the mayor of Hoboken, New Jersey in the term of 2018–2022. The election took place on November 7, 2017. Incumbent mayor Dawn Zimmer announced that she would not run for a third term on June 20, 2017, hoping to pursue climate change issues higher up in the chain of government, and endorsed City Councilman Ravinder Bhalla.

zh.s: 2017年霍博肯市长选举于2017年11月7日举行，选出2018至2022年任期的市长。时任市长道恩·齐默于2017年6月20日宣布不竞选第三届，希望在更高层级的政府中推动气候变化议题，并支持市议员拉文德·巴拉竞选。

en.s: The 2017 Miami mayoral election took place on November 7, 2017. Incumbent Mayor Tomás Regalado was term-limited and could not run for re-election. City Commissioner Francis Suarez, the son of former Mayor Xavier Suarez, ran to succeed him. He faced three little-known opponents and entered the election as the frontrunner, with endorsements from the Miami Herald and the Miami Times.

zh.s: 2017年迈阿密市长选举于2017年11月7日举行。时任市长托马斯·雷加拉多受任期限制，不能竞选连任。前市长泽维尔·苏亚雷斯的儿子、市委员弗朗西斯·苏亚雷斯参选接替他。他有3名知名度较低的对手，竞选前被视为领先者，并获得《迈阿密先驱报》和《迈阿密时报》支持。

en.s: The Jersey City mayoral election of 2017 was held on November 7, 2017. Democrat Steve Fulop was re-elected to a second term with 77% of the vote. This was the first mayoral election after Jersey City voters approved moving the elections from May to November, following a 2016 referendum.

zh.s: 2017年泽西市市长选举于2017年11月7日举行。民主党人史蒂夫·富洛普以77%的得票率成功连任第二届。这是泽西市选民在2016年公投通过将选举从5月改到11月后举行的首场市长选举。

en.t: 2017 New York City borough president elections
en.s: The 2017 New York City borough president elections were held on November 7, 2017, to elect the presidents of each of the five boroughs in New York City. They coincided with other city elections, including for mayor, public advocate, and city council. All five incumbents were re-elected, and Democrats won all boroughs except for Staten Island.

zh.s: 2017年纽约市行政区区长选举于2017年11月7日举行，选出纽约市5个行政区各自的区长。选举与其他市级选举同时举行，包括市长、市公益维护人和市议会选举。5名时任区长全部连任，民主党赢得除史泰登岛外的所有行政区。

en.s: The 2017 mayoral election in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania was held on November 7, 2017, and resulted in incumbent mayor Eric Papenfuse, a member of the Democratic Party, being re-elected to a second term.

zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州哈里斯堡市长选举于2017年11月7日举行。民主党籍时任市长埃里克·帕彭富斯成功连任第二届。

en.s: The 2017 Cincinnati mayoral election took place on November 7, 2017, to elect the Mayor of Cincinnati, Ohio. The election was officially nonpartisan, with the top two candidates from the May 2 primary election advancing to the general election, regardless of party. Incumbent Democratic Mayor John Cranley won re-election to a second term. While the election was nonpartisan, all the candidates were known Democrats.

zh.s: 2017年辛辛那提市长选举于2017年11月7日举行，选出俄亥俄州辛辛那提市市长。该选举正式上为无党派选举，5月2日初选中排名前两位的候选人进入大选，不论党派。民主党籍时任市长约翰·克兰利成功连任第二届。虽然选举不分党派，所有候选人均被认为是民主党人。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 7, 2017, in two states: Virginia and New Jersey. These elections formed part of the 2017 United States elections. The last regular gubernatorial elections for these two states were in 2013. Both incumbents were term-limited, so both seats were open. Democrats held the governorship in Virginia and picked up the governorship of New Jersey.

zh.s: 2017年11月7日，美国弗吉尼亚州和新泽西州举行州长选举，是2017年美国选举的一部分。这两个州上次定期州长选举都在2013年举行。由于两位时任州长都受任期限制，两个州长职位均无时任州长竞选连任。民主党保住弗吉尼亚州州长职位，并赢得新泽西州州长职位。

en.s: The 2017 mayoral election in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, was held on November 7, 2017, and resulted in the election of Democratic Party nominee Danene Sorace to her first term as mayor.

zh.t: 2017年宾夕法尼亚州兰开斯特市长选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州兰开斯特市市长选举于2017年11月7日举行。民主党候选人丹妮娜·索拉斯当选，开始首个市长任期。

en.s: The 2017 Minneapolis City Council election was held on November 7, 2017, to elect the members of the Minneapolis City Council. The political composition remained unchanged, with the Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL) retaining 12 seats and the Green Party of Minnesota one seat. Three DFL incumbents were defeated by intraparty opponents. The new City Council convened on January 8, 2018.

zh.t: 2017年明尼阿波利斯市议会选举
zh.s: 2017年明尼阿波利斯市议会选举于2017年11月7日举行。市议会的党派构成没有变化，明尼苏达州民主农民劳工党保有12席，明尼苏达州绿党保有1席。3名民主农民劳工党籍时任议员在党内竞争中落败。新一届市议会于2018年1月8日召开会议。

en.s: The 2017 Minneapolis mayoral election was held on November 7, 2017, to elect the mayor of Minneapolis. This was the third mayoral election in the city's history to use ranked-choice voting. Municipal elections in Minnesota are nonpartisan, although candidates were able to identify with a political party on the ballot. No candidate achieved a majority in the first round of ballot counting on election night.

zh.s: 2017年明尼阿波利斯市长选举于2017年11月7日举行。这是该市历史上第三次使用排序选择投票的市长选举。明尼苏达州市政选举不分党派，但候选人可以在选票上标明党派。选举夜第一轮计票后，没有候选人获得过半票数。

en.s: The 2017 Kansas City, Kansas mayoral election took place on November 7, 2017, to elect the Mayor/CEO of the United Government of Wyandotte County and Kansas City, Kansas. The election is officially nonpartisan. Incumbent Mark Holland ran for reelection and faced David Alvey in the general election. Alvey and Holland received 51.84% and 47.4% of the vote respectively. Holland conceded on election night.

zh.t: 2017年堪萨斯州堪萨斯城（堪萨斯州）市长选举
zh.s: 2017年堪萨斯州堪萨斯城市长/首席执行官选举于2017年11月7日举行，选出怀恩多特县与堪萨斯州堪萨斯城统一政府的市长兼首席执行官。该选举正式上为无党派选举。时任市长马克·霍兰德竞选连任，在大选中对阵戴维·阿尔维。阿尔维和霍兰德的得票率分别为51.84%和47.4%。霍兰德在选举夜承认败选。

en.t: 2017 New York City Public Advocate election
en.s: The 2017 New York City Public Advocate election was held on November 7, 2017. Letitia James defeated challenger David Eisenbach in the Democratic primary on September 12, 2017. To date, James is the last citywide Democrat to carry Staten Island in a general election.

zh.s: 2017年纽约市公益维护人选举于2017年11月7日举行。莱蒂希娅·詹姆斯于2017年9月12日民主党初选中击败挑战者戴维·艾森巴赫。截至目前，詹姆斯是最近一位在纽约市全市性大选中赢得史泰登岛的民主党人。

en.s: The city of St. Paul, Minnesota held an election on November 7, 2017, to elect its next mayor, which was won by city councilman Melvin Carter III. Chris Coleman, who had served as mayor from 2006, did not run for a fourth term and instead planned to run for Governor of Minnesota in 2018. This was the second mayoral election in St. Paul to use ranked-choice voting.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州圣保罗市于2017年11月7日举行市长选举，选出下一任市长，市议员梅尔文·卡特三世当选。克里斯·科尔曼自2006年起担任市长，没有竞选第四届，而是计划于2018年竞选明尼苏达州州长。这是圣保罗市第二次在市长选举中使用排序选择投票。

en.t: 2017 Washington's 45th state senate district special election
en.s: A special election was held on November 7, 2017, to fill the vacant seat in the Washington State Senate representing the 45th district. The seat was left vacant after the death of incumbent Andy Hill in October 2016. Dino Rossi, a former candidate for U.S. Senate in 2010 and for governor in 2004 and 2008, was appointed to fill the seat until the election.

zh.t: 2017年华盛顿州参议院第45选区特别选举
zh.s: 2017年11月7日，华盛顿州参议院第45选区举行特别选举，以填补空缺席位。时任议员安迪·希尔于2016年10月去世，导致席位空缺。曾在2010年竞选联邦参议员、并于2004年和2008年竞选州长的迪诺·罗西获任命暂代该席位，直至举行选举。

en.s: The 2017 Lansing mayoral election was held on November 7, 2017, following a primary election on August 8, 2017. Incumbent Mayor Virgil Bernero declined to seek a fourth term, and a crowded race developed to succeed him. State Representative Andy Schor placed first in the primary election by a wide margin, winning 68 percent of the vote, and he advanced to the general election with City Councilwoman Judi Brown Clarke, who won 23 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2017年11月7日，兰辛举行市长选举，初选于同年8月8日举行。时任市长维吉尔·贝尔内罗决定不竞选第四个任期，众多候选人参加角逐。州众议员安迪·肖尔在初选中以较大优势排名第一，获得68%的选票，并与获得23%选票的市议员朱迪·布朗·克拉克一同进入普选。

en.s: The 2017 Erie County Executive election was held on November 7, 2017. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Kathy Dahlkemper ran for re-election to a second term. She won renomation and then faced businessman Art Oligeri, the Republican nominee, in the general election. Despite Donald Trump's victory in the county in the 2016 presidential election, Dahlkemper narrowly defeated Oligeri, winning re-election by a 304-vote margin.

zh.t: 2017年宾夕法尼亚州伊利县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2017年11月7日，宾夕法尼亚州伊利县举行行政长官选举。民主党籍现任行政长官凯西·达尔肯珀竞选连任第二个任期。她再次获得提名，并在普选中对阵共和党提名人、商人阿特·奥利杰里。尽管唐纳德·特朗普在2016年总统选举中赢得伊利县，达尔肯珀仍以304票的微弱优势击败奥利杰里，成功连任。

en.s: The 2017 Northampton County Executive election was held on November 7, 2017. Incumbent Republican County Executive John Brown, who was the unsuccessful Republican nominee for Auditor General in 2016, ran for re-election to a second term. He won the Republican nomination unopposed and faced former County Councilman Lamont McClure, the Democratic nominee, in the general election. McClure defeated Brown by a wide margin, winning 54 percent of the vote to Brown's 46 percent.

zh.t: 2017年宾夕法尼亚州北安普顿县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2017年11月7日，宾夕法尼亚州诺森伯兰县举行行政长官选举。共和党籍现任行政长官约翰·布朗竞选连任第二个任期。他曾在2016年代表共和党竞选审计长但未能当选。布朗在共和党初选中无人竞争，随后在普选中对阵民主党提名人、前县议员拉蒙特·麦克卢尔。麦克卢尔以54%对46%的得票率大胜布朗。

en.s: The 2017 Buffalo mayoral election was held on November 7, 2017. Incumbent three-term Democratic mayor Byron Brown won re-election to a fourth term.

zh.s: 2017年11月7日，布法罗举行市长选举。民主党籍现任市长拜伦·布朗已连任三届，此次再次当选，开始第四个任期。

en.s: The 2017 Lehigh County Executive election was held on November 7, 2017. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Tom Muller declined to seek re-election to a second term, instead endorsing Whitehall Township Commissioner Phillips Armstrong as his successor. Armstrong won the Democratic primary unopposed. County Commissioner Brad Osborne defeated County Controller Glenn Eckhart to win the Republican nomination, 56–44 percent, and faced Armstrong in the general election.

zh.t: 2017年宾夕法尼亚州利哈伊县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2017年11月7日，宾夕法尼亚州利哈伊县举行行政长官选举。民主党籍现任行政长官汤姆·穆勒决定不竞选连任第二个任期，并支持怀特霍尔镇委员菲利普斯·阿姆斯特朗接替自己。阿姆斯特朗在民主党初选中无人竞争。县委员布拉德·奥斯本在共和党初选中以56%对44%的得票率击败县主计长格伦·埃克哈特，获得提名，随后在普选中对阵阿姆斯特朗。

en.s: The 2017 Stamford mayoral election was held on November 7, 2017. The election saw the reelection of David Martin.

zh.s: 2017年11月7日，斯坦福举行市长选举，戴维·马丁连任。

en.s: The 2017 Detroit mayoral election was held on November 7, 2017, to elect the Mayor of Detroit, Michigan. It was the first mayoral election for the city since it emerged from state control under Michigan's emergency manager law. Incumbent Mike Duggan won re-election to a second term. The Mayor of Detroit is elected on a non-partisan basis, where the candidates are not listed by political party.

zh.s: 2017年11月7日，密歇根州底特律举行市长选举。这是该市在州政府依据紧急管理人法案接管后恢复自治以来首次举行市长选举。时任市长迈克·杜根成功连任第二个任期。底特律市长选举不设党派，选票上不会标注候选人的政党。

en.s: The 2017 Greensboro mayoral election was held on November 7, 2017, to elect the mayor of Greensboro, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of Nancy Vaughan.

zh.s: 2017年11月7日，北卡罗来纳州格林斯伯勒举行市长选举。南希·沃恩连任。

en.s: The 2017 Westchester County Executive election was held on November 7, 2017. After a primary in September, State Senator George Latimer was chosen as the Democratic Party candidate to challenge incumbent County Executive Rob Astorino. Latimer defeated Astorino 56.6% to 43.4%. The County Executive race took place alongside elections for the county legislature.

zh.t: 2017年韦斯特切斯特县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2017年11月7日，韦斯特切斯特县举行行政长官选举。9月初选后，州参议员乔治·拉蒂默获民主党提名，挑战时任行政长官罗布·阿斯托里诺。拉蒂默以56.6%对43.4%的得票率击败阿斯托里诺。县议会选举也同期举行。

en.s: The 2017 Charlotte mayoral election took place on Tuesday, November 7, 2017. Party primary elections were held on Tuesday, September 12, 2017. Second-round primaries would have been held on Tuesday, October 10, 2017, if they had been necessary, but both primary winners received more than the minimum 40 percent of the vote needed to avoid a runoff. The incumbent, Democrat Jennifer Roberts, was eligible to run for a second two-year term.

zh.s: 2017年11月7日，夏洛特举行市长选举。各党初选于9月12日星期二举行。如果有必要，第二轮初选原定于10月10日星期二举行，但两党初选获胜者都超过避免决选所需的40%最低得票率，因此没有举行第二轮初选。民主党籍现任市长詹妮弗·罗伯茨有资格竞选第二个两年任期。

en.s: The biennial nonpartisan election for the Mayor of Raleigh, North Carolina, was held on Tuesday, Oct. 10, 2017. As no candidate won a majority of the vote in the first round, a runoff was held on November 7, 2017, as requested by the second-place finisher, Charles Francis. Incumbent Mayor Nancy McFarlane defeated Francis in the runoff, winning a fourth term in office.

zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州罗利举行的两年一度、无党派市长选举首轮于2017年10月10日星期二举行。由于没有候选人获得过半选票，应第二名查尔斯·弗朗西斯的请求，于11月7日举行决选。时任市长南希·麦克法兰击败弗朗西斯，连任第四个任期。

en.s: The 2017 Durham mayoral election was held on November 7, 2017, to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina. It saw the election of Steve Schewel.

zh.s: 2017年11月7日，北卡罗来纳州达勒姆举行市长选举。史蒂夫·舍韦尔当选。

en.s: The 2017 Fayetteville mayoral election took place on November 7, 2017, to elect the mayor of Fayetteville, North Carolina. It saw the election of Mitch Colvin, who unseated incumbent mayor Nat Robertson.

zh.t: 2017年北卡罗来纳州费耶特维尔市长选举
zh.s: 2017年11月7日，北卡罗来纳州费耶特维尔举行市长选举。米奇·科尔文当选，击败时任市长纳特·罗伯逊。

en.s: The 2017 King County Executive election took place on November 7, 2017, following a primary on August 1, 2017. Incumbent County Executive Dow Constantine ran for re-election to a third term. He faced little-known challengers, and placed first in the primary by a wide margin, winning 77 percent of the vote. Retired engineer Bill Hirt placed second with 13 percent and advanced to the general election.

zh.s: 2017年11月7日，金县举行行政长官选举，初选于8月1日举行。时任行政长官道·康斯坦丁竞选第三个任期。他面对几名知名度不高的挑战者，并在初选中以77%的得票率大幅领先，排名第一。退休工程师比尔·赫特以13%的得票率排名第二，进入普选。

en.s: The 2017 Atlanta mayoral election occurred on November 7, 2017, with a runoff election held on December 5, 2017. Incumbent mayor Kasim Reed, a member of the Democratic Party who had been in office since 2010, was ineligible to run for reelection due to term limits. A total of 14 candidates qualified for the November 7 non-partisan election.

zh.s: 2017年11月7日，亚特兰大举行市长选举，并于12月5日举行决选。民主党籍时任市长卡西姆·里德自2010年起任职，受任期限制，不能竞选连任。共有14名候选人通过资格审查，参加11月7日的无党派选举。

en.s: The 2017 Atlantic City mayoral election was held on November 7, 2017, to elect the mayor of Atlantic City, New Jersey. Primary elections were held on June 6. Incumbent Republican Don Guardian lost re-election to a second term to Democratic city councilman Frank Gilliam.

zh.s: 2017年11月7日，新泽西州大西洋城举行市长选举，初选于6月6日举行。共和党籍现任市长唐·加迪安未能连任第二个任期，败给民主党籍市议员弗兰克·吉列姆。

en.s: The 2017 Seattle mayoral election was held on November 7, 2017. It was won by former U.S. Attorney Jenny Durkan, who defeated Cary Moon in the general election by 15 percentage points. The two candidates had advanced from an earlier primary election held in August, which ensured that Seattle would have its first female mayor since Bertha Knight Landes was elected in 1926.

zh.s: 2017年11月7日，西雅图举行市长选举。前美国检察官珍妮·德坎当选，在普选中以15个百分点的优势击败凯莉·穆恩。两人此前在8月举行的初选中胜出，因此西雅图自1926年贝莎·兰德斯当选后，再次选出女性市长。

en.s: The Dongfeng Renault 2017 Chinese FA Women's Super Cup (Chinese: 东风雷诺2017中国足协女子超级杯) was the 16th Chinese FA Women's Super Cup, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Chinese Women's Super League and Chinese Women's Football Championship. The match was contested at Wuhan Sports Center Stadium by 2017 Chinese Women's Football Championship winners Shanghai, and Dalian Quanjian, champions of the 2017 Chinese Women's Super League, on 7 November 2017.

zh.s: 东风雷诺2017中国足协女子超级杯是第16届中国足协女子超级杯。这项年度足球赛事由上赛季中国女子足球超级联赛冠军对阵中国女子足球锦标赛冠军。2017年11月7日，2017年女足锦标赛冠军上海队与2017年中国女子足球超级联赛冠军大连权健队在武汉体育中心体育场交手。

en.s: The 2017 Pittsburgh mayoral election took place on November 7, 2017. The primary election was held on May 16, 2017. Incumbent Democratic Mayor Bill Peduto successfully ran for re-election to a second term. Three Democrats, including Peduto, and no Republicans filed petitions to appear on the respective primary ballots before the deadline on March 7, 2017. Peduto won the Democratic primary and was officially unopposed in the general election.

zh.s: 2017年11月7日，匹兹堡举行市长选举，初选于同年5月16日举行。民主党籍时任市长比尔·佩杜托成功连任第二个任期。3月7日截止前，共有三名民主党人（包括佩杜托）提交申请，要求参加各自的初选；没有共和党人提交申请。佩杜托赢得民主党初选，因此在普选中没有对手。

en.t: 2017 Westchester County Board of Legislators elections
en.s: The 2017 Westchester County Board of Legislators elections were held on 7 November 2017 in conjunction with the 2017 Westchester County Executive election. The elections resulted in major gains for the Democratic Party with the party flipping three previously Republican seats and control of the County Legislature from a Republican led Coalition. Benjamin Boykin became chair of the board and Catherine Parker Majority leader.

zh.t: 2017年韦斯特切斯特县立法机构选举
zh.s: 2017年11月7日，韦斯特切斯特县举行立法机构选举，与该县行政长官选举同期举行。民主党大幅增加席位，翻转了三个此前由共和党控制的席位，并从共和党主导的联盟手中夺得县议会控制权。班杰明·博伊金出任议长，凯瑟琳·帕克出任多数党领袖。

en.s: The 2017 Cleveland mayoral election took place on November 7, 2017, to elect the Mayor of Cleveland, Ohio. The election was officially nonpartisan, with the top two candidates from the September 12 primary election advancing to the general election, regardless of party. Incumbent Democratic Mayor Frank G. Jackson won reelection to a fourth term.

zh.s: 2017年11月7日，俄亥俄州克利夫兰举行市长选举。选举名义上不设党派，9月12日初选中得票最高的两名候选人不论党派都进入普选。民主党籍现任市长弗兰克·G·杰克逊成功连任第四个任期。

en.s: The 2017 Annapolis mayoral election was held on November 7, 2017, to elect the mayor of Annapolis, Maryland. Mike Pantelides, the incumbent mayor, ran for a second term as mayor. Democratic nominee Gavin Buckley won the election with 61.06% of the vote, becoming the city's next mayor.

zh.s: 2017年11月7日，马里兰州安纳波利斯举行市长选举。时任市长迈克·潘特利德斯竞选连任第二个任期。民主党候选人加文·巴克利以61.06%的得票率获胜，成为该市下一任市长。

en.s: The 2017 Virginia House of Delegates election was held on Tuesday, November 7. All 100 seats in the Virginia House of Delegates were contested. The Republican Party held a 66–34 majority in the House of Delegates before the election but lost 15 seats to the Democratic Party, resulting in the Republicans holding a 50–49 advantage.

zh.s: 2017年11月7日星期二，弗吉尼亚州举行众议院选举，全部100个席位改选。选举前，共和党以66席对34席占多数，但此次失去15席，最终仍以50席对49席领先。

en.t: Shamshad TV is attacked by gunmen and suicide bombers, with a security guard killed and 20 people wounded; ISIS claims responsibility for the attack
en.s: Shamshad Media Network (Pashto: شمشاد) is based in Afghanistan and Dubai. Shamshad Media Network is a private and an independent network based in Afghanistan, which began transmission in 2005. Shamshad's broadcast area covers a large portion of the country where ethnic Pashtuns live and also covering isolated areas.

zh.t: 武装人员和自杀式袭击者袭击Shamshad电视台：一名保安遇难、20人受伤，ISIS宣称负责
zh.s: Shamshad传媒网络（普什图语：شمشاد）设在阿富汗和迪拜，是一家独立的私营媒体网络，自2005年开始播出。其节目覆盖阿富汗大部分普什图人聚居区，也覆盖一些偏远地区。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Madagascar on 7 November 2018. As no candidate received a majority of the vote, a second round involving the top two candidates, Andry Rajoelina and Marc Ravalomanana, was held on 19 December. On 27 December Rajoelina was announced as the winner with 56% of the vote.

zh.s: 马达加斯加于2018年11月7日举行总统选举。由于没有候选人得票过半，得票最高的两名候选人安德里·拉乔利纳和马克·拉瓦卢马纳纳于12月19日参加第二轮投票。12月27日，拉乔利纳被宣布以56%的得票率获胜。

en.s: Global Wars 2018 was a professional wrestling tour and livestreaming event co-produced by the American Ring of Honor (ROH) and Japanese New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) promotions. The tour's four events took place on November 7 at the Androscoggin Bank Colisee in Lewiston, Maine, November 8 at Lowell Memorial Auditorium in Lowell, Massachusetts, November 9 at Buffalo RiverWorks in Buffalo, New York and November 11 at Mattamy Athletic Centre in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2018年全球战争摔角巡演及线上直播活动由美国摔角联盟ROH与日本新日本职业摔角联合举办。巡演共举行4场：11月7日在缅因州刘易斯顿举行，11月8日在马萨诸塞州洛厄尔举行，11月9日在纽约州布法罗举行，11月11日在加拿大安大略省多伦多举行。
zh.n: 本条目记录源信息框列出的活动日期。

en.s: General elections were held in Mauritius on 7 November 2019. The governing Alliance Morisien, which changed its name from Alliance Lepep before the election, came to power in 2014 after defeating the Labour Party-led government in an upset. Pravind Jugnauth became prime minister in 2017, succeeding his father, Anerood Jugnauth. The opposition denounced the transition, claiming it was nepotism.

zh.s: 2019年11月7日，毛里求斯举行大选。执政的毛里求斯联盟在选举前由“人民联盟”改名而来。该联盟于2014年击败工党领导的政府、出人意料地上台执政。普拉温德·贾格纳特于2017年接替父亲阿内鲁德·贾格纳特出任总理。反对派谴责这次权力交接，称其为任人唯亲。

en.s: The 2020 People's National Party (PNP) leadership election was triggered after Peter Phillips announced his intention to resign as Leader of the People's National Party following the party's defeat at the 2020 general election. It was held on November 7, 2020. If Hanna was elected, she would have served as the second female President of a Jamaican political party and the second female Leader of the Opposition in Jamaican history.

zh.s: 彼得·菲利普斯宣布，人民民族党在2020年大选中失利后，他打算辞去党主席职务，随后触发2020年人民民族党领导人选举。选举于2020年11月7日举行。如果哈娜当选，她将成为牙买加政党史上第二位女性党主席，也是牙买加历史上第二位女性反对党领袖。

en.t: UFC on ESPN: Santos vs. Teixeira
en.s: UFC on ESPN: Santos vs. Teixeira (also known as UFC on ESPN 17 and UFC Vegas 13) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on November 7, 2020 at the UFC Apex facility in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area, United States.

zh.t: UFC ESPN赛事：桑托斯对阵特谢拉
zh.s: UFC ESPN赛事：桑托斯对阵特谢拉（又称UFC ESPN 17、UFC维加斯13）是终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）主办的综合格斗赛事，于2020年11月7日在美国内华达州恩特普赖斯的UFC Apex场馆举行。恩特普赖斯属于拉斯维加斯都会区。

en.t: Joe Biden is confirmed elected as the 46th president of the United States, defeating incumbent Donald Trump
en.s: Joseph Robinette Biden Jr. (born November 20, 1942) is an American retired politician who served as the 46th president of the United States from 2021 to 2025. A member of the Democratic Party, he represented Delaware in the United States Senate from 1973 to 2009 and also served as the 47th vice president under President Barack Obama from 2009 to 2017.

zh.t: 乔·拜登确认当选美国第46任总统，击败时任总统唐纳德·特朗普
zh.s: 小约瑟夫·罗比内特·拜登（生于1942年11月20日）是美国退休政治人物，曾于2021年至2025年担任美国第46任总统。他是民主党成员，1973年至2009年代表特拉华州担任联邦参议员，并于2009年至2017年在总统巴拉克·奥巴马手下担任第47任副总统。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in the city of Montreal, Quebec, Canada, on November 7, 2021, as part of the 2021 Quebec municipal elections. Voters elected 103 representatives in a first-past-the-post electoral system. The general election decides the majority composition of the city council and each of the 19 borough councils. The newly elected mayor appoints 2 city councillors for the Ville-Marie borough.

zh.s: 加拿大魁北克省蒙特利尔市于2021年11月7日举行市政选举，是2021年魁北克省市政选举的一部分。选民通过领先者当选制选出103名代表。大选决定市议会和19个区议会的多数构成。新当选市长任命2名市议员代表玛丽城区。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Quebec City on November 7, 2021, the same day as elections in Montreal and other municipalities in the province.

zh.s: 2021年11月7日，魁北克市举行市政选举；蒙特利尔及该省其他市镇也在同一天举行选举。

en.s: General elections were held in Nicaragua on 7 November 2021 to elect the President, the National Assembly and members of the Central American Parliament. These were the last elections held before Ortega's abolition of elections in Nicaragua in 2026, citing a perceived need to form a "wall" against opposition movements. President Daniel Ortega of the Sandinista National Liberation Front sought re-election, while five opposition candidates appeared on the ballot.

zh.s: 尼加拉瓜于2021年11月7日举行大选，选举总统、国民议会议员和中美洲议会议员。总统丹尼尔·奥尔特加代表桑地诺民族解放阵线竞选连任，选票上另有5名反对派候选人。

en.s: The Canadian province of Quebec held municipal elections in its municipalities on November 7, 2021.

zh.s: 加拿大魁北克省各市镇于2021年11月7日举行市政选举。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in the Canadian province of Prince Edward Island on November 7, 2022.

zh.s: 加拿大爱德华王子岛省于2022年11月7日举行市政选举。

en.s: The 2023 Virginia Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 7, 2023, concurrently with elections for the Virginia House of Delegates, to elect senators to all 40 seats in the Senate of Virginia for the 163rd and 164th Virginia Assembly. Nomination primaries held through the Department of Elections were held June 20, 2023. These were the first elections held following redistricting as a result of the 2020 census.

zh.s: 2023年弗吉尼亚州参议院选举于11月7日星期二举行，与弗吉尼亚州众议院选举同时进行，选出弗吉尼亚州议会第163届和第164届的40名参议员。候选人提名初选由选举部门于2023年6月20日举行。这是2020年人口普查后重新划分选区以来的首次选举。

en.s: Elections were held in Texas on November 7, 2023. Texas voters statewide voted on 14 proposed amendments to the Texas Constitution. A special election took place to fill the vacancy from Texas's 2nd House of Representatives district, which was followed by a runoff on January 30, 2024. In addition, Texas counties, cities, and school and other special districts had local elections and other ballot issues, such as bond proposals.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州于2023年11月7日举行选举。全州选民就14项得克萨斯州宪法修正案提案投票。得克萨斯州联邦众议院第2选区举行特别选举以填补空缺，随后于2024年1月30日举行决选。此外，得克萨斯州各县、市、学区和其他特别行政区也举行地方选举，并就债券提案等事项进行投票。

en.s: Elections were held in Pennsylvania on November 7, 2023, to fill judicial positions, allow judicial retention votes, and fill numerous county, local and municipal offices, the most prominent being the mayor of Philadelphia. The necessary primary elections were held on May 16, 2023. In addition, special elections for legislative vacancies could be held at various times in 2023.

zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州于2023年11月7日举行选举，改选司法职位、举行司法人员留任投票，并选出多个县、市和地方职位，其中最受关注的是费城的市长选举。必要的初选于2023年5月16日举行。此外，2023年还可在不同时间举行立法职位的特别选举，以填补空缺。

en.s: The 2023 United States attorney general elections were held on November 7, 2023, in the states of Kentucky and Mississippi, with an election held in Louisiana on November 18, to elect the attorneys general of three U.S. states. The previous elections for this group of states took place in 2019. These elections took place concurrently with several other state and local elections.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，肯塔基州和密西西比州举行州检察长选举，路易斯安那州则于11月18日举行选举，选出这三个州的州检察长。这几个州上一次举行此类选举是在2019年。这些选举与多场其他州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 7, 2023, in the states of Kentucky and Mississippi, with an election having occurred in Louisiana on October 14. These elections form part of the 2023 United States elections. The last regular gubernatorial elections for all three states were in 2019. In Louisiana, term-limited incumbent John Bel Edwards was succeeded by Jeff Landry, flipping the seat from Democratic to Republican control.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，肯塔基州和密西西比州举行州长选举，路易斯安那州则于10月14日举行选举。这些选举是2023年美国选举的一部分。这三个州上一次举行常规州长选举是在2019年。在路易斯安那州，受任期限制不能连任的现任民主党州长约翰·贝尔·爱德华兹由杰夫·兰德里接任，州长职位因此由民主党转为共和党执掌。

en.s: The 2023 Mississippi elections took place on November 7, 2023, with the primary on August 8 and any required runoffs on August 29. All executive offices in the state up for election, as well as all 52 seats of the Mississippi State Senate, all 122 seats in the Mississippi House of Representatives, and many local offices. The qualifying deadline for all 2023 Mississippi races was February 1, 2023.

zh.s: 2023年密西西比州选举于2023年11月7日举行，初选于8月8日举行，必要的初选决选于8月29日举行。竞选职位包括州内全部行政职务、州参议院全部52席、州众议院全部122席，以及许多地方职位。2023年所有选举的候选人资格申请截止日期为2月1日。

en.s: The 2023 Mississippi State Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 7, 2023, to elect all 52 members of the Mississippi State Senate to four-year terms. It was held concurrently with elections for all statewide offices and the Mississippi House of Representatives. Primary elections took place on August 8.

zh.s: 2023年密西西比州参议院选举于2023年11月7日（星期二）举行，选出州参议院全部52名议员，任期四年。选举与所有全州公职和密西西比州众议院选举同时进行。初选于8月8日举行。

en.s: The 2023 New Jersey State Senate elections were held on November 7, 2023. New Jersey voters elected state senators in all of the state's legislative districts for a four-year term to the New Jersey Senate. This was the first election after redistricting following the 2020 United States census. The winners of these elections were sworn in on January 9, 2024. Democrats retained their 25–15 majority over Republicans.

zh.s: 2023年新泽西州参议院选举于2023年11月7日举行。新泽西州选民在该州所有立法选区选出州参议员，任期四年。这是2020年美国人口普查后重新划分选区举行的首次选举。胜选者于2024年1月9日宣誓就职。民主党以25席对共和党的15席保住多数。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Kentucky on November 7, 2023. Notably, few Democratic candidates ran for statewide offices. The Lexington Herald-Leader attributed this to Kentucky's strong Republican lean and the fact that Republicans gained seats in the Kentucky General Assembly in 2022.

zh.s: 肯塔基州于2023年11月7日举行大选。值得注意的是，竞选全州公职的民主党候选人很少。《列克星敦先驱报》认为，这是因为肯塔基州明显倾向共和党，而且共和党在2022年赢得了肯塔基州议会的席位。

en.s: The 2023 New Jersey General Assembly elections were held on November 7, 2023. New Jersey voters elected two Assembly members in all of the state's legislative districts for a two-year term to the New Jersey General Assembly. This was the first election after redistricting following the 2020 United States census. Democrats expanded their majority in the chamber by picking up both seats in the 3rd and 11th districts, and one each in the 8th and 30th.

zh.s: 2023年新泽西州州议会选举于2023年11月7日举行。新泽西州选民在该州所有立法选区各选出2名州众议员，任期两年。这是2020年美国人口普查后重新划分选区举行的首次选举。民主党在第3和第11选区各赢得两个席位，并在第8和第30选区各赢得一个席位，多数席位因此增加。

en.s: The 2023 New York City Council elections were held on November 7, 2023, with primaries having occurred on June 27, 2023. Due to redistricting and the 2020 changes to the New York City Charter, councilmembers elected during the 2021 and 2023 City Council elections will serve two-year terms, with full four-year terms resuming after the 2025 New York City Council elections. Party nominees were chosen using ranked-choice voting.

zh.s: 2023年纽约市议会选举于2023年11月7日举行，初选于2023年6月27日举行。由于重新划分选区和2020年《纽约市宪章》修订，在2021年和2023年市议会选举中当选的议员任期为两年；2025年纽约市议会选举后，任期将恢复为完整的四年。各党提名人通过排序选择投票产生。

en.s: The 2023 Mississippi House of Representatives election was held on Tuesday, November 7, 2023, to elect all 122 members of the Mississippi House of Representatives to four-year terms. It was held concurrently with elections for all statewide offices and the Mississippi State Senate. Primary elections took place on August 8. The 2023 election was the first election held under new district maps following redistricting as a result of the 2020 census.

zh.s: 2023年密西西比州众议院选举于2023年11月7日（星期二）举行，选出全部122名州众议员，任期四年。选举与所有全州公职和密西西比州参议院选举同时进行。初选于8月8日举行。这是根据2020年人口普查后重新划定的新选区举行的首场选举。

en.s: The 2023 Philadelphia mayoral election was held on November 7, 2023 to elect the mayor of Philadelphia. Nominees for the Democratic and Republican parties were selected through primaries on May 16, 2023. Incumbent Democratic mayor Jim Kenney was term limited and could not seek reelection to a third term. Philadelphia's three most recent mayors were previously members of Philadelphia City Council who resigned their seats to run for mayor due to the "resign to run" provision of Philadelphia's election law.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，费城举行市长选举。民主党和共和党的候选人由5月16日举行的初选选出。时任民主党市长吉姆·肯尼（Jim Kenney）因任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。费城最近三任市长此前都是费城市议会议员，他们辞去议员职务竞选市长，是因为费城选举法规定参选者须先辞职。

en.s: The 2023 Texas constitutional amendment election took place on November 7, 2023. Texas voters statewide voted on 14 proposed amendments to the Texas Constitution, passing all except for Proposition 13, which would have increased the mandatory retirement age for state justices and judges.

zh.t: 2023年得克萨斯州宪法修正案选举
zh.s: 2023年11月7日，得克萨斯州举行宪法修正案选举，全州选民就14项宪法修正案投票。除第13号提案外，其余提案均获通过。第13号提案拟提高州法官的强制退休年龄。

en.s: The 2023 Indianapolis City–County Council elections took place on November 7, 2023, with all 25 seats up for election. Before the elections, Democrats held a 20-5 seat majority. New districts were drawn in 2021 that were used for this Election. Primaries for the council were held May 2, 2023. Following the elections, Democrats held their control of the council with a 19–6 majority.

zh.t: 2023年印第安纳波利斯市县议会选举
zh.s: 2023年11月7日，印第安纳波利斯市县议会25个席位全部改选。选举前，民主党以20比5占多数。2021年划定的新选区用于本次选举，议会初选于2023年5月2日举行。选举后，民主党以19比6继续控制议会。

en.s: The 2023 Mississippi lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 7, 2023, to elect the lieutenant governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Republican Lieutenant Governor Delbert Hosemann won re-election to a second term in office, significantly outperforming Republican Governor Tate Reeves in the concurrent gubernatorial election. Hosemann faced a competitive primary challenge from far-right state senator Chris McDaniel but ultimately defeated him in the August 8 primary.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，密西西比州举行副州长选举。共和党籍现任副州长德尔伯特·霍斯曼（Delbert Hosemann）连任，开始第二个任期；在同日举行的州长选举中，他的得票表现明显好于共和党州长泰特·里夫斯（Tate Reeves）。霍斯曼在初选中遭到州参议员克里斯·麦克丹尼尔（Chris McDaniel）的有力挑战，但于8月8日的初选中击败对手。

en.s: The 2023 Portland, Maine mayoral election was held on November 7, 2023, to elect the mayor of Portland, Maine. Since 1923, municipal elections in Portland have not included formal partisan nominations. In September 2022, Mayor Kate Snyder announced that she would not seek re-election to a second term in office. Mark Dion was elected mayor after five rounds of voting.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，缅因州波特兰举行市长选举。自1923年以来，当地市政选举都没有正式的政党提名。2022年9月，市长凯特·斯奈德（Kate Snyder）宣布不再竞选连任。马克·迪昂（Mark Dion）经过五轮投票当选市长。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of New Jersey on November 7, 2023. Primary elections were held on June 6. All 80 seats in the New Jersey General Assembly for two-year terms, and all 40 seats in the State Senate for four-year terms. In addition to the State Legislative elections, numerous county offices and County Commissioners, in addition to municipal offices, were up for election.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，美国新泽西州举行普选，初选于6月6日举行。州众议院全部80席和州参议院全部40席均在本次选举中改选，众议院议员任期两年，参议员任期四年。此外，多个县级职位、县委员和市政职位也举行了选举。

en.s: The 2023 Mississippi gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 2023, to elect the governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Republican Governor Tate Reeves won re-election to a second term, defeating Democratic nominee, Public Service Commissioner Brandon Presley. This was the sixth consecutive time that a Republican was elected governor of Mississippi. Primary elections were held on August 8. Reeves won the Republican nomination, while Presley won the Democratic nomination unopposed.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，密西西比州举行州长选举。共和党籍现任州长泰特·里夫斯（Tate Reeves）击败民主党候选人、公共服务委员会委员布兰登·普雷斯利（Brandon Presley），连任第二个任期。这是密西西比州连续第六次选出共和党州长。初选于8月8日举行，里夫斯赢得共和党提名，普雷斯利则在无人竞争的情况下获得民主党提名。

en.s: The 2023 United States state treasurer elections were held on November 7, 2023, in the states of Kentucky and Mississippi, with an election held in Louisiana on November 18, to elect the state treasurers of three U.S. states. The previous elections for this group of states took place in 2019. These elections took place concurrently with several other state and local elections.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，肯塔基州和密西西比州举行州财政部长选举，路易斯安那州的选举则于11月18日举行，以选出这三个州的财政部长。上一轮这几个州的选举于2019年举行。本次选举与多场州和地方选举同期举行。

en.s: The 2023 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 7, 2023, to elect the governor and lieutenant governor of Kentucky. Incumbent Democratic governor Andy Beshear won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican state Attorney General Daniel Cameron. This was the only statewide victory in 2023 for Democrats in Kentucky. This race was one of two Democratic-held governorships up for election in 2023 in a state Donald Trump won in 2020.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，肯塔基州举行州长和副州长选举。民主党籍现任州长安迪·贝希尔（Andy Beshear）击败共和党籍州检察长丹尼尔·卡梅伦（Daniel Cameron），成功连任。这是2023年民主党在肯塔基州唯一一次全州选举胜利，也是2023年两场在唐纳德·特朗普于2020年胜出的州举行的民主党籍州长选举之一。

en.t: 2023 United States secretary of state elections
en.s: The 2023 United States secretary of state elections were held on November 7, 2023, in the states of Kentucky and Mississippi, with an election held in Louisiana on November 18, to elect the secretaries of state of three U.S. states. The previous elections for this group of states took place in 2019. These elections took place concurrently with several other state and local elections.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，肯塔基州和密西西比州举行州务卿选举，路易斯安那州的选举则于11月18日举行，以选出这三个州的州务卿。上一轮这几个州的选举于2019年举行。本次选举与多场州和地方选举同期举行。

en.s: The 2023 Houston mayoral election was held on November 7, 2023, with a runoff on December 9 because no candidate won a majority of the vote in the first round. It was held to elect the mayor of Houston, Texas. Incumbent Democratic mayor Sylvester Turner was term-limited and could not seek re-election to a third term in office. Municipal elections in Texas are officially nonpartisan.

zh.s: 休斯敦市长选举于2023年11月7日举行。由于没有候选人获得过半选票，12月9日举行了决选。此次选举旨在选出得克萨斯州休斯敦市市长。时任民主党市长西尔维斯特·特纳（Sylvester Turner）受任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。得克萨斯州的市政选举在法律上不设党派。

en.s: The 2023 Kentucky Secretary of State election took place on November 7, 2023, to elect the Secretary of State of Kentucky. Incumbent secretary of state Michael Adams won re-election to a second term after he defeated Democratic nominee Buddy Wheatley. Primaries were held on May 16, 2023.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，肯塔基州举行州务卿选举。时任州务卿迈克尔·亚当斯（Michael Adams）击败民主党候选人巴迪·惠特利（Buddy Wheatley），成功连任，开始第二个任期。初选于2023年5月16日举行。

en.s: Operation 1107 (Burmese: ၁၁၀၇ စစ်ဆင်ရေး) is an ongoing joint military operation launched on 7 November 2023, by the Karenni National People's Liberation Front, Karenni Army, and Karenni Nationalities Defence Force against the Tatmadaw military junta in Myanmar, during the Myanmar civil war. It was launched in support of the concurrent Operation 1027 by other rebel forces in Myanmar. It has since been subsumed into the scope of Operation 1111.

zh.s: 1107行动（缅甸语：၁၁၀၇ စစ်ဆင်ရေး）是缅甸内战期间的一场联合军事行动。克耶民族人民解放阵线、克耶军和克耶民族保卫军于2023年11月7日发起行动，打击缅甸军政府军队。行动旨在支持缅甸其他反政府武装同期发起的1027行动，后来并入1111行动。

en.t: 2023 Rhode Island's 1st congressional district special election
en.s: The 2023 Rhode Island's 1st congressional district special election was held on November 7, 2023. The seat became vacant following incumbent Democratic representative David Cicilline's resignation on May 31, 2023, to become the president and CEO of the Rhode Island Foundation. This was the first congressional special election in Rhode Island since the 1967 2nd district special election and the first special election in the 1st district since 1935.

zh.t: 2023年罗得岛州国会第一选区特别选举
zh.s: 2023年11月7日，罗得岛州国会第一选区举行特别选举。民主党籍现任众议员戴维·西西莱恩（David Cicilline）于2023年5月31日辞职，转任罗得岛基金会总裁兼首席执行官，因而留下席位空缺。这是罗得岛州自1967年第二选区特别选举以来首次举行国会特别选举，也是第一选区自1935年以来首次举行特别选举。

en.s: The 2023 United States state legislative elections were held on November 7, 2023, for eight state legislative chambers in four states. These off-year elections coincided with other state and local elections, including gubernatorial elections in three states. Special elections were held throughout the year in several states. The Democratic Party flipped control of Virginia's lower house, the House of Delegates, which it had lost two years earlier, and retained its majority in Virginia's upper house, the Senate.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，美国四个州的八个州议会院举行选举。这些非总统选举年选举与其他州和地方选举同期举行，其中包括三个州的州长选举。全年还有多个州举行特别选举。民主党重新赢得弗吉尼亚州众议院的控制权；两年前该党曾失去这一席位多数。同时，民主党保住了该州参议院的多数席位。

en.s: The 2023 Kentucky Attorney General election took place on November 7, 2023, to elect the attorney general of Kentucky. Republican incumbent Daniel Cameron retired to run unsuccessfully for governor against Andy Beshear. Republican nominee Russell Coleman defeated Democratic nominee Pamela Stevenson.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，肯塔基州举行总检察长选举。共和党籍现任总检察长丹尼尔·卡梅伦（Daniel Cameron）卸任参选州长，但未能击败安迪·贝希尔。共和党候选人拉塞尔·科尔曼（Russell Coleman）击败民主党候选人帕梅拉·史蒂文森（Pamela Stevenson）。

en.s: An election for Mayor of Indianapolis was held on November 7, 2023. Primary elections were held on May 2. Incumbent Democratic mayor Joe Hogsett sought and won re-election to a third term in office. Hogsett and Republican Jefferson Shreve advanced to the general election. Shreve was later elected to the U.S. House of Representatives in the 2024 elections, representing Indiana's 6th congressional district.

zh.t: 2023年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 印第安纳波利斯市长选举于2023年11月7日举行，初选于5月2日举行。民主党籍现任市长乔·霍格塞特（Joe Hogsett）参选并成功连任，开始第三个任期。霍格塞特和共和党人杰斐逊·史里夫（Jefferson Shreve）进入普选。史里夫后来在2024年当选美国众议院议员，代表印第安纳州第六国会选区。

en.s: The 2023 Philadelphia City Council election was held November 7, 2023; all seats on the Philadelphia City Council were up for election. The Democratic Party maintained its super-majority on the council. The election took place on the same day as the 2023 Philadelphia mayoral election and other local elections in the Commonwealth.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，费城市议会举行选举，全部席位均进行改选。民主党保住了议会的绝对多数。本次选举与2023年费城市长选举及宾夕法尼亚州其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2023 Minneapolis City Council election took place in the city of Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States on November 7, 2023. The Minneapolis City Council is made up of 13 members, with one council member representing each of the city's 13 wards. Typically, council members serve four year terms, but due to census redistricting, the 2021 and 2023 elections were for two-year terms.

zh.t: 2023年明尼阿波利斯市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年11月7日，美国明尼苏达州明尼阿波利斯举行市议会选举。市议会由13名成员组成，每人代表该市一个选区。通常议员任期为四年，但由于人口普查后重新划分选区，2021年和2023年选出的议员任期均为两年。

en.s: Legislative Assembly elections were held in Mizoram on 7 November 2023 to elect all 40 members of Mizoram Legislative Assembly, which had 174 candidates and saw 80.66% voter turnout. The votes were counted on 4 December 2023 which showed the Zoram People's Movement's victory winning 27 seats out of 40.

zh.t: 2023年米佐拉姆邦立法议会选举
zh.s: 2023年11月7日，印度米佐拉姆邦举行立法议会选举，改选全部40个席位，共有174名候选人参选，投票率为80.66%。计票于2023年12月4日进行，佐拉姆人民运动党赢得40席中的27席。

en.s: The 2023 Virginia House of Delegates election took place on November 7, 2023, concurrently with elections for the Virginia Senate, to elect members of the 163rd Virginia General Assembly. All 100 delegates were elected to two-year terms from single-member districts. Nomination primaries held through the Department of Elections were held on June 20, 2023. Democrats gained three seats, winning back control with a 51–49 majority after having previously lost it in 2021.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，弗吉尼亚州举行众议院选举，并同期选举州参议院议员，以选出第163届弗吉尼亚州议会成员。众议院100个单一选区席位全部改选，议员任期两年。州选举部门主持的提名初选于2023年6月20日举行。民主党增加3席，以51比49重新取得控制权；该党此前在2021年失去多数。

en.s: The 2023 mayoral election in Charlotte, North Carolina was held on November 7, 2023. The primary election for the Democratic Party was held on September 12, 2023, while only one candidate each filed for the Republican Party and Libertarian Party. The incumbent Mayor, Democrat Vi Lyles, was first elected in 2017 and re-elected in 2019 and 2022. She was eligible to seek re-election for a fourth term and won.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，北卡罗来纳州夏洛特举行市长选举。民主党初选于2023年9月12日举行，共和党和自由意志党各只有一名候选人报名参选。民主党籍现任市长维·莱尔斯（Vi Lyles）于2017年首次当选，随后在2019年和2022年连任。她有资格竞选第四个任期，并最终当选。

en.s: The 2023 Orlando mayoral election took place on November 7, 2023. Incumbent Mayor Buddy Dyer, the longest-serving mayor in city history, ran for re-election to his sixth full term. He faced three challengers: former City Councilman Sam Ings, former Republican State Senate candidate Steve Dixon, and businessman Tony Vargas. Dyer entered the campaign as the frontrunner, significantly outraising and outspending his opponents, and earning the endorsement of the Orlando Sentinel.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，奥兰多举行市长选举。时任市长巴迪·戴尔（Buddy Dyer）是该市任职时间最长的市长，他竞选连任第六个完整任期。他的三名对手分别是前市议员萨姆·英格斯（Sam Ings）、前共和党州参议员候选人史蒂夫·迪克森（Steve Dixon）和商人托尼·巴尔加斯（Tony Vargas）。戴尔竞选初期便被视为领先者，他筹集和支出的竞选资金都远超对手，并获得《奥兰多哨兵报》支持。

en.t: 2023 Erie County, New York Executive election
en.s: The 2023 Erie County, New York Executive election took place on November 7, 2023, to select the County Executive of Erie County, New York. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Mark Poloncarz ran for re-election to a fourth term, which he said would be his last. He was challenged by businesswoman Chrissy Casilio, the Republican nominee.

zh.t: 2023年纽约州伊利县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2023年11月7日，纽约州伊利县举行行政长官选举。民主党籍现任行政长官马克·波隆卡兹竞选连任第四个任期，并表示这将是他的最后一个任期。共和党提名的商人克丽丝·卡西利奥向他发起挑战。

en.s: The 2023 Durham mayoral election was held on November 7, 2023, to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina. Incumbent mayor Elaine O'Neal, the first black woman elected to the position, chose to retire after a single two-year term. The nonpartisan blanket primary was held on October 10. City councilor Leonardo Williams and state senator Mike Woodard advanced to the general election.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，北卡罗来纳州达勒姆举行市长选举。首位当选该职位的非裔女性、时任市长伊莱恩·奥尼尔决定在完成一个两年任期后退休。无党派综合初选于10月10日举行，市议员莱昂纳多·威廉斯和州参议员迈克·伍德德进入普选。

en.s: The 2023 Des Moines mayoral election was held on November 7, 2023. Mayoral elections in Des Moines are officially nonpartisan and use the plurality vote system, with no possibility of a runoff. Incumbent mayor Frank Cownie decided to retire rather than run for re-election to a historic sixth term in office. At-large city councilor Connie Boesen narrowly defeated ward 3 city councilor Josh Mandelbaum, as well as several other candidates.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，得梅因举行市长选举。该市市长选举依法不设党派，采用相对多数票制，不举行决选。时任市长弗兰克·考尼决定退休，不再竞选历史性的第六个任期。市议会无分区议员康妮·博森以微弱优势击败第三选区市议员乔什·曼德尔鲍姆及其他多名候选人。

en.s: The 2023 Boise mayoral election was held on November 7, 2023, to elect the mayor of Boise, Idaho. The election was officially nonpartisan. Incumbent mayor Lauren McLean won re-election to a second term in office, defeating former Boise police chief Mike Masterson and two other candidates.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，爱达荷州博伊西举行市长选举，选举依法不设党派。时任市长劳伦·麦克莱恩击败前博伊西警察局长迈克·马斯特森和另外两名候选人，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2023 Carmel mayoral election took place on November 7, 2023. Republican nominee Sue Finkam defeated Democrat Miles Nelson by a 14.4% margin to become the next mayor. Incumbent Republican Mayor James Brainard, first elected in 1995, chose to retire, creating an open race for the position for the first time in 28 years.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，卡梅尔举行市长选举。共和党候选人苏·芬卡姆以14.4个百分点的优势击败民主党人迈尔斯·纳尔逊，当选市长。共和党籍时任市长詹姆斯·布雷纳德自1995年首次当选，他决定退休，因此该职位28年来首次成为开放席位。

en.s: The 2023 Columbus mayoral election took place on November 7, 2023, to elect the mayor of Columbus, Ohio. Incumbent Democratic mayor Andrew Ginther was re-elected to a third term in office. A primary election would have been held in May, but because only two candidates qualified for the race, both advanced directly to the November general election. Two write-in candidates were later certified to the general election ballot.

zh.t: 2023年俄亥俄州哥伦布市长选举
zh.s: 2023年11月7日，俄亥俄州哥伦布举行市长选举。民主党籍时任市长安德鲁·金瑟连任第三个任期。初选原定于5月举行，但由于只有两名候选人获得参选资格，两人直接进入11月普选。后来又有两名写入式候选人获准列入普选选票。

en.s: The 2023 Nassau County Legislature Election was held on November 7, 2023, to elect the 19 legislators in Nassau County, New York, one from each of the county's legislative districts. The elections coincided with other elections to various cities, towns, and villages. The Republican Party maintained their 12–7 majority from the 2021 election.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，纽约州拿骚县举行立法机构选举，改选19名议员，每人代表该县一个立法选区。选举与多个市、镇和村庄的选举同期举行。共和党保住了2021年选举后12比7的多数。

en.s: The 2023 Snohomish County Executive election took place on November 7, 2023, to elect the county executive of Snohomish County, Washington. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Dave Somers ran for re-election to a third term. Somers was challenged by Republican Bob Hagglund, a data scientist, and Democrat Christopher Garnett, a small businessman. In the primary election, Somers placed first by a wide margin, winning 52 percent of the vote.

zh.t: 2023年斯诺霍米什县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2023年11月7日，华盛顿州斯诺霍米什县举行行政长官选举。民主党籍现任行政长官戴夫·萨默斯竞选第三个任期。共和党人、数据科学家鲍勃·哈格伦德和民主党人、小企业主克里斯托弗·加内特向他发起挑战。萨默斯在初选中以52%的得票率大幅领先。

en.s: The 2023 Wichita mayoral election was held on November 7, 2023, to elect the mayor of Wichita, Kansas. The election is required to be non-partisan, but most candidates are known to be affiliated with political parties. Incumbent Democratic mayor Brandon Whipple unsuccessfully ran for re-election to a second term, losing to registered Libertarian candidate Lily Wu.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，堪萨斯州威奇托举行市长选举，依法不设党派，但大多数候选人的政党背景是公开的。民主党籍时任市长布兰登·惠普尔竞选连任第二个任期，但败给登记为自由意志党成员的莉莉·吴。

en.s: The 2023 Tucson mayoral election was held on November 7, 2023, to elect the mayor of Tucson, Arizona. Primary elections were held on August 1. Incumbent Democratic mayor Regina Romero won re-election to a second term in office. This election coincided with City Council elections in Ward 1, 2, and 4, which incumbent Democrats won.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，亚利桑那州图森举行市长选举，初选于8月1日举行。民主党籍时任市长雷吉娜·罗梅罗成功连任第二个任期。同日还举行了第一、第二和第四选区的市议会选举，民主党籍时任议员均获胜。

en.s: The 2023 Akron mayoral election was held on November 7, 2023, to elect the mayor of Akron, Ohio. Party primaries were held on May 2. Incumbent Democratic mayor Dan Horrigan chose not to seek re-election to a third term in office. In the Democratic primary, Ward 8 city councilor Shammas Malik won the nomination, prevailing in a field of seven candidates.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，俄亥俄州阿克伦举行市长选举，党派初选于5月2日举行。民主党籍时任市长丹·霍里根决定不竞选第三个任期。在民主党初选中，来自第八选区的市议员沙马斯·马利克击败另外六名候选人，获得提名。

en.s: The 2023 Seattle City Council election was held on November 7, 2023, following a primary election on August 1. The seven district-based seats of the nine-member Seattle City Council are up for election; the districts were modified based on the results of the 2020 census. Four incumbent members of the city council did not seek reelection.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，西雅图举行市议会选举，初选于8月1日举行。九人组成的市议会中，七个按选区划分的席位改选；选区根据2020年人口普查结果作了调整。四名时任市议员没有竞选连任。

en.s: The 2023–24 Pueblo mayoral election was held on November 7, 2023, to elect the mayor of Pueblo, Colorado. Incumbent Democratic mayor Nick Gradisar ran for re-election to a second term in office. Since there was no candidate that received a majority of votes in the initial round of the election, a runoff election was held on January 23, 2024.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，科罗拉多州普韦布洛举行市长选举。民主党籍现任市长尼克·格拉迪萨尔竞选连任第二个任期。由于首轮没有候选人获得过半选票，2024年1月23日举行了决选。

en.s: The 2023 Gary, Indiana, mayoral election was held on November 7, 2023, to elect the mayor of Gary, Indiana. Primary elections were held on May 2. Incumbent mayor Jerome Prince ran for re-election to a second term in office, but lost the Democratic primary to state senator Eddie Melton. This election marked the first time in the history of Gary, Indiana, that a one-term mayor was defeated in a reelection bid.

zh.t: 2023年印第安纳州加里市长选举
zh.s: 2023年11月7日，印第安纳州加里举行市长选举，初选于5月2日举行。时任市长杰罗姆·普林斯竞选连任第二个任期，但在民主党初选中败给州参议员埃迪·梅尔顿。这是加里市历史上首次有只任职一个任期的市长在竞选连任时落败。

en.s: The 2023 Allegheny County Executive election was held on November 7, 2023, to elect the next chief executive of Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The incumbent county executive, Rich Fitzgerald, was ineligible to run for a fourth consecutive term due to term limits.

zh.t: 2023年阿勒格尼县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2023年11月7日，宾夕法尼亚州阿勒格尼县举行行政长官选举，以选出新任县行政长官。时任行政长官里奇·菲茨杰拉德受任期限制，不能竞选连续第四个任期。

en.s: The 2023 Spokane mayoral election was held on November 7, 2023, to elect the mayor of Spokane in the U.S. state of Washington. The election was officially nonpartisan. Incumbent Republican mayor Nadine Woodward, who ran for a second term, and former Senate Majority Leader Lisa Brown advanced to the general election as the top two candidates in the top-two primary on August 1, 2023.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，华盛顿州斯波坎举行市长选举，依法不设党派。共和党籍时任市长纳丁·伍德沃德竞选第二个任期，她与前州参议院多数党领袖丽莎·布朗在2023年8月1日举行的前两名晋级制初选中名列前两位，进入普选。

en.s: The 2023 Boston City Council election was held on November 7, 2023, with primaries occurring on September 12, 2023. All thirteen councillors from the nine districts and four councillors at-large were up for election. Elections in Boston are officially nonpartisan. Two councillors, Michael F. Flaherty and Frank Baker, did not seek re-election. Of the 11 members of the council seeking re-election, nine were successful, while Ricardo Arroyo (District 5) and Kendra Lara (District 6) were defeated.

zh.s: 2023年11月7日，波士顿举行市议会选举，初选于2023年9月12日举行。来自九个选区的13名议员和四名无分区议员全部改选。波士顿选举依法不设党派。迈克尔·F·弗拉赫蒂和弗兰克·贝克两名议员没有竞选连任。11名竞选连任的议员中，九人成功连任；第五选区的里卡多·阿罗约和第六选区的肯德拉·拉拉落选。

en.s: The 2023 Columbus City Council election was held on November 7, 2023, to elect the nine members of the Columbus City Council.

zh.t: 2023年俄亥俄州哥伦布市议会选举
zh.s: 2023年11月7日，俄亥俄州哥伦布举行市议会选举，选出市议会全部九名成员。
